༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo chen po sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI061_rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad pad+mo rgyas byed/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo chen po sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ pra ṇa myā ṇa shrī wa rā dā+e bud+dha bha ga wan badz+ra ku mā ra sh+tsa dwai ya tsakra nā tha sid+dhe shwa ra badz+ra tsār+ya gu ru hrī ṇi ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon po grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon bla ma gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / /lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs rig 'dzin rig pa'i tshogs/ /gang zag snyan khung gcig nas gcig brgyud rim byon pa'i/ /brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra 'khor 'das kun khyab kun tu bzang / /dag pa'i 'gro la longs skur shar ba rdo rje sems/ /de nyid sprul sku mtshan brgyad ldan pa'i pad 'byung ste/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'gran gyi do med rnam gsum rgyal/ /pad+mas rjes bzung sgra bsgyur lo tsā klu'i dbang po/ /rdo rje rin chen la sogs rig sngags grub pa'i phul/ /yang phur zhal gzigs phur srung dam can bran 'khol pa'i/ /sngags 'chang mtshungs med 'khon ston rim par byon la 'dud/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad snying po'i mtshan 'chang bla chen dang / /de sras thu bo bsod nams rtser gson 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs khrod rdor 'dzin kun gyi dbang po grags pa'i mtshan/ /de lta'i yab sras mtshungs med rnams la phyag bgyi 'o/ /thub dbang gnyis pa gnas lnga rig pa'i chos rje dang / /sa gsum mnga' bdag mthu stobs bsam yas 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /lhag par phyi rabs snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /'gro mgon rje dang theg chen chos rje la sogs rgyal/

/gzhan yang mthu stobs mnga' bdag rgya gar shes bzang dang / /phyi nang rig gnas kun mkhyen sa skya lo tsā'i zhabs/ /de sogs mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /rim byon brgyud pa'i bla ma kun la bdag cag dad/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen zhes bya ba'i/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /kun gyi 'gran bral sprul pa'i skyes mchog gang der 'dud/ /gang gi thugs sras dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can dang / /'dzam gling rgyan mchog sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros te/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spro bsdu'i byed po gang / /kho bo'i yongs 'dzin 'gran gyi do med mus pa rje/ /gang thugs gnyis med ye shes ngang du ro gcig pa'i/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha bcas kun rgyal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus khro bo'i sku/ /sku gsum zhal ldan phyin drug phyag gi yal gas mdzes/ /bsdu dngos zhabs bzhi yi 'khor lo'i dbus na rab brjid pa'i/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nur snying nas 'dud/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rab 'byams dang / /bstan srung dbang mo dkar mo lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /mthu ldan dam can bcu gnyis rnams la gus btud nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs rnam bshad 'chad la spro/ /ches zab 'phrin las phur bu'i gdams pa pad+mo'i tshogs/ /zab don ze'u 'bru rab tu rgyas par kha 'byed pa'i/ /kho bo'i legs bshad nyin mor byed pa 'di longs la/ /skal bzang bung bas bshad sgrub dar dir phyogs brgyar spel/ /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas te bzung zhing spel bar gdams nas/ 'dir gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi yab chos dri ma med pa lhag pa'i lha mchog bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo chen po sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/

'o skol gyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa 'di la gsang sngags byung tshul spyir bstan pa dang / rdo rje phur pa byung tshul bye brag tu bshad pa/ skabs su bab pa'i don dngos bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gdul bya so so'i khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun pa chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad rigs su bsdu na/ theg pa dman pa dang theg pa chen po gnyis sam/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir gsang sngags kyi theg pa yin la/ 'di la yang phyi'i rgyud sde dang nang gi rgyud sde gnyis las/ phyi'i rgyud kri ya 'am bya ba'i rgyud ni/ ston pa shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ u pa 'am spyod rgyud dang / yo ga ste rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs la/ nang gi rgyud bla med kyi tan+t+ra rnams ni rdo rje 'chang chen pos chos 'byung yangs pa'i zhing khams su gsungs par bshad cing / de nyid mi'i yul du ji ltar bab pa'i tshul la/ 'ga' zhig ston pa shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston khar lung bstan pa/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri la 'byung / /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /mi las skal ldan dam pa zhig /byang chub mchog tu 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes bshad pas/ lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis te nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas rgyal po dza'i yul du byung ste/ rgyal po'i rmi lam du phyogs thams cad 'od kyis gang ba dang rin po che'i glegs bam rang babs su rmis nas/ gnyid sad pa dang bltas pas 'dug kyang ci yin ma shes pas/

ḍā ki ni ste mkha' 'gro ma zhig la gtad/ mkha' 'gro ma des skye tshangs nas klu sgrub sogs rim gyis spyan drangs nas shes zer la/ kha cig ni rgyal pos ma shes te/ dge slong ku ku ri pa zhes bya ba spyan drangs pas/ des kyang gzhan ma shes/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u nyid shes nas bsgrubs pas rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong ste/ /der rgyud sde bco brgyad po thams cad shes/ de nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bshad pas rgyal po 'khor bcas grub pa thob/ /de nas gzhan la 'phel ba yin zer ba yod mod/ de dag ni mi 'thad de/ rgyal po dza la phyag na rdo rjes 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa de dgag par mi nus kyang / bla ma la ma bsten par rang gi glegs bam bltas pa tsam gyis gsang sngags bsgrubs pas 'grub na/ gsang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /lus can dmyal ba 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /zhes bshad pa dang yang 'gal zhing / bla ma med na srid mthar 'khyams/ /zhes bla ma la ma bsten par gsang sngags kyi dngos grub mi thob par gsungs pa sogs slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag las gsal bar bshad pa ltar yin la/ 'o na rang lugs gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams mi'i yul du bab tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'di la gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis kyi lugs srol mi 'dra ba zhig 'byung na'ang / 'dir skabs su babs pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs ltar bshad na/ sprul sku shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston khar/ rigs can lnga ma gtogs pa'i slob ma rnams bsdus nas/ de'i nang nas rig 'dzin gyis rgyal po kun dza ras zhus pa/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa sde snod gsum gsungs kyang / 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa ma gsungs par mya ngan las 'da'am/ gdung 'tshob pa'i skyes bu su 'byung zhes pa la sogs pa zhus pas/ bud+dha'i zhal nas/ the tshom zhu ba legs so/

/de kho na nyid nges pa'i don theg pa chen po gsang sngags de gnas skabs gnyis dang bcur 'byung ste/ de gang zhe na/ rmongs pa gdung ba sel ba na'ang 'byung / gang sgron ma yongs su bkod pa na'ang 'byung / gang gis nges pa rnyed pa na'ang 'byung / snying po byang chub tu nges pa na'ang 'byung / dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba na'ang 'byung / gdul bya thabs la bab pa na'ang 'byung / byin gyis brlabs pa na'ang 'byung / brgyud pa thams cad kyi grags pa na'ang 'byung / gang gi ched du mdzad pa na'ang 'byung / lung chen nges par bstan pa na'ang 'byung / las rgyud yongs su gcod pa na'ang / dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa na'ang 'byung / thams cad nas thams cad du 'byung ngo / /kun tu snang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / gdung 'tshob ba'i skyes bu phyag na rdo rje 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas mya ngan las 'das par gyur to/ /de nas lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis 'das pa dang dam pa'i rigs can lnga nang du yang dag 'jog las langs te/ de yang rigs can lnga ni/ dgongs pa lung ston pa las/ lha klu gnod sbyin srin po mi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha'i lha grags pa chos skyong / rig 'dzin/ klu'i klu 'jog po/ rig 'dzin/ gnod sbyin gyi gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / rig 'dzin/ srin po'i srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ rig 'dzin/ mi'i mi pi tsa can dri ma med rig 'dzin no/ /rigs 'dzin lnga po de rnams/ 'jig rten gyi ston pa nub par gyur pa dang / shin tu yid mi dga' nas/<!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>de rjes kun kyang rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi bya bas za hor gyi yul khams zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes zhabs kyis bcags pa'i ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse zhes bya ba/ rtse mo na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seṅges 'khrab sa byed pa/ rtsa ba na gcan gzan stag gi tshang yod pa/

rtsa ba sdong bu shun pa lpags pa lo ma 'bras bu'i sman sna tshogs kyi shing skyes pa/ ngos la brag dkar po seṅge khyi tshugs bcas pa 'dra ba yod pa de'i rtse la 'dus te/ kha gnam du bltas nas mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ e ma kye hud/ e ma klong ye shes kyi sgron ma nub pas mun pa gang gis sel/ ston pa 'das nas bdud dang mu stegs sus 'dul/ nges don gsang sngags dus nam 'byung / rin thang med pa'i rin po che dug dang nam brje/ bud+dha'i bstan pa nam 'byung / ci tsam gnas/ tha ma gar nub 'gro/ mya ngan las 'das nas gar gshegs/ gang du bzhugs/ 'jig rten mgon med rnams la mgon skyabs sus byed/ gdung 'tshob su 'byung zhes pa la sogs pa gdung ba nyi shu rtsa lnga bton to/ /gdung ba de rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsan nas/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la gdung ba sel bar bskul nas/ phyag rdor gyis ri ma la ya yi rtse mor byon no/ /rigs can lnga ngo mtshar skyes te su yin/ pha gang / ma gang / yul gang yin dris pas/ smras pa/ nga ni mi 'khrul rdo rje yin/ /stong pa chen po nga yi yul/ /rdo rje'i rigs can nga yi gdung / /pha ni thabs mchog dpag tu med/ /ma ni shes rab brjod las 'das/ /thog ma med pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /nga yi yid bzhin nor bu gtor/ /nor bu rin chen bdud rtsi de/ /yod pa ma dran stor ba tshor/ /thar med nad kyis gzir gyur cing / /mun pa mun nag rab tu 'khyams/ /bshes gnyen dam pa zhig gis bstan/ /nor bu rin chen rtsad bcad pas/ /gzhan nas ma rnyed rang las rnyed/ /stor ba nyid na stor bral med/ /shes la rnyed rtags ma shes la/ /stor zhes tha snyad btags par zad/ /'dir smros gsal bar bshad byas pas/ /lha dang mi yi rigs 'dzin las/ /rim par brgyud de grags par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang gdung ba bsang du gsol zhus pas/ gsang bdag gis bka' stsal pa/ ye shes sgron ma nub kyi gdung ba la/

sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur zhing / /ma rig smin mdzad 'dul ba na/ /le lo can la phan gdags phyir/ /byung nas mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ /sems nyid 'od gsal mun pa sel/ /zhes so/ /bdud dang mu stegs sus 'dul ba la/ gang dag gdug pa ma rungs pa/ /bdag med stong pa'i stobs kyis 'dul/ /ces so/ /gsang sngags nam 'byung la/ gsang sngags gdul bya'i snod las 'byung / zhes so/ /btsong na ci nyes la/ dug dang bdud rtsi brje ba ni/ /gnyis ka phung byed brlag par 'gyur/ /ces so/ /bstan pa gar 'byung gar nub la/ dang po skye 'gag med las byung / /tha ma brjod bral med par 'gyur/ /thog ma tha ma med pas na/ /byung yang snga phyi yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /'di nas gar gshegs gar bzhugs la/ 'di nas de bzhin nyid 'dir gshegs/ /gdal khyab chen po'i ngang du bzhugs/ /sems nyid 'od gsal bstan pa sgrogs/ /zhes so/ /mgon med mgon skyabs sus byed la/ /skye med dbyings kyi ye shes de/ /sems can mgon med skyabs chen yin/ zhes so/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob su 'byung la/ /dpag tu med pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /'khor ba'i sems can brgyud las 'byung / /'khor ba'i sems can rgyun chad na/ /sangs rgyas gdung yang rgyun chad yin/ /sprul pa rang byung rang zhi la/ /de nyid de la nub pa med/ /'das dang ma 'das gcig nyid de/ /bral dang ma bral ga la yod/ /ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pas gsal te/ des na sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis rmongs pa gdung ba sel ba na gsang sngags 'byung zhes gsungs pa'i don 'di yin la/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa na 'byung zhes pa ni/ dgongs pa ni chos nyid yin la/ nges pa ni yin pa yin thog tu phebs pa la bya/ 'grel pa ni ye shes lnga la bya'o/ /de yang gang zhig gis 'grel na/ dam pa'i rigs can lnga la sogs pas 'grel zhing / de'i tshe gzhi gsang sngags 'byung zhes pa'i don yin/

gdul bya thabs la bab pa na'ang 'byung zhes pa ni/ gsang sngags 'byung ba'i rgyu gdul bya dug gsum cher smin pa sngon byung ltar na phyi rol tu ru ṭa'i rnam pa can/ rjes 'jug ltar na nang don du bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'di yin pas/ 'di 'dul ba'i ched du'ang gsang sngags 'byung zhes pa 'og tu ru ṭa'i gleng gzhi'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar yin te/ de dag gis ni spyir gsang sngags byung tshul mdor bstan pa tsam bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ sngon tshe ston pa'i rigs can rnam gsum la/ /chos 'khor bskor nas mya ngan 'das tshul bstan/ /de rjes gsang bdag dbang pos ma la yar/ /dam pa'i rigs can rig 'dzin rnam lnga la/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'khor bskor tshul 'di/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa rnams la nyer mkho bar/ /gsang sngags 'chang ba bdag gis shes nas bkod/ /gsang sngags slob par 'dod rnams 'di longs shig /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje phur pa byung tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar te gter ma'i byung tshul bshad pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyi rdo rje phur ba'i rgyud rtsa dum rang bsgyur du mdzad pa dang sbyar te bka' ma'i byung tshul bshad pa gnyis las/ de yang dang po sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gleng gzhi ltar bshad na/ sngon rgya gar du 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la sogs pa'i slob dpon brgyad la bka' brgyad po so sor bka' bab/ de'i nang nas slob dpon pad+ma la phur pa'i bka' bab cing / de'i rjes su 'brangs nas bod 'dir dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa yin la/ de yang slob dpon pad+mas mnga' bdag rje 'bangs brgyad la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas/ rang rang gi las skal dang bstun mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sku'i che mchog gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bka' brgyad po rje 'bangs so so la bka' bab/ de nas dus der bka' brgyad kyi chos skor de dag gdul bya gzhan rnams kyi nyams su mi longs pa la dgongs te/

re zhig gter kha so sor slob dpon nyid kyis sba bar mdzad cing / de nas dus phyis lung bstan dang mthun par gu ru chos dbang la sogs pa gter ston rim par byon pa rnams kyis gter kha so so nas spyan drangs te/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas dar ba rnams la gter mar 'jog pa yin zhing / 'di dag gis rnam gzhag rgyas pa sgrub pa sgrom brgyad kyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnying ma dag nas 'byung ba ltar yin pas/ de nyid kyi lo rgyus ni/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde thams cad rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyi ye shes dang las las grub pa'i ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lha ma srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa rnams la gtad do/ /de nas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi che mchog gi rgyud sde thams cad gser gyi sgrom bur bcug yang dag gi rgyud sde thams cad shel gyi sgrom bur bcug gshin rje'i rgyud sde thams cad lcags kyi sgrom bur bcug rta mgrin gyi rgyud sde thams cad zangs kyi sgrom bur bcug phur pa'i rgyud sde thams cad rus pa'i sgrom bur bcug ma mo'i rgyud sde thams cad bse'i sgrom bur bcug 'jig rten pa'i rgyud sde thams cad mchong gi sgrom bur bcug dmod pa drag sngags kyi rgyud sde thams cad gzi'i sgrom bur bcug nas so so'i rgyas btab ste/ bang bar bcug nas tha ram btab bo/ /rin po che sna snga las byas pa'i sgrom bur gsang sngags bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud lung man ngag rnams bcug ste rgya rim pa brgyad btab bo/ /rin po che'i bang pa rim pa dgur bcug ste/ bka' rgyud sde de dag thams cad sba bar 'dod nas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad bka' bgros pas/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma na re/ dpag bsam gyi shing la sba zer/ lha na re/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du sba zer/ klu na re/ rgya mtsho'i gting du sba zer/

gza' na re/ nam mkha'i mthong su sba zer/ bdud na re/ bdud yul mun pa'i gling dgu na bdud mkhar bzo ba rtse dgu la sba zer/ rgyal po na re/ gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi steng du mkhar khu le rtse dgu la sba zer/ gshin rje na re/ ri rab kyi 'og na lcags nag po dgu brtsegs la sba zer/ dmu na re/ dmu yul ngam brang klu shong du dmu mkhar nag po'i rtse la sba zer/ gnod sbyin na re/ gnya' shing 'dzin gyi byang shar gyi rtse na lcang lo can du sba zer/ bgegs na re/ byang shar bgegs kyi gling na 'dre mkhar skya bo 'or po che la sba zer/ srin po na re/ srin yul lang ka pu rang na srin mkhar dgu brtsegs la sba zer/ btsan na re/ bsam gtan brag gi them pa la btsan mkhar dmar po ldem pa yod pas der sba zer/ de ltar lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi bka' re stsal nas/ so so'i 'dod pa'i dbang gis ma 'chams pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che zhes bya ba des/ dur khrod chen po ro myal tshal zhes kyang bya/ 'dam bu'i tshal zhes kyang bya/ bsil ba'i tshal zhes kyang bya ba der lha ma srin sde brgyad 'dus nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas te bka' stsal pa/ e ma ho/ lha srin dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs nyon/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i dgongs pa gting phyung la/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi dkyil nas dgongs te bshad/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la sogs 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis nyan/ /log lta tshar gcod don du khro bo'i skur sprul nas/ /lta spyod zab mo'i gsang sngags bsdus pa'i don/ /'khor gyi khro tshogs rig 'dzin rnams la bshad/ /bstan pa mi nub gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyis gser gyi glegs bam bris/ /bka' yi srung ma sde brgyad khyed la gtad/ /khyed rnams rang rang 'dod pa ma zer bar/ /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba 'di/ /bam ro gsar rnying longs spyod 'di na yod/ /gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad 'di na mang /

/kang ka 'dab chags mang po 'di na lding / /shing dang chu dang me yang 'di na 'dzoms/ /rang byung mchod rten chen po 'di na yod/ /rnal 'byor dka' thub spyod pa byed pa'i gnas/ /gsang sngags zab mo sba ba'i gnas su bzang / /lha srin thams cad 'dus la mchod pa bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyang de la 'chams te/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi mchod rten bde byed legs pa'i nang du sbas so/ /de nas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma dang lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis mchod pa byed do/ /de nas grub thob rnal 'byor pa dag la brgyud de rgya bkrol ba'i lo rgyus ni/ rgya gar gyi yul rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub kyi mtshams dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba de na/ nyin re bzhin rlung nag 'tshubs pa dang / thog dang ser ba 'bab pa dang / mtshan mo 'od dang me dang / glog 'khyug pa dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba las/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pas dgongs pa mdzad pas/ grub thob rnal 'byor pa brgyad ngo mtshar skyes te bgros byas pas/ 'on te 'jig rten gyi khams 'tshengs pa'i chos 'ong / 'on te 'jig rten phung ba'i ngan sngags 'ong / 'dir bdag cag rnams dgongs pa la bzhugs la blta zer nas/ de la kun 'chams pas/ slob dpon chen po brgyad kyis dur khrod brgyad nas dgongs pas 'dus nas nam mkha' la byon te/ dur khrod chen po de na dgongs pa la bzhugs pa las/ ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i sgrom bu dgu la 'od rnam pa lngas bskor nas mchod rten gyi nang na bzhugs pa la/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma dang bdud dang gshin rje la sogs pa lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis skor ba byed cing 'dug pa la/ slob dpon rnams kyis mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni bshams/ bka' bden pa'i chos ni bshad/ dgos pa rgya bskyed nas dbang du bsdus pa las/ dgung bdun gyi nub mo ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma dang lha ma srin sde brgyad dbang du 'dus pas/

de rnams kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /e ma hoḥ sku ni lhar gsal gsung ni sngags su sgrogs/ /thugs ni mnyam nyid rdo rje lta bu la/ /sprul pa ston mdzad slob dpon chen po brgyad/ /bka' ni mi stsal gsung ni ji ltar nyan/ /zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon brgyad kyis bka' stsal pa/ /e ma ho/ 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / /bdud dang gshin rje la sogs sde brgyad rnams/ /bka' bzhin byed cing khyod kyis mchod byed pa'i/ /sgrom bu dgu po da lta khyer la shog /ces bka' stsal pas/ sgrom bu dgu po gdan drangs te brgyad slob dpon brgyad la skad cig yud tsam la gtad de/ gser gyi sgrom bu slob dpon bi ma la mi tra'i phyag tu gtad/ shel gyi sgrom bu slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i phyag tu gtad/ lcags kyi sgrom bu slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi phyag tu gtad/ zangs kyi sgrom bu slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phyag tu gtad/ rus pa'i sgrom bu slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag tu gtad/ bse'i sgrom bu slob dpon dha na saṃ kri ta'i phyag tu gtad/ mchong gi sgrom bu slob dpon rum bu gu ya de wa tsaṇ+ḍa'i phyag tu gtad/ gzi'i sgrom bu slob dpon shan+ti gar+bha'i phyag tu gtad/ rin po che las byas pa'i sgrom bu rgya rim pa brgyad btab pa bam par bcug ste slob dpon rnams kyi dbus su bzhag nas song / de nas slob dpon rnams kyi rang rang gi sgrom bu kha phye bas/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi lcags kyi sgrom bu'i nang nas gshin rje'i rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/ de yang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon klu sgrub snying po'i zangs kyi sgrom bu'i nang nas pad+ma gsung gi rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/ rta mchog rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i shel gyi sgrom bu'i nang nas yang dag gi rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/

he ru ka ga la la sogs pa thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon pad+ma'i rus pa'i sgrom bu'i nang nas phur pa'i rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/ bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud la sogs pa thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon bi ma la'i gser gyi sgrom bu'i nang nas bdud rtsi'i rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/ bdud rtsi rol pa dang bam po brgyad pa la sogs pa thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon dha na saṃ kri ta'i bse'i sgrom bu'i nang nas ma mo'i rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/ ma mo gsang ba 'dus pa gtan tshigs kyi le'u dang ma mo srid pa bem la sogs pa thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon rum bu gu ya de wa tsaṇ+ḍa'i mchong gi sgrom bu'i nang nas 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs kyi rgyud sde thams cad byung ste/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las la sogs pa'i rgyud thams cad byung ngo / /slob dpon phud byed shān+ti gar+bha'i gzi'i sgrom bu'i nang nas dmod pa drags sngags kyi rgyud thams cad byung ngo / /de nas rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa'i sgrom bu de slob dpon gang gi kha phye yang ma phyed/ rgya bcag kyang ma chag nas/ slob dpon brgyad kyis dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad de/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ bam pa rang grol du gyur te de'i nang nas bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi rgyud sde rnams byung ngo / /de nas slob dpon chen po brgyad kyang / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gshin rje la mkhas par gyur to/ /klu sgrub snying po gsung gi sgrub pa la mkhas par gyur to/ /hūm̐ ka ra yang dag la mkhas par gyur to/ /bi ma la bdud rtsi yon tan la mkhas par gyur to/ /slob dpon pad+ma phur pa la mkhas par gyur to/ /slob dpon dha na saṃ kri ta ma mo la mkhas par gyur to/ /slob dpon rum bu gu ya de wa tsaṇ+ḍa 'jig rten mchod bstod la mkhas par gyur to/

/slob dpon phud byed shan+ti gar+bha dmod pa drag sngags la mkhas par gyur to/ /zhes pa'i lo rgyus 'di dag ni yi ge rnying ma rnams las 'byung ba ltar bkod pa yin la/ de rnams kyis sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar te/ gter ma'i byung tshul mdo tsam bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ sngon tshe rig 'dzin skyes bu mchog rnams kyis/ /zab mo'i rgyud rnams sde brgyad tshogs la gtad/ /dus der mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo ches/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams la bka' stsal nas/ /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po ru/ /mchod rten bde byed legs par gter du sbas/ /de nas grub mchog rnams kyi nus pa yis/ /snang srid lha srin thams cad bran bkol te/ /rgyud sde'i glegs bam tshogs rnams phyag tu bab/ /de rjes grub dbang rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /slob dpon chen pos bod yul gangs khrod 'dir/ /rje 'bangs rnams la chos 'khor bskor ba'i rjes/ /zab chos mtha' dag gter kha so sor sbas/ /de nas gu ru pad+ma'i ma 'ongs pa'i/ /lung bstan bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i skyes chen tshogs/ /mang du byon te gter kha so so nas/ /rang rang chos skal mtha' dag spyan drangs te/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir 'phel ba'i rgyun 'di la/ /zab las ches zab gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi/ /gter ma'i srol zhes yongs su grags 'di byung / /de phyir 'khrul med lung gi legs zin nas/ /de lta'i skyes chen rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i/ /de ltar snga 'gyur gter ma'i chos 'di rnams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i snying por nges/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa chos rje sa paṇa gyis rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud rtsa dum rang 'gyur du mdzad pa dang sbyar te bka' ma'i byung tshul bshad pa ni/ 'o na phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu 'di/ /pha rgyud ma rgyud sogs gang gi khongs su rtogs pa yin zhe na/

de yang spyir snga 'gyur snying ma ba'i lugs 'di la theg pa rim pa dgu'i rnam gzhag mdzad de/ de yang rim pa dgu ni/ phyi'i theg pa gsum ni/ nyan thos kyi theg pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa/ byang chub sems dpa' pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ste gsum yin zhing / nang gi theg pa la yang phyi nang gnyis las/ kri ya u pa yo ga ste/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la phyi'i rgyud sde'am theg pa gsum/ mahā yo ga'am rnal 'byor chen po ste/ thabs pha'i rgyud dang / a nu yo ga'am rjes su rnal 'byor te shes rab ma'i rgyud dang / a ti yo ga'am shin tu rnal 'byor te/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum la nang gi rgyud sde'am theg pa gsum zhes bya ba'i rnam gzhag mdzad cing / yang pha rgyud la do ha skor dang / ma rgyud la sgyu 'phrul skor dang / gnyis med rgyud la sems phyogs skor zhes kyang grags par gsungs la/ yang slob dpon lang lhag gi bzhed pas/ rdo rje phur pa 'di la rang gzhung tshugs pa'i rgyud sum cu rtsa bdun/ rgyud chung bcu drug ces bzhed de/ de la rang gzhung tshugs pa'i rgyud sum cu rtsa bdun la/ rtsa ba lta bu'i rgyud gsum/ bshad pa'i rgyud lnga/ cha mthun pa'i rgyud gsum/ rgyud phyi ma gnyis/ phyi ma'i phyi ma gsang ba sde drug bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga/ rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga/ la bzla ba'i rgyud lnga/ drag po rme thabs kyi rgyud gnyis/ 'phrin las gtso bor ston pa 'bum skos dang sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /de la rtsa ba lta bu'i rgyud gsum ni/ chos thams cad drag po 'phrin las kyi dgongs par ston pa rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa dang / chos thams cad sku lnga ye shes lngar ston pa khrag 'thung rol pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / dur khrod khu byug rol pa dang gsum mo/ /bshad pa'i rgyud lnga ni/ rdo rje rigs la dgongs pa gsang rgyud/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la dgongs pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgyud/ rin po che'i rigs la rin po che 'bar ba/ pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma snang ba/ las kyi rigs la karma ku ru rgyud do/ /cha mthun pa'i rgyud gsum ni/ rdo rje 'bar ba/ me lce 'bar ba/ gab pa 'khor lo'o/ /rgyud phyi ma gnyis ni/ dur khrod khu byug gi le'u bcu bzhi pa dang / bcu gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyud do/ /phyi ma'i phyi ma gsang ba sde drug ni/ las gsang ba'i rgyud/ don gsang ba'i rgyud/ gsang ba gter gyi rgyud/ gsang ba yang le gter gyi rgyud/ gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud/ gsang ba dgongs rgyud do/ /bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga la/ las kyi rdo rje kha tshar/ sras mchog rdo rje sked khre/ drag po mdung rtse gsum pa/ drag po ze ma nag po/ lcags zer nag po'o/ /rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud lnga ni/ zhe sdang yongs su dag pa'i rgyud la sogs pa lnga'o/ /la bzla ba'i rgyud lnga ni/ phur bu bla ma chen po mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyud/ ye shes nyi zer/ nam mkha' rol pa/ mthar thug yang zhun/ thugs kyi yang zhun no/ /drag po rme thabs kyi rgyud gnyis ni/ gsang phur stag mo kha 'thab dang seṅge kha 'thab bo/ /de ltar sum cu rtsa drug 'phrin las gtso bor ston pa 'bum skos dang sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /de rnams ni rang gzhung tshugs pa'i rgyud sum cu rtsa bdun zhes bya'o/ /rgyud chung bcu drug ni/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa la sogs pa khro bo bcu la rgyud bcu/ dam can la bzhi ste/ shwa na dkar nag bse rgyud khra bo/ /tsha ba yang gter/ ri ma ri 'bum pa'i rtog pa'o/ /de nas gtor rgyud dang / tshogs rgyud gnyis te bcu drug tu bzhed/ de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag de rnams kyi nang nas/ lung a nu yo ga shes rab kyi rgyud la tan+t+ra tra chen po sde bco brgyad la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa'i nang nas/

'phrin las kyi rigs phur bu rtsa ba'i rgyud rdo rje khros pa bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud dam/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud kyi rdo rje rigs kyi le'u zur du phyung ba la/ phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bur grags pa yin/ 'di nyid chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas shangs sreg shing gi dgon par gter nas spyan drangs shing rang bsgyur du mdzad ces yongs su grags pa de'i tshul ni/ shangs sreg shing zhes bya ba'i dgon pa 'di nyid/ thog mar shangs kyi dur khrod chos lung zhes bya bar/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob/ bla ma chos lung pa zhes bya ba'i dgon pa yin la/ de nyid chos lung pa'i slob ma phyug chen cha ru ba bya bas dgon pa de nyid bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi phyag tu legs par phul zhing gsung chos kyang mang du zhus te dgon gnas de nyid kyi gdan sa bar pa mdzad de 'jam dbyangs gar gzigs ma'i sku 'dra bris sku chos rje nyid kyi phyag bris ma shin tu byin rlabs che zhing ngo mtshar ba deng sang gi bar du yod pa 'di yin no/ /de nas bar skabs zhig tu mgo tshong zer ba'i sngags dgon nas/ mgo ban bdud rtsi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i sngags pa gcig gis dpe cha ye hrul le ba cig chos rje nyid la phul byung ba la gzigs rtog mdzad pas/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgya dper 'dug pas thugs rab tu mnyes te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di lta bu ni shin tu nas kyang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs shing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rang bzhin kho na yin pas/ 'di lta bu la rang re rnams kyis bkur bsti bya dgos gsungs/ slar rtsa dum gyi po ti sngags pa de rang la bskur nas khyed rang ri gdong ma gir song cig nged rnams kyis ser bsgrengs rgyas pa byed do gsungs nas/ bdag nyid chen po rang gi gtso mdzad 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mchod 'bul rgyas pa dang bcas te spyan drangs shing /

slar yang bsgyur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa 'di ni khungs btsun zhing bka' yod la lhad med pa kho na ste yid ches kyi gnas dam par gyur pa yin no/ /de nas sngags ban la yang gnang sbyin rgya chen mdzad nas dga' zhing mgu bar gyur to/ /yang 'di'i lo rgyus rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris zhig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud 'di ma rgyud yin pa las/ don yod grub pa'i rigs yin par kun mkhyen bu ston chen pos gsungs shing / spyir ma rgyud la so so'i rgyud dang / cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud gnyis yod pa las/ cha mnyam du ston pa'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs yin la/ phur pa rtsa dum 'di yang cha mnyam gyi rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa 'dra zhing / 'di la 'phags pa'i yul na kī la ya 'bum sde'i rgyud dam/ bi to ta ma la'i rgyud ces yod pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi le'u har ston du byas pa da lta'i rtsa dum du grags pa 'di yin no/ /'di'i rgya dpe bsam yas nas rim par brgyud de skabs cig tu shangs kyi sngags pa shes rab bzang po zhes bya ba'i lag na yod pa/ chos rje sa paṇa sreg shing du phebs pa cig la phul bas/ chos rje pas rgya dpe la bsu ba dang mchod pa mdzad nas chos rje nyid kyis rang bsgyur du mdzad pa yin la/ spyir rgyud 'di la khro lo tsā ba dang / dpyal lo tsā ba gnyis kyis kyang 'gyur re re yod gsungs/ zhes 'byung ba yin la/ de ltar yid ches khung btsun gyi gnas su gyur pa'i phur pa rtsa dum de nyid ni rtsa ba'i rgyud mchog tu gyur pa yin la/ bshad rgyud ni myang 'das/ gsang snying / kī la ya yig 'bru gnyis pa/ karma mā la 'phrin las kyi rgyud de de dag la sogs pa rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud de dag nas bstan pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa du ma zhig yod pa rnams lugs srol chen po bco brgyad du 'du zhing /

de yang bsdu na bzhir 'dus te/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis 'khon klu'i dbang po la brgyud pa phur pas lugs su grags pa dang / gzhan yang khyi nag gyang 'gyel gyi lugs/ phur pa jo mo lugs/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje las brgyud pa'i lugs rnams su yod pa las/ 'di 'khon klu'i dbang po nas brgyud pa'i phur pa sa lugs su grags pa 'di nyid yin la/ 'di la bshad thabs kyi man ngag gi dbang du byas na/ spyir dam pa'i chos kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma 'khrud bar byed pa'i tshul ni/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa gsum gyi ni sgra dang tshad ma dang snyan ngag dang gtan tshigs la sogs pa'i sgo nas ngag gi dri ma 'khrud pa gtso che bar bshad/ kri yog sde gsum gyis ni khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa'i sgo nas lus kyi dri ma bkru ba gtso che bar bshad/ bla med gsar rnying rnams kyis ni sgom sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas yid kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba gtso che bar bshad/ de dag kyang tshul drug gi gnad kyi sgo nas zin pa dgos te/ thag lta bas gcad/ bogs sgom pas dbyung / la spyod pas dor/ gzhi dam tshig gis gzung / rim pa dbang gis dbye/ don man ngag gis bsgrub pa dang drug yin/ de yang lta ba rgal rtags kyis ma bshad na gol sgrib kyi brdar sha mi chod/ sgom pa nyams myong gis ma bshad na ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal mi thon/ spyod pa gnang bkag gis ma bshad na blang dor gyi mtha' mi shes/ dam tshig rnam grangs kyis ma bshad na srung mtshams kyi shan mi phyed/ dbang gdams ngag gis ma bshad na dbang la byin rlabs mi 'byung / man ngag snod brtags la ma bshad na bdud rtsi'i bcud yal bar 'gyur bar gsungs pa yin la/ gzhan yang gsang sngags bshad tshul skyon brgyad kyi dbang du mi gtang ba cig dgos te/ de yang skyon brgyad ni/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa khyad par med par bshad na rdo rje theg pa na babs pa'i skyon/

sngags phyi nang khyad par med par bshad na bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i don las gol te gol 'brog 'chol ba'i skyon/ 'brel tshul gnyis dang ma 'brel bar bshad na bsnyon pa'i 'dum tshig gi skyon/ spyi dang khyad par gyi dgos ched med par bshad na don med 'chal ba'i skyon/ rtog ge dang the tshom gyi gegs sel ma shes na mdzangs pa lce 'dum gyi skyon/ mi mthun pa'i tshig don sdeb ma shes na/ long ba dang long ba thug pa lta bu'i skyon/ mngon par rtogs pa'i go rim sdeb ma shes na bdud rtsi ro nyams pa'i skyon/ gong 'og gi 'khrugs sdeb ma shes na/ rin po che rtsa rtse nor ba lta bu'i skyon te/ skyon brgyad dang bral ba dgos par bshad cing / gzhan yang gzhung lugs 'chol bar bstan pas sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams/ rtog ge rus su bton pas chos kyi phan thogs nub/ sngon gyi dag yig bcos pas sngags kyi nus pa yel/ ma rabs mtho sar bton pas chos khrims rgyal khrims zhig bod la ho cha bsdebs pas rigs brgyud chol bar song / dam med slob dpon tshogs pas srid pa'i ma mo 'khrugs/ dam nyams slob ma bsten pas be sgrel g.yang la lhung / gsang sngags bon khyer byas pas dngos grub chu rgyun chad/ zab don khrom bshad byas pas mkha' 'gro dbyings su byer/ yang bzod chos la byas pas chos kyi phan thogs nub/ ces rnying ma'i dam pa'i chos bshad thabs kyi yi ge rnams las 'byung bas/ chos 'chad pa rnams kyang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgra bcom chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi thugs ma khrel bar 'chad shes pa ni shin tu gnad che ba yin no/ /de rnams kyis chos rje sa paṇa gyi rtsa dum rang bsgyur du mdzad pa dang sbyar te bka' ma'i byung tshul bshad thabs mdo tsam dang bcas te bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ 'khon gyi mtshan 'chang nges don 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'khon ston rim brgyud rtsa dum rgyud rgyal mchog

/'khon rigs kun dga' rgyal mtshan phyag bab pa'i/ /'khon gyi yab chos rgyud kyi rgya dpe dngos/ /gang der 'jam dbyangs dge slong gzhon nu'i zol/ /gang de'i bsngags brjod bkur bsti ches mdzad nas/ /gang la'ang thogs med blo yis rgyud kyi don/ /gang zhig gsal bar rtogs nas rang bsgyur mdzad/ /e ma rdo rje 'chang gi bka' dri med/ /rtsod bral 'phags pa'i yul gyi yi ge las/ /rdo rje rnon po dngos kyis bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /rgyud rgyal 'di ni ngo mtshar gnas min nam/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams kyis bka' gter gnyis kyi byung tshul mdo tsam bshad zin nas/ /'dir rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi rang gzhung dri ma med pa 'di nyid 'chad pa la/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor rnams byon tshul brgyud pa'i che ba dang bcas te gtan la phab dgos pa las/ de la yang rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa ji ltar byung ba'i gleng gzhi dang / rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ gang zag snyan nas brgyud de ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos skus dgongs pas bshad/ longs skus brda' yis bshad/ sprul skus tshig brda sbyar nas bshad/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i mnga' bdag des/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas ma g.yos bzhin du rang bzhin thugs rje'i byin rlabs las/ rang snang dag pa sku gsung thugs lhun grub/ gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa'i rgyan nyid du rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par bzhengs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor nyid las mi zhan pa'am mi dman pa'i yon tan gyi mnga' thang chen por dbang bsgyur bas/ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa 'bras bu'i sems dpa' rnams la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos phun sum tshogs pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis med rang rig rang shar gyi tshul gyis gsungs te/

'khor dang ston pa chos kyi snang ba gsum dbyer med kyi 'dul bar bya ba dang / 'dul byed gnyis med du rang bzhin gyis grol bar mdzad pa ste/ chos 'byung bdud rtsi'i khungs 'byin las/ 'dir brgyud pa gsum du phye ba las/ ston pa kun tu bzang po'i 'khor bcu ni sprul pa yin te/ nges pa'i don du 'khor dang ston pa tha mi dad pa'i phyir rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa zer/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la kha cig na re/ rgyud gsung pa'i gnas rang snang longs sku'i zhing du gdul bya sprul pa ma gtogs rang rgyud pa med na chos bstan pa'i dgos pa med cing / don rtags kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor yang 'dul bar bya ba la bstan gyi/ rang gi thugs kyi sprul pa la bstan mi dgos te/ sprul pa la rtog pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na byang sems sa bcu pa sogs rang rgyud pa'i 'khor dang sprul pa gnyis ka'o zhes zer ro/ /de ni khyed kyi dgongs pa ma lon par snang ste sprul pa'i gdul bya yod pas chos ston pa'i dgos pa yod de/ phyi rabs la gsang bdag gis 'chad pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir dang / don rtags kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i sngar sems rgyud ma dul ba 'dul phyed du gdul bya la bstan ma yin gyis/ rang snang la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan lhun rdzogs su shar ba ste/ me long gi ngos la gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin no/ /sprul pa la rtog pa med kyang ye shes yod pas/ de nyid kyis chos nyan cing 'dzin par byed do/ /gal te sprul pa la rig pa'i ye shes med na/ shākya thub pa dang gsang bdag la sogs pa la ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mi mnga' bar thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /lung gis kyang gnod de/ de bzhin thugs kyi khyad par las/ /rang snang rgyal ba'i sems rtsogs dang / /zhes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ched du gleng ngo /

/zhes pa dang / de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid dbang bsgyur ye shes thugs rje'i ngang / /rang snang ba nyid ting 'dzin gzugs can sgyu ma rnam dag gsal ba ni/ zhes pa la sogs pas gnod do/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang zhing khams kyang bsam gyis mi khyab cing tshad med de/ sdong po bkod pa las/ spu yi rtse mo gcig la yang / /zhing rnams dbye ba bsam mi khyab/ /sna tshogs dbyibs kyang tha dad de/ /de dag 'dres par gyur pa med/ /ces gsungs pas/ nam mkhas gang du khyab par chos sku dang longs skus khyab cing / sems can gyis gang du khyab par sprul pa'i sku dang 'phrin las kyis khyab pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhing khams la phyogs dang ris su chad pa med de/ zhing 'di nyid kyi gong na'ang gzhan dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod kyis mi lang ba yod par rtogs par bya zhing rang re so skye rnams kyi snang ngor shar ba'i tha mal ba'i bsdus pa'i ma dag par snang ba 'di kun yang rang gi las nyon gyi snang ba tsam las dag pa'i zhing ngam/ lhag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du gdod ma nas gnas pas/ de ltar du blta bar bya ba yin ste/ dper na nyi zla'i snang ba mi gsal ba ma yin mod kyi/ dmus long rnams kyis ma mthong ba bzhin du shes par bya ba yin te 'di la shes byed kyi lung rigs mang du yod kyang / 'dir ma spros so/ /shes par 'dod na kho bos ngag las btsal lo/ /de ltar na chos sku kun tu bzang pos longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gnyis med rang rig rang shar gyi tshul du gsungs zhing / de dag gis sprul pa'i sku rigs gsum mgon po la gsungs pa rnams la rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa zhes bya ste/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes 'cham bshad gsal ba'i me long las/ spyir btang ba'i dbang du byas na/ chos sku kun tu bzang pos longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsungs/ des sprul pa'i sku rigs gsum mgon po la gsungs te de yan chad rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa yin par gda'/

zhes gsungs pas so/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi nang tshan rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / rgyud kyi them 'byor bcu'i nang nas/ gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum gyi rgyud kyi khog dbub ces gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ srid gzhi kun khyab kun tu bzang po yis/ /rang snang dag pa'i 'khor gyi rigs lnga la/ /gnyis med ngang du gsungs pa'i zab mo'i rgyud/ /sprul sku rigs gsum mgon por babs pa'i tshul/ /'di ni zab yangs rgyud kyi gleng gzhi ste/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud byon pa'i tshul yang 'di/ /de ltar shes na brgyud pa'i rtsa ba dang / /zab mo'i chos la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ rigs gsum mgon po de dag gi lha klu gnod sbyin gsum la brgyud pa yang / 'jam dpal mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur te gtso bor zab mo'i phyogs kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas lta ba'i phyogs ston/ spyan ras gzigs thugs rje'i mnga' bdag tu gyur te gtso bor byams snying rjes skyob pa'i phyogs kyi don mdzad pas sgrub pa'i phyogs ston/ phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur te gtso bor thabs la mkhas pas drag shul phyogs kyi don mdzad pas spyod pa'i phyogs ston/ de yang 'jam dpal gzhon tshul mdzes pa'i sku dang ldan pa des lha rnams kyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par bstan te/ lha gnas su drags ldan phyogs skyong la bshad/ des lha tshangs pa rin chen 'od 'bar la/ des tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag la/ des tshangs pa kun grol la/ des tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin la/ des lha dbang brgya byin la/ des tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de/ lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin cing sangs rgyas kyi gdung gsob par gyur/ spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi sman gyi sku dang ldan pa des klu dug can gyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par klu rgyal rigs gh+ri na nag po la bstan/

des klu mo ma ma kha 'dul la/ des klu mo 'dul tshangs ma la/ des klu yid 'ong dga' la bstan/ des tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de/ sngar bzhin du gyur/ phyag na rdo rje 'jigs tshul sdigs pa'i sku dang ldan pa des gnod sbyin gyi gnas su gnod sbyin gyi lus dang bsam pa dang mthun par gnod sbyin kun tu bzang po la bstan/ des gnod sbyin grags ldan phyogs skyong la bstan/ des gnod sbyin tshom bu 'bum sde la bshad de sngar bzhin du gyur to/ /yang gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes mi yul du shar phyogs za hor gyi rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la bshad nas rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin la/ des u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / yul dbus kyi slob dpon bi ma la mi tra/ bal po'i slob dpon shī la mañju ste mkhas pa mi gsum la bshad pa las/ 'dir gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum gyi nang nas gu ru'i gleng gzhi/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku che ba'i yon tan cung zad tsam brjod par bya ste/ de yang gong du bshad pa'i slob dpon rnam pa gsum po de dag gi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu 'dus par grags pa'i 'grel chen 'bum nag las/ 'gro ba'i don phyir da lta rnga yab gling na bzhugs pa yis/ /'khrungs dka'i skyes bu gcig pu nges don theg pa gcig tu bzhed/ /skye rgyud gnyis las 'khrungs shing rmad du byung ba'i rigs gnyis ldan/ /gdug pa rnam gsum btul nas dngos grub rnam gsum brnyes pa po/ /che ba bzhi ldan rig 'dzin bzhi yi ngo bor gyur pa khyod/ /grub chen brgyad ldan gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad ldan la rab tu 'dud/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar las slob dpon chen po 'di nyid kyi skye rgyud rnam pa gnyis ni/ mngal skyes dang / brdzus skyes yin la/ de yang mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na/ shar phyogs za hor gyi yul mngal skyes kyis 'dul bar gzigs nas/

grong khyer gzi brjid ldan zhes bya ba na/ yab rgyal po thor cog can zhes bya ba la btsun mo gnyis yod pa las/ btsun mo des ma zhes bya ba la sras thod gtsug can zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs par bzhed/ brdzus skyes ltar na/ nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul brdzus skyes kyis 'dul bar gzigs nas/ dha na ko sha'i gleng du pad+ma'i sdong po las brdzus te 'khrungs par bzhed/ de ltar mngal skyes dang brdzus skyes kyi lo rgyus mi 'dra ba las/ shar phyogs za hor pa dang / nub phyogs u rgyan pa gnyis mi mthun te/ za hor pa na re/ slob dpon pad+ma nged kyi rgyal po'i sras yin/ mngal skyes yin zhes zer/ u rgyan pa na re nged kyi rgyal po'i sras yin brdzus skyes yin zhes zer te/ sprul pa'i bkod pa yin pas gnyis ka bden pa yin te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig gis phur pa lang lab lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin bla ma gu ru yang dag gi spyan sngar slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i lo rgyus la 'chad tshul mi mthun pa mang du gda' ba ji ltar legs ces zhus pas/ bla ma gu ru yang dag gi zhal nas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'di bskal pa bcu gsum gyi mngon rol du sangs rgyas pad+ma'i dbang po'i dbyangs zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin zhing / 'dir gang la gang 'dul du sprul pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa yin pas/ de'i yon tan gyi rnam par thar pa phyogs re tsam mthong ba la brten nas/ lo rgyus 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba rnams 'byung ba yin te/ gang ltar yang 'gal ba med do zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'dir ni slob dpon rin po che'i rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul ba med pa siṃdhur rgya mtsho ma dang sbyar te cung zad brjod na/ thog mar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing kun las mchog tu gyur pa nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya ba de na/ thams cad pad+ma las brdzus te skye zhing zas dang skom la sogs pa thams cad kyang bsam ma thag tu bdud rtsi'i zas kyis 'tsho ba yod do/

/nyin dang mtshan mo'i ming yang med par 'od kyi snang bas khyab cing / sa dang rdo'i ming yang med pa rin po che'i sa gzhi mnan na nem byed cing / bteg na 'phar byed pa sogs mdor na yon tan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i gnas mchog khyad par du 'phags pa de na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gtso bo sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i thugs rje'i 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu kha dog rnam pa lnga ldan zhig spros te/ lho nub rnga yab kyi gling phran de na siṃdhur rgya mtsho zhes kyang bya/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling zhes kyang bya/ mtsho gaṅga dri med ces bya ba zhig yod pa de'i dbus su bab pa las/ rgyas par thod 'phreng rigs lnga sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang / hril gyis bsdu na/ mtsho de'i dbus su klu'i rgyal po 'jog po gnas pa'i khang bzang khyad par du 'phags pa yod pa'i steng du me tog pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi dbus su/ mtsho skyes rdo rje 'di nyid rang byung gi tshul du 'khrungs pa yin te/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma las/ e ma ho/ lho nub rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ /siṃdhur rgya mtsho rol pa'i mtsho gling du/ /klu rgyal 'jog po gnas pa'i khang steng du/ /pad+ma 'bar ba'i sdong po'i rtse las 'khrungs/ /rang byung ngo mtshar can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa snyigs ma'i sems can rnams shin tu 'dul dka' ba la/ thugs rjes gzigs nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul sku shākya thub pa'i zhing khams lho 'dzam bu gling / khyad par du rgya gar gyi yul khams dang / yang sgos su thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'dul ba'i zhing khams bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dul ba'i don du/ sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya bar don mdzad par sprul to/ /de yang dang po rgya gar gyi yul gyi nub phyogs dpal o ḍi ya na zhes bya ba'i yul rin po che 'bar ba'i grong khyer na rgyal po spyan med 'byor ldan zhes kyang bya/

rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi zhes kyang bya ba chos skyong ba'i rgyal po de/ auḍ+yi na'i rgyal khams la mnga' mdzad pa'o/ /baiḍūr+ya'i pho brang zhes bya ba rin po che 'od 'bar ba/ phyi nang med par ma sgrib par gsal ba'i nang na btsun mo brgya rtsa brgyad dang / phyi blon nang blon bar blon la sogs pa 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bzhugs pa la sras rgyal bu mi mnga' nas/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga la dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po phul te/ chos kyi srid ces bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo tshar gcig bton nas 'gro ba rnams la mchod sbyin rgya chen po mdzad par dam bcas te/ dkor mdzod kyi nor thams cad sbyin par btang bas lo mang du lon pa dang dkor mdzod rnams zad cing stongs par gyur nas/ sbyin pa'i 'phro bcad kyang slong mo ba 'phro ma chad pa la/ da ni bang mdzod thams cad zad cing stongs nas med do zhes smras pa dang / 'o na nged cag la ma sbyin zhing ma thob na/ gzhan la sngar byin pa rnams don med do zhes smras par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la phyi'i rgya mtsho na klu'i bu mo mdzes ldan ma'i lag na nor bu rin po che dgos 'dod 'byung ba zad mi shes pa cig yod par 'dug de chos kyi sbyin pa gtong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig gis bslang na ster ba yin par 'dug pas de bslang dgos snyam nas rgya mtsho la gzings bcas nas phyi'i rgya mtsho las nor bu rin po che the ngas mang du bslang pa'i ded dpon gcig yod pa la bka' bsgos nas 'khor rnams dang bcas chas pa las/ rgyal po la 'khor rnams kyis mi gshegs par zhu ba phul kyang ma gsan te/ gzings kyi nang du zhugs nas phyogs bzhir dar po che 'phyar/ mthun pa'i rlung byung ba dang 'gro/ mi 'dod pa'i rlung byung ba dang phyogs bzhir zha nye'i gting rdo'i tshab chen po bzhi rnga ma'i thag pa la 'phyangs su bcug ste/ gzings sdod par byas nas rgyal po 'khor bcas phyi'i rgya mtsho la nyag thag bcad nas bzhud par chas pa'i tshe/

mi mthun pa'i rlung 'khor nas 'gror ma gter ba la/ rgyal po spyan med 'byor ldan gyis dkon mchog dang chos skyong srung ma la bden pa bdar te/ kho bos snga phyir sems can gyi don rgya chen po yong na rlung 'tshub 'di rang zhi la 'gro ba dang mig gcig kyang bye bar gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu spyan g.yas pa bye zhing rlung rnams rang zhi la song bar gyur to/ /de nas dar po che 'phyar nas mthun pa'i rlung phyogs su btang pas/ dpag chen gyi mda' 'phangs pa bzhin song ngo / /de nas rin po che'i gling du phyin pa dang / 'khor gzhan rnams rin po che'i gling du bzhag nas/ rgyal po dang ded dpon gnyis gru chung cig tu zhugs nas phyin pa dang / ri dkar po cig mthong ba'i tshe/ rgyal pos pha gi na ri dkar po gcig 'dug pa ci'i ri yin byas pas/ ded dpon na re/ pha gi rin po che dngul gyi ri yin zer ro/ /de nas yang phyin pa dang ri sngon po gcig mthong ba na/ rgyal pos ri sngon po gcig 'dug pa ci'i ri yin dris pas/ de ni rin po che baiḍūr+ya'i ri yin zer ro/ /de nas yang ri ser po gcig mthong ma thag ci'i ri yin dris pa dang / de ni gser gyi ri yin pas ri pha gi'i rtsar phyin pa dang / gser gyi bye ma'i sa gzhi yod do/ /de'i mdun na rin po che sna tshogs pa'i mkhar gcig yod do/ /mkhar de'i mdun na rdo'i gtun bu gcig yod kyis/ de'i sgo rdungs zhig nang nas lha mo brgyad rin po che khyer te phul nas 'ong gis/ de rnams la gtam ma smra cig de nas yang rdungs zhig de rjes nor bu rin po che bsam 'phel khyer yong ba yin no/ /zhes ded dpon gyis rgyal po la bslabs nas btang ngo / /rgyal pos de ltar byas pas/ lha mo brgyad klu mo cig rnams kyis rgyal po la rin po che phul nas bsam pa'i don grub bo/ /ded dpon drin che'o zhes smras te/ nor bu rin po che zab shos cig byin no/

/de'i tshe rgyal pos nor bu rin po che stegs kyi steng du bzhag la/ ngas rnyed pa'i nor bu 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin nges na/ nga'i mig long ba 'di phye bar gyur cig ces gsol ba btab ma thag tu spyan g.yon pa phye ste gsal bar gyur to/ /des dus nam mkha' nas in+d+ra bodhi sid+dhi pha la zhes pa'i sgra grags par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po dang ded dpon gnyis kyis tshur 'ong ste 'khor rnams yod sa der phyin no/ /de nas ded dpon rin po che brtag pa la mkhas pa des/ rin po che mching bu la sogs pa ran par cha bgos te byin no/ /mang na chur bying nas 'gro bas srog dor bar byed do/ /chog shes par gyis shig ces smras so/ /de nas gzings kyi kha lo bsgyur nas rang gi yul phyogs su 'ong ste/ u rgyan gyi yul dang thag mi ring ba zhig tu slebs pa'i tshe/ chos blon kri ṇa 'dzin zhes bya ba des gru chung gcig tu zhugs nas bsur byung ba dang mjal te/ dga' ba'i gtam mang du mdzad cing nor bu gcig kyang skyes kyi tshul du gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal blon gnyis lhan cig tu byon pas/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling na 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khyil ba la steng nas me tog gi char 'bab cing / 'og nas chu bya rnams skad snyan sgrogs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can gzigs te/ rgyal pos blon po la pha gi ci'i ltas yin gsungs pas/ blon po na re/ rgyal po la spyan med pa la 'di 'dra gzigs pa ci lags zhus pas/ ngas dkon mchog rin po che dang nor bu la gsol ba btab pas mig gnyis ka shin tu gsal ba byung ngo gsungs/ blon pos smras pa/ kyai rgyal po chen po/ mkhyen par mdzod cig ngas sngon chad pad+ma'i tshal pha gi na rgyal pos me tog len du btang ba'i dus su/ pad sdong chen po zhig gi steng na khye'u ya mtshan can cig 'khrungs gda' bas/ rgyal pos sras la khyer 'ong snyam na'ang /

ci 'dra yin snyam nas khyer ma spobs shing / brtag dpyad byas nas da bzod rgyal po la zhu snyam pa lags/ da ni rgyal po rang nyid gzigs pa la 'byon par zhu zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po rab tu dges te/ de ltar na 'gro/ myur du rang 'gro gsungs te/ mtshan ltas gsungs pa/ mdang gsum gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'phro ba/ /nam mkha' las byung bdag la thim/ /yang cig nub cig rmi lam na/ /snying gi dkyil nas nyi ma shar/ /de yis 'dzam gling khyab par gyur/ /gzhan yang lung bstan pra ltas rnams/ /dge bas kho bo'i 'dod don 'grub/ /ces gsungs nas rgyal blon gnyis po sngon la gru chung ngu zhig tu zhugs nas mtsho gling der phyin pas/ ngang pa dang ngur pa la sogs pa'i bya sna tshogs dang / bung ba'i sgra dbyangs di ri ba dang / dri zhim po chil chil 'ong zhing / nyams dga' zhing rig pa 'ur 'gro ba lta bu yong ba'i gnas cig 'dug go /de yang rgyal blon gnyis der slebs pa dang / lo sprel lo zla ba dpyid zla tha chung spre'u zla ba/ nyi ma spre'u'i nyi ma/ dus tshes bcu'i snga phyi nyi ma shar ba dang dus 'dzoms te/ me tog pad+ma'i sdong po chen po la kha dog sna tshogs yod pa/ dri zhim pa blta na sdug pa/ phra sbom spang gi 'khyud pa tsam/ 'dab ma 'dom gang yod pa cig 'dug go /de'i steng gi pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru bye ba'i dbus na/ khye'u chung blta bas mchog mi shes pa yid du 'ong ba mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa/ dbu skra thor gtsug tu bcings shing / phyed mthur la sil bur byas pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje pad+ma dang / g.yon gyis spyi blugs kyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dung la pho tshos byugs pa lta bu zhig rang byung du 'khrungs nas bzhugs pa rgyal blon rnams kyis gzigs so/ /'di ni pha ma med par khye'u'i skur sprul te/ ma dag pa'i rgyu rkyen gang yang med par rgya mtsho'i gleng du byon pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/

ma rig pa'i sems can log pa'i lam la spyod pa rnams 'dren pa'i dpal du byon pa yin la/ ngo bo bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sprul par gdon mi za ba yin cing / mtshan mtsho skyes rdo rjer gsol ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ pha dang ma med khye 'u sprul pa'i sku/ /rgyu dang rkyen med rgya mtsho'i klong las byon/ /ma rig log pa'i sems can 'dren pa'i dpal/ /bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ /sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas rgyal po in+d+ra bodhi de nyid ngo mtshar nas/ khye'u de la smras pa/ khye'u khyod kyi pha ni gang yin/ ma ni gang yin/ rigs ni gang du gtogs/ yul ni gang du bzung / zas skal ni gang la brten/ 'di na ni don ci byed ces dris pas/ khye'u des smras pa/ bdag gi pha ni rig pa'i sems yin no/ /ma ni dbyings kun tu bzang mo yin no/ /rigs ni dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par gtogs so/ /yul ni chos kyi dbyings skye ba med par bzung ngo / /zas skal du ni gnyis snang gi rtog pa za'o/ /'dir ni nyon mongs pa gsod pa'i spyod pa byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes nas/ 'di ni sprul pa'i sku cig yin 'dug pas nga'i bu skal dang mchod gnas bya'o gsungs te/ der pad+ma'i sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad/ khye'u de yang khyer te rgyal blon khye'u dang bcas pas 'khor tshong pa rnams yod sar sleb bo/ /der 'khor thams cad dga' nas 'di skad smras so/ /e ma ho/ u rgyan yul gyi rje blon 'bangs kyi tshogs/ /nyams dga' blo bde don kun phyogs gcig 'grub/ /rgyal po sras med dmangs pos sras kyang rnyed/ /'bangs rnams 'phongs pas dbul pos nor yang rnyed/ /chos kyi rgyal pos chos nor bu rnams thob/

/ded dpon mkhas pas rgya mtsho'i nor rnams thob/ /thams cad smon pa'i gnas su da gyur to/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas khye'u dang rgyal blon 'khor tshogs rnams rang gi yul ngogs su 'byon pa'i lam zhig tu mtsho 'gram cig na mi rgan mgo dkar por song ba zhig nya rgya btsugs te/ lcags kyu re la nya re brgyus nas phar ling tshur ling byed pa cig gzigs so/ /de'i tshe khye'u'i dgongs pa la rgyal po'i sras po rgyal srid bzung ba 'di nya mo lcags kyus zin pa dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal 'ong ces pa'i brdar dgongs/ yang byon pas nags gseb cig na khwa ta gcig gis sreg pa gcig bdas song pas/ sreg pa de tsher phung gcig la 'khril song ba dang / khwa ta yang der song nas sreg pa ded pas/ khwa ta g.yas su song dus sreg pa g.yon du bros/ khwa ta g.yon du song dus sreg pa g.yas su bros te mthar sreg pa thar nas song ba gzigs so/ /de'i tshe khye'u chung gi dgongs pa la/ tsher phung de rgyal srid/ khwa ta de rgyal po/ sreg pa de pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal srid thabs kyis spong ba'i brdar dgongs/ de nas yang dum cig byon pa'i lam kha de na/ 'jag ma'i phub pa'i khyim zhig na/ dge bsnyen pho mo gnyis la bu gcig 'dug pas/ des byis pa gzhan cig bsad pas/ 'dis 'dra min dgu byas te zer nas/ khyim nas bton gtong ba cig gzigs pas/ khye'u'i dgongs pa la/ skabs cig tu bdag gis rgyal po'i khrims la gnod pa byas nas bdag spyugs gtong ba'i brdar dgongs/ de nas byon pas rgyal po'i pho brang gzigs sar phebs pas der yod kyi skye bo rnams rab tu dga' nas bsu ba dang dga' ston rgya chen po byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol ba btab bo/ /ngas rnyed pa'i nor bu rin po che 'di/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ma nor ba yin na/ nga'i khye'u bzhugs pa'i khri 'di rin po che sna bdun gyi khrir gyur cig

rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs kyang yod par gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu rin po che'i khri dang gdugs su gyur ro/ /de la khye'u bzhugs nas rgyal bur mnga' gsol te/ rgyal bu'i mtshan rgyal po thor cog can zhes bya bar btags so/ /de nas rgyal pos ngas rnyed pa'i nor bu rin po che 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ma nor ba yin na/ bdag gi sngar sbyin pa btang nas bang mdzod stong pa rnams gang bar shog ces brjod pas/ sngon bang mdzod stong pa rnams/ sngon ci yod pa ltar gang bar gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po chen po des gser gyi rnga bo che brdungs nas phyogs thams cad du sgra bsgrags te/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che las dgos 'dod kyi char 'bebs pas/ su ci 'dod pa gang la gang dgos pa thams cad long cig ces sgra bsgrags so/ /de nas rgyal po'i nor bu rin po che la sman dang dri'i khrus chab gsol/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags tsan+dan dang dri yis gdugs/ rgyal pos sku khrus gsol gos gtsang ma gyon nas/ phyogs bzhir lha la phyag btsal nas 'di skad ces gsol ba btab bo/ /nga'i rnyed pa'i nor bu rin po che 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ma nor ba yin na/ sems can thams cad ci 'dod pa bzhin du char phob cig ces brjod pa tsam gyis phyogs bzhi nas rlung langs nas/ sa gzhi'i mi gtsang ba thams cad phyags nas char zim bus ban bun gyi rdul mi ldang bar byi dor byas la/ de nas dang por kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa'i char phab nas ltogs pa thams cad tshims par byas so/ /de nas gos kyi char phab nas 'khyags pa thams cad tshims par byas so/ /de nas nor gyi char phab nas gang la gang 'dod kyi dbul 'phongs thams cad tshims par byas so/ /der rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu 'dus pa thams cad ltogs 'phongs dang bral bar byas nas/ da ni khyed rnams theg pa chen po'i chos la longs spyod cig ces bka' bsgos te/

der thams cad kyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas chos la longs spyad pas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ las can rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi yis/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i klong las byon te rnyed/ /dad pas spyan drangs rgyal por mnga' gsol mdzad/ /rgyal srid chos kyi khrims kyis bde la bkod/ /rgyal po thor cog can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de dag ni thog mar skye brgyud kyi rim pa rnams yin la/ gnyis pa mdzad pa'i las thabs bstan pa la gsum ste/ dang po rgyal srid spangs nas mthu dang dngos grub ji ltar brnyes pa/ bar du sde brgyad gdug pa can gang ltar btul ba/ tha ma dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sa 'dul dang rab gnas ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas rgyal bu sprul pa'i sku des rgyal sa bzung bas 'gro don mi yong bar thugs kyis dgongs nas/ rgyal po dang blon po rnams sun 'don pa'i phyir brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de/ sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing / phyag na dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum pa cig thogs nas gar mdzad pas/ pho brang gi rtser rgyal bu gar mdzad pa la blta ba'i mi mang po 'tshogs te yod pa la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phyag nas shor ba'i tshul mdzad nas/ blon po dbang po che ka ma ha ki bya ba'i bu'i mgo bo la rgyab bo/ /blon po'i bu der shi bar gyur to/ /de yang rgyal khrims gang gis nyes pa de la chad pa gcod pas/ blon po rnams tshogs nas rgyal po la zhus pa/ rgyal bur mnga' gsol yang tshul ma yin pa'i spyod pa byas nas blon po'i bu bsad pas/ da rgyal bu rang gsal shing gi rtse la skyon la chad pa bcad 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos smras pa/ rgyal bu 'di mi ma yin gyi bu yin nam/ sprul pa yin nam mi shes pas bsad na mi legs te/

ngas brtag gis gsungs nas/ blon po rnams la spyugs cig par gnang ngo / /de nas yang rgyal po thugs la gcags nas ma dgyes kyang rgyal khrims btsan pa'i dbang gis mi spyugs pa'i dbang med nas rgyal pos sras rgyal bu la gsungs pa/ rin chen mtsho skyes pad+ma'i sdong bu las/ yab med yum med khye 'u sprul pa'i sku/ /sras kyi 'phongs nas rgyal bur dbang bskur yang / /rgyal bu'i spyod pas blon po'i phru gu bkum/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal khrims chad pas bcad/ /bsad pas spyugs par gnang gis gshed gshegs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /yang sras rgyal bus yab rgyal po la gsungs pa/ e ma ho/ gsan dang yab gcig rgyal po chen po lags/ /'jig rten 'di na pha dang ma dkon yang / /yab dang yum du bgyis nas rgyal sar phyung / /las kyi lan chags blon po'i phrug gu bkum/ /yab kyi rgyal khrims gnyan pas spyugs pa lags/ /skye 'chi med pas bsad la nga mi 'jigs/ /yul la zhen pa med pas spyugs la mi dga' med/ /yab yum yun du sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /las kyi dbang gis phyis su mjal nas mchis/ /zhes gsungs nas yab dang yum la phyi phyag byas pas/ der yab yum gyi thugs la 'di sprul pa'i sku cig yin nges snyam nas shin tu ma dgyes nas bshums so/ /der sras rgyal bus kyang yab la 'chang nas bshums so/ /der blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu de khrid de dur khrod chen po sil ba'i tshal bya ba mi ma yin dang gcan gzan gtum po yod pa shin tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dur khrod der bskyal lo/ /de nas yul des chos lugs kyis yul de'i mi shi tshad dur khrod der skyel bas/ ro gos ras yug re la bstum nas/ ro zan 'bras chan khal re sngas su bcug nas 'jog pa las/ rgyal bu des sngags kyi sbyor ba mdzad nas zas su ro zas zos/ gos su ro gos gon shin tu longs spyod dang ldan par yod pa las/

dus phyis su song ba dang yul der mu ge chen po byung ste/ mi phal cher shi nas ro gos ras yug re skyel ba las/ ro zas 'bras chan khal re skyel ba de ma byung nas/ de nas zas skal du ro la longs spyad pas/ dur khrod na gnas pa'i las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dbang du 'dus nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad do/ /pho byung ba thams cad bsgral nas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma mchod/ mo byung ba thams cad la sbyor ba byas te dbang du bsdus pas/ der mi kun na re/ srin por 'dug zer nas der srin po shān+ta rak+ṣi ta bya bar mtshan btags so/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ lho phyogs sil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /rgyal srid spangs nas brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad/ /sta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol dgongs pa yis/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /shān+ta rak+ṣi ta la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas za hor gyi dur khrod dga' ba'i tshal du ro la longs spyod cing spyod pa mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul mas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ de nas o rgyan gyi dur khrod so ba'i gling sogs pa phyogs bzhi'i dur khrod kun tu byon nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pas/ mkha' 'gro ma zhi ba'i mtshos byin gyis brlabs te/ sngon pad+ma la 'khrungs sa'i rgya mtsho'i gling der gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma'i brda' skad kyis bsgrubs pas/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dbang du 'dus so/ /de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo'i zhal yang gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs te/ rgya mtsho'i klu dang bar snang gi gza' phran la sogs pas bran du khas blangs nas dbang du 'dus pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing chos gsungs pa la brten nas nus pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor par gyur te/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal du btags so/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/

phyogs bzhi'i dur khrod kun tu brtul zhugs mdzad/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs/ /rdo rje phag mo'i zhal mthong dngos grub thob/ /nam mkha'i gza' phran thams cad bran du bkol/ /rdo rje drag po rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de nas rgya gar gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams la gsang sngags kyi chos rtsad bcad snyam nas za hor pra ta ra'i lam du dge slong shākya mi tra dang / shākya bshes gnyen gnyis slob dpon pra ha ti la chos nyan du 'gro ba dang 'phrad nas/ khyed gar 'gro gsungs pas/ nged brag dmar bya khyung bya ba na slob dpon pra ha ti bya ba bzhugs pas/ de la chos nyan du 'gro byas pas/ 'o na nga yang 'gro gsungs nas byon te/ slob dpon pra ha tis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan yang shākya seṅger btags so/ /de nas yo ga'i chos mu tsa ta ya dang / o ga tsar+ya dang / ta tha saṃ kri ha dang / yo ga'i rgyud chen po gsum bshad pas/ tshar res shes kyang sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyir tshar bco brgyad nyan pa dang / ma bsgrubs par de nyid du yo ga'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis zhal gzigs pa yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ brag dmar bya khyung tshal gyi skye tshang du/ /slob dpon pra ba ha ti'i spyan sngar byon/ /rnal 'byor yo ga'i chos la sbyangs pa mdzad/ /yo ga'i lha tshogs rnams kyis zhal gzigs pas/ /shākya seṅge'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas shākya seṅge'i thugs dgongs la/ rnal 'byor yo ga'i chos cig bsgrubs la/ yo ga tshe'i rigs 'dzin brnyes par bya dgongs nas/ ri bo ma la ya na slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyin te zhus pas/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi zhal nas/ ngas khyed 'dul ba'i dus la ma bab pas/ u rgyan dha na sha'i gtsug lag khang na/ dge slong ma kun dga' mo bya ba phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba la mkhas pa cig yod pas der song la dbang bskur zhus shig ces lung bstan te/

de nas shākya seṅges dge slong ma can du byon te/ g.yog mo bram ze mo ku ku mo la 'phrin brdzangs pas ma phyin pa la/ brjed dam byas pas/ mo rang gi brang shel dkar gyi gri gus gshags te/ slob dpon la bstan pas zhi ba'i lha sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal bkra lam me la bstan pa mthong bas/ 'di kha dge slong ma yin nam snyam nas phyag dang bstod pa byas te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang cig zhu byas pas/ nga ma yin dge slong ma nang na yod pas songs shig ces zer ba ltar song nas gsol ba btab pas/ dge slong mas shākya seṅge de yi ge hūm̐ gcig tu byas nas zhal du mid nas dbang bskur nas bshags pa dang bcas te/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sgrib pa dag par byas nas/ phyi sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbang bskur te/ tshe'i rigs 'dzin thob par dbang bskur/ nang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang bskur te phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thob par dbang bskur/ gsang ba dpal rta mgrin gyis dbang bskur te/ dregs pa thams cad dbang du 'dus par dbang bskur ro/ /de nas slar yang shākya seṅges 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi drung du byon te/ 'jam dpal phyi nang gi chos mang po gsan/ tshar res shes te 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs so/ /slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i spyan sngar byon te/ dpal yang dag sgrub pa dang / sgrub pa rnam gsum gyi chos gsan te zhal gzigs/ slob dpon shākya de wa'i spyan sngar byon te/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos gsan/ phur pa'i lha tshogs kyi zhal gzigs/ slob dpon na gardzu na'i spyan sngar byon nas pad+ma dbang chen gyi chos gsan te zhal gzigs/ slob dpon rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i spyan sngar byon nas/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyis chos gsan nas zhal gzigs/ slob dpon dha na saṃ kri ta'i spyan sngar byon nas/ srid pa ma mo'i chos gsan pas zhal gzigs/ slob dpon rum bu gu ya de wa'i spyan sngar byon te/

dmod pa drag sngags kyi chos gsan/ bstan pa srung ba'i ngan sngags dang drag sngags mang po gsan zhal gzigs/ slob dpon shrī sidha'i spyan sngar byon te bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i sems phyogs thams cad gsan te/ chos thams cad tshar res shes shing lha thams cad kyi zhal gzigs te mtshan yang blo ldan mchog sred du btags so/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ rgya gar yul gyi phyogs bzhi'i gnas chen du/ /rig 'dzin grub thob mang po'i spyan sngar byon/ /yo ga rnam gsum chos la sbyangs pa mdzad/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi chos kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ /mkhas pa blo ldan mchog sred la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas slob dpon chen po blo ldan mchog sred kyi thugs dgongs la/ da nga gsang sngags kyi chos la mnga' brnyes kyang / skye 'chi med par tshe'i rigs 'dzin sgrub la sngon gyi o rgyan dang za hor gyi rgyal po dang blon po rnams chos la gzung snyam nas za hor gyi yul du byon nas/ za hor gyi rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi bu mo me tog man+da ra ba zhes bya ba mtshan dang ldan pa cig dbang du bsdus nas bsgrubs te mo gzung mar khrid nas/ ri bo po ta la zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pho brang gi lho phyogs na/ brag phug ma ra tī ka zhes bya ba kha lho nub tu bltas pa/ dus gsum du me tog gi char 'bab pa/ tsan+dan gyi nags yod pa/ rigs gsum mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas tshe bsgrubs pas/ zla ba gsum na mgon po tshe dpag med kyi zhal gzigs nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor bzhag nas zhal du blug ste 'chi ba med pa rdo rje lta bu'i lus su gyur nas yo ga tshe'i rigs 'dzin thob pa yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ brag phug ma ra tī ka'i skye tshang du/

/'chi med tshe yi rigs 'dzin bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /mgon po tshe dpag med kyis byin brlabs pas/ /skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i lus su gyur/ /'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de nas za hor gyi yul mi rnams chos la gzud pa'i phyir/ yab yum gnyis kyis grong khyer na mar bsod snyoms la byon pas/ rgyal po de dang yul mi kun gyis phrag dog byas nas/ mtha' mi ban+dhe 'khyam po cig gis sngon la nged kyi skyes pa thams cad bsad/ bud med thams cad la spyad/ de nas rgyal po'i bu mo khrid nas rigs bslad/ da dung 'khor la gnod pa skyel ba 'di la skyon dbab dgos/ sdig pa spyi khur byas nas sreg dgos zer nas/ mi res tsan+dan khur re dang / til mar bre re bsdus nas bsregs pas/ gzhan bsregs pa rnams zhag gsum nas du ba chad pa yin pa la/ zhag dgu ru du ba ma chad nas bltas tsa na/ me lce thams cad phyir 'bar nas rgyal po'i pho brang thams cad 'tshig til mar rgya mtshor 'khyil nas nang thams cad pad+mar chags te/ pad+ma'i sdong po cig gi kha na yab yum gnyis sku grang grang 'dra ba/ bsil bsil 'dra ba 'dug nas/ rgyal po la sogs pa ya mtshan skyes nas bstod pa/ sku ni mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu'i sku/ /gsung ni mi 'gag rdo rje lta bu'i gsung / /thugs ni mi 'gyur chos nyid rdo rje'i thugs/ /sku gsung thugs ni skye med rdo rje'i ngang / /mtsho skyes rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag cag ma rig nongs pa mthol lo bshags/ /bdag cag yul khams bde la 'god du gsol/ /zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ grong khyer gyi me thams cad zhi ste sngar bas kyang mdzes pa nyams dga' bar gyur te/ mtshan pad+ma saṃ bha wa btags te za hor gyi rgyal khams chos la gzud do/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ za hor rgyal khams 'dul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can chos la btsud/

/ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ /rgyal khams thams cad chos kyis gang bar mdzad/ /pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la/ da ni u rgyan gyi rgyal khams chos la gzud snyam nas/ u rgyan gyi yul na mar bsod snyoms la byon pas yul ba rnams kyis kyang ngo shes te/ 'dis sngar yang nged kyi blon po'i phru gu bsad de rgyal khrims la gnod pa bskyal/ da dung yang 'dis gnod pa skyel bas 'di sreg dgos zer nas/ sngar gyi bu bsad pa'i blon po la sogs pa yul mi rnams kyis sdig pa spyi khur byas nas/ tsan+dan khur re dang til mar bre re bsdus nas bsregs pas/ sngon chad gzhan bsregs pa zhag bdun bdun nas du ba chad pa yin pa la/ da res zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig du ba ma chad de/ de nas rgyal pos 'khor rnams blta bar bskul bas sus kyang 'jigs nas blta ma nus te/ der sngar gyi yab rgyal po nyid kyi thugs ma ches te/ gal te sprul pa'i sku cig yin na ma 'tshig gam snyam nas/ der 'khor dang bcas pas blta ru 'ong bas/ til mar zhing dor gnyis tsam du mtsho ru 'khyil ba'i dbus su sol ba'i gur chen po cig gi nang du pad+ma'i sdong po gcig gi steng na yab yum gnyis sku zil pa khrom me byas nas/ sngar gyi 'gro ba rnams thugs rjes bsgral ba'i brda ru/ thod pa'i phreng ba lnga bcu rtsa gcig sku la gsol nas bzhugs pas/ yab rgyal po la sogs pa rnams ngo mtshar skyes te skor ba lan gsum byas nas bstod pa/ dngos grub mchog brnyes ya mtshan chen po'i sku/ /skye 'chi gnyis spangs pad+ma'i nang nas 'khrungs/ /'khor ba thugs rjes bsgral ba'i thod 'phreng gsol/ /sprul sku rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces zhabs spyi bor blangs nas mchod gnas su bzhugs par zhus pas/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/

/spyir gyi khams gsum 'khor ba 'khyams pa 'di/ /sdug bsngal btson dong nang du chud pa yin/ /rgyal por skyes kyang 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i gnas/ /rang sems skye mched chos skur ma shes na/ /rgyal por skyes kyang 'khor ba'i skye gnas su/ /rgyun mi 'chad par yang yang brgyud mar 'khor/ /rgyal po chen po sems nyid stong gsal ltos/ /phyi ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po nyid dus de rang du rang sems chos skur mthong nas rtogs grol dus gcig tu byung ste rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /yang rgyal pos bstod pa/ rtog pa bla med pad+ma rgyal po'i sku/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen man ngag rnams/ /klong nas grol mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod nas thod 'phreng sku la gsol pas/ pad+ma thod phreng du btags/ rgyal po'i sras po mdzad pas pad+ma rgyal por btags so/ /de nas rgyal po'i mchod gnas lo bcu gsum mdzad nas/ o rgyan gyi rgyal khams thams cad chos la bkod de/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi 'khor dang bcas pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gis dngos grub thob bo/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ u rgyan rgyal khams 'dul du gshegs pa'i dus/ /gshed mas me yi dbus su bsregs pa'i tshe/ /me phung mtsho ru bsgyur nas rdzu 'phrul bstan/ /in+d+ra bo dhi byang chub lam la bkod/ /sras mchog pad+ma rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis mu stegs kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa'i phyir/ rgya gar yul du byon nas mu stegs kyi ston pa lnga brgya dang bgro gleng byas pas/ khong rnams kyis slob dpon ma thub pa la brten nas/ der mu stegs kyis slob dpon la mthu byed kyin 'dug pa la/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul mas bse'i sgrom bu cig gtad nas/ bdud dang mu stegs thul cig par lung bstan pa dang /

bse'i sgrom bu srog ser gtad dang bcas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i ngan sngags bsgrubs pas zhag bdun nas rtags byung ste/ mu stegs nags gseb na slob dpon la mthu byed pa de dag la/ nags kyi steng du thog bab nas thams cad mes 'tshig ste mu stegs pa rnams nyams thag cing / ma shi ba rnams nang pa sangs rgyas par bcug nas/ mtshan yang 'phags pa seṅge sgra sgrog tu btags so/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ lho phyogs rgya gar yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma yis byin gyis brlabs/ /mu stegs ston pa lnga brgyas rtsod pa bzlog /ngan sngags bdag po mu stegs thog gis bsgral/ /'phags pa seṅge sgra sgrog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la/ nges 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub kyang / /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin ma 'grub na phan yon med par dgongs nas/ de 'grub pa'i slad du rgya gar yul gyi tshu rol/ bal po'i yul gyi pha rol/ yang le shod kyi brag phug bya ba na me tog dgun yang mi skam pa bkra shis la byin che ba der byon te/ sgrub sde ma bal mo shākya de wa bya ba mtshan dang ldan pa gcig khrid nas/ dpal yang dag mar me dgu ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye zhing sgrub pa mdzad pa la gtad rnam pa gsum byung ste/ klu rkyang po dang / gnod sbyin ma dgong kha bya ba dang / bar snang khams kyi glog sprin dang gsum gyi gtad byas te/ lo gsum du gnam las char gcig kyang ma babs/ rtsi thog dang lo thog ma skyes pas/ der rgya gar dang bal po la sogs par mi nad dang phyugs nad sprin ched pa lta bu byung nas der mi phyugs mang po shi ba na/ slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la/ 'di gzhan cis kyang ma lan te bdag phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la mi ma yin rnams kyis gtad byas par dgongs nas/ bal po ji la ji tsa dang / bal mo ku la kun gnyis la gser phye bre gang spyan gzigs su bskur nas/

rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang slob dpon rnams kyi spyan sngar bsrings pa/ bdag phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la bar chad rnam pa gsum byung bas/ bar chad 'dul ba'i chos gcig gnang ba zhu zhes spyan sngar btang pas/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams na re/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra wa hasti la gtad 'dul ba'i rdo rje phur pa'i chos cig zhus shig gsungs nas/ slob dpon pra wa hasti la zhus pas/ phur pa bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i nang nas dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i las kha mi khur gcig brdzangs pas/ yang le shod kyi brag phug tu phebs pa tsam gyis bar chad rnam pa gsum po zhi/ rgya mtsho las rlangs pa byung / sa las drod byung / gnam la sprin 'thibs/ bar snang las char babs te/ rtsi shing dang 'bru dang me tog thams cad dus gcig la sngo lam skyes te 'bras bu dus su smin no/ /'bru de zos pas mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad/ mu ge yang sangs nas rgyal khams thams cad bde zhing skyid par gyur to/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis de'i dus su dpal yang dag gi lha tshogs dang rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs kyi zhal gzigs te/ yang dag tshong pa dang 'dra par dngos grub che ste bar chad mang ba la/ phur pa skyes ma dang 'dra ba bzhin bar chad 'dul bar dgongs nas yang phur sbrags ma'i sgrub pa mdzad pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste/ de'i dus su phur srung bcu gnyis la sogs pa dam la btags pa yin no/ /de'i tshe mtshan yang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du grags so/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ /yang dag bde chen snying po sgrub pa'i tshe/ /bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gnas der thob/ /rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /gzhan yang bal yul a su ra'i brag phug ces bya ba/
