rdzas mod pa/ dngos grub nye ba zhig yod pa der sngar gyi grogs po shākya mi tra dang / shākya pra bha gnyis kyang byung ste/ khong gsum gyis rdo rje phur bu bsgrubs pas/ grub rtags rab 'bring tha gsum byung ste/ rab phur pa gcig nam mkha' la lding ba de/ gu ru pad 'byung gis blangs te tsan+dan gyi nags la brgyab pas de ma thag thul gyis 'tshig nas slar lo 'dab 'khrungs so/ /de la dgongs pa ci yod ce na/ de'i gseb na mu stegs kyi gnas khang yod pa de bcom pa'o/ /yang rtags 'bring po phur pa gcig maṇ+ḍal gyi steng nas 'gul zhing 'phar ba byung / de bhi ma las blangs nas chu bo gaṅga la btab pas chu bo chad/ de la dgos pa ci yod na/ de na klu nor rgyas bya ba mu stegs la 'tsho ba ster ba cig yod pas de gzhom pa'o/ /yang rtags tha ma phur pa 'dzum zhing dgod pa cig byung / de bal po shi la mañjus blangs te/ mkhar gong gi brag la btab pas phye mar phung song / de la dgos pa ci yod na/ de na the rang gi pho brang yod cing des mu stegs la mngon shes ston pa yod pas de rnams btul ba yin no/ /yang de gsum gyi gsang mtshan ni/ slob dpon blo ldan mchog sred rtsal/ dā na saṃ kri dang / da na u pa ya ste gsum po des rgya mtsho'i gling la bsgrubs pas/ steng gza' dang rgyu skar gyis thog ser phab/ 'og klu dang sa bdag gis rgya mtsho lud du bcug bar snang gi lhas dus ma yin pa'i char dang rlung nag btang bas/ slob dpon thugs khros te/ phur pa gcig nam mkha' la bsgril bas gnam gyi gza' skar thams cad thang la lhung ngo / /phur pa gcig mtsho la btab pas mtsho skam ste klu phrug tsho ngu skad dir gyis song ngo / /phur pa gcig bar snang la btab pas/ bar snang gi lha dang gza' thams cad sa la lhung ba la brten nas/ slar de thams cad kyis srog snying phul nas gus pa btud do/ /de ltar slob dpon rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes pa ste/

de dag gis ni mthu dang dngos grub ji ltar brnyes pa'i tshul legs par brjod zin nas/ bar du sde brgyad gdug pa can gang ltar btul tshul ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul ba'i don du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid spyan drangs pa yin te/ de yang mkhyen rab kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal de bzhugs sa rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bzhugs kyang / zhal bde ba can du bstan nas bzhugs te/ thugs kyi bde ba can gyi gdul bya rnams 'dul par dgongs nas/ de yang 'jam dpal nyid kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan du sprul pa'i gong rol du yang / jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sprul par grags pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos lha sa 'phrul snang dang / lha sa ra mo che la sogs pa dang / mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa bzhengs nas dam pa chos kyi srol bstod nas yod pa la/ 'jam dpal gyis bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su chos dar zhing rgyas par bya bar dgongs te/ de yang rgyal po dbang po che cig tu sprul nas mnga' 'og tu bsdu bar dgong nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pas/ bod yul du rgyal po khri lde gtsug brtan dang / yum rgya mo gyim shang ong co gnyis pho brang brag dmar du rin po che'i khri'i steng du gzims nas bzhugs pa la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer sna lnga'i rtse las khye'u tshon gang pa cig gyim shang ong co'i mngal du 'phros nas sprul pa bkye'o/ /der yum gyi rmi lam na 'od zer nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba gcig byung nas mngal gyi nang du khye'u gcig bzhugs pa rmis nas/ yab la smras pas/ bar snang gi lha phran cig nyid rang gi bu ru 'ong ba'i rtags yin te 'ong ba'i rmi lam de rab tu bzang ngo zer nas yab rgyal po yang shin tu dgyes so/

/de nas yum mi bde ba med par 'gul 'phar la sogs pa byung ba dang / shes pa gsal ba dang / lus yang ba dang / nyon mongs pa mi skyed par gyur ro/ /de nas zla ba dgu dang ngo bcu nas yum las pho brang brag dmar tshal du na tsha med par bltams pa yin te/ rgyal bu de nyid la so dung so 'khor ma yod pa/ skra mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyil ba/ mdzes pa lha'i bu lta bu cig 'khrungs te/ rta'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i skar ma rgyal gyi nam langs nas nyi ma shar ba la 'khrungs so/ /de nas mtshan ni khri srong lde'u btsan du btags te/ de nas rgyal bus dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa dang / yab khri lde gtsug brtan dgung du gshegs nas/ der rgyal sar phyung ste/ jo mo gsum khab tu bzhes pa ni/ tshe spong bza' dmar rgyal dang / 'bro bza' byang chub 'od dang / pho skyong bza' rgyal mo btsun rnams khab tu bzhes pa las/ lo bdun du 'bangs rnams phyi so kha bsrungs pa dang / nang gi so tshis mdzad nas rgyal khrims bskyangs so/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shu pa glang gi lo la dam pa'i chos bya bar dgongs nas/ sngar gyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang / bod mun pa'i dmag rum lta bu la gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / dam pa'i chos kyi srol bstod nas bod la shin tu bka' drin che bar 'dug pas/ da ni ngas kyang dam pa'i chos dar ba cig bya dgos snyam pa'i thugs dgongs rgya chen po cig skyes nas/ da ni sngon la dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang gi rten 'gro ba mi rnams kyis mos pa byed pa'i sa/ rgyal po bdag rang gi thugs dam sngon la lha khang cig bzhengs dgos snyam nas yang yang thugs dgongs bkye bas/ gling bzhi ri rab lcags ri dang bcas pa cig la dpe blangs nas bzhengs par thugs kyis bcad/ btsad pos dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon pa stag gi lo la rmangs gding bar bzhed nas/ slob dpon bo dhi satwa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' mkhyen pa che ba cig yod par grags nas/

gnyags dz+nyā na ku ma ra bya ba rgya gar gyi skad shes pa cig la gser bre gang bskur/ g.yog po gnyis dang bang chen pa mi gsum btang nas spyan drangs pas/ bod kyi btsad po dang tshe snga ma'i 'grel yod pas 'gro dgos gsungs nas/ bod du byon nas mjal ba dang / de la rgyal pos 'di skad zhus pa/ slob dpon lags/ bdag rang gi g.yar dam dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang gi rten/ 'gro ba mi rnams kyis mos pa byed pa'i sa/ gtsug lag khang cig bzhengs pa lags pas/ dbyibs gling bzhi gling phran ri rab lcags ri dang bcas pa cig la dpe blangs nas bzhengs bsam pa ji ltar legs sam zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ dpal brag dmar bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa 'dzam bu'i gling na byin brlabs che ba cig byed pas/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa ste mtshan nyid kyi sde snod thams cad dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde thams cad dang mthun zhing mi 'gal ba 'gran gyi do med pa cig bgyi 'tshal gsungs/ de nas rgyal pos mkhan po rin po ches de ltar mkhyen lags sam zhus pas/ ngas cis kyang shes te/ de lta bu gcig o tan+ta pu ri na yang yod pa ngas mthong / de la o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang zhes kyang grags 'dug gsungs pas/ rgyal pos 'o na cis kyang legs 'dug pas de ci 'dra zhig yod zhus pas/ rgyal po rang legs par gson cig ngas bshad kyis/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon gyi dus su mu stegs rig 'dzin gyi sgrub pa po gcig yod pa des ro sgrub byed pa la/ dngos grub len pa'i sgrub g.yog mtshan rtags dang ldan pa kun tu btsal bas ma rnyed pa la/ skabs cig ma ga ta'i dge slong sgrub pa po la nye gnas gcig yod pa de/ de'i mtshan rtags dang ldan par mthong nas/ sgrub pa po dge slong la maṇ+ḍal rin po che sna tshogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang bcas te yang dang yang du phul bas/ khyod nga la gdams ngag 'dod dam zer ba la/

rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ nga khyed kyi nye gnas dpa' bo'i rtags can 'di zhu 'o byas pas/ des de la phul lo/ /de nas khong gnyis kyis sgrub khang du phyin pa dang / ro sog phon tsam pa gcig dkyil 'khor gyi steng na 'dug go /de nas rig 'dzin des dge tshul de la khyod ro la dpa' ba'i rtags yod pa yin pas ma 'jigs par 'di'i lce chod cig lce de gser gyi ral grir song ba dang nga la byin cig de gar gtad sar 'gro bar nus pa yin te/ nga 'og min du rig 'dzin bsgrub tu 'gro ba yin/ ro 'di gser du 'gyur bas/ de khyod la rngan par sbyin no zer/ der des mnyam par bzhag go /dge tshul des ro la bzhon nas gris lce gcod du bcug pa dang / ro mgul zhing mig hrig hrig kha tab tab byed pa dang lce dar sham tsam cig nyug nyug byung ba la ma zin no/ /lan gnyis su ma zin pa dang / de nas ro'i lce ma chod na/ dang por nged rang gnyis gsod/ de nas stong gsum dang srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad gsod du 'ong bas bsgrims la chod cig zer ro/ /de nas dge tshul gyis ro dang kha sprad de bsgrims pa dang / sos lce zin nas bcad pas ral grir gyur nas nam mkhar dbyugs te/ dge tshul gyis nam mkhar 'phur ba dang / rig 'dzin na re/ khyed nang pa sangs rgyas pa la pham pa 'ong ba yin pas ral gri ni nga dbang na mar la shog cig zer ba la/ de lta yin mod ngas ltad mo blta yis zer nas ri rab kyi khar song nas/ gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar dang bcas pa dang / lcog bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum bkod pa dang bcas pa la bltas pas legs par mthong / de nas mar 'dzam bu'i gling ngogs su ral gri dbyugs pas rig 'dzin gyi drung du byung nas/ ro gser du gyur pa de dge tshul khyod gyis shig 'dis dge slong lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba ldangs te/ rus pa ma chod cig bcad na log 'tshor 'gyur te phyis mi skye'o/

/gzhan du na nang bcad kyang nub la skye'o/ /de skad zer te kho rang ral gri nam mkha' la dbyugs te 'og min du song ngo / /dge tshul des slob dpon dge slong de la smras pa/ 'o cag dge slong lnga brgya'i bzhugs sa gtsug lag khang cig bzhengs dgos pas/ mgon po las gzhi zhu ba'i gtor ma mdzod cig zer nas/ bha liṃ byas pas bya rog gis khyer nas mtsho gcig gi dkyil na de'u yod pa'i khar bzhag de'u de'i khar gtsug lag khang gcig brtsigs te/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla dang bcas pa la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang u tan+ta pu ri bya ba yod pas/ rgyal po chen po'i thugs dam gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dpe yang de la byas na 'gran gyi do med pa sde snod gsum dang sngags rgyud sde thams cad dang mi 'gal zhing byin rlabs yang shin tu che ba cig yong mchi bas/ de la dpe bya'i gsungs pas rgyal po shin tu dgyes te/ des na shin tu bka' drin che bas mkhan po rin po ches sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa zhu 'tshal/ zhes zhu ba phul ba dang / mkhan po'i gsung gis/ khyed bod kyi lha 'dre mi ma yin pa rtsub po 'dug pas/ nga byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dul ba yin pas thul mi thul blta yis/ rgyal po rang rmangs thing cig gsungs nas/ de nas mkhan pos sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ mnga' bdag nyid kyi sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol/ phyag tu gser thogs nas rmangs rkos pas/ sa khru gang tsam gyi 'og nas 'bras dkar mo khal gcig dang / sa zhag zho'i kri ma lta bu mdog ser po ro shin tu mngar ba ka ra'i dro ba mang po byung nas/ rgyal po nyid kyis zhal du yang gsol dbu la yang byugs so/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i bsam pa yang 'grub/ bod yul du chos kyi bstan pa dar yong gsungs so/ /de nas rmangs bting nas brtsigs pas/ dge bsnyen nyer gcig la sogs pa bod kyi gnod sbyin mthu bo che dang /

mthu mo che rnams kyi gtad byas nas/ nyin mo brtsigs pa nub mo bshig nas rtsig tu ma ster ro/ /der slob dpon la thabs gzhan ci ma mchis sam zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bdag gis kyang mtshan nyid kyi chos ma lus par shes nas byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa yin te/ bod kyi lha 'dre gdug rtsub can 'di rnams mi thul ba 'dug pa la thabs gcig yod kyis gsungs nas/ bod kyi klu srin gdug pa can 'di rnams drag pos 'dul dgos par 'dug pas/ de la bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug bya ba de na/ o rgyan rgyal po'i sras mdzad pa'i slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sprul pa'i sku can mthu che la rtsal drag pa/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa mdzad pa cig bzhugs pas/ de spyan drangs na rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub la/ mi ma yin gdug pa can rnams kyang thul bar 'gyur ro gsungs pas/ de nas bka' lung de mnga' bdag gi mnal lam du byung ba skad mdzad nas/ phyi 'khor nang 'khor ba kun la bka' stsal pa/ mdang gsum nga'i rmi lam na/ rgya gar dang bal yul gyi mtshams na yang le shod kyi brag phug bya ba na/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa zhes bya ba bzhugs pas/ de spyan drangs na nga yi bsam pa 'grub ces pa cig rmis pa ltar/ 'di khyed rnams kyis spyan drangs dgos pas/ khyed bang chen pa gsum gtang ngo / /bka' bgros cig gsungs pa dang / de la 'bangs rnams na re 'thad do rigs so zer kyang / bang chen khas len pa ma byung ba la/ der rgyal po nyid kyis/ sbas rma po che gsal snang dang / seng mgo lha lung gnyis la bka' nan stsal nas/ g.yog gsum ste dpon g.yog lnga la gser bre gang dang bar gyi lam brgyags la sogs pa bskur nas lam du bcug pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan lam du srung ma rnams kyis bskul nas/ bod yul has po ri'i rtsa bar bod kyi btsad po lha khang cig brtsigs pas/

slob dpon gyi 'byon lam du bang chen pa mi lnga yong ba yod pas/ de rnams thang chad nyon mongs pas/ slob dpon nyid mang yul gung thang tsam du 'byon par zhu/ zhes srung ma rnams kyis bskul ba de bzhin du slob dpon pad+mas tshur byon pa'i lam du dam can sa bdag ma bzhi btul/ de nas tsan+dan gyi khog nas byon pa'i thugs rje chen po rang byung mched bzhi'i rab gnas mdzad nas bkra shis par byas/ de nas bal yul gyi 'phags pa shin kun gyi rtsar byon pas/ de'i sa bdag sbrul lto nag po bya bas bar chad byas te/ nyi ma phyed nas nam sro bar la/ slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa'i phur pa gcig la sngags btab ste nam mkha' la 'phangs pas/ phyogs de'i pha bong bdun dang / de'i rtse mo la yod pa'i gshin rje nag po dang / rdo ba'i sku gcig yod pa thams cad nam mkha' la 'phur te lha 'dre thams cad btul nas/ da lta rdo ba de sa la nub kyang mos pa byed pa yod gsung ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyis mang yul gung thang du bzhugs pa dang / bang chen pa rnams mjal nas/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis mkhyen bzhin du/ khyed su yin gang du 'gro gsungs pas/ nged bod kyi btsad pos slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan 'dren du btang pa yin khyed lags sam zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas yin yong / ngas ni zla ba gsum gyi gong nas srung ma rnams kyis bskul byung nas 'ong / khyed bang chen pa rnams nyon mongs kyi dogs nas ngas 'dir yong nas zla ba gsum 'dir bsdad pa yin/ khyed re 'gor/ da nga la 'bul rgyu ci yod phul cig gsungs nas/ der bang chen pas phyag byas nas gser phye bre gang phul bas/ da dung ci yod phul cig gsungs pas/ rgyal pos de ka las ma bskur/ da nged rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bran du 'bul zhes phyag btsal skor ba byas nas slob dpon gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs pas/ der slob dpon mnyes te/ ngas khyed bod kyi dad pa la rgyu zog 'dug gam mi 'dug bltas pa yin/

nga la snang ba thams cad gser du yod pa yin gsungs nas phyag g.yas pa gung thang gi g.yas phyogs su brkyangs bas/ g.yas phyogs kyi ri thams cad g.yon du bsgyur/ phyag g.yon pa nub phyogs su brkyangs pas g.yon thams cad g.yas su bsgyur/ sa rdo kun yang gzi dang mchong dang gser du bsgyur nas/ bang chen pa rnams la yang byin nas nga'i mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ni 'di lta bu yod/ khyod rang rnams nga la yid ches par gyis/ gser gyis bdag la don med kyi/ 'on kyang mnga' bdag gi dgongs pa rdzogs par 'grub cing bsod nams 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir re zhig blangs kyi gsungs nas/ mang yul dang bal yul gyi phyogs su gtor nas btang ste/ dus phyi ma la bod kyi gser thams cad mang yul dang bal yul du 'bo bar 'dug gi gsung ngo / /bang chen pa'i sems la nged la byin pa'i gser g.yu tsho ci yin nam snyam nas so so'i phag tu phyin nas bltas tsa na/ bden par gser du song 'dug der so sor yid ches so/ /de nas slob dpon dpon g.yog tshos mar byon te kha la la thog tu byon pas/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / srid pa'i lha chen po 'od lde gung rgyal la sogs pa brgyad dang / klu chen po ma dros gzi can la sogs pa rnams kyis bsus nas a tsa ra 'di bod la shor na nged rang bod kyi lha 'dre rnams bran du 'khol ba zhig yong bas/ da lta a tsa ra 'di la bar gcod bya ba rigs zer te mtho 'tshams byas pa la/ 'jig rten gyi lha tshangs pa 'od lde gung rgyal bya ba des sbrul chen po gcig tu sprul nas mgo bo kha la la thog tu sleb par byas/ mjug ma khams kyi g.yar mo thang du sleb par byas/ nga'i bu tsha dang 'khor g.yog rnams bran du 'dzud dam mi 'dzud zer nas thog bcu gsum phab pas/ slob dpon gyi dbu zhwa'i steng du sol ba ru 'thor song nas blags ma rnyed do/ /de nas yang dag dang phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te gzir bas/

bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas bran du khas blangs te dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim du bzhag go /de nas btsang po na mar byon te don kha ring mor byon pa dang / zhang zhung gi dgra lha srid pa'i rgyal mo mu tsha med bya bas bar chad bya bar brtsams nas ri chen po gnyis su brdzus te slob dpon dpon g.yog rnams ri bar du bcir bar byas pas/ slob dpon gyis brag la phyag 'khar btsugs nas brag la lam byas te/ brag gi kha na phar byon pas mo rab tu dngangs shing bred par gyur te/ srog gi snying po phul nas srung mar khas blangs/ gsang ba'i mtshan yang gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu 'od ces bya bar btags so/ /de nas byang gnam thang na mar byon pas/ gnam sman dkar mos slob dpon la thog dbab par brtsams tsa na/ phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du chu me long gang tsam bzhag pa dang / der sor zer song tsa na khrag skam po sran ma'i rdog po bdun tsam du song 'dug go /de nas mo ya mtshan skyes bred nas mo dpal mo'i dpal mtsho la bros so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dpal mo'i la thog tu sgrub pa zhag bdun bsgrubs te khros pa las/ mtsho nang nas chu pa ru gang blangs nas mtsho me phung du bsgoms pas/ mtsho bun gyis khol byung ba dang / mo sha rus bye ste bred pa la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gcig rgyab pas mig g.yas bcer ba dang mos gus pas btud de zhus pa/ mahā gu ru rdo rje slob dpon lags/ /ston pa'i zhal dkyil rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ /bar chad mi bgyid thugs dam dgongs pa slod/ /srog snying phul nas dga' zhing bran du byed/ /zhes gsol shing dam la btags te ming yang gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig mar btags so/ /de nas 'u yug na mar byon tsa na ya ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa rnams kyis ri bar du bcer bar bsam nas cho 'phrul byas pa las/ slob dpon gyis ri thams cad phyag 'khar gyis so sor bor/

g.ya' ri gangs ri la sogs pa'i gnas thams cad bshig ya ma bcu gnyis skyong ma bcu gnyis rnams kyis srog snying phul nas dam la btags so/ /de nas the'u sha mo lung du byon tsa na/ yar la sham pos g.yag dkar po ri logs tsam gcig tu sprul nas nyal rlangs dang / kha rlangs dang / sna rlangs las na bun dang sprin du byas/ sna chu dang kha chu las kha ba dang bu yug tu btang pas/ slob dpon gyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas nas sna nas bzung / zhags pa'i phyag rgyas ske nas bcings/ lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas rkang lag bzhi sgrog tu bcug dril bu'i phyag rgyas g.yag de btsog brdung byas pas/ khye'u dar gyi gos can cig tu gyur te srog snying phul nas dam la btags so/ /de nas byang zang zang du byon nas byang gi 'brong chen mo brgyad btul nas dam la btags so/ de nas sta sde shang tshal du phebs tsa na/ grom pa rgyang gi lha khang gi rab gnas kyang mdzad do/ /de nas lha thang lha'i rtsar byon pa dang / thang lhas nyams sad par bya ba'i phyir gnod sbyin chen po cig gi lus su sprul te/ slob dpon dpon g.yog rnams za ba'i tshul du byas pa dang / slob dpon gyis phyag sdigs mdzub gcig sug byas pas/ byis pa g.yu'i zur phud can gcig tu log gis song ba dang / 'o 'di klu'i rgyal po me thod dkar po zhes kyang bya/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa zhes kyang bya/ gnyan chen po thang lha zhes kyang bya ba yin pas/ 'di la ngas gro cig bslang gis gsungs nas gshegs song bas/ phyi dro gro 'khor tsam na/ na bza'i phu dung gi nang dri nas ci yang mi dro ba'i 'khur ba lab leb 'dra ba dang / zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams nas byon nas dam la btags so/ /de nas g.yas ru nas mar byon pas g.yas ru'i lha 'dre thams cad ru lag tu bros so/ /g.yas ru gtsang gi 'gram du lha khang gi rab gnas mdzad do/ /de nas byang 'phan yul du byon tsa na/ byang ting ting lo sman dang /

stag sman zor gdong ma dang / byang phug mo la sogs pa rnams kyis byang thun gsum gyi lhags pa thams cad tshon gcig tu byas te/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa la rgyab pas/ 'khor rnams kyang rengs la khad/ slob dpon nyid kyang sku bag ser tsam byung ba la/ slob dpon gyis gangs ri gnod sbyin gyi rten me phung du bsgoms pa las/ mar la lcags tshan phog pa bzhin du lhan gyis zhu bas bod kyi gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi srog snying phul nas dam la btags so/ /de nas yang gtsang gi gtsang po la sdong po'i gru la rgal te/ stod lung dong par byon pa dang / slob dpon gyis gro bzhes byed ran 'dug pas/ blon pos grab gyis shig gsungs pa la blon pos chu mi 'dug pas ci drag zhus pas/ khyed rang chu zer cig gsungs te mthu dang nus pa phul du byung ba'i rtags kyis phyag 'khar brag la rgyab pas chu ci 'dod byung nas bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub ste ding sang gi bar du yang gzhong pa'i lha chu zhes kun la grags pa 'di yin no/ /de nas mkha' la brag ring du dgung zhag gcig bzhugs nas bod kyi btsan thams cad dam la btags so/ /de nas zam phug tu bzhugs te bdud thams cad dam la btags so/ /de nas g.yag ri rong du bzhugs te bod kyi rgyal po dang 'gong po thams cad dam la btags so/ /de nas has po ri dang nye bar byon pa'i tshe/ bod kyi btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsu ba mdzad de/ rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la/ nga bod kyi mgo nag gi rje yin pas nga la phyag 'tshal snyam/ slob dpon gyi thugs dgongs la/ nga grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa slob dpon du spyan drangs pa yin pas/ nga la phyag byed de 'ong snyam nas phyag la ma bzlum mo/ /der slob dpon gyis nga che nga btsun gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khams gsum sems can 'chi la skrag /yo ga tshe yi rig 'dzin grub/ /nga 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/

/rdo rje tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa bdog /skye 'chi med pa'i sku thob pas/ /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /nga rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /khams gsum dbang sdud kyi gdams ngag bdog /snang srid 'khor 'das kyi dpe cha la/ /drang don nges don gyi bshad pa byed/ /nga dge bshes pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor 'das shan 'byed kyi gdams ngag bdog /sems nyid kyi shog bu snal ma la/ /tshig dang bral ba'i yi ge bris/ /nga yig mkhan pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /chos yi ge med pa'i gdams ngag bdog /'di ltar snang ba'i gyang logs la/ /gnyis su med pa'i lha ris byas/ /nga lha bzo pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /snang stong 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag bdog /mi dug lnga'i nad kyis nyen pa la/ /zag med sman gyis gso bar byed/ /nga sman pa pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /bdud rtsi chos kyi gdams ngag bdog /dad pa che ba'i mdun gros kyang / /mi tshe gtan gyi mdun ma byas/ /nga gtso bo pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor ba rtsad gcod kyi gdams ngag bdog /shes rab snying rje'i mtshon thogs nas/ /nyon mongs log pa'i dgra bo btul/ /nga dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /'khor ba ru bzlog gi gdams ngag bdog /dug lnga'i gdon lnga dgrar lang na/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bor grub/ /nga mthu chen pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /dug lnga rtsad gcod kyi gdams ngag bdog /khyod gdong dmar srin po bod kyi rje/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i khengs sems can/ /nga rgyal 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /bod kyi mnga' bdag ma lags sam/ /khyed mnga' thang che ba glo ba dga'/ /rgyal po nyid la phyag mi 'tshal/ /rgyal po'i na bza' la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs nas thal mo ya gcig dengs mdzad nas phyag g.yas kyis btsal bas/ rgyal po'i na bza' la me lhab kyis 'bar ma thag rgyal po 'khor bcas shin tu 'gyod de/ phyag dbu thod bud bud du btsal nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te/

dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma 'byung gnas khyed lta bu la phyag ma btsal ba sogs/ bdag cag ma rig mun pas bsgribs pas sgo gsum gyi sdig pa tshabs po che 'di ltar bgyis pa lags/ nga ni gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags dgos na/ thabs ji ltar byas na legs bka' stsal du gsol zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rdo'i mchod rten lnga rang byon dang khyad par med pa bzo khyad shin tu thon pa nyi ma gcig la grub par byas na phan yon shin tu che'o gsungs pas/ rgyal pos 'o na bzo bo ji ltar drag zhus pas/ zas kyi grab gyis bzo bo rnams sleb yong ba yod gsungs ma thag bal po rdo bzo ba lnga dkrong gis sleb byung bas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' ste zas gos gya noms sa tshim par byas la bzhengs lugs ji ltar 'gab slob dpon la zhus pas/ nged rang yon mchod rnams lugs gnyis gang byed kyang thog mar tshe sring ba 'di rang gal che bas tshe ring mchod rten bzhengs dgos te/ de la bzo khyad ci 'dra zhig dgos na/ mchod rten gyi bum ldir gyi ldan la tshe'i bum pa rang byon gyi tshul du yod pa cig dgos gsungs nas/ tshe chu der sbed pa'i cho ga mdzad pa la brten nas da lta'i bar du yang bum pa'i gzugs kun gyis mthong bar yod do/ /de nas rang re rnams tshe ring ba'i dgos pa dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa cig nyams su len dgos pas chos gter mchod rten bsgrub bo/ /de la bzo khyad ji ltar dgos na/ brag ri pu ti gzings pa 'dra ba'i steng du dgos gsungs pa'i brag pu ti 'dra ba yang da lta kun gyis mthong bar yod do/ /de'i rjes su rang re rnams dam pa'i chos byed pa la bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog dgos pas na/ bdud 'dul mchod rten bya ste/ de la bzo khyad ji lta bu zhig yod na/ brag ro bsgongs pa 'dra ba'i steng du rgyag dgos gsungs pa'i brag de yang kun gyis mthong bar yod do/

/de nas rang re rnams dam pa'i chos la bar chad med par byas nas/ gsang sngags pa 'dod yon lam du byed pa la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dgos pa na/ longs spyod mchod rten bsgrub ste/ de'i bzo khyad ni nor gzhong du nor bu bzhag pa'am/ gtor gzhong du gtor ma bzhag pa lta bu dgos gsungs pa'i/ brag gzhong pa 'dra ba'ang da lta kun gyis mthong bar yod do/ /de nas rang re rnams rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa zhig dgos pas na/ dngos grub mchod rten bzhengs par bya ste/ de'i bzo khyad ni brag nor bu mig gsum mam/ rin po che spungs pa 'dra ba'i steng du dgos pas/ brag nor bu 'dra ba'ang da lta kun gyis mthong bar yod cing / mchod rten rnams kyang bzo khyad phul du byung ba rgya gar lugs kho na'i ngos byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba dang bcas da lta'i bar du yang kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas su bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /de ltar rgyal pos rdo mchod rnams bzhengs pa'i dus/ ra rdzi gcig gis shin tu ngo mtshar skyes te/ nga rang yang 'di lta bu'i mchod rten zhig 'grub na snyam ra dkar mo'i 'o mas brdzis pa'i sa phag gi mchod rten phru gang zhig bzhengs te dkar rtsi sgran pas/ slob dpon rin po ches khyed kyi 'di lta bu byas pa shin tu ngo mtshar bas/ 'di la ngo mtshar mchod rten du ming thogs gsungs pa'ang deng sang gi bar du yod do/ de nas slob dpon rin po ches rab gnas dang bkra shis mnga' gsol la sogs pa legs par mdzad rjes bzo bo lnga po yang mchod rten so so la thim zhing / bzo chas rnams gter du bzhugs pa'i brag zangs mo che kha sbub pa 'dra ba da lta yang yod do/ /'di lta bu'i rdo mchod bzhengs tshul gyi lo rgyus khyad par can 'di rnams gzhan du gsal ba zhig ma mthong yang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung las/

lo rgyus 'di rnams sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun yin pa'i tshul mdzad nas gsungs kyang / don la sngags 'chang nyid rang bai ro tsa na'i sku'i sprul pa yin par gdon mi za bas/ sngon gyi skye ba dran pa'i rnam par thar pa yin nges su 'dug ces bdag gi bla ma 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can gyi gsung las yang yang thos so/ /de nas slob dpon pho brang du spyan drangs nas gser gyi khri la bzhugs nas/ zhal skyems dang / bshos dang / 'jig rten gyi spyan gzigs sna tshogs drangs/ za 'og gi smug ber sku la gsol nas bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal pos phyag rten dang bcas pas phyag mdzad nas 'di skad zhus so/ /e ma ho/ ngo mtshar che ba thugs rje'i bdag /bdag ni srin po gdong dmar bod kyi rje/ /bod kyi mi ni 'dul dka' bas/ /dam pa chos kyi rten cig gzugs/ /slob dpon sprul pa'i skur bzhugs pas/ /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab par zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ bod kyi mnga' bdag rgyal po lags/ /bod gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'dre yul du 'dug pas/ de la klu'i gter bzhugs dgos par 'dug gsungs nas/ ma dros gzi chen la klu gter bcug cing sa bslong ba'i cho ga mdzad/ de nas pho brang has po rir byon nas chu gtor gzi'i phor pa gang la ting nge 'dzin gyis rgya bskyed nas slob dpon gyis lha 'dre zil gnon gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /hūm̐ nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas te/ /mngal gyis ma gos mtsho skyes rdo rje yin/ /nga la gnod pas mi tshugs tshe'i rigs 'dzin brnyes/ /lus ngag yid gsum lha ru gsal ba'i dregs pa zil gyis gnon/ /lha 'dre'i rtog 'dzin chod pas 'jigs pas sdig tu med/ /nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lha srin sde brgyad shong yang shong / /shong yang shong ste yangs yang yangs/ /sems nyid stong pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lha yang med de 'dre yang med/

/nga la cho 'phrul ci bstan yang / /nga la g.yo ba rdul tsam med/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma chen po 'di/ /mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed/ /so sor thob pa sngags kyis byas/ /phyag rgyas 'pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med/ /tshig bshad bden pas bkrol te bsngo/ /'di khyer sa gzhi gnang ba sbyin/ /khri srong lde'u btsan bsam pa sgrubs/ /lha khang rtsigs shig lha 'dre kun/ /sngags 'chang nga yi bka' ma bcag /gum gum chum chum las la 'dus/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lha 'dre dregs pa can thams cad kyis rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas dam la btags so/ /de'i dus su bai ro'i thang lha yar zhud bya ba de ma 'dus nas/ der slob dpon gyis thang lha'i rtsar byon pa dang / khos slob dpon la thog rgyab pas/ slob dpon gyi dbu zhwa'i steng du sol ba'i dum bu gcig tu song ngo / /der slob dpon gyis yar la thog 'phangs pas/ gangs kyi rtse mo zhud por song bas/ thang la yar zhud du grags so/ /de nas chab gtor te bka' 'og tu 'dus so/ /de nas sma chen spom ra kho 'ong du ma 'dod de/ der slob dpon gyi lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas snying nas bzung zhing bkug pas/ kho rkang pa ya gcig khams kyi g.yar mo thang du bzhag ya gcig pho brang has po ri la bzhag nas bdag g.yar khams che ba cig lags na'ang / ban chung khyod kyi bka' nan ches pas/ nga mi 'ong ba'i dbang ma byung bas 'dir 'ongs pa yin/ da bka' ci stsal zer ba la/ der slob dpon gyis gtor ma 'di khyer la mnga' bdag gi dgongs pa sgrubs shig gsungs pas/ yang kho na re/ bka' bstsal pa bzhin byed dgos na bdag skam chas la dga' bas nga la skam chas cig zhu zer nas/ der snod dkar po cig gi nang du rin po che brdar te byin gyis brlabs nas byin zhing dam la btags so/ /de nas klu ma dros gzi chen dang / yar la sham po dang / sma chen spom ra dang / mgyogs chen ldong ra dang / byang la btsun mo che dang /

lha 'od lde gung rgyal dang / bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas tshar bcad cing rjes su bzung ste khams gsum zil gyis gnon par mdzad pa'i sgo nas 'dul bar mdzad pa de dag gis ni bar du sde brgyad gdug pa can gang ltar btul tshul rnams legs par brjod zin nas/ da ni mthar bsam yas kyi sa 'dul dang rab gnas ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de nas slob dpon rin po ches gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs sar byon te/ rtsig pa'i gseb tu bzlas yungs gtor bas me 'bar ro/ /de nas yang rgyal po dpe dkar 'di klu tsha za ma ti bya ba yin pas/ sa gzhi thams cad zhang po klus dbang ba la/ mis 'phrog pa 'di ma phod nas/ 'khor the rang stong sde bshig tu btang pas/ der phyin pa na me 'bar nas bshig ma thub par log byung ste/ rje ci lags/ bshig pa'i glags mi gda'/ 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar/ tsha tsha skar ltar 'phrug cing gda' zer ro/ /der 'gong po spun dgus bshig tu phyin pas kyang me 'bar te dpe dkar la sngar ltar zer ro/ /der dpe dkar rang gis phyin pas kyang me 'bar te bshig ma thub nas/ 'di cis lan snyam du bsam pa dang / de ring gi mon bu a tsa ra de yin thag chod pas sngags ci bzla'i yod dam snyams nyan du phyin pas/ slob dpon gyis mkhyen te nyan pa'i rna ba la phur pa gcig btab pas rna ba 'on/ yang rdzas dang rten 'brel sogs ji ltar byed blta bar phyin te bltas pa'i tshe/ de yang mkhyen nas mig la phur pa gcig btab pas mig longs/ de nas mgyogs par bros 'gro dgos snyams pas/ de yang mkhyen te rkang pa la phur pa gcig btab pas rkang pa zha nas der 'gong po spun dgus khyogs la btegs nas ngu rdzi di ri ri song ngo / /de nas khos zhang po klu la sa gzhi thams cad ni mon bu a tsa ras 'phrogs/ nga'ang 'di ltar btang na da khyed sdod dam byas pas/

klu rnams la dbang ma dros pa che bas/ nged kyi ni kha sing du sa gzhi dang srog snying phul ba yin pas/ da khyod rang yang skyabs su song zer te/ der rgyal po dpe dkar gyis kyang srog snying phul nas g.yog tu khas blangs so/ /'di skabs kyi dpe dkar de ni rgyal 'gong dpe dkar yin gyis/ rgyal po chen po dpe ha rar grags pa'i chos skyong chen po 'di ni ma yin pa'i tshul/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin/ dus phyis kho bo cag gi lag tu bsam yas nas byung ba'i gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud ces bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin rgyal po'i bka' dri ma med pa'i rgyud chung gi dpe rnying ma zhib tu bltas pas kyang yid ches khyad par can rnyed pa yin te/ de yang rgyud chung de nyid las chos skyong chen po de nyid kyi 'byung tshul 'di ltar 'byung ste/ chos skyong chen po gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rtsi'u dmar po 'di ni/ sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul nas dbang bskur zhing dam la btags te rgyud kyang gsungs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs zhing dam bcas pa yin la/ de nas rgyud chung de nyid rgya gar gyi dur khrod me 'bar gyi gnya' ri dmar nag zur gsum gyi mdun/ srin mtsho khol ma me lce rigs kyi 'gram brag dmar srin po lang 'dra'i gnas su gter du sbas pa las/ dus phyis gnas der slob dpon pad+mas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ thog mar gnod sbyin gyis spyang ki khrag gi ral pa can dag tu sprul nas gnod pa'i tshul du bstan pa la/ slob dpon chen pos gnod sbyin rtse'u dmar gyi cho 'phrul yin par dgongs nas/

rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin brtan pos phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje phyar bas/ de ma thag spyang ki rnams rta mchog zhon pa'i skyes bu bdun du gyur nas gnod sbyin chen pos bzod gsol phyag btsal te rang gi tshul rnams zhus pa'i tshe/ slob dpon chen po thugs rab tu dges nas zab mo'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur te/ gsang ba'i mtshan du kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes bya bar btags shing / de nas sngon bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa bzhin du slar yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing skyong bar bka' bsgos zhing dam la bzhag de'i dus su rgyud chung de yang slob dpon chen pos gter nas spyan drangs shing / de phyin chad gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid slob dpon chen pos srung mar mdzad pa yin la/ de nas slob dpon bod du byon pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin 'di nyid kyi sprul pa rta mchog zhon pa'i skyes bu bdun gyis mnga' ris dpal thang nas bsu ba byas te bsam yas kyi bar du rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas 'phrin las cher bsgrubs par bshad pas/ rgyu mtshan des na/ rgyal 'gong dpe dkar de la 'dogs pa'i sngon rol du chos skyong chen po 'di nyid slob dpon chen po nyid kyi srung mar mdzad pa yin pas de gnyis don la tha dad yin pa'i tshul de ltar yin la/ ༈ /'di'i tshul rgyas par ni gnod sbyin rgyal po spu gri dmar po'i snying gi rgyud dang / de nyid kyi don rnams kho bos tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'i chos skyong chen por 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba las rtogs par bya'o/ /'o na gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rtse'u dmar po 'di nyid khro rgyal rta mgrin dang / slob dpon chen po sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba mnos pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa yin na/ gang zag so skye'i rtsa sbubs su 'jug pa mi rigs so snyam na/

de ni nges pa yod pa ma yin te/ spyir don la ye shes pa la rnam pa 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba'i btsan bdud rgyal po sogs mang du 'byung ba sa lo chen po'i gsung rab sogs tshad ldan gyi yig cha du ma las bshad pa'i phyir dang / sngon gyi dus su yang dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma dang thugs rgyud cig gis bsdus pa'i lha mo dud pa'i gsol ba can gang zag 'ga' zhig la bab nas lung bstan stsal ba'i tshe/ de dus kyi log lta can 'ga' zhig gis log rtog ngan smras bgyis pa la dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa dag gis 'di skad du/ ye shes kyi lha mi la mi 'bab/ babs pa 'di dag 'jig rten pa'o/ /zhes smra ba ni shin tu mi 'thad pa ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rdo rje shugs phab nas de la dge mi dge dri ba dang / slar gshegs su gsol ba bshad cing / gzhan yang rgyud sde nas rdo rje sems dpa' 'bebs pa'i ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga bshad pa thams cad don med par 'gyur bas so/ /zhes bshad pa ni 'thad par mngon te/ zhing skyong gi dbang po dpal dur khrod bdag po yang gang zag phal pa'i rtsa sbubs su byon nas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog gi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i tshul rje rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar las 'byung ba dang / gzhan yang de 'dra ba'i rigs can gyi lo rgyus mang du snang ba'i phyir dang / mdor na sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams ni/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa la/ gru dang gzing dang zam pa la sogs pa'i bem po'i gzugs su sprul nas kyang gzhan gyi don mdzad par bshad na/ thabs tshul gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ /des na chos skyong chen po 'di yang / don la ye shes pa yin yang rnam pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso bo'i tshul bzung nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin pa gong gi lo rgyus kyis the tshom med par gsal ba yin no/

'o na chos skyong chen po 'di'i mtshan la rgyal po dpe dkar zhes 'jig rten na grags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ de'i tshul ni spyir rgya skad du/ bi hā ra zhes pa/ bod skad du/ gtsug lag khang pa zhes pa ste de zur chag pas/ dpe dkar dang dpe har du song ba yin pa/ skad zur chag gi rnam gzhag bshad pa'i gsung rab rnams las 'byung bas na/ des na chos skyong 'di'i mtshan la rgyal po dpe dkar zhes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'jig rten gyi dregs byed kun gyi gtso bo yin pas rgyal po dang / slob dpon chen po'i gtsug lag khang gi srung mar bskos pas na/ gtsug lag khang gi ming rgya skad de de'i srung ma la thogs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon pad+mas dges bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig g.ya' ri mo dang / gangs ri mo nyi shu rtsa gcig bod kyi gnod sbyin mthu bo che dang mthu mo che thams cad dam la btags so/ /gza' chen po brgyad dang rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dbang du bsdus te/ ri rdo ri ru bzhag klung rdo klung du bzhag nas lha khang gi rmangs bting ste/ rgyal po nyid kyi dbu rtse rigs gsum ri rab kyi tshul du byas/ 'khor sa gser gyi ri bdun gyi tshul du byas/ yag sha gong 'og nyi ma dang zla ba'i tshul du byas/ gling chen bzhi/ gling chung brgyad/ bu tshal gser khang gling jo mo tshe spong bza' dmar rgyan gyis bzhengs/ khams gsum zang khang gling jo mo pho skyong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis bzhengs/ jo mo 'bro bza' byang chub 'od kyis dge rgyas bye ma gling bzhengs/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ni/ ar+ya pa lo'i gling / byams pa'i gling / 'jam dpal gling / sems skyed gling / khrims khang gling / sngags pa gling / bsam gtan gling / ye rtsa gling / tshad ma gling / sgra bsgyur gling / sna tshogs lcags khra gling / dpe dkar gling / zur bzhi mchod rten bzhi phyi lcags ris bskor ba/

phyogs bzhi na mgon khang bzhi/ sgo'i gdong na rdo rje ring bzhi/ rdo ring chen po bzhi'i steng na zangs kyi khyi chen po bzhi/ de ltar rmangs bting nas slob dpon dgongs pa la bzhugs nas lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis rtsig rogs byas pas/ ri rdo ri la bzhag pa klung du bsnyil nas nyin mo mis brtsigs pa las/ mtshan mo lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho bar gyur to/ /de nas slob dpon gyis thugs dgongs la/ ngas lha ma srin sde brgyad thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum dam la thogs sam ma thogs snyam nas dgongs pa la bzhugs te gzigs pas/ lha ma srin sde brgyad po gzhan thams cad dam la thogs nas 'dug pas/ klu 'di'i lus dam la thogs pas bsam yas rtsig gin 'dug ngag dam la thogs nas bka' nyan zer gyi 'dug yid dam la ma thogs par gnod pa sna tshogs skyel bar 'dug pas/ yid 'dul ba'i phyir du slob dpon klu 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas yod pa dang / rtsig bzo mkhan po ha shang mahā ya na dang / her pak+ṣi karma la sogs pas rtsig bzo zin nas/ shing bzo mkhan po rgya nag lang tsho he dang / bal po bha ru la sogs pas ste'u klad la bskor zhing / rgyal po shing ga na yod/ shing lag rdugs so byas pas/ der rgyal po dngangs te shing 'di tsam zhig gang nas btsal snyams te/ rgyal po 'dar yed yed byung ba de/ bu tshal gyi klu'i rig pas glags rnyed nas/ des rgyal po la bar chad byas te/ mi dkar rta dkar gcig gi cha lugs su byas nas rgyal po'i drung du 'ong nas/ rje rgyal po chen po bsam yas kyi shing dgos tshad ngas byin gyis/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dgongs pa bkrol bar zhu byas pas/ rje'i thugs la dngos grub yin snyam zhal gyis bzhes pas/ der 'o na nga rgyal pos slob dpon dgongs pa grol du mi 'jug ri mna' skyol zer nas/ der rgyal pos mna' bskyal te/ de nas mchims phu'i brag phug dge gong du slob dpon gyi spyan sngar byon pas/

slob dpon gyi sku ni mi snang la/ khyung chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug pas/ slob dpon chen po lags dgongs pa bkrol bar zhu zhus pas ma gnang ba la/ yang slob dpon dgongs pa bkrol ba zhu dngos grub chen po bdog zhus pas/ der slob dpon gyis dgongs pa bkrol ba dang / rgyal pos gong gi bka' mchid gsol bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rje mnga' bdag lags/ gtsug lag khang gi shing rang bzhin gyi 'ong ba yin te/ bdag gi klu 'di'i lus ngag gnyis ka dam la thogs yod kyang / klu 'di'i yid dam la ma thogs 'dug pas dam la btags snyam pa lags te/ da dus snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus la bab pa'i dus su/ sa gzhi klu'i dbang byed/ nad du mdze rigs bco brgyad dar ba cig 'ong / mthar thug mi'i khang pa thams cad klu'i 'dzin pa zhig 'ong bas thams cad kyang 'jigs pa ste/ sa thams cad sa 'og gi klus khang ste dbang byed pa cig 'ong ngo gsungs so/ /de nas mnga' bdag gis mar byon pa na/ klu'i gtsang po la shing rnams bskur te/ bsam yas la nag mer gyis chags so/ /de nas de'i lo la rgyal po'i lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhes pa la rmangs bting nas brtsigs pas/ rta lo la ljongs dbu rtse rigs gsum gling phran bcu gnyis/ khyad par gling bzhi ste bcu drug rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la ji ltar bsam pa bzhin grub pas/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon pad+mas lug gi lo la nyi ma 'od zer gyi skur bstan nas rab gnas mdzad pas/ byin rlabs ngo mtshar can drug byung ste/ byang chub gling gi dpal rnam par snang mdzad nam mkha' la 'phar ba dang / dbu rtse'i lha thams cad phyir shar gyis 'thon 'byung ba dang / de nas rje'i thugs la nang du mi tshud snyam pa byung ba dang / skad cig la nang du tshud pa dang / dbus kyi rdo ring gi steng na zangs kyi khyi mo che ba bzhi yod pas phyogs bzhir mchong skad bzhi 'don pa dang /

'khor sa'i smyug ma rnams ma btab par dus gcig la shed kyis skyes pa dang drug byung ngo / /de ltar dpal gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po legs par bzhengs shing bkra shis mnga' gsol la sogs pa mdzad pa'i rjes su/ mdo dang gsang sngags gsar rnying gi bstan pa la sogs pa nyi ma shar ba ltar ches cher rgyas par gyur cing / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che shin tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa sogs/ mdor na chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dgongs pa'i bzhed don thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrubs par mdzad pa yin no/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ byang phyogs rgyal po'i don la byon pa'i tshe/ /bod kyi gnod sbyin thams cad dam la btags/ /bsam yas mnga' gsol rgyal po'i dgongs pa bsgrubs/ /bod yul thams cad chos kyis gang bar mdzad/ /nyi ma 'od zer sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de nas slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas mchims bu'i gnas mchog brag dmar skye tshang zhes bya ba'i brag phug tu/ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab mo nang gi rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang brnyes pa sogs 'bras bu'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa ste bka' drin bsam pa'i rwa ba las 'das pa yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ bsam yas mchims bu'i brag dmar skye tshang du/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad gsang sngags dkyil 'khor du/ /las can rgyal po rje 'bangs smin mdzad cing / /gsang sngags 'bras bu'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ /bka' drin bsam las 'das la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga ni/ chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ grub chen nam mkha'i snying po/

slob dpon bai ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes/ 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes/ rgyal po g.yu dra snying po/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ sngags 'chang rdo rje bdud 'joms/ slob dpon ye shes dbyangs/ sog po lha dpal/ sna rnam ye shes zhang / shud bu dpal gyi rdo rje/ ldan ma rtse mang / ka ba dpal brtsegs/ shud bu dpal gyi seṅge/ ngam rgyal ba'i blo gros/ khye'u chung lo hi/ dran pa nam mkha'/ 'od dran dbang phyug rma thog rin chen/ dpal gyi dbang phyug rgyal ba byang chub/ lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon mchog 'byung gnas te skyes bu dam pa de rnams thams cad kyis bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag thams cad kyi nyams len phul du phyin pa mdzad pa la brten nas/ nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la chibs zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i grub pa'i rtags bstan tshul sogs ni so so'i rnam thar rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin shes par bya zhing / gzhan yang skal ldan gyi slob ma mchog dman du ma zhig smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis spa gro stag tshang seṅge bsam grub kyi phug par byon te/ gdug pa can gyi bdud dang mu stegs dang dam sri la sogs pa'i ma rungs pa rnams 'dul bar mdzad cing / gnas chen khyad par du 'phags pa gangs te se la sogs pa gangs ri'i rigs dang / yar lung shel brag la sogs pa brag ri'i rigs rnams su chos gter nor gter la sogs pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i gter rnams ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung ba'i phyir sba bar mdzad cing / ma rungs pa rnams tshar bcad de mtshan yang rdo rje gro lod du grags so/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ stag tshang seṅge bsam grub skye tshang du/ gdug pa'i bdud dang mu stegs dam sri btul/ /gnas chen gangs brag rnams la gter chen sbas/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i sems can thugs rje'i gzigs/

/rdo rje gro lod rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /da nas slob dpon rin po ches sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas rnams kyi ngos 'dzin cung zad brjod na/ gsol 'debs dang bstun pa'i gnas ni/ sta ko btsan gyi gangs/ sham bu lha yi gangs/ bu le klu yi gangs/ gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin gyi gangs te gangs chen bzhi dang / bsam yas mchims bu'i brag phug sgrags kyi yang rdzong gi brag phug yar lung shel gyi brag phug mkhar chu phug ring gi brag phug yer ba zla ba'i brag phug rgyang gi yon po lung gi brag phug chu bo ri dpal gyi brag phug shams po gangs 'dab kyi brag phug ste brag phug chen po brgyad yin la/ gangs te se'i phyogs bzhi'i brag la slob dpon rin po che'i zhabs rjes re re yod pa dang / grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi ni/ pre ta gnam mtsho/ lha mtsho srin mtsho/ gnam mtsho phyug mo/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho ste de rnams la phyag rjes re re 'jog par mdzad pa sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong bar mdzad pa la sogs pa smin grol gyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ bod kyi gangs chen bzhi la yang dben mdzad/ /brag phug chen po brgyad la sgrub khang mdzad/ /phyogs bzhi'i brag la sprul sku'i zhabs rjes bzhag /grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la phyag rjes bzhag /'gro drug sgrib sbyong mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang lho phyogs mon kha'i brag ste bum thang gi brag la rdo rje'i sku'i rjes gsal por yod par bshad cing / sku tshab gter lnga la sogs pa bod kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi don du legs par 'jog par mdzad pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mthar phyin du rgyas par mdzad pa de rnams ni/ bod kyi lha gcig la sogs pa 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du mngon par mtho zhing / thugs rje khyad par can gyi sgo nas rjes su bzung ba yin no/

/de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ lho phyogs mon kha'i brag la sku rjes bzhag /sku tshab gter lnga bod kyi don du sbas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' ru chub par mdzad/ /bod kyi lha gcig 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal/ /thugs rje khyad par can la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de nas slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis bod kyi 'gro ba rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos kun nas blangs te/ srin po rnams kyi kha gnon du 'byon par mdzad pa las/ lha sras mu khri btsan po la sogs pa rnams kyis skyel thung mdzad cing / zhal gdams gnang ba'i lo rgyus la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa rnams ni bdag gi bla ma 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa sogs thang yig rgyas pa rnams su blta bar bya zhing / 'dir ni 'grel chen 'bum nag gi dngos bstan ji lta ba bzhin brjod na/ slob dpon rin po che lho nub rnga yab gling phran du 'byon par dgongs pa bstad pa'i tshe/ ngam 'dre gsal le/ cog ro bza' dpal gyi mchod gnas ma/ mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal dang gsum gyis slob dpon gyi phyag phyi byas nas 'brangs/ zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams mar log gsungs pas/ ngos cag phyag phyir 'brang zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ nga gnam la bya ltar 'phur nas 'gro na khyed kyis 'ong ngam/ sa la byi ltar 'dzul nas 'gro na khyed kyis 'ong ngam/ chu la nya ltar 'phyos nas 'gro na khyed kyis 'ong ngam/ nga lho nub srin po'i kha gnon la 'gro ba yin gsung ngo / /'o na bdag cag rnams la yang dag pa'i gdams ngag cig zhu byas pas/ de la dbang bskur dgos gsungs/ 'o na dbang yang bskur ba zhu byas pas/ de ma thag tu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gsungs pa dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsum dngos su byung ngo / /der slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyed rnams ye shes kyi lha la dbang zhu'am/

nga la zhu gsungs/ der cog ro bza' na re/ slob dpon las bka' gnyan zhing drin che bar ma mchis kyang / ye shes kyi lha dngos su byon pa 'di la bdag ni ye shes kyi lha la dbang zhu zer/ mkhar chen bza' na re/ ye shes kyi lha dngos su byon yang slob dpon gyis cho 'phrul lags pas/ bdag ni slob dpon la zhu zer/ ngam 'dre na re/ slob dpon gyis thugs dgongs dang sbyar ba zhig zhu zer/ der slob dpon gyis saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ byas te dkyil 'khor gsum thugs khar bsdus pas/ cog ro bza' la dbang bskur mkhan ma byung ste/ phyis bon stabs su bshad gyer la sogs pa spros pa ches che/ mthu ni byung bkra shis/ phur pa lce lugs bya bar grags so/ /de nas mkhar chen bza' dang ngam 'dre gnyis ka la slob dpon gyis dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur/ dbang chos zhu ba'i skabs su mkhar chen bza zhu don bzhi zhus pa ni ngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di blo dman pas tshig nyung la don 'grel ba cig zhu/ ngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di nyon mongs pa che bas nyon mongs pa 'dul ba cig zhu/ ngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di bya ba che bas sgrub thag nye ba'i chos cig zhu/ ngos cag bud med kyi lus 'di kha zhan pas mthu che ba'i chos cig zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon dang po chos zhu ba la mnyes/ de nas gdams pa zhu ba la mnyes te/ der sgrub sde chen po brgyad la thugs dgongs gtad pas/ de bzhi phur pa rtsa ba 'di la tshang 'dug par dgongs nas/ slob dpon gyis zhal nas/ gsang sngags zab mo 'di chig brgyud yin pas ngas khyod la bshad kyis/ khyod kyis ngam 'dre la shod gsungs shing gdams pa rnams legs par gnang ba yin la/ de lta bu'i slob dpon chen po de nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi smin grol yongs su rdzogs par mnos nas/ grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i lam srol 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni/

'khon ston lo tsā ba chen po klu'i dbang po srung ba nyid yin zhing / de nas brgyud pa'i phur pa sa lugs su grags pa ni da lta'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /de ltar slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas 'di'i de skabs kyi gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad nas/ de nas spa gro stag tshang seṅge phug nas/ tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma la kha na gzer ba la chod kyis gshegs pa la/ rjes su dris pas/ bal yul du'ang nyi ma la kha ru gzer ba la byon gda' skad/ der bal mo shākyas 'bras skyems dang / bu ram gyi zhal zas drangs/ dar man gyi na bza' phul nas bzhugs par zhu phul kyang ma gnang bar/ rnga yab gling du srin po 'dul du gshegs nas/ lho nub rnga yab gling phran dpal gyi ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen po der/ lo brgya brgya lon pa nas khyi'u lo brgyad pa rer gyur te/ yang dge tshul/ dge slong / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa la sogs pa rnams rim gyis mnos te rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rgyal po dam pa mdzad cing sha khrag kho na'i bza' btung la longs spyod pa'i srin po pho mo thams cad dam la btags te bod yul gyi sems can rnams la gnod pa skad cig kyang mi byed par bka' bsgo ba mdzad pa sogs thugs rje chen pos rgyun mi chad par gzigs pa ste/ de lta bu'i bka' drin can gyi sprul pa'i skur rgyun mi chad par bzhugs pa yin no/ /de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ lho nub rnga yab gling phran dpal ri'i rtser/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mang po'i rgyal po mdzad/ /sha za srin po thams cad dam la btags/ /bod la rgyun chad med par thugs rjes gzigs/ /drin can sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de ltar dus tha ma lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dus kyi skabs 'dir bod kyi sems can thams cad kyis las ngan bsags pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu sdug bsngal rgyun chad med par myong ba 'di'i dus su slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la khyed shes khyed mkhyen gyi sgo nas rnam par thar pa rnams yid la dran zhing /

gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba yang yang du btab pa la brten nas/ bdag cag gis gtso byas 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs te byin gyis brlabs pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba the tshom dang som nyi med cing yid brtan thob pa kho na yin te/ de dag ni gsol 'debs las/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no// ༈ //de dag gis ni brgyud pa gsum gyi nang nas/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa byung ba'i tshul/ sprul pa'i sku rigs gsum mgon pos lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang mi'i yul gyi 'gro ba rnams rig 'dzin gyi sa la 'god par mdzad pa dang sbyar te gleng gzhi gsum gyi nang nas gu ru'i gleng gzhi slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa mdo tsam bstan zin pa yin la/ de lta bu'i rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul dgos don bsdus pa'i tshul gyis ston pa la/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes 'cham bshad gsal ba'i me long las/ de rnams kyi nang nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis zab mo lta ba'i phyogs lha'i yul du gsungs zhing rgyas par mdzad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sgrub pa zab mo'i gnad rnams klu'i yul du gsungs zhing rgyas par mdzad/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes drag shul mngon spyod kyi las rnams gnod sbyin gyis yul dang mi'i yul du gsungs nas shar phyogs za hor gyi rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad/ des mkhas pa mi gsum la bshad/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ yul dbus kyi slob dpon bi mā la mi tra/ bal po'i slob dpon shī la mañju rnams kyis bod kyi lo tsā ba gnyags dz+nyā na ku ma ra dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba la sogs pa la rim pas gsungs te/

de rnams rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa yin par gda'/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab thugs rje dang / /mthu rtsal gcig bsdus rigs gsum mgon po yis/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin mi yul du/ /gsang sngags spel ba'i rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs/ 1 /mang du byon cing khyad par gangs khrod 'dir/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'byung ba'i rtsa lag mchog /pad+ma 'byung gnas gang gi ngo mtshar gyi/ /rnam par thar pa de dag legs soms la/ 2 /skal bzang mang thos kho bo'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /skal bzang mi phyed dad pas gsol ba thob/ /skal bzang rmad byung brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog /skal bzang rnams kyi byin rlabs bzhugs par nges/ 3 /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni de lta bu'i slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid la lhag pa'i lha mchog bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal dngos su bstan cing / byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul dang sbyar te/ gleng gzhi gsum gyi nang nas ston pa'i gleng gzhi bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu byon pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ de yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas de la/ sku'i sgo nas zhal dngos su bstan cing / gsung gi sgo nas phur pa'i rgyud rnams bka' stsal la/ thugs kyi sgo nas dbyings rig dbyer med rang ngo sprad pa'i sgo nas ji snyed pa'i shes bya thams cad la ye shes rgyas par mdzad pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu de nyid byon pa'i tshul ji lta bu yin zhe na/ de'i tshul ston pa la gsum ste/ gdul bya ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ 'dul bya gang gis btul ba'i tshul/ 'dul thabs ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ karma he ru kas khrag 'thung chen po la zhus pa/ srin po ru tra gdug pa 'di/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni ci las byung / /'bras bu gang du smin par 'gyur/

/las bskal spyod pa cig zhig byed/ /ma btul ba yi skyon ni ci/ /btul na yon tan ci zhig thob/ /ces zhus pa las/ khrag 'thung rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ /log pa'i sems can chen po 'di/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu las byung / /rkyen ni bla ma spangs pa 'o/ /'bras bu nyon mongs lnga ru smin/ /las bskal chags sdang spyod la zhen/ /ma btul lha mi'i srid pa brlag /sangs rgyas zhing yang stong par gyur/ /btul na yon tan dpag med de/ /dug gsum rtsad gcod 'khor dong dkrug /ces gsungs pa ltar rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa'i rgyud las kyang bshad do/ /de'i don mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ sngon 'das pa'i dus bskal pa kun nas bkod pa zhes bya ba la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i bstan pa'i dus su/ khyim bdag ke'u ka'i bu thar pa nag po zhes bya ba/ g.yog ngan bag ces bya ba zhig yod do/ /de'i dus su dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu zhes bya ba/ sku nyan thos/ gsung mdo sde/ thugs gsang sngags la spyod pa cig byung ngo / /thar pa nag pos dge slong gi drung du phyin te smras pa/ nyon mongs lnga ma spangs par spyad pas grol ba'i chos zhig yod dam med byas pa la/ dge slong gi gsang sngags la dgongs te yod du rung byas pas der thar nag na re/ kho bo khyod kyi rjes su 'brang zer ro/ /de nas g.yog dan bag khrid de zhus pas/ dge slong gis smras pa/ ji ltar de nyid ma bcos na/ /dngos po bzhi la spyad byas kyang / /nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin te/ /'di ni rnal 'byor dam pa'i lam/ /zhes bshad pas/ dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin ma shes te/ thar nag gis gsang sngags sgra ji bzhin par sbyang ngo / /g.yog dan bag gi dgongs pa can du sbyang ngo / /thar nag la khyod kyi de nor ro byas pas/ 'o na nged rang gnyis bla ma la thug tu 'gro zer te thug pas/ dge slong thub dka' gzhon nus dgongs pa can no byas pas thar nag khros te/

dge slong thub dka' yul phyung zhing 'tsho ba rnams 'phrogs so/ /de nas kho rang gi dngos po bzhi la spyad pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pas/ de'i skye ba phyi ma la spyang kir lan lnga brgya skyes so/ /de'i phyi ma la 'phar ba lag sdeb dang / lcags spyang sngon po dang / gcan gzan rnams su lan lnga brgya lnga brgyar skyes so/ /kho rang yang gnyen po re res bsad do/ /de nas 'bu sbur dang / yi dwags dang / dmyal ba rnams su skyes shing rgyud sbyang ngo / /de nas mjug tu ri ma la ya'i drung du smad 'tshong ma kun tu rgyu zhes bya ba srod la lha dang 'grogs/ nam gung bdud dang 'grogs/ tho rang btsan dang 'grogs pa cig gi bur skyes so/ /de ltar pha gsum la ltos pas bu yang gdong pa gsum du yod pa'i g.yas dkar po/ g.yon dmar po/ dbus mthing nag tu yod pa'o/ /lag pa yang drug ste/ der kho yan lag rags pas ma de bu skye 'phror shi bas/ mi rnams kyis ma'i ro dang bu gnyis ka dur khrod du sbas so/ /de nas bu des ro'i 'o ma 'thung / de nas chu ser 'jibs/ de nas nu ma zos pas/ zhag bdun bdun phyid do/ /de nas brang phug ste glo snying zos/ de nas phyi sha zos/ de nas ma'i sha zad pa dang / 'gog shes par song nas/ ro khang bsgyel te phyir 'thon la/ ro gzhan zos pas lus la spu khab 'dra ba skyes/ sder sen lcags kyu 'dra ba byung / rgyab nas gshog pa skyes te 'phur shes pas steng 'og thams cad kyi sems can thams cad bsad nas zos so/ /ru tra ma tra ru ma tra zer zhing nga las dbang che ba su yod zer ba la/ dus mtshan mas/ lha'i rgyal po ma hraṃ ka ru ṇa zhes bya ba yod byas pas/ der phyin te kha nas me dbal btang nas bsad do/ /de'i chung ma'ang 'phrogs nas lha ma srin sde brgyad dang / sidha ke ri phyogs skyong bcu/ dbang phyug ma thams cad dbang du bsdus so/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad log lta skyes te/

rgyud las/ bdag nyid chen po rtag pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab la/ /'gro ba'i tshul du sngon byung ba/ /de'i tshe sems can thams cad ni/ /'o dod 'bod cing ltung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag gis ni gdul bya khyad par can bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa 'dul byed khyad par can ji ltar byung ba ni/ de'i tshe karma he ru kas dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bskul nas/ 'og min du bka' bgros te sems can thams cad kyi don du ru tra 'dul bar byas pa las/ ru tra de bam ril thod mkhar gyi nang na bam chen gyi steng du srin mo kro dhi shwa ri dang 'dod pa la rol zhing / bdud dang srin po lha ma srin gyis bskor ba'i phyi na rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dang / keng rus kyi ri rab kyis bskor yod pa las/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi sprin dmar nag tu gtibs/ thugs rje chen po'i 'brug sgra bsgrags/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'phyar te/ 'phrin las bzhi'i dang po zhi bas 'dul bar dgongs te/ sprul sku dbu zlum zhabs brjen/ lhung bzed dang / seg shang can mang du sprul nas byon pas/ thar nag na re/ go'u ta ma khyod rang gi dka' thub la nos cig ltogs na zho zo/ skom na chu grang 'thung zer se gol gtogs nas song ngo / /'od srung ser thub rnams kyang 'gre'o/ /yang bud+dha rnams kyis bka' bgros pa/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi ba'i phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo la/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun mdzod/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag bsreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ /zhes bud+dha thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bka' bgros te/ rdo rje rta'i tshogs la bka' bsgo ba/ song song 'jig rten na srin po 'khor bcas kyis sems can gyi liṅga byed pa thul cig

ces bsgos pas/ rta'i dbyangs sgrog cing song bas 'khor tsho bred do/ /ru tra rang na re/ mgrin bu ltogs na ri gsum gyi rtswa zo/ skom na lung gsum gyi chu 'thung zer ba la/ rdo rje rtas rta bro byas pas/ ru tras khyur mid du mid do/ /rta mgrin gyi lus brgyangs pas skad ngan shor te rta mgrin gyi rta mgo spyi bo nas bton no/ /de nas gshin rje gshed btang pas/ ru tra na re/ gsus po che sems khral bskyungs zer ro/ /de ltar khro bo rim gyis btang pas ma thul ba de dag gis ni 'dul byed khyad par can bstan zin nas/ gsum pa 'dul thabs khyad par can ni/ yang dus gsum gyi bud+dha thams cad bka' bgros nas/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed la dgongs bzhin pas/ da thabs kyis 'dul dgos dgongs te/ bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje rta'i tshogs la ru tra 'khor bcas ling la song ba'i bar du/ ri ma la yar so tshugs shig ces bsgos nas/ yum bzhi dang bcas te so btsugs so/ /ru tra'i pho brang thod mkhar gyi nang du/ bam chen gyi steng na srin mo kro dhi shwa ri yod pa las/ dus gsum gyi bud+dha thams cad kyi sprul pa gcig tu bsdus te/ ru tra thar pa nag por sprul te/ srin mo kro dhi shwa ri can du byon pas/ sgeg pa dpa' bo byon nam zer te/ 'khor ba smin pa'i dung phor du/ nyon mongs pa'i gar chang gis bkangs nas drangs pas/ de gsol bar ma zad gzhan yang rak+ta'i rgya mtsho yang 'thung / sha chen gyis lang ling yang zas/ rus chen gyi khram khrom yang 'chos so/ /de nas srin mos ltas pas rang gi khyo bas bzhin bzang bar mthong ste the tshom skyes pa na/ sprul pa'i sku des srin skad bsgrags pas yid ches te/ ma chags thabs kyi sbyor ba mdzad nas/ srin mo'i lhums su zla dkyil la byang sems hūm̐ gi rnam par phab ste bzhag go /gzhan yang sprul pa bkye nas dbang phyug ma/ si dang / byi mo thams cad la sbyor ba byas te bzhag go

/sprul pa des srin mo pa'i rgya mtsho la chags pa'i tshul bstan nas cung zad yengs pa na/ rdo rje rta'i tshogs kyi ru tra 'ong ba'i mtshan ma mthong ste/ rdo rje rta'i 'dur glu sgrags pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa de dbyings kyi ngang du mi dmigs par gyur te/ de nas srin po ru tras rang gi gnas su 'ong pas/ nyams mi dga' zhing skyi g.ya' nas 'jigs te smras pa/ e ma nga'i khyim du su 'ongs zhes smras pas/ srin mos bsus nas sgeg pa dpa' ba de lta bu'i tshig ngan pa ma gsung cig khyod kyi dgongs pa bdag gis bsgrub ste/ lhums na'ang gdung 'tshob par mchis so zhes brjod pas/ kho yid ches te chags pa'i sbyor ba byas so/ /de nas zla ba rim gyis tshang ba dang / 'khor gtum mo dang srin mo rnams la'ang / phag gi mgo can dang dom gyi mgo can la sogs pa'i ltas ngan mang po skyes/ ru tras srin mo kro dhi shwa ri la bu ston byas pas bstan byung ba na/ rdo rje gzhon nu dbu gsum phyag drug pa rdo rje'i shog pas bar snang khyab pa/ kī la ya'i sgra sgrogs pa dang bcas pa skyes 'dug pas/ ru tra 'khor dang bcas pa rnams brgyal nas 'gyel bar gyur to/ /kha nas khrag skyugs so/ de skad du/ rdo rje khros pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ khro chen rab tu khros pa mthong ba yis/ /skad cig tsam la ru tra dngangs shing skrag /phyogs bcu kun tu 'bros pa'i tshul yang bstan/ /sdug bsngal chen po de yi dus su myongs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas brgyal ba sangs pa dang / /ru tra lang nas 'khor rnams bos te/ /kye ma dbang phyug nga yi phyug ma la/ /gang phyir dug pa chen po skyes/ /khyed kyis brlag pa'i dus la bab/ /dam tshig gang la srung mi bsrung / /yongs su rtogs pa med kyang bla/ /dam tshig sgyu ma yin pas na/ /de la dam tshig su zhig zer/ zhes smre sngags mang du brjod pas/ bdud kyi dmag dpung ni gtibs/

bdud kyi ru mtshon ni 'phyar/ swo dang phya'i sgra sgrogs shing byung ba dang bstun nas/ ru tras kyang dbu gsum phyag drug tu bras pas/ yang rdo rje gzhon nus dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par sprul te ba spu'i bu ga nas dbu gsum phyag drug pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ngag smra brjod kyi lce'i dbang po smra brjod dang bral bar byin gyis brlabs nas nyon mongs par gyur to/ /yang ru tras dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par sprul pa dang / rdo rje gzhon nus dbu stong phyag stong spyan bye ba stong du sprul te dbu dgu mang po ba spu'i bu ga nas bkye'o/ /gzhan yang khro bo bcu sprul nas phyogs skyong bcu gdan du bting ngo / /de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyi gtsug nas ha sa ya ra hri da ya 'phros/ ru tra'i spyi gtsug tu zhugs pa dang / ru tra skyob pa'i lha dang bral zhing / gzhan yang gab pa'i sngags drug rnams rim pa bzhin du rdo rje gzhon nu'i lte ba nas a be sha ya 'phros/ gab pa nag po thugs ka nas 'thon zhes pa'ang snang / ru tra'i lte bar thim pas gzugs la dbab/ de nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i yan lag rnams nas shrī griṃ a na ya 'phros/ ru tra'i yan lag rnams la thim pas byang du gzhug par gyur/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i ljags las dz+wa la pa ya 'phros/ ru tra'i lce la thim pas smyo ba bzhin du gyur/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyi bo nas ta thā ya spros/ gab pa nag pa nas skye'i ltong ltong nas spros zhes pa'ang snang / ru tra'i spyi bor thim pas lus sems rnams rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang gnas nas bi da ya spros/ ru tra'i mtshan mar thim pas sha khrag rus pa rnams zhal du btab par gyur te/ mdor na ru tra gangs ri rgyud chad pa ste ri ngo chad pa ltar du 'gyel zhing / bdud kyi 'khor rnams kyang so sor byer ro/ /dus der rdo rje gzhon nu la dus gsum gyi bud+dha thams cad kyis rdo rje srin po'i ngur dbyangs kyis bstod do/

/rdo rje rta'i tshogs kyis rta'i rngam dbyangs kyis dpa' skongs so/ /de'i tshe rdo rje gzhon nus kho rang gi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phrogs nas phung po la thur ma btsugs te/ a la la ho zhes gsungs shing zhal du gsol ste khyur mid mdzad nas phyal du sbyangs pas skye ba grangs med pa'i lus blangs pa ni dran/ las dge sdig gi mi bslu bar ni rig dus der ru tras smre sngags brjod do/ /de rjes rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang gnas nas bton nas 'dun du bzhag la/ spyo ba rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas spyos so/ /spyo ba brgyad kyi ngos 'dzin ni mdo dgongs 'dus na bzhugs so/ /'khor sde brgyad kyis kyang bshags pa re byed kyin rang rang gi mgo bo bcad nas phul lo/ /skabs der ru tras smras pa/ gnam nas bton pa thugs rje chung / /'bangs su mchi 'o rtsis ma chung / /bka' las 'das na 'tshig par 'gyur/ /ma dang sring mo bran mo rnams/ /'bangs su 'bul lo bka' la thogs/ /dbus su mchis skal mi ldan gyis/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' la zhog /phud la 'tshal skal mi ldan gyis/ /lhag ma kha brus bron la stsol/ /ces so/ /rtsa rgyud las kyang / ru tra ma rungs de yi dus su btul/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu la/ /gzugs kyi phung po gdan du rab tu bting / /rna ba'i dbang po'i zhi ba'i chos kyang nyan/ /yid ni 'gyod pa'i smre bshags mang du byas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ru tra gtso bo'i gdan du bting / /'khor rnams kyis kyang phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa pho kha phub mo gan rgyal/ byin pa 'khril bar gdan du bting / rtsa bas chos nyan/ de nas ru tra 'di mahā kā lar byas te sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa bsrungs nas/ 'og phyogs kyi 'jig rten rnam par rol pa'i zhing khams su rdo rje rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas su 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan no/ /de nas bh+rum̐ zhes brjod pas/

kho'i thod mkhar rdo rje phur pa'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas phur pa'i lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad de ltar du byung ba ste/ ma dag pa ru tra gtso 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa rnams ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang rnam par dag pa ni sbyong byed yin zhing / des de sbyangs pa la brten nas sku gsum gyi go 'phang mngon du gyur pa ni sbyangs 'bras yin no/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed la sogs pa'i sgo nas gdul bya dang 'dul byed dang / btul tshul gyi rnam gzhag rnams legs par bshad pa de dag gis ni ston pa'i gleng gzhi bstan zin to// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ sngon tshe gdul bya ma rung ru tra'i tshogs/ /'dul byed bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /legs par btul nas rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ /'di ni sngon byung ston pa'i rnam sprul yin/ 1 /rjes 'jug nyon mongs rnam rtog ru tra'i zhing / /rnam dag smin 'grol lam gyi 'dul byed kyis/ /btul bas 'bras bu sku gsum thob byed pa'i/ /bka' srol 'di ni gzhan dang thun mong min/ 2 /e ma ngo mtshar gleng gzhi rnam gsum gyis/ /e ma ston dang bstan pa bstan 'dzin rnams/ /e ma gsal bar ston pa'i rnam gzhag 'di/ /e ma snga 'gyur rnying ma'i khyad chos yin/ 3 /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yan gyi gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum dang / brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi nang nas rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa byung tshul bshad zin nas/ da ni gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa byon tshul ston pa la/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang dang lam gyi rim pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang sbyar nas/ bshad par bya ste/

de yang thog mar rgyal ba dgongs brgyud dang rig 'dzin rig brgyud rnams la don bsdus kyi tshul gyis gsol ba 'debs pa rgyud 'debs de nyid kyi dbu na tshigs bcad gsum bzhugs pas/ de dag gi don zhar byung gi tshul du thog mar bstan nas/ de'i rjes su dngos gzhi gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa byon tshul rnams rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang thog mar rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpal ldan brtan g.yo kun khyab srid zhi'i bdag /ces pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de'i don yang / bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi dpal dang ldan zhing brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can kun la khyab pa/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das kyi mnga' bdag dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa nyid de/ de yang rang gi ngo bo'am rang bzhin ni brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings nyid/ don dam par 'gyur ba med pa la/ 'od gsal rang rig gi ngo bo bde ba chen po/ chos kyi sku ste mtha' snyed du kun tu bzang po zhes grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i don to/ /de'i rjes su rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa'i 'khor gyi rnam pa can rigs lnga thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rnam dag de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang rig stong dbyer med pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos pa ste/ rang gi ngo bo de ltar du gnas kyang / dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor gyi snang ngor/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi skur bzhengs te/ rab tu mdzes pa'i mtshan bzang dpe byad kyis dpal 'bar bar spras shing / zab don rdo rje theg pa'i chos ma lus par longs spyod pa'i sgo nas yon tan rdzogs pa bde stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/

zhes pas dngos su longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs par bstan nas/ shugs la rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams la'ang gsol ba 'debs pa bstan to/ /de yan chad kyis rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa yin la/ de'i rjes su/ o ḍi ya nar rgyal po'i rigs 'khrungs shing / /zhes sogs kyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ de yang o ḍi ya na ni u rgyan gyi skad dod mtshams ma sbyar ba ste/ der gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'gro bas/ bod skad kyi dbang du byas na 'phur 'gro'am/ rgya skad kyi dbang du byas na u rgyan te/ der rgyal po'i rigs su sku 'khrungs shing zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mtha' yas par mdzad cing / gangs ri'i ljongs sam gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gdug pa can ma rungs pa kun btul ba'i sgo nas sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad/ mdor na rgya bal bod gsum thams cad du sku dpag tu med par sprul nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub nam mkha' las char 'bab pa bzhin du 'bebs par mdzad pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid yin pas de la kha tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /dngos su slob dpon chen po nyid la gsol ba btab pa bstan te/ shugs la mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal/ sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa thams cad la gsol ba btab pa ste/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa rnams la don bsdus kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i don zhar byung gi tshul du bstan zin nas/

de yan chad kyi gong gi sa bcad kyi rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul rnams bshad zin pa yin la/ spyi don gsum pa gang zag snyan nas brgyud de ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ slob dpon chen po de nyid kyis lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba la/ rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor rnams ma tshang ba med pa legs par bstsal cing / de nyid nas brtsams te rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rnams la snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i bla ma zhes 'jog pa yin te/ de dag gi byon tshul brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang sbyar te dngos gzhi rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis ston pa la/ 'khon gyi gdung rabs rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa/ de'ang sa skya pa'i gdung rabs gnyis ldan rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud 'dzin gyi bla ma gzhan la'ang gsol ba 'debs pa gsum gyi/ dang po la don tshan bcu gcig tu yod pa las/ dang po 'khon klu'i dbang po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'phags yul rig gnas rgya mtsho'i grur bzhugs nas/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang nor bu len pa'i ded dpon des/ nor bu 'dod pa'i bsam pas lam gyi dka' tshegs la ma ltos par grur zhugs te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che klu dbang las len pa ltar/ skyes chen dam pa 'dis kyang bod yul mtha' 'khob kyi sems can rnams la brtse ba chen po'i kun nas blangs te/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rig gnas rgya mtsho'i gru'i nang du zhugs nas zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i dam pa'i chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu len par mdzad pa'i ded dpon dang chos mtshungs pa'i klu'i dbang po srung ba la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ gnyis pa 'khon rdo rje rin chen la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ grub pa'i sar bzhugs zhes sogs te/ de yang grub pa brnyes pa'i sar bzhugs kyang / gdul bya tha mal pa'i snang ngor dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul du 'dzin par mdzad pa'i skyes bu gang zhig

rdo rje ltar mi phyed pa'i stong pa nyid dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i snying rje chen po ste/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med mnga' ba'i skyes chen dam pa rnam gnyis la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa 'khon shes rab yon tan la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'khor 'das sgyu mar rtogs pa'i zhes sogs te/ de yang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar rtogs pa'i shes rab rnam par dag pa dang / khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin can te/ mdor na stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po zung 'jug tu yon tan dang ldan pa'i skyes chen dam pa de la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ bzhi pa 'khon tshul khrims rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dam pa'i tshul bzhin zhes sogs te/ /de yang skyes bu dam pa dge slong gsar bu ba'i tshul bzhin mdzad spyod zhib cing / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang / shes rab kyi bslab pa ste bslab pa gsum ldan gyi khrims kyis rang rgyud mdzes shing / gzhan sems can thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa rgyal po zhes pa'i mtshan gyi mtha' can dang ldan pa'i skyes bu de la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /lnga pa 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ zab gsal rdo rje'i sku zhes sogs te/ de yang zab pa stong pa nyid dang gsal ba bde ba chen po ste gsal stong gnyis med dam thab gsal gnyis med rdo rje lta bu'i sku nyid rang don du sngon du gyur kyang / gzhan gyi snang ngor tha mal ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i gtsug tor shes rab ces pa'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don yin la/ drug pa 'khon dge skyabs la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dge legs gzhir gyur zhes sogs te/

de yang dge legs thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che gang gi thugs la mnga' ba'i stobs kyis 'gro ba'i skyabs sam phyag gi gnas su gyur pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mi bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyis yon tan dang ldan pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa khyod la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /bdun pa 'khon dge mthong la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gcig tu dge ba'i chos la zhes sogs te/ de yang gang gi thugs rtse gcig tu rgyun mi chad par dge ba'i chos ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la bar ma chad du thugs gzhol zhing de la brten nas yang dag pa spros pa dang bral ba nges pa'i don mngon sum du mngon par mthong yang tha mal pa'i snang ngor rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshul ston pa de la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ brgyad pa 'khon ston bal po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ glang gi brag la zhes sogs te/ de yang skyes bu mchog de rang don chos sku mngon du mdzad zin kyang / gzhan ngor tsha mo rong gi glang gi brag deng sang phur rir grags pa'i bdag gi bla ma 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can gyi sgrub gnas de nyid kyi brag gi ngos la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal mngon sum du legs par gzigs nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub pa brnyes pa'i 'khon ston chen po bal po'i mtshan can de la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /dgu pa 'khon shākya blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ snga 'gyur shākya'i ring lugs zhes sogs te/ de yang snga 'gyur shākya seṅge'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi mdzad srol gyi mchog tu gyur pa rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la brtson par mdzad pas grub pa'i sa brnyes pa'i zag med kyi blo gros mnga' ba can de la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/

bcu pa 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gsang sngags mthu yi zhes sogs te/ de yang snga 'gyur gyi gsang sngags rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yang phur gnyis kyi sgom sgrub dang bzlas brjod la brtson par mdzad pa'i mthu yi dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis la sogs pa bran du 'khol ba'i 'khon rog chen po shes rab kyi phung po dang tshul khrims kyi phung po la sogs pa zag med kyi phung po lnga sngon du gyur pa'i skyes chen de la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /bcu gcig pa 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dri med dkon mchog gdung 'dzin zhes sogs te/ de yang drang don ltar na rigs dri ma med pa 'od gsal gyi lha'i gdung dang / lha dang srin po 'khon pa'i bar du 'khrungs pa'i 'khon gyi gdung brgyud 'dzin zhing / nges don du 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid 'od gsal gyi lhar 'khrungs pa yin pas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdung brgyud dri ma dang bral ba/ spang bya sgrib gnyis las 'khon pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog dam pa theg pa chen po'i chos kyi khrir 'khod nas theg chen kun gyi mchog gyur gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po gang yin pa de la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ de yan gyis 'khon gyi gdung rabs rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa de dang sa skya pa'i gdung rabs gnyis ldan rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di la don tshan bcu bdun du yod pa las/ dang po dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ snyigs dus gangs can dpal gyur ces sogs te/ de yang snyigs ma snga bdo ba'i dus 'dir gangs can gyi skye dgu rnams kyi dpal du gyur pa byang chub sems dpa' phyag na pad+mo'i rnam par sprul pa'i skur gdon mi za ba'i 'gran zla dang bral ba'i bla ma'i mchog skyes chen dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po zhes snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzam bu'i gling ma lus pa yongs su khyab pa'i bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/
