/gnyis pa slob dpon rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ de sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhes sogs te/ de yang bla chen kun dga' snying po de nyid kyi sras drang don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul ston par mdzad cing / nges don du rdo rje rnon po nyid gos dkar gyis bklubs pa'i tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi tshul bzung nas shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la mkhyen pa phyogs med du rgyas shing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i rtse mor gson pa'i skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs la gus pa dang bcas pas 'dud do zhes pa'i don yin la/ gsum pa rje btsun rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus zhes sogs te/ de yang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo gangs khrod kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi mnga' bdag rgyud sde'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel bar nus pa'i mkhyen rab can nges don gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs de la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa gcung dpal chen 'od po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ zab mo'i lam gyi zhes sogs te/ de yang rdo rje theg pa'i zab mo'i lam gyi sgo nas rang gi rgyud smin par mdzad cing mgon med pa'i sems can gzhan la brtse ba snying rje chen po'i thugs mnga' ba'i stobs kyis sman spyad la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad la/ khyad par gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dpal dang brtse ba snying rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis srid pa'i tsha gdung sel bar mdzad pa de nyid la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ lnga pa chos rje sa paṇa la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ mkhyen rab thogs med ces sogs te/

de yang zab yangs mkhyen rab gting mtha' med pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi blo gros kyis thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pas/ sa skya paṇa chen zhes pa'i mtshan tsam thos pas kyang blo gsal rnams la dang ba'i dad pa dbang med du bskyed par nus shing / chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa la 'jig rten 'di na mkhas pa kun gyi mig gcig pu lta bur gyur pa yin la/ rgya gar gyi sgra las bod skad du bka' dang bstan bcos du ma bsgyur bar mdzad pa sogs/ bod rmongs pa rnams la yang dag pa'i lam ston par mdzad pa'i yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /drug pa bzang tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ sngon bsags bsod nams zhes sogs te/ de yang bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen po bsags pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du yon tan gyi tshogs du ma las grub pa'i rigs rus su bskrun pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i snyan pa'i grags pas rgyal mtshan chen po srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du bsgrengs par mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhas pa gang der 'dud/ ces pa'i don yin la/ bdun pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ zab rgyas chos dang zhes sogs te/ de yang zab cing rgyas pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pas thugs rgyud bltams pas/ chos rje bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po'i yon bdag hor gyi rgyal po brgyud pa dang bcas pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos gang gi zhabs zung bla lhag tu bsten nas/

zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du bod 'chol kha gsum gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i khri skor bcu gsum/ rgya'i mi yur chen mo/ chos dung dkar po rgyang grags sogs kyis gtsos pa'i blo'i rwa ba las 'das pa'i bsnyen bkur rgya chen po phul te/ chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor mnga' thang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan gyi dpal chen po can lha 'dre mi gsum kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi chos srid ma lus pa'i bdag por gyur pa skal ba bzang po can kun gyi bla mar bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa zhes yongs la grags pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po blo gros rgyal mtshan de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /smras pa/ sngon tshe sa skya paṇa chen khu dbon zhabs/ /stobs ldan hor gyi rgyal pos gus bsten nas/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs bdag por mnga' phul te/ /bod yul shing sgo 'dzin pa'i chol kha gsum/ 1 /dam chos yon du phul ba nas bzung ste/ /sa skya pa yi 'bangs su ma gyur su/ /'di 'dra soms la deng dus cher rlom kun/ /bzang por 'chos pa'i khengs sems 'di dor la/ 2 /mchod 'os mchod sogs ya rabs mdzangs pa yis/ /rnam thar bskyangs na rang gzhan kun la mdzes/ /zhes bya ba yang shugs 'byung du smras pa lags so/ /de nas chos rgyal 'phags pa'i rjes su 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud ma yin pa'i brgyud 'dzin gyi bla ma gzhan lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di 'byung bas/ de'i dang po kha 'ub pa 'od dpal la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rje btsun mchog las zhes sogs te/ de yang sa skya pa'i rje btsun mchog rnams las 'khrul pa med pa'i yang phur gyi gdams pa zab mo rnams legs par mnos nas/ skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i gdul bya gzhan la gdams pa de nyid 'chad mkhas kyi 'od zer dang ldan pa chos kyi rje kha 'ub pa de nyid la 'dud/ ces pa'i don yin la/

gnyis pa bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ chos kun dga' bzhi'i zhes sogs te/ de yang zab mo'i gdams pa nyams su bzhes pa la brten nas chos kun kyang dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes kyi ngo bor ro cig tu rtogs shing / de la brten nas chos thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med skyong bar mdzad pa'i chos kyi rje bu lung pa de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ mchog tu gzhan la phan pa'i zhes sogs te/ de yang mchog tu'am khyad par du gdul bya gzhan la phan pa'i thugs snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing / rgya skad bod skad gnyis smras pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams legs pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i blo gros can/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros de nyid la 'dud zhes pa'i don yin la/ bzhi pa dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gzhung lugs man ngag kun 'dus zhes sogs te/ de yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs man ngag dang bcas pa kun 'dus pa'i dga' ba'i tshal lta bur bzhugs shing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i gang zag dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /lnga pa gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rnam mang gsung rab mtha' dag ces sogs te/ de yang gdul bya'i bye brag rnam pa mang po'i ngo bor gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la legs par sbyangs nas/ de dag gi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs shing / zab mo'i yang rtse man ngag gi nying khu rdo rje theg pa'i gdams ga'i bang mdzod 'dzin par mdzad pa'i rin po che'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor mchod pa ltar/ 'gro ba kun la dgos 'dod ma lus pa stsol ba'i chos kyi rje gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan de nyid dang de'i brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa la 'dud zhes pa'i don yin la/

de dag gis ni brgyud 'dzin gyi bla ma gzhan la gsol ba 'debs pa'i khongs nas skyes bu dam pa lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa'i don rnams skabs 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis bstan zin nas/ da ni gong gi sa bcad kyi 'khon sa skya pa zhes pa'i mtshan mchog gnyis dang ldan pa'i gdung rabs dri ma med pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa la don tshan bcu bdun yod pa'i bdun pa yan chad gong du bstan zin nas/ de'i rjes su brgyad pa bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bslab gsum ngur smrig ces sogs te/ de yang lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ste bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud phyug pa'i gzugs kyi sku nyid ngur smrig gi chos gos kyis mdzes par spras shing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i sprul pa'i skur gdon mi za ba'i skyes bu dam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa'i/ spyir bod du 'gyur ro cog gi bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag tu dpal ldan sa skya pa/ yang sgos snga 'gyur rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa rmangs nas bslangs te dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med pa de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /dgu pa bla chen kun rgyal la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ grub pa'i rigs 'khrungs zhes sogs te/ de yang grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po thog ma gnam lha'i gdung brgyud/ bar du 'khon gyi gdung brgyud/ tha mar sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud de/ rigs rus cho 'brang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rigs su sku 'khrungs shing / shes bya'i gnas thams cad kyi de kho na nyid gzigs pas phan bde'i 'byung gnas su gyur cing 'gro kun dga' bar byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par mdzad pa can de la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/

bcu pa theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ sa skyong gtsug gi nor bu zhes sogs te/ de yang spyir rgya bod kyi skye dgu kun gyi dpal du gyur cing / khyad par sa skyong chen po'i gtsug gi nor bu'i khri la zhabs sen dbang gi rgyal po nye bar bzhugs pa theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor bar mdzad pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'jig rten na theg chen rin po che zhes yongs su grags shing / dam pa gang gi drin las dpal sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas par mdzad pa'i sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag rdo rje phur pa la bka' drin mchog tu che ba de la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ skabs 'dir sa skya pa'i grub mtha'i srol 'dzin rjong lugs pa rnams kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis sa lugs kyi phur pa gsan tshul cung zad brjod na/ brgyud pa'i rim pa snga ma rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ theg chen pa'i drung du rje brag thog pa bsod nams bzang pos gsan cing / de'i drung du rje rdo rje gdan pa nyid kyis gsan par rje de nyid kyi gsan yig las bshad cing / yang gsan yig de nyid las/ gong du bshad pa dang cung zad mi 'dra ba'i brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di ltar yang 'byung ste/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje gzhon nu/ karma he ru ka rigs kyi rdo rje 'chang / slob dpon u pa rā dza/ pra ha ti/ dha na saṃ kri ta/ pad+ma sam+bha wa/ sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rdo rje rin po che/ shes rab yon tan/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / 'khon ston bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa chos rgyal/

gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen pa/ mkhan chen seṅge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ de'i drung du thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis gsan par bshad cing / yang na/ 'phags pa/ dpon dkar ba/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen pa man sngar bzhin dang / yang na/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ kham sgom/ mchog gi legs pa/ shes rab tshul khrims/ mchog gi sems dpa'/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ mtha' bzhi ston pa/ rdo rje brag po/ rdo rje thod 'phreng / rol pa'i rdo rje/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen chos rgyal 'phags pa man gong bzhin dang / yang glo bo lo tsā bas bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī la'ang zhus pa yin no zhes kyang bshad cing / yang rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal nyid kyi phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bsgyur ba gsan pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ ma tiṅga/ bi kha ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ ta thā ga ta shrī/ chos rje sa paṇa/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgya tsha lung mang po/ blo chen/ bde ba can pa/ gar thig pa/ mkhan chen sher rdor ba/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ mkhan chen grags rdor ba/ chos rje grags don pa/ chos kyi rje bka' 'gyur ba/ shākya rgyal mtshan/ de'i drung du rdo rje gdan pa chen po kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis gsan pa yin zhes rje de nyid kyi gsan yig las 'byung ba lags/ /bcu gcig pa 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes bzung zhes sogs te/ de yang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes su bzung ba'i stobs kyis mkhyen brtse nus gsum/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan yang yon tan de thams cad sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs shing /

rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brten pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus dang bral bar rtogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par mdzad pa de nyid kyi zhabs la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ bcu gnyis pa sngags 'chang rgya gar shes bzang la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med ces sogs te/ de yang rgyud 'debs mdzad pa po sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid la/ nges don du lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dang dbyer med pa ste khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhugs kyang / gzhan ngor ngur smṛg 'dzin pa mchog gi tshul ston par mdzad pa'i nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan zhes grags pas rdo rje gzhon nu nyid la thugs dam gyi gtso bo mdzad cing / lhag pa'i lhas zhal bstan par nges pa'i phyogs 'di'i bstan pa la bka' drin che ba de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /bcu gsum pa 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bkra shis la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dpal ldan mthu stobs mgon po zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal he ru ka zhes pa yi ge bzhi'i don dang ldan pa mthu stobs kyi mgon po rje btsun bir+wa pas byin gyis brlabs shing / bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gnyis mthar phyin pas chos kun zab gsal gnyis med nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du rtogs shing / mtshan yang nam mkha'i mtshan can du grags pa de dang brgyud par bcas la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ bcu bzhi pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la gsol pa 'debs pa ni/ mang thos blo gsal rnam dag ces sogs te/ de yang tshig rkang gnyis ni rjes 'jug rnams la dgongs nas rtsom pa po nyid kyis kha skong gi tshul du mdzad par snang ste de'i don ni/ shes bya'i yul du gyur pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas rnam pa lnga la mang du thos pa de'i don la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rab tu gsal ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur cing khrims ldan 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnam par dag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas che ba ma lus pa mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gcig pu lta bur gyur pa lha mchog zur phung lnga pa gang des sa skya 'khon gyi gdung brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rigs rus dri ma med pa'i skur sprul nas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa yongs dang /

khyad par yang phur gnyis kyi bstan pa la bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i sa lo tsā ba chen po kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /bco lnga pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam sprul zhes sogs te/ tshigs bcad 'di ni bdag gi bla ma 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa yin te/ de'i don ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i rnam par sprul pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa 'jig la nye ba'i tshe de dag yar ngo'i zla ba ltar dar zhing rgyas ba'i ched du bsam bzhin du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i skyes bu chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mthu rtsal nus pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan can gzugs can dang gzugs med kyi skye 'gro thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas bstan pa rin po che phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad pas/ nges don du rigs kun gyi bdag po drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor/ gos dkar lcang los mdzes pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba'i tshul ston par mdzad pa rje btsun ngag gi dbang pos gdung rigs 'dzin pa'i 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rnams kyi nang nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i sgo nas dar rgyas su mdzad pa la sus kyang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes bu chen po rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba gnyis pa lta bu de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa'i sngags 'chang bla ma bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa cung zad brjod na/ skyes bu dam pa 'di'i rigs rus gang las byon pa ni/

thog mar gnam lha'i brgyud pa byon tshul/ bar du dri med 'khon gyi brgyud pa byon tshul/ tha mar 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud byon tshul gsum gyi sgo nas ston kyang de dag gi tshul ni/ mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gdung rabs dri ma med pa rnams las gsal bas/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bkod la/ de lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyi nang nas bla ma chen po 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'bras bu'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum dang / sgrub pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum bzlas nas/ lung gi dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i chu mo glang gi lo la/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas lung bstan dang mthun pa bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po'i 'gram btab/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi dge legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel thams cad bsgrigs/ de nas dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras rnams kyis gong 'phel du mdzad cing / khyad par bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku ring la rgya bod hor gsum gyi skye bo dregs pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus shing / de dag gi 'byor pa'i cha shas rnams gdan sa chen po'i cha rkyen du sbyor bar mdzad pas gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ dge 'dun gyi sde sogs shin tu dar bar mdzad nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang khri phrag bco brgyad la sogs pa 'dus te/ sngon thub pa'i dbang pos lha dang mi'i 'khor tshogs kyi dbus na chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i dus las kyang ches ngo mtshar ba lta bur gyur mod/ 'on kyang bar skabs su skye bo bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gi byed pa dang /

bod kyi sems can spyi mthun gyi las la brten nas/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar gtsug lag khang rnams la zhig gsos/ mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang / de'i zhabs tog la sogs rgyun chad pa la nye zhing / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bde skyid 'byung ba'i rtsa ba byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rabs kyang nyag phra bar gyur pa sogs bstan pa rin po che cung zad nyams dma' ba'i dus zhig byung 'dug na'ang / rgyal ba rnams ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang khams gsum gyi sems can la nyin mtshan dus drug tu bya ra mdzad pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa ltar/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags shing / bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la skad cig kyang g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i tshad med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag de nyid kyis spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams mu mtha' ma mchis pa rnams su sems can gyi don mdzad pa brjod kyis mi lang zhing / khyad par kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes nas rang snang la dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams 'ba' zhig las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdul bya tha mal pa rnams kyi snang ngor bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag dpal ldan sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i ched du dka' spyad dang ngal dub mtha' yas pa zhig khyad du sad pa'i sgo nas bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas su 'gyur ba'i thabs la brtson par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir du gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten sngar yod rnams kyi zhig gsos dang /

ma 'ongs pa'i dad can rnams bsod nams gsog pa'i don du ngo mtshar ba'i rten gsum gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs du ma zhig mdzad de/ de dag kun la mchod pa'i rgyun phun sum tshogs pa sbyor ba dang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba mdo sngags kyi bshad grwa bzang po gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa gtsugs te/ de dag so so'i bca' khrims rnam par dag pa'i rgyun bzang po la bkod cing / de'i cha rkyen du chos gzhis rlabs po che sbyor ba dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dang / de'i sbyin bdag mi dbang sa skyong chen po rnams kyi dbu 'phangs bstod pa dang / mi dge ba'i las byed pa'i sdig chen rnams drag po mngon spyod kyi sgo nas tshar bcad de/ rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du gnas spar nas/ de rnams kyis ma 'ongs pa'i srid pa'i rgyun gcod pa dang / gong ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs su de dag gi lo dang zla ba'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul bar bde kyai gsang gsum yang phur la sogs pa'i gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod sogs dge rgyun rlabs po che 'dzugs pa dang / bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnam bzhi'i brjod don thun mong ba mi 'gal ba ston cing / thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'brel bar nyams su len tshul ston pa'i gsung rab mang po gsar du brtsams pa dang / gzhan yang dbang lung man ngag la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba'i sgo nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa dang / rang gi rgyal tshab dang skye dgu rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i phyir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rigs spel ba'i cho ga mdzad pa sogs/ mdor na skyes bu chen po 'di'i dgung lo bcu bdun tsam bzhes pa nas bzung ste drug bcu re brgyad bzhes pa'i bar du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pa sna tshogs pas gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul gyis 'gro ba rnams legs par bskyangs te spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas par mdzad cing /

khyad par gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bde skyid 'byung ba'i rtsa ba bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa rnams deng sang gi bar du yar ngo'i zla ba ltar dar zhing rgyas te rgya bod hor gsum na 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs pa 'di ni sngags 'chang bla ma 'di kho na'i bka' drin las byung ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /smras pa/ bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam thar la/ /'gran par nus pa'i sngags 'chang sprul pa'i sku/ /gang gis bstan pa spel ba'i mdzad 'phrin rgyun/ /'di 'dra skyong ba kho bo skal ba bzang / /'on kyang snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rags/ /ji ltar byas kyang thams cad mgu ba dka'/ /de phyir bdag gi 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /'bad med 'grub bar bslu med rgya mtshos mdzod/ /ces thugs rje bskul ba'i tshig kyang shugs 'byung du smras so/ /de'i rjes su gong gi don tshan bcu drug pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo zhes sogs te/ tshigs bcad 'di ni gong gi rgyud 'debs kyi kha skong du kho bos gsar du brtsams pa yin te/ de yang smin byed dbang gi chu bo bskur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i sgo nas thog mar thugs rgyud legs par sbyangs bar mdzad nas/ de'i rjes su bar du gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo la rtse gcig tu mdzad nas/ gsung bzlas kyi grangs kyang bye ba la thug gi bar du mthar phyin par mdzad de/ tha mar skal bzang gi 'gro ba snod ldan rnams la rnam par grol ba thar pa'i lam mchog ston par mdzad pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdung rigs su sku 'khrungs pa/ nges pa'i don du lhag pa'i lha mchog dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid gdul bya'i snang ngor dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur ston par mdzad pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/

/bcu bdun pa bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ sngon tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs te/ /tshigs bcad 'di yang kho bo cag gis gsar du kha bskangs pa yin te/ de'i don ni/ sngon gyi dus bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe mkhan po bo dhi satwa'am byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho zhes par sku skye ba bzhes te chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la sogs pa'i gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing / phyi rabs gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs su 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bar sku skye ba bzhes nas/ de skabs kyi dus mtshungs pa'i rgyal sras thogs med/ lo tsā ba rtse mo'i mtshan can/ yar lung seng rgyal la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi slob ma dpag tu med pa bskrun te mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas de lta bu'i 'gro mgon chos rje de nyid dus ngan snyigs ma'i skabs 'dir/ rab dkar gangs ri'i phung po'i mdangs kyang 'phrog par byed pa'i na bza' lhab lhub kyis sku smad mdzes shing / bung ba ltar gnag pa'i yid 'ong dbu skra gsil bur gyur ba nyal nyil du 'phyang bas rdo rje sku'i bla steng mdzes par byas pa'i gsang sngags 'chang ba kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa'i bla ma/ gzhan gnod kyi bsam pa rtsa ba nas spangs pa'i byang chub sems dpal chen po/ yon tan gyi tshogs gang yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa nges pa'i don du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu nyid bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyi don du sku'i skye ba lan gcig ma yin pa rim par byon te/ so so skye bo'i tshul bzung ba'i da lta'i sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i mtshan la grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa de nyid kyi zhabs la dus lan gcig ma yin pa yang dang yang du gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/

/de lta bu'i sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyi drung du bdag gi bla ma dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi spro ba dang bsdud pa'i byed pa po rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can de nyid kyis lugs 'di'i smin byed kyi dbang dang chos skyong dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang sogs kyang gsan par mdzad de/ dus phyis gling ga bsam gtan phug tu bsnyen sgrub kyang mthar phyin par mdzad pas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal dngos su bstan cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa yin te/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ rdo rje phur pa 'di 'phrin las kyi lha yin pas gzhan las rtags mtshan myur zer ba cis kyang bden par 'dug ces dad ldan gyi bu slob rnams la yang yang gsung ba las thos so/ /spyir bdag gi bla ma bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'di nyid ni nges pa kho nar rdo rje 'chang chen po yin mod kyang gdul bya gzhan gyi snang ngor yang gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas shing thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bya ba mthar phyin nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur te bstan pa'i bya ba bshad sgrub rgyun ma chad pa'i sgo nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ mthar sku tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i tshul gyis thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i ngang nas gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang las dag pa rnams kyi snang ngor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyi bsu bas mngon sum du spyan drangs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig mnga' ba yin la mdor na de lta bu'i bdag gi bla ma yongs su 'dzin pa chen po de nyid dus da lta mkha' spyod chen po 'og min na bzhugs pa la the tshom cung zad kyang dgos pa ma yin no/

/smras pa/ sgyu 'phrul sras po thub pa'i dbang po dang / /bdag gi 'dren pa rje btsun bla ma khyed/ /spangs rtogs nus pa'i yon tan mtshungs na yang / sngon gyi rgyal de rigs can gsum gyi skyabs/ /mgon khyod bdag cag rnams kyi dpal du shar/ /de phyir bka' drin mtshungs med mus pa rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'bral med thugs rjes skyobs/ /zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig kyang shugs 'byung du smras so/ /de yan gyis 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rabs la gsol ba 'debs pa don tshan bcu bdun gyis bsdus pa rnams 'phros don cung zad dang bcas te bstan zin nas/ da ni brgyud 'dzin gyi bla ma gzhan la'ang gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul rnams ston pa las de'i khongs nas skyes bu dam pa lnga la gsol 'debs kyi don rnams chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rjes su dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang gis bstan zin yang / 'dir brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi dbang du byas na/ chos rje bla ma'i rjes nas sa lo chen po'i bar du gong gi bla ma brgyud pa de rnams las gzhan pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma bzhi las rim par brgyud kyang chog pas/ de dag la gsol ba 'debs pa'i don bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ mtha' yas byang chub thugs kyi zhes sogs te/ de yang 'gro ba mtha' yas pa la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po mchog gi thugs kyi dpal dang ldan zhing bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa mnos pa nas bzung / dus nam du yang de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa gang gis kyang thugs rgyud la ma gos pas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa can de la 'dud ces pa'i don yin la/ gnyis pa rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ skye dgu kun la dga' bzhi'i zhes sogs te/ de yang skal bzang las 'phro dang ldan pa'i skye dgu thams cad la lan gcig ma yin pa dus rnam pa kun tu bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ngang la lam gyi mchog zab mo'i yang rtse dga' ba bzhi'i dri ma med pa'i lam gyi rgyun bzang po legs par ston par mdzad pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po de la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/

/rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po 'di mdo gang las lung bstan na/ rgyal ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sde snod kyi mdo las lung bstan pa yin te/ ji skad du/ de tshe 'jig rten mgon po'i sprul pa sprul/ /de tshe dge slong kun dga' bzang po 'byung / /tshul khrims kyis kyang khyad par 'phags gyur la/ /thos pa mang zhing pha rol phyin pas 'phags/ /thabs dang shes rab la ni shin tu bslabs/ /de dag chos kyi sems brgyud brjed mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu 'phags pa rnams dang 'grogs par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo de yi yon tan gang yod pa/ /mang du bsgrags kyang mthar thug 'gyur ba med/ /ces gsungs pa'i tshig 'di dag gis lung bstan pa yin par bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab las bshad do/ /gsum pa lnga rig paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rig gnas kun la zhes sogs te/ bzo rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ nang don rig pa ste shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga po kun la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu yangs pas rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros rgyas shing mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i snyan pa'i grags pa rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab cing / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rmad du byung ba phyogs gcig ma yin pa rnam pa brgyar g.yo ba mdzad pa can de nyid la 'dud zhes pa'i don yin/ bzhi pa glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gang blo 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes sogs te/ de yang rje btsun legs pa'i 'byung gnas gang de'i thugs rgyud lhag pa'i lha mchog ngag gi dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs pa la brten shes bya'i gnas kun la blo gros kyi snang ba rab tu rgyas shing / lhag par rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje mi'i sku gzugs can chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos nyams dang rmi lam gyi tshul du rgyun chad med pa nye bar rjes su bzung ba la brten nas/

rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab ma lus pa'i mdzod du gyur pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen yongs su 'dzin pa chen po bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba'i brgyud 'debs rtsom pa po sa skya lo tsā ba nyid kyis rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa de la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa'i don no/ /de rnams kyi stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang dang lam gyi rim pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi byon tshul bstan zin pa yin la/ da ni smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi byon tshul cung zad brjod par bya ste de yang bla ma brgyud pa gzhan rnams gong stod las dang 'dra ba las cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni chos rje bla ma'i rjes su mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ thar pa 'dul khang mkhan po thugs rje shes rab/ sngags 'chang dharma kirti/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po/ bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ de'i drung du sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes gsan pa yin la/ yang smad las kyi drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rje btsun rin po che yan stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi bla ma brgyud pa dang 'dra ba las/ de nas chos rje sa paṇa chos rgyal/ 'phags pa/ lo mchog bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub/ de'i drung du sa skya lo tsā bas gsan pa yin no/ /de ltar brgyud pa mang du 'dus pa'i sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i drung du/ spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas gsan la/ dam pa de nyid kyi drung du snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis gsan nas/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang gzhan yang stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub la sogs pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu du ma la gnang ba las/

thugs sras brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyi gcen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos bdag gi bla ma lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub la gnang ba yin no/ /de ltar brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros te rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched 'di gnyis kyi drung du/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag gis lo gzhon nu nas bzung rang lo nyi shu man chad la lugs 'di'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang lan mang du mnos shing / de dang 'brel ba'i sgrub dkyil gyi yi ge gsar rnying sogs phyogs 'di la mkho ba'i gsung rab mang po'i bshad lung dang / phyag rgya'i gar 'cham dbyangs rol la sogs pa'i phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyi phyag khrid rnams kyang bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas stsal zhing / 'di'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang yang mnos la/ dus phyis lo nas spyan snga rin po che chos kyi spyan ldan gyi drung du smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang zhus te phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud dbang / rdo rje las rim sogs kyi lung yang mnos/ gzhan yang ches zab rmad du byung ba'i yang phur gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i gdam pa rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i khrid kyi brgyud pa 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che/ grub chen hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra/

bal po shī la mañju/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ jo mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal/ mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mchims ston shākya pra bha/ shud bu dpal gyi seṅge/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ rba sgom blo gros dbang phyug ldang ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan/ lce btsun seṅge dbang phyug grub thob lce sgom chen po/ slob dpon gnyer sgom chen po/ gu ru rin chen chos kyi dbang phyug mtshungs med shes rab rin chen/ 'bri byug pa rin chen 'bum/ yar lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa nam mkha' bsod nams/ zhal bu ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rin po che nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rje bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang chos rgyal/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag grub ba mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la dges bzhin du gnang ba'o/ /bar ma chad pa las 'ong pa'i bka' ma'i lugs kyi nyams khrid yongs su rdzogs pa dang / chos skyong dkar bdud lcam dral gyi sgrub skor gsar rnying rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung sogs/ chos kyi rje grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan las kyang thob par bgyis te/ da dung yang rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor 'di la/ dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa chen pos ngom med du 'tshol ba la skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bus rtag 'grus su gnas pa lags so/ /de rnams kyis brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi nang nas gong gi sa bcad kyi gang zag snyan nas brgyud de ji ltar dar ba'i tshul rnams sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes pa dang sbyar te rgyas par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ ngo mtshar mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs/ /tshogs kun rin chen 'phreng ba ji bzhin byon/ /byon pa de dag ji bzhin legs par bshad/

/bshad pa 'di dag blo gsal rnams kyis spel/ /ma rig las 'khon 'khon rigs nas brgyud de/ /shes bya kun mkhyen mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gyis/ /rjes bzung skyes mchog mchog rnams bzhed pa'i srol/ /mchog tu ches zab zab mo kun gyi bcud/ /rdo rje phur pa'i lam srol 'di slob la/ /rdo rje slob dpon gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /rdo rje gzhon nu bsgrub la chig gril na/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang tshe 'dir 'grub par 'gyur/ /e ma 'phrin las lha 'di byin rlabs che/ /che bar nges so kho bos yid ches rnyed/ /rnyed pa 'di la skal bzang slob bu kun/ /kun kyang yid gnyis spong la lam 'dir bzhugs/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gis ni rdo rje phur pa byung tshul bye brag tu bshad pa mtha' dag bstan zin nas/ gsum pa skabs kyi don dngos bshad pa la/ 'dir skabs kyi don bshad gzhi'i gtso bor gyur pa ni/ rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu nyams len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa 'di nyid yin la/ de 'chad thabs kyi man ngag gang gis 'chad na/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgron gsal las/ rgyud 'di'i ming ni ci zhig yin/ /su yi don du 'di nyid mdzad/ /su zhig byed po 'di'i tshad ci/ /'di yi dgos pa ci zhig yin/ /zhes gleng bslang ba lnga gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par/ spyir btang ba rtsis mgo lnga'i sgo nas bshad kyang rung mod/ yang na/ phur pa rgyud kyi rgyal po ste/ /phur pa lung gi bla ma yin/ /phur pa man ngag gi nges pa'i don/ /zhes gsungs pas phur pa rgyud ltar bshad pa/ phur pa lung ltar bshad pa/ phur pa man ngag ltar bshad pa ste/ bshad thabs rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas bshad kyang rung zhing / yang rgyud kyi bsdu thabs gnyis zhes pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rnam pa gnyis su phye nas bshad kyang rung la/ yang rgyud kyi 'ching drug gi sgo nas bshad na/ phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas bsgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung /

dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas te don gyi khog dbub/ khams gsum nas srog la dbang bskur zhing srog gi ye shes sems srog la dbang bskur/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs shing mchod cing bsnyen pas dngos grub kyi bcud blangs/ gab pa'i sngags drug dang / tshe lung khrus lung gis kha bskangs te gdabs pa'i las bya/ mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum gyis las kyi 'jug bsdu ba ste/ rgyud kyi 'ching drug gam khog don drug gi sgo nas bshad kyang rung zhing / yang gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum gyis spyi khog dbub/ mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum gyis don gyi shan dbye/ phur bu'i rgyu bzhis gang zag rnam pa bzhi mthar dbyung / sgrub lugs chen po gsum gyi 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang / thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags kyis ye shes kyi lha gnad la dbab/ ngan sngags bsdu yig drug gsum bco brgyad kyis mkha' 'gro ma dngos su bkol/ srog gi don so gsum gyis dmigs pa gsum gyi gnad bkrol/ bsgral lugs chen po bco brgyad kyis gnag pa'i las bya/ mthar phyin brgyad kyis las kyi kha bskangs/ mthar btul gsum gyis las kyi lto ba gdab ces pa ltar smad las gtso bor gyur pa thems sbyor bcu'i sgo nas bshad kyang rung ba yin la/ yang dkyus kyi tshig drug ma shes na 'phrin las gong 'og gi shan mi phyed/ gab pa'i sngags drug ma shes na sngags gzer drag po dgra la mi 'phog sbas pa'i mchong drug ma shes na gab sbas kyi thag mi chod/ man ngag srog gi chan sa ma shes na dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa mi chod/ gshog pa rlabs chen gyi cho ga ma shes na dgra bgegs kyi bla mi khugs/ gsang phur seṅge kha 'tham gyi cho ga ma shes na rnal 'byor pa nang 'thab na bsgral ba'i thabs med/ gnad gcod kyi thabs ma shes na las la sbyar na tshur bzlog 'khor lo'i bskor thabs ma shes na las mi 'grub/ ling ga'i bca' thabs ma shes na dmigs pa'i gnad brlag

kun gzhi'i gnad ma shes na btab pa la don med/ tshe lung srog lung gi dgongs pa ma shes na ngan sngags dang khyad med/ gnas spar ba'i cho ga ma shes na bshan pa dang khyad med ces pa gnad tho bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad kyang rung zhing / yang lag len mngon rtogs kyi srog them bdun/ dris lan gegs sel gyi srog them bdun/ man ngag gnad kyi srog them bdun te srog them nyer gcig gi sgo nas bshad kyang rung la/ yang gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ khro bo khro mo nyi shu/ mgo brnyan nyi shu/ sras mchog lnga/ sgo ma bzhi ste phur pa rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu nga gcig de las spros pa'i yan lag gi lha nyis stong drug brgya dang gcig gis bskyed rdzogs 'phrin las gsum dang sbyar nas bshad kyang rung ba yin te/ don de dag la dgongs nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rdo rje phur pa'i dbang chog blo gsal dga' ba bskyed byed las/ de la bshad lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ phur pa rgyud ltar bshad pa/ phur pa lung ltar bshad pa/ phur pa man ngag ltar bshad pa ste bshad thabs rnam pa gsum/ rgyud kyi bsdu thabs rnam pa gnyis/ khog don drug them sbyor bcu/ gnad tho bcu gnyis/ srog them nyer gcig rnams su yod ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de dag hril gyis bsdu na/ stod las byang chub bsgrub pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang / smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ stod las la yang chu bo bzhi 'dus pa'i sgo nas bshad cing nyams su len dgos te/ chu bo bzhi ni/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes lam rim smon lam las/ chu bo bzhi 'dus gdams pa nyams len cing / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi smin byed dbang gi chu bo bskur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭika stong thun dang bcas pa/ gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo lag len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa/

man ngag gnad kyi chu bo dris lan gegs sel dang bcas pa rnams yin pa las/ des na skabs 'dir chu bo rnam pa bzhi dang khog don drug gi sgo nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang thog mar smin byed dbang gi chu bo sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas lam rnams nyams su len dgos pa yin te/ dbang ma bskur la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes dang / dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par rtogs na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pas/ dbang ma thob par gsang sngags zab mo'i lam 'chad pa dang / nyams su len pa sogs gang byas kyang phan yon mi 'byung ba'i khar nyes dmigs ches lci ba zhig 'byung bas na/ rdul mtshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gang yang rung bar dbang bskur ba cis kyang thob dgos pa yin zhing / de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon ni/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun du ni/ /ma bsgom par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces dang / gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag nas 'grub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i phan yon du ma zhig dang ldan pa'i smin byed dbang gi chu bo bskur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i sgo nas lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo nod pa la 'phral dang yun du 'bad pa bya dgos pa yin te rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la dbang la ma brten pa'i lam gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba thob nas lam rnams nyams su blangs pas mthar thug 'bras bu gang mngon du byed na/

phur bu ngan sngags gtsug lag gi rgyud las/ phur bu rnam bzhi'i dgongs pa yis/ /gang zag rnam bzhi'i mthar dbyung ngo / /rig pa ye shes phur bu ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi klong du gdab/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i phur pa ni/ /khams gsum sems can la gdab bo/ /gsang ba byang sems phur pa 'di/ /yum gyi mkha' klong dag par gdab/ /mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa ni/ /dgra dang bgegs la gdab pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phur pa'i rgyu bzhi gang zag rnam pa bzhis mthar dbyung zhes bya ba yin pas de yang / nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag gis rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa yul chos kyi dbyings la btab/ ri bo lta bu'i gang zag gis tshad med snying rje'i phur pa'am/ thugs rje sprul pa'i phur pa khams gsum gyi sems can la btab/ bya ka lan ta lta bu'i gang zag gis gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la gdab/ tsan+dan sdong po lta bu'i gang zag gis mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khar btab pa la sogs pa nyams su blangs pa la brten te mthar 'bras bu sku bzhi'am/ kun tu bzang po rigs bzhi gang yang rung ba thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ rig pa ye shes phur pa de/ /lhang gis rtogs na theb pa yin/ /'bras bu chos sku skye med thob/ /ces dang / tshad med snying rje'i phur pa de/ /byams dang snying rje chen pos gdab/ /'bras bu sprul pa'i sku yang thob/ /ces dang / lhag pa byang sems phur pa de/ /yum gyi mkha' klong dag par gdab/ /bde ba dngos med thob pa'i tshad/ /'bras bu longs sku bde chen thob/ /ces dang / gsal bar bsgom na bskyed pa yin/ /nyams 'og tshud na bsgral ba yin/ /gnyis su med na sbyor ba yin/ /lhang gis rtogs na theb pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /don de dag la dgongs nas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lam rim smon lam las/ /ye shes byang chub sems sogs phur bu bzhi/

/nam mkha' tsan+dan lta bu'i gang zag bzhi/ /kun bzang rigs bzhi'i sa la 'god par shog /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba de nyid la/ gang gis sgrub pa'i slob dpon/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma/ ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dang gsum du yod pa las/ dang po gang gis sgrub par byed pa slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ dkyil chog rdo rje las rim las/ /blo yang rgyud la goms pa dang / /ting 'dzin las su rung ba dang / /phyi nang sde snod thams cad la/ /som nyi med cing the tshom med/ /gsang ba sbas pa'i thabs mchog rnams/ /snod ngan rnams la mi spel zhing / /zab mo'i dbang mchog thob pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid ci rigs pa dang ldan zhing bsnyen pa las su rung ba zhig dgos pa yin la/ gnyis pa gang la bya ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ yang las rim las/ rkyen thub mi bzlog dam tshig can/ shes rab rnam gsum sgo nas sbyangs/ /man ngag lung la rtag dga' zhing / /des shing 'jam la snyan par smra/ /thabs dang shes rab zab mo'i don/ /gnyis med don la mi skrag cing / /slob dpon dag la gus byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /zhes sogs kyi mtshan nyid ci rigs pa dang ldan pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa zhig la mdzad pa rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i phyag len yin zhing / gsum pa ji ltar bya ba'i dbang gi cho ga de nyid 'khrul med kyi yig cha gang gi rjes su 'brang na 'dir slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yang phur thun mong gi sgrub thabs/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i phur pa'i tho yig de dag gi gsal byed dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rtogs par sla ba/

de'i zur 'debs rin po che'i do shal dang / sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gnyis sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba bskyed byed sogs dang / bdag gi bla ma rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang / 'bring po bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun sogs tshad ldan gyi gsung rab de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ tshe 'di nyid la bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du bya bar 'dod pas rdo rje theg pa'i lam la don gnyer gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa dang ldan zhing / khyad par lugs 'di'i chos dang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i skal pa bzang po can gyi rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi phung khams skye mched la sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan du thebs par byed pa ni lugs 'di la brten nas rang dang gzhan gyi don bde blag tu 'grub pa'i 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams kyi med thabs med pa'i rtsa ba'i chos su shes par bya'o// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ smin byed bdud rtsis bltams pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /smin byed don du gnyer ba'i slob ma la/ /smin byed sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bor grags pa 'di/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen rnams las brgyud/ /brgyud pa gzhan gyis 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ /bral zhes dam pa kun gyis bsdags par mdzad/ /mdzad pa 'di 'dri'i rjes 'jug skal ba bzang / /des na lam 'dir 'jug pa'i blo ldan rnams/ /rnams mang yon gyis brgyud ldan bla ma mchod/ /mchod pas mnyes nas smin byed chu bo nos/ /mnos pa ji bzhin skal ldan gzhan la spel/

/bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gis ni chu bo rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba smin byed dbang gi chu bo bskur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i sgo nas thog mar rgyud ma smin pa smin par bya dgos pa'i tshul rnams bstan zin nas/ de ltar dbang gi rgyud smin pa'i gang zag des grol byed kyi lam sgom par byed pa la/ gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo lag len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa'i zab mo'i don rnams nyams su len dgos pas na/ de dag gi don rnams ston pa la/ rgyud kyi khog don drug dang sbyar nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang khog don dang po phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lngas sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba ni/ kī la ya me lce gsang pa'i rgyud las/ gnas dang bdag nyid 'khor rdzas dus/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan na/ /las rnams gang 'dod 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lnga las/ bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa ni/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid kyang / mu stegs can nam sdig can nam/ dam nyams lta bus bsgrub pas chog gam zhe na/ des ni mi 'grub ste/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ /blo sbyangs rgyud goms ting 'dzin gsal/ /theg dgu sde snod don la mkhas/ /dad ldan thugs brtse bag tsha med/ /rig 'dzin bla mar der bshad do/ /zhes pa ltar/ blo sbyangs pa che ba/ rgyud legs par goms pa/ ting nge 'dzin shin tu gsal ba/ theg pa rim pa dgu'i don phyin ci ma log par shes pa/ sde snod gsum gyi don ma lus pa khong du chud pa/ bla ma la dad pa che ba/ slob ma la thugs brtse dung che ba/ sems can gyi don du chos 'chad pa la ngal dub sogs kyis bag tsha ba med pa ste/ yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa rab/ gsum gnyis tshang ba 'bring / tha ma gsum cha tshang ba cig dgos so/ /yang na yon tan gnyis te sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rab rgyud sde dang sde snod mtha' dag shes pa/

'bring tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad shes pa/ tha ma rang rang gi skor ma nyams pa shes pa cig dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud bzang ba/ ngang ring ba/ dad pa che ba/ snying rje che ba/ sgrub pa la mos pa'o/ /de ltar yang phur pa myang 'das las/ phun sum tshogs pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /byams dang snying rje sngon btang la/ /srid pa'i phur bu bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de dag gis ni bdag nyid phun sum tshogs pa bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bshan pa'am/ sdig can gyi khyim mam/ sgo khang ngam/ srang mdo lta bur bsgrubs pas 'grub bam zhe na/ mi 'grub ste/ gnas la gnyis las/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i gnas so/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs kyis bcags pa byin che ba'i gnas/ grub pa thob pa bkra shis pa'i gnas/ gzhung dang mthun pa'i 'grub thag nye ba'i gnas/ yid dang mthun pa nyams dga' ba'i gnas so/ /de ltar yang myang 'das las/ gnas kyi dam pa bstan pa la/ /gzhung ldan bkra shis byin can dang / /nyams dga' ba yi gnas dang bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs kyis bcags pa'i rgyal po'i khab sam/ bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa grub pa thob pa bkra shis pa'i gnas ni/ spa gro stag tshang seṅge phug lta bu'am/ tsha mo rong gi glang brag lta bu'am/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya lta bu'am/ byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong lta bu la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa gzhung dang mthun pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i gzhung dang mthun pa dang / 'di rang gi gzhung dang mthun pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas de'i shar nas phung brdal ba 'dra ba/ lho ri mor bris pa 'dra ba/ nub skyob pa 'dra ba/ byang skyor ba 'dra ba/ yang na shar na ri'am brag 'bras bu'i phung po brdal ba lta bu/ lho na ri'am brag dar dkar gyi yol ba bris pa 'dra ba/ nub na ri'am brag rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba/

byang na ri'am brag btsun mo gu zo re thod gyon pa 'dra ba yod na bzang ngo / /yang na zhib tu brtags te/ shar lho na me lha'i dung ris med pa ste ri'am brag me 'bar ba lta bu yod na ngan/ lho nub na srin po'i mdung rtse med pa ste/ ri'am brag mdung bslangs pa lta bu yod na ngan/ nub byang na rlung lha'i ba dan med pa ste/ ri'am brag ba dan 'dra ba 'dug na ngan/ byang shar na dbang ldan gyi rbab khung med pa ste/ ri'am brag rbab rgyab pa'am rdzogs khung 'dra ba 'dug na ngan pas de 'dra med pa btsal lo/ /gnyis pa 'di rang gi gzhung dang mthun pa ni/ ri'am brag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku 'gying pa 'dra ba la 'dug na gtso bo nye bar 'ong / ri'am brag khro bo'i sku 'gying pa 'dra ba la 'dug na khro bo bcu nye bar 'ong / ri'am brag mgo brnyan gyi sku 'gying pa 'dra ba la 'dug na mgo brnyan nye bar 'ong bar bshad do/ /shar lho mtshams na gcan gzan 'thur la rgyug pa 'dra ba 'dug na shwa na ma nye bar 'ong / lho nub mtshams na mtsho bzhi bskyil ba 'dra ba 'dug na bse mo nye bar 'ong / nub byang mtshams na skyes bu gzhu dkar bdung pa 'dra ba 'dug na skyes bu gying nye bar 'ong / byang shar mtshams na bud med nag mo dar 'phyar ba 'dra ba 'dug na re ma ti nye bar 'ong bar gsung ngo / /bzhi ba yid dang mthun pa nyams dga' ba'i gnas ni/ phu nas dri ma med pa'i chu 'bab pa/ mda' nas rtsi shing nags tshal lo 'dab rgyas pa/ bya skad rnam pa sna tshogs sgrog pa tsha mo rong gi phur ri lta bu ste/ gsang rgyud las/ me tog mang po'i gling yod dang / /ri ni rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /skyed mos tshal dang dpag bsam shing / /ngang pa bung ba'i sgra sgrog cing / /bya ni skad snyan sna tshogs sgrog /gnam ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dra/ /sa ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'dra/ /gnas ni dbyibs legs kha shar bltas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i gnas ni/

gnam gri 'dra ba/ sa gru gsum du yod pa/ logs la tsher ma can gyi shing skyes pa ste/ myang 'das las/ drag po'i gnas kyi dam pa ni/ /dur khrod shing gcig rgya gram lam/ /gcan gzan mang po'i rgyu lam dang / /gnam ni gri 'dra sa gru gsum/ /logs la tsher ma can gyi shing / /de ni drag po'i sgrub gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag gis ni gnas phun sum tshogs pa bshad zin nas/ gsum pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dam nyams sam/ rang bzhin ngan pa can nam/ 'khon grib can gyis 'ong ngam zhe na/ des mi 'ong ste/ 'khor la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ /dad ldan dam che gus la brtson/ /shes rab gsum la blo sbyangs shing / /rtsa ba'i sngags zlos gtsang rme chung / /dkyil 'khor 'bri mkhas 'khor gyi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan kun tshang pa rab/ 'bring gsum gnyis/ tha ma gsum cha tshang dgos/ yang na bka' lo bde ba gyong khengs med pa/ brtul zhugs che ba sgrub pa la dad pa'o/ /dbye na bzhi ste/ phyi nang brda sbyor gyi 'khor/ rdul chags skyes bu'i 'khor/ thugs dang 'thad pa yum gyi 'khor/ mchod pa stob pa'i 'khor ro/ /dang po ni/ thal skyel me len chu bcu ba dang 'phrin skyel ba sogs byed pa ste phyi'i 'khor yin no/ /gnyis pa ni g.yos sogs bya ba byed pa nang gi 'khor ro/ /gsum pa ni gzugs ma mtshan ldan te gsang ba'i 'khor ro/ /bzhi pa ni bsnyen sgrub ji lta ba shes pa cig dgos te/ des rang khams ma bde na thun mi 'chag pa gso dgos pas so/ /gzhan yang snod kyi skyon gsum nges par spangs nas/ yon tan gsum dang ldan pa cig nges par dgos shing / gtso bor dam tshig ma nyams pa gal che'o/ /de dag gis ni 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bshad zin nas/ bzhi pa dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ nam dga' dga' dang ci thong thong du zhugs pas 'grub bam zhe na/ mi 'grub ste/

zla ba dang / tshes grangs dang / skar ma dang / gza' bzhi brtsi ste/ de yang gsang rgyud las/ ra ba bzhi la bsnyen pa'i dus/ /'bring po bzhi la sgrub pa'i dus/ /tha chung bzhi la las sbyor bya/ /zhes pa dang / zla stod thams cad bzlog pa yin/ /zla smad thams cad thebs pa yin/ /ra ba bzhi la gdab las bzlog /'bring po bzhi la zor las bzlog /tha chung bzhi la las dag bya/ /zhes dang / zla ba so so'i tshes grangs yang gsang rgyud las/ dpyid zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ /nyi shu gnyis dang bcu drug 'bring bcu bzhi'o rab/ /shar dang de bzhin shar lhor blta'o/ /dbyar zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ /brgyad rab dang bco lnga 'bring dus drug tu tha ma/ /nub byang byang shar kha blta 'o/ /ston zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ /rab nyi shu bco brgyad 'bring gnyis gsum tha ma la/ /byang shar byang dang nub tu blta'o/ /dgun zla gsum la brdeg pa ni/ /bcu gsum rab bcu drug 'bring nyi shu dgu tha ma/ /byang dang lho ru blta ba 'o/ /dpyid zla gsum la bzlog pa ni/ /bcu bdun rab bcu dgu 'bring tshes gcig nyi shu brgyad tha ma/ /dbyar zla gsum la bzlog pa ni/ /tshes gnyis rab lnga 'bring dang bco lnga dang / /tshes gsum bcu drug bcu bzhi tha ma'o/ /ston zla gsum la bzlog pa ni/ /nyi shu lnga rab dang gsum 'bring dang gnyis tha ma/ /dgun zla gsum la bzlog pa ni/ /bco brgyad rab nyi shu 'bring nyi shu bdun tha ma/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gza' dang skar ma rlung nad phrad pa dang / nyi ma bdud kyi nyi ma sogs la drag po'i las rnams byas na shis par phur pa'i yi ge rnams su bshad cing / bsnyen pa sogs ni gza' dang skar ma shin tu bzang zhing phun sum tshogs pa la bya bar gsungs so/ /de dag gis ni dus phun sum tshogs pa bshad zin nas/

lnga pa rdzas dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa la/ myang 'das las/ lha rnams mnyes par bya ba dang / /srid rtse'i nyes pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las dang ni/ /bsgrub pa'i sngon du rdzas bsog bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'tsho ba zas kyi yo byad/ rkyen bzlog sman gyi yo byad/ lha sgrub pa'i yo byad/ thugs dam bskang ba'i yo byad/ dgra bgegs gsad pa'i yo byad do/ /dang po 'tsho ba zas kyi yo byad ni/ zas dang rten rdzas la sogs pa mi gtsang bas bsgrub tu mi rung zhing / shin tu gtsang sbra dang ldan pa dgos pa yin te/ nus pa khyad par can bskyed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rkyen bzlog sman gyi yo byad la gnyis te/ phyi'i rkyen bzlog pa dang / nang gi rkyen bzlog pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dgra bzlog pa dang / bgegs bzlog pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon du sgrub khang btsan po brag ri lta bu rgyan dang ldan pa/ rbab khung dang / mda' yab dang / spang khang dang / brtsegs khang dang / mdzod chung dang ldan pa bya'o/ /gnas der go cha dang / phub chung dang / mda' gzhu dang / mdung thung dang / 'phrul 'khor dang / sgyogs rdo brang rkang dang ldan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'dre bzlog pa la sreg rdzas dang / zor rdzas dang / thun rdzas dang / bzlas yungs dang / thod ngan dang / dug khrag dang / gu gul dang / tshil chen dang / ro ras dang / shing shun dang / ling ga dang / 'khor lo'i rdzas rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi rkyen bzlog pa la gnyis te/ nang 'dus pa las gyur pa bzlog pa dang / nyon mongs pa rang dbang med par bzlog pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rlung la rlung sman dang / tshad pa la bsil sman dang / grang ba la drod sman dang / 'khris pa la bcas sga bu ram/ tshad nad 'dus pa la sman thams cad tshang bar bya/ gtsags cha dang / thur ma dang / bra ba la sogs pa'ang gsag go /gnyis pa nyon mongs pa'i nad la zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa/

gti mug gi gnyen por rten 'brel bsgom mo/ /yang na chos thams cad rang bzhin med par byas la/ bla ma'i snyan brgyud zab mo thos pa tsam gyis rgyud grol ba/ bsgom pa tsam gyis byin rlabs 'byung ba la nan tan bya'o/ /gong gi gsum pa lha sgrub pa'i yo byad ni/ sgrub khang du stegs bu gru bzhi bar thod rdzas dang bum gter 'jug pa/ yi dam dang srung ma'i gtor ma sogs gshom tshul dang / gzhan yang rgyud las/ spyang dam rdzas yod na shugs kyis 'du/ rang shugs su las byed do/ ki 'phar ba khyi dang wa/ /shwa na ma yi rdzas su bzhag /mar khu zhag dang 'o ma khrag lho nub tu/ /bse mo bzhi yi rdzas su bzhag /mda' nub byang du shas stag ras gzig ras rnams/ /skyes bu gying gi rdzas su bzhag /byang shar gyis bya nag rta nag nal bu'i sha /re ma ti yi rdzas su bzhag /dbus su dpal chen rta yi dkyil gtor gcig /dbus su khri 'u'i steng du bzhag /dza ṣa ta rak+tas mtha' ma bskor/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lag len rnams ni mthong ba'i brgyud pa'i phyag len dang 'bum nag sogs yi ge rnying ma rnams las zhib tu shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa thugs dam bskang ba'i yo byad ni/ sgrub khang der sa rgyan gnam rgyan logs rgyan sogs/ las zhi drag gang byed kyang de dang mthun par gshom par bshad do/ /lnga pa dgra bgegs gsad pa'i yo byad ni/ smad las kyi tshe 'chad pa skabs su babs pas 'dir ma spros so/ /'dir smras pa/ phun tshogs mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /phun tshogs sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /phun tshogs 'khor rdzas dus nam nges byas nas/ /phun tshogs lha mchog sgrubs dang skal bzang rnams/ /ma lus lus can srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'dir snang snang ba'i bya ba kun spangs nas/ /yang dben dben par chos mthun spun grogs dang / /lhan cig gcig tu sgrub rnams 'di phyir bde/ /mdo sngags zab yangs mang du thos pa'i nor/

/nor bu gang de brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung / /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i byi dor byas pa'i rgyan/ /rgyan de gtsug tu bsten na don kun 'grub/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gis ni khog don drug gi dang po phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa las kyi gzhi bzung ba bstan zin nas// ༈ //da ni khog don gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas te don gyi khog dbub pa ni/ gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo lag len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum bsgom tshul la sogs pa'i don rnams ston pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i mngon rtogs 'di la yang rgyud sde thams cad kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa phur pa rtsa dum nyid la brten nas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge rnying ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod cing / khyad par rang lugs kyi bka' srol 'di nyid la'ang rje sa skya pa chen po'i mdzad pa'i yang phur thun mong ba'i sgrub thabs las byang dang bcas pa rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tho yig dpal ldan bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pas sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs sa los mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ de nyid la sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen gyis mchan bu gnang ba/ tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs mang du yod pa las/ 'dir/ 'og min chen por zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /'phags pa'i yul du bho dhi satwa'i mtshan/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /sngags 'chang sngon gyi skyes rab gsum la 'dud/ /ces pa ltar nges pa'i don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku las ma g.yos kyang / skal bar 'tshams pa'i gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/

rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bho dhi satwa dang / bod gangs can gyi khrod du sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med par yang nas yang du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i bdag cag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can de nyid kyi sku'i skye ba snga mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pas don 'grub ces bya ba 'di nyid/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos sam gzhung yin te/ 'di bshad pas sgrub thabs gzhan rnams kyi don yang bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur bas so/ /des na 'di 'chad pa la sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ 'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum gyi dang po la/ gnas dang yo byad 'du bya ba/ tshogs bsags te mtshams bcad pa/ bshags pa bya zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas brgyan te rten bkram pa/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma mdun/ rak+ta g.yas/ phud g.yon/ bsnyen phur mdun/ rnge'u chung la sogs pa gang bder gzhag go /zhes gsungs pa de dag gi don ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam sogs kyi rten dang / khyad par rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku bris 'bur sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bsham la/ de'i mdun du dpal chen po'i gtor ma/ de'i g.yon du rak+ta/ gtor ma'i g.yas su sman phud gtsang ma/ de rnams kyi mdun du/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sogs phyag 'di skabs kyi gtor ma gshom pa'i phyag len la/ dpal chen po'i gtor ma shin tu che ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i g.yas g.yon du rgyas par na khro bo bcu la de dang 'dra ba'i gtor ma bcu gshom par bshad cing /

'bring du steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams la thun mong du gtor ma bzhi/ gtso bo dang bcas pa'i lnga tshar ram/ yang na gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon du khro bo'i spyi gtor re re byas te gsum du byed kyang chog par bdag chen rgya gar ba'i rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil chog phyag len rnams gsal bar bkod pa'i gsung rab las bshad cing / gzhan yang deng sang phyag len rgyas pa'i skabs su mdzad pa'i dam rdzas bcu gcig tshar gshom pa'i thog mar/ dkar gtor zlum po gshog pa can mdzad pa 'di ni rdo rje phur pa'i bdag bskyed bzhes pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ de nas dkar gtor zlum po bzhi gshom pa ni/ rim pa bzhin du/ kyai rdor/ bde mchog gur lcam dral/ zhal bzhi pa rnams kyi yin zhing / de nas zlum gtor dkar po gshog pa cung zad zlum pa'i dbyibs can du byas pa ni/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum dang / de nas dkar gtor zlum po gnyis kyi dang po las mkhan rnams dang phyi ma dkar mo nyi zla'i yin/ de nas dmar gtor gru gsum pa gnyis bya ba ni bdud rgyal dang phur srung dam can bcu gnyis kyi yin zhing / de nas 'jug gi zlum gtor ni/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gi yin no/ /yang phur gtor logs su rgyas par gshom pa'i tshe/ dam rdzas bcu gcig tshar gyi thog ma'i zlum gtor gshog pa can nyid mi mdzad pa'i phyag len kyang snang ngo / /de ltar dam rdzas bcu gcig tshar gyi ngos 'dzin 'di rnams ni/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyis mi dbang gdong dga' bar dam rdzas 'di rnams ngos 'dzin gyi dris lan bka' dam gnang dus blo la zin pa bzhin bris pa yin no/ len bzhin bkod pa mdzes par byas la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ bsnyen phur gzhan yang / rnga/ cha langs/ dung la sogs pa ci bder gzhag la/

yo byad thams cad tshang bar bya zhes pa ste/ rje btsun rin po ches bsnyen sgrub sbags pa'i tho yig las/ de la dang po gnas brgyan te rten bkram pa la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang / gtor ma mdun/ rak+ta g.yas/ phud g.yon/ bsnyen phur mdun/ rnge'u chung dang dril bu gang bder bshams mo/ /zhes mdun gyi rten gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs shing / rnal 'byor pa rang gis byin gyis rlobs pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ 'grel chen 'bum nag las/ g.yas dkar gyi bdud rtsi byin gyis rlobs pas g.yas su bsham/ g.yon dmar gyi rak+ta byin gyis rlobs pas g.yon du bsham/ dbus mthing gi gtor ma byin gyis rlobs pas dbus su bsham ste/ go rim yang bstan to/ /zhes bshad cing / rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa las/ /pho thod mo thod ma ning thod/ /ba ling rak+ta bdud rtsi bsham/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /de nas tshogs bsag pa sogs ni sgrub thabs las/ gnyis pa la tshogs bsag pa dang mtshams bcad pa gnyis kyi dang po la gnyis las/ tshogs bsag pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs gsungs pa de dag gi don/ tshogs bsag shing mtshams gcad pa la/ tshogs bsag pa dang mtshams gcad pa gnyis kyi dang po la yang gnyis te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'o/ /dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ de dag gi tshig don ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba po bdag nyid dang de kho nar ma zad 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ skyabs yul phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo ste sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang /

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas te chos dkon mchog dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag ste dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum ga 'dus pa/ dbang bskur ba sogs gsum ldan gyi rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang de dag gi'ang bla ma nas rdo rje 'chang gi bar brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul gyis skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhan yang theg pa thun mong la grags pa'i dkon mchog gsum dang / khyad par dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas la/ gzhan yang byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bor gnas pa sogs chos la/ 'khor dkyil 'khor ba sogs dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin te/ de dag ni tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba tsam yin la/ cung zad rgyas par phye na/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed las/ rang nyid shar ram lhor kha phyogs pas bstan bde ba la 'dug ste/ nam mkhar bla ma yi dam chos srung rnams mngon sum ltar bzhugs par mos nas skyabs 'gro'i khyad par bzhi gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro gzhung bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bya/ zhes pa dang / sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi sgrub thabs gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun las kyang / rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos nas skyabs 'gro khyad par bzhi ldan gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyad par gzhi ldan gyi skyabs 'gro bya dgos pa las/ de yang khyad par bzhi ni/ yul gyi khyad par/ rten gyi gang zag gi khyad par/ rgyu'i khyad par/ dus kyi khyad par dang bzhi la 'jog dgos te/ bsnyen sgrub gsal byed kyi khyad par bzhi/ zhes pa'i skabs su/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi mchan bu las/

bsdu na skyabs 'gro'i yul bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad du 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam/ skyabs su 'gro ba po rang dang pha ma rigs drug gis skyabs 'gro byed par bsam/ rgyu 'jigs dad snying rje gsum/ dus sangs rgyas ma thob bar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang rgyu'i khyad par ni 'jigs dad snying rje gsum ste/ dang po 'jigs pa la yang bzhi ste/ spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa/ rang don yid byed kyi 'jigs pa/ tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi 'jigs pa'o/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa la/ spyir 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang / bye brag tshe 'di dang bar do dang / skye ba phyi ma'i 'jigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung pas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das/ dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gsod gcod dang bkol spyugs kyi sdug bsngal/ mi la 'dod pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab cing bzod du med la/ sdug bsngal de dag las skyob pa'i skyabs dkon mchog rin po che yin pas/ de'i ched du skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhing / gnyis pa la tshe 'dir chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nad dang gdon la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang / 'chi khar dug gsum drag po skyes pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyor ngan pa dang /

gnad bcong drag po'i gzir ba la sogs pa tshe 'di'i 'jigs pa de rnams las bskyab pa'i phyir dang / gsum pa bar do'i 'jigs pa ni/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang / nyams nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum/ ma nges pa'i rtags drug la sogs pa bar do'i 'jig pa de dag las bskyab pa'i phyir dang / bzhi pa ni/ skye ba phyi mar las ngan gyi dbang gis mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad la sogs pa'i gnas ngan par skye pa dang / sdig grogs la sogs pa'i grogs ngan pa dang 'phrad ba/ sdig dpon la sogs pa'i dpon ngan pa dang / mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa'i slob dpon ngan pa dang / tshig don phyin ci log pa la sogs pa'i chos ngan pa dang / dug gsum shas che ba'i rang rgyud ngan pa la sogs pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'gal rkyen du 'gro ba thams cad la 'jigs shing bskyab pa'i ched du yin la/ gnyis pa rang don yid byed kyi 'jigs pa ni/ 'o na rang nyid gcig pu sdug bsngal de dag las bskyab pa'i phyir/ skyabs su 'gro'am snyam na/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo skyes te nyan rang gi byang chub bsgrub kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub la thag ring du song ba yin te/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi/ /rten gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i rten gyi gegs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las kyang / las dang po pa'i gang zag gi nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed ni/ sems bskyed sna re rgyud la skyes pa dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhi stong gi thag ring du song bar bshad pas so/ /de'i phyir rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi dman sems las bskyab pa'i phyir du yin la/ gsum pa ni/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang yin pa la yin pa ltar du ngo ma shes pa tha mal gyi snang ba sna tshogs su bzung ba la brten nas/

'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung zhing / de las bskyab pa'i phyir dang / snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du shes kyang / lha de la mtshan ma'am bden par mngon par zhen na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las mi thar te/ dngos por 'dzin pa las ma 'das pas so/ /bzhi pa gya nom lhar zhen gyi 'jigs pa ni/ des na snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba de yang rdzogs rim rnam par mi rtog pa'i rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos te/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des phyir gya nom lhar zhen gyi 'jigs pa las bskyab pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba yin/ des na 'jigs pa bzhi po de dag las bskyab pa'i phyir/ skyabs yul khyad par can rnams la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro dgos te/ sngon chad sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa las ma thar ba yang skyabs yul de dag la blo ma khel zhing / zhe thag pa nas skyabs su ma song ba las byung ba yin pas so/ /de skad du yang spyod 'jug las/ sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag gis ni rgyu 'jigs pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba bstan zin la// ༈ //gnyis pa dad pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba la gsum ste/ dang ba'i dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa'o/ /dang po dang ba'i dad pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan thos bsam gyi yul du ma shar ba la brten nas 'di lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa snyam rang byung dngas sing ba'am/ dga' yal le ba zhig 'byung ba de nyid yin la/ 'o na dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ shes bya ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang /

sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i snying rje chen po dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol bar nus pa ste/ de lta bu'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan mthong nas bcos ma ma yin pa'i rab tu dang ba skyes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'dod pa'i dad pa ni/ sngar gyi yon tan de rnams mthong nas/ 'di lta bu'i yon tan rnams bdag gis kyang ci nas thob par 'dod pa'i 'dod pa dang 'dun pa drag po'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gsum pa yid ches pa'i dad pa ni/ yon tan khyad par can de lta bu dang ldan pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyis nam yang mi bslu snyam pa'i spyir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos rnams la yid ches shing / khyad par mi dge ba'i las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams nas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong dgos par gsungs pa dang / rgyu mi dge ba spangs te/ dge ba khyad par can bsgrubs pas mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par gsungs 'dug pas/ de lta bu'i las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing dad 'dun drag pos kun nas blangs te/ sdig pa mi dge ba thams cad spong zhing / dge ba khyad par can sgrub pa'i blang dor phyin ci ma log pa lag len la khel ba zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gsum pa snying rje ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can drin chen gyi pha ma sha stag yin la/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ngos drag la yun ring pa 'di las ci nas kyang sgrol dgos pa 'dug ste/ de lta bu'i nus pa ni da lta bdag la med cing / bdag las ches lhag pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang stong 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / tshangs pa dang rgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams la yang med/

der ma zad sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang med la/ 'o na su la yod na skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la yod pas/ de'i phyir sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba bla na med pa la 'god nus pa cig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de dag ni khyad par bzhi'i nang nas rgyu'i khyad par nyid yin la/ gnyis pa yul gyi khyad par ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la lam ston pa'i ston pa dang / chos la lam dngos dang / dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba'i tshul gyis skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhing / de yang smin mtshams tsam gyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge'i bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ yi dam lha tshogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par mos pa'am/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa ltar na/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos pa byed pa'o/ /de yang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes pa nas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin pas/ skyabs yul thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gyi rnam pa can du bsgom dgos la/ de yang phyogs bcu ni/ phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / dus gsum ni/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum na byon pa dang 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pas na bde bar gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'o/

/de lta bu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung 'od dpag med/ thugs mi bskyod pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'phrin las don yod grub pa ste mdor na sangs rgyas rigs lnga thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung po nyi khri chig stong / zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung po nyi khri chig stong / gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa'i chos gyi phung po nyi khri chig stong / dug gsum cha mnyam pa 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung po nyi khri chig stong ste/ chos kyi phung po stong khrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ nyan thos 'phags pa/ rang rgyal 'phags pa/ byang sems 'phags pa ste 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag yin pas/ de dang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams tha mi dad pa de nyid thabs kyi bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du bsgom pa ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i rim gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug pa de/ gsang sngags pa rnam pa lam du byed pa'i dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i bdag nyid/ bka' bstan bcos sogs gsung rab po ti'i rnam pa gdong dar phra bun ne ba gtso bo'i sku rgyab tu bsgom pa ni chos dkon mchog theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog thams cad kyang khro bo bcu la sogs pa 'khor gyi lha tshogs su bsgom pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ de dag ni khyad par bzhi'i nang nas yul gyi khyad par ro/ /gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba po rten gyi gang zag gi khyad par ni/ 'o na rang nyid gcig pu'i skyabs yul de rnams la skyabs su song bas chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/ gzhung las/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ ces 'byung bas/
