nyams grib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /zhes pa ste/ de ltar gyur pa las rang nyid nyams shing thar pa la sgrib pa'i grib kyis gos pas mdor na nyes par byed pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun bshags zhes pa'i don yin la/ gnyis pa gang la bshags par bya ba ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags dgos pas/ rten gyi stobs ni/ spyir phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams dang / khyad par rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dam tshig can gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bshags zhes pa ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mtshan ma smos pa dang / smos pa las spyi dang sgos su bzhag pa'o/ gsum pa ji ltar bshags par bya ba ni/ sngar byas 'gyod dang zhes pa rkang pa gsum gyis bstan te/ de yang sngar byas pa'i sdig pa la dug zos pa lta bu 'gyod sems drag po bskyed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las mi byed snyam pa gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs kyi sdom sems kyi sgo nas bshags/ de yang bshags bya bshags byed bshags yul rnams snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du 'gyod tshangs rnams thol zhing bshags kyis/ 'gyod tshangs dag pa'i dngos grum ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes pa'i don yin la/ de yan gyis thog mar bshags pa'i rnam gzhag rnams bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa rjes su sdom pa bskyang ba la/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi dang po la/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa/ skyabs 'gro gsum gyi dang po ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/

/zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ba'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi bdag nyid can lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pas bstud de phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i don yin zhing / gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i/ /zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang phyi 'dod yon dang / nang bdud rtsi/ gsang ba byang sems bla na med pa mnyes mchod la sogs pa mchod pa kun gyis gus pas mchod par bgyid cing / khyad par bde bar gshegs pa khyed rnams kyi bka' drin dang 'bangs bya ba'i ched kyi phyir bdag gi lus kyang 'bul bar bya zhes pa'i don yin la/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba la/ yul thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa dang / khyad par ba gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /zhes pa tshig rkang gnyis te/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid dang / chos lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid can dang / dge 'dun yon tan gyi gnas su gyur pa'i 'phags pa ste phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong ba'i dkon mchog gsum la dus rtag tu bdag gzhan sems can thams cad ni skyabs su mchi zhes pa'i don yin zhing / yang sangs rgyas chos dang sogs kyi don slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim gyi rang 'grel nas 'byung ba ltar bshad na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes sogs kyi don ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo rdo rje gzhon nu ni yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas de'i thugs ka na gnas pa'i snying po dam pa yi ge hūm̐ ni chos/ dpa' bo'i 'khor na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams ni dge 'dun no/

/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum po ni skyabs su gsol ba'i gnas so/ /skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba ni rnal 'byor pa'i lus ngag yid gsum ste/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa'o/ /zhes 'byung zhing / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rnal 'byor sngags bdag ces sogs te/ de ltar ye shes kyi 'khor lo la skyabs su gsol nas/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la gsol ba btab pa'i phyir gnyis su med pa'i don las byung ba'i rnal 'byor dam pa gsang ba'i sngags kyi bdag por gyur pa'i dbus kyi gtso bo he ru ka dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can de rnams la yang rnal 'byor pa bdag lus ngag yid gsum skyabs su 'chi zhes pa'i don yin la/ gsum pa khyad par ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi/ zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid chen por gyur pa yi stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems kyi dngos po ni rdo rje slob dpon yin pas/ de'i phyir khyad par can du gyur pa'i yul gang zhig la lan gcig ma yin par yang yang du rdo rje slob dpon la dus rtag tu rnal 'byor pa bdag ni skyabs su mchi zhes pa'i don yin la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ khas blangs pa'i dbang por gsol ba dang / khas len dngos bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ /zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de ltar gong du skyabs su gsol ba'i lha tshogs dkyil dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams dang / de lta bu'i gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ ting nge 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi ngang can 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / slob dpon dam pa rnams la bdag dad pa dang ldan pas rjes su 'jug na thugs g.yengs pa lta bu ni ma yin/ bu gcig pa la ma byams pa bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ni de dag ma lus pa bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa yin la/

gnyis pa khas len dngos bshad pa la/ mthun phyogs bsgrub pa/ mi mthun phyogs spang ba/ dge ba spel ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bdag gi dus 'di nas zhes pa tshig rkang gsum ste/ de yang de rnams kyi spyan sngar khas blangs zhing dam bcas pa ni 'di'o/ /zhes rnam grangs rjes dran pa yin te/ de yang sngon gyi dus dang dus de ring khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mchis shing dam bcas pa ni rnal 'byor pa rang gi ming yid yul du byas la chos kyi ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bdag gi dus 'di nas bzung ba nas brtsams te/ 'on te'am/ ji srid du byang chub mi thob mi srid pas/ de srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ bdag gis dkyil 'khor slob dpon dang bcas pa rnams kyis ji ltar bsgo ba'i sdom pa legs par lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzung bar bgyi zhes sngar dbang dus su thob pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i phyir dam bca' ba ste/ rdo rje las rim rang 'grel las/ de ni dang po ji ltar bsgo ba khas len zhing dam bcar gzhug pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mi mthun phyogs spang ba ni/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa gang / /zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang rnal 'byor pa bdag gi tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i dus nas lus ngag yid gsum gyis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / gzhan dag la bdag gis bgyid du stsal ba dang / gzhan dang gzhan dag gis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa gang yin thams cad/ dkyil 'khor rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dang / slob dpon dam pa la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag mchis nas su/ dus gsum kyi sdig pa bgyis pa rnams sngar byas pa ni yul mchog khyed rnams la ma lus pa so sor mthol lo bshags so/ /de lta mi bgyid do/ /phyis kyang sdom lags so snyam du bshags par bya ba'i don yin la/ gsum pa dge ba spel ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems/

/zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang ya tha rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te dbus kyi gtso bo dang / de'i gsung dam pa'i chos yang dang yang du bstan par mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang / der ma zad gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor dam pa blang bar bya la/ gzhan dag ni dor bar bya ba ma yin te/ ma tha rang rgyal dang / zag pa zad pa'i dgra bcom pa nyan thos la sogs pa de dag gi dang / gzhan yang 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams thams cad la rnal 'byor pa bdag dga' zhing phrag dog med par/ de rnams la rjes su yi rang ngo zhes pa'i don yin zhing / bzhi pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can ma lus srid par ltung / /zhes pa tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de yang khams gsum na gnas pa'i sems can ma lus pa ste srid par ltung ba'i lam rgyud lnga/ 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa rnams la dus kun la phan gdags par bya ba'i phyir/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid rnam par smin pa'i lus gdos bcas dang bcas pa 'dis ni phan thogs par mi 'gyur gyis/ rgyu mtshan des na mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byas la/ da gzod du sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba'i slad du/ bdag gis bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan sngar mchis pa'i dus 'di nyid du ni/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis bskyed par bgyi'o zhes pa'i don te/ de dag gis ni bshags pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags par byas zin pas/ rang rgyud kyi sdig pa thams cad dag nges snyam pa'i dga' ba gdung pa zhig bsgom ste/ sor chud pa'i stobs dran par byas la/ de nas sngar rten gyi stobs kyi skabs su spyan drangs pa'i mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing ngam/ tshogs kyi rten de thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i sngags tshig rnams brjod cing /

sems kyi tshogs kyi zhing de thams cad 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i rnam par mer gyis zhu ste rang gi snying gar thim par bsam mo/ /de dag ni rje btsun rin po che'i tho yig las/ gsum pa spyi shes pa'i bshags pa dang / mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i don dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas bshags pa bya ba'i tshul rnams bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ nyes pas ma gos dam pa'i mchog yin yang / /nyes pa bshags byed de yang dam pa zhes/ /nyes pa kun bral bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /nyes pa 'dag par 'dod rnams 'di longs shig /bshags pas nyes ltung ma lus bshags byas nas/ /bsod nams bsgrub la brtson pa'i bsod nams can/ /skyes mchog de 'dra gang de skyes bu'i mchog /'di phyi kun du bde ba 'di nyid yin/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa byin gyis brlabs pa la/ /bdag dang gnas sogs la byin dbab pa dang / /rdzas sogs byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs las/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros zhes sogs te/ de yang rang gi lus rdo rje gzhon nur gsal pa'i snying ga nas sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag rnal 'byor pa rang nyid dang mdun bskyed dang 'brel na de'i dkyil 'khor gyi gnas te/ dkyil 'khor gang du sgrub pa'i sa phyogs dang / mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba bdag bskyed kho na'i dbang du byas na/ sgrub pa po rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de nyid ka dkyil 'khor gyi gnas yin par gsungs pas de lta bu'i gnas su thims pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur bar bsam pa ste/ 'di la so sor gsol ba dang / /thun mong du gsol ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs las/ hūm̐ nam mkha'i 'di'i dbyangs la byin dbab kyi ldings dbyangs zhes bya zhing /

sngon gyi dbyangs rnying yin par dbyangs kyi brjed byang seṅge'i nga ro las bshad do/ mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs te/ de dag gi tshig don ni/ byin gyis rlob pa po spyan drangs pa'i gnas/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa rgya dang phyogs su ma chad pa nas drangs/ spyan drangs bar 'os pa gang spyan drangs na/ zhi ba dang khro bo'i lha rab 'byams mtha' yas pa'i tshogs mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu dang byin rlabs can rnams tshur gshegs zhes pa'i tshig gis spyan drangs pa bzhin 'dir byon la/ de ltar spyan drangs nas gang gsol snyam na/ gnas mchog gam/ dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs pa dang / sgrub pa po phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag la dbang bzhi bskur te dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes pa'i don yin la/ dbang ji ltar bskur na/ dri ma dag pa dang / skal pa 'jog pa dang / 'bras bu la dbang ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya ste/ /des na dbang zhes brjod par bya/ /zhes pa'i don rje btsun rin po ches/ yi ge sgras drangs pa'i bshad pa dang sbyar te gsal bar mdzad pa ltar yin la/ 'dir skabs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa rnams gnas sam gdan nyid la ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin te/ dper na pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pa 'byung ba ltar/ 'dir gnas dang gdan dang dkyil 'khor gsum shin tu 'brel zhing / de bzhin du gnas dang dkyil 'khor mi 'gal ba la dgongs nas/ gnas rak+ta'i mtsho nas spyan 'dren pa la/ rak+ta mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ de ltar zhi khro rab 'byams spyi'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/

khyad par rab khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa ni/ sgrub thabs las/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang gang nas spyan drangs na/ chos kyi dbyings mtshon pa gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gnas sam dkyil 'khor nas drangs/ gang spyan drangs na bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ gtso bo yab yum spyan drangs/ dgos pa ci'i phyir spyan drangs na/ gnas sam dkyil 'khor la byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sgrub pa po la dbang bskur ba'i phyir drangs/ byed las ci byed na/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa ste bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa yin la/ de nas phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi khro bcu yab yum spyan drangs pa ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ skal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil lam/ dkyil 'khor nas/ gang spyan drangs na/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor te khro bo bcu yab yum mo/ /de nas khra thabs nyi shu spyan drangs pa ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ zhing chen te mi ro gsar rnying spungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas drangs/ gang spyan drangs na/ yab kyi sprul pa g.yas pa'i phyag brnyan bcu dang / yum gyi sprul pa g.yon gyi phra man bcu ste lcam dral nyi shu spyan drangs/ de nas sgo ma bzhi spyan drangs ba ni/ gang nas spyan drangs pa na/ byams pa dang sogs khong nas snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms tshad med bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ram gnas te de'i ngang nas spyan drangs/ gang spyan drangs na/ tshad med bzhi'i sems can rnams rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi nas 'dren pa'i sprul pa'i ye shes sgo ma bzhi spyan drangs/ de nas sras mchog lnga spyan drangs pa ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ las bzhi ste zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las ma lus pa sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ gang spyan drangs na phur pa sras kyi lha tshogs te/ sras mchog rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum dngos spyan drangs pa yin la/

de nas mgron thabs kyi lha'am 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa la/ thog mar gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong pha rol nas ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas kyi gshin rje dmar nag gi lha tshogs te chags sdang gi gnyen por gyur pa sbyangs 'bras la sbyang gzhi'i ming gis btags pa'am 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i gshin rje rnams spyan drangs/ 'dir skabs kyi gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi ngos 'dzin ni sa lo chen po'i rin chen rtsa ba'i dris len las/ gshin rje dmar nag ces pa ni/ /rnying ma ba la grags pa'i kha thun gdong drug zil gnon/ ma ru rtse rnams dang / gsar ma'i dmar nag 'jigs gsum kyang yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas ma mo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs spyan drangs pa ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ rak+ta ste khrag gting mtha' yas pas mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs te sha za'am 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba'i mkha' 'gro rnams spyan drangs/ de nas gying gi lha tshogs spyan drangs ba ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ rkang rus ri ltar spungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ ging chen ka ra'i lha tshogs zhes pa las sna tshogs byed pas sam pho nya ste rgya skad du/ kiṃ ka ra zhes 'byung ba yin la/ 'di nyid btsan bdud rgyal po sogs 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba rnams yin par sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rin chen rtse ba'i gnyer pa la gnang ba'i dris lan springs yig las gsungs te/ de nyid las gying ka ra zhes pa/ /'og sman mchod kyi skabs na/ gying chen bco brgyad gying phran 'bum sde la zhes pa dang don gcig pas/ btsan bdud rgyal po sogs 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba rnams yin la/ 'di dag ngos 'dzin rnying ma'i yig cha rgya che ba rnams su gsal zhes gsungs so/ /de nas phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs spyan drangs pa ni/

gang nas spyan drangs na/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gang spyan drangs na/ ma dang sring mo bu dang ming po la byams pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa po'i grogs mdzad ma/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rjes su zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs de thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ bod yul mun pa'i smag rum na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir bsam bzhin du sku'i skye ba bzhes pa bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul zhing dam la btags nas bod yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ slar yang bod 'dir srin po'i dmag gi 'jigs pas nyen par gzigs nas/ de bsrung ba'i phyir srin po'i kha gnon du da lta yang lho nub rnga yab gling gi pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma sprin phung 'thibs pa lta bu'i bskor ba spyan drangs pa ni/ gang nas spyan drangs na/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi gling g.yog rnga yab kyi gling 'di'i dbyangs sngon gyi dbyangs rnying ma gzhi mdzad nas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas gsar du mdzad par sems te/ sa lo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dbyangs yig kun gsal sgra dbyangs las gzhan pa'i dbyangs yig rnying pa rnams su 'di mi 'byung bas so/ lho nub srin po bsnol ba'i gdan stengs sam de dang don 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor nas spyan drangs/ gang spyan drangs na slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i byin rlabs can 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ spyan drangs nas gang gsol na/ spyan drangs pa bzhin du tshur gshegs te dkyil 'khor ram gnas mchog 'di la byin gyis rlabs pa dang /

sgrub pa po mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur te/ dngos grub thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de la brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum gyis bskor ba nam mkhar sprin 'thibs pa ltar thibs kyis byon par bsam/ de'i 'og rig lnga gdan tsho lnga la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams byon/ de'i 'og rigs 'dzin 'bum phrag du ma la ma mo mkha' 'gros bskor ba byon par bsam ste/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs par bsams la/ gnyis pa thun mong du gsol ba ni/ a la la hoḥzhes pas spro ba bskyed/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams gsal btab/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa ma ya ho/ zhes brjod pas/ yum rnams kyis bskul/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas yab rnams kyis gnang ste/ de lta bu'i sgo nas nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam pa can thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pas 'od dang 'od zer gyis rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas dpag tu med pa byung / gnas la thim pas gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs nas gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel tshe de nyid la thim pas byin rlabs gong 'phel du byas/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang / dbang bzhi thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad rtsa ba nas dag mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa skad cig de nyid la thob par bsams la/ de nas ngo mtshar ba'i tshig gis dam tshig bskul ba ni/

sgrub thabs las/ 'phags mchog 'di'i dbyangs chos rje bla ma dam pas bka' gnang nas/ dkon gnyer slob dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa yin par rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris dbyangs kyi brjed byang las bshad do/ thugs rje'i dus la babs/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang 'phags mchog ces spyan drangs pa de thams cad la bos nas/ thugs rje'i nus pa 'byin pa'i dus la babs 'phrin las kyi khyad par bstan pa'i dus la babs/ byin rlabs kyi mthu rtsal byung ba'i dus la babs/ sgrub pa po la byin gyis rlobs ba'i dus la babs/ /sgrub pa po la dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la babs/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs/ zhes bskul te/ bskul ba ltar mdzad par gsol ba ni/ mthu can zhes bos nas/ bdag la mthu stobs bskyed cig kyai bcom ldan 'das zhes nan tan bya ba'i don du slar yang bod ba ste lan gnyis bod pa'o/ /de bzhin du byin can zhes bos nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig kyai bcom ldan 'das zhes slar yang bod/ dbang chen zhes bos nas bdag la dbang bskur cig kyai bcom ldan 'das zhes slar yang bod/ dngos grub kyi mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang stsol cig kyai bcom ldan 'das zhes bod/ mdor na bdag las dag pa byas pa'i 'bras bu thams cad 'dir mchis par mdzod la/ dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'bad med du bdag la stsol/ zhes pa'i don can gyi tshig gis gsol ba btab la/ skabs 'dir sgrub thabs kyi gzhung du gsal bar mi 'byung yang / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gong gi lha tshogs rnams rang la thim par bsam dgos par snang ste/ rje sa chen gyi rdo rje phur pa'i las byang las/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la babs/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyi rjes su/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa 'di 'byung bas de'i dgongs don gzhag rgyu de las gzhan du ma 'das pas so/

/rnga dang dung sil snyan dril bu la sogs pa'i rol mo rnams 'bud dkrol gyi sgra dang bcas pas kyang byin dbab pa sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar bya ba ste/ de yan gyis bdag dang gnas la sogs pa byin dbab pa bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa rdzas sogs byin gyis brlabs pa la/ myang 'das las/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gi 'bru gsum gyis/ /bsregs gtor sbyangs pa'i rim pa yis/ /'phel zhing bcud dang ldan par ni/ /thugs kyi hūm̐ gis brlab par bya/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ bdud rtsi thod pa mdun bzhag la/ /sbyor ba'i ngang las bde ba bsgrub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'di la yang / spyir khog phub nas bstan pa dang / gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'i sgo nas nyams len gyi rim pa bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'grel chen 'bum nag sogs las 'byung ba ltar bshad par bya ste/ de yang sdom ni/ gang gis byin rlabs snod gang yin/ /bsam rgyu'i rdzas gang sbyong byed gang / /phyag rgya bskyed pa'i lha gang yin/ /byin rlabs mdo gsum rtsa ba brgyad/ /yan lag sum cu so gsum mo/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni/ gang gis byin gyis rlob byed gsum ni/ zhal g.yas dkar bas bdud rtsi byin gyis rlob pas bdud rtsi g.yas su bsham/ zhal g.yon dmar bas rak+ta byin gyis rlob pas rak+ta g.yon du bsham/ zhal dbus mthing bas gtor ma byin gyis rlob pas gtor ma dbus su bsham pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang du bsham pa'i snod la yang gsum ste/ rgyud las/ pho thod mo thod ma ning thod/ /bha liṃ rak+ta bdud rtsi sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ma ning gi tho par bdud rtsi/ pho thod du gtor ma/ mo thod du rak+ta bshams/ gsum pa gang bsham rgyu'i dngos po la yang gsum ste/ sman phud gtsang ma la bdud rtsi sbyar ba dang / 'bru sna la dpal zas rgyan dang bcas pa ste/ de yang gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ ched du gtad nas bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha la ya chos nyid du shes pa'i dmigs pa dang /

lhar shes pa'i dmigs pa dang / dgug gzhug tu shes pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngags las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ yang 'od zer skye 'gro thams cad la phog pas las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dag par byas nas/ thams cad chos nyid kyi ngang du lhan lhan song bar bsam pa yin par bshad la/ gnyis pa kī la ya lhar shes pa'i dmigs pa ni/ sngags kyi 'od zer las rdo rje gzhon nur gyur te/ de re res kyang zhal nas sngags bzlas pas 'od zer 'phros te/ snang srid thams cad la phog pas snang srid thams cad lha tshogs su gyur par bsam pa yin la/ gsum pa kī la ya dgug gzhug tu shes pa'i dmigs pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer lcags kyu la sogs pa spros la/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam par shes pa nri dang tri'i gzugs su gnas pa de/ lcags kyu'i bzung / zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bu'i myos par byas la ling ga la bstims par bsgom pa yin par gsungs shing / mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu'i bzlas pa ni/ dper na shing bu phra mo'i sna la me sbar nas bskor na/ dmar thag rgyun ma chad par 'khor nas 'ong ba ltar/ sngags bzlas pas 'od zer rgyun ma chad par bsam pa ni/ mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bu'i bzlas pa zhes bya/ 'di la yang yul la bsten nas brgyad du 'gyur ba yi ge rnying ma rnams las 'byung ba yin te/ de yang rnal 'byor pa rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs sbyang pa la/ rang gi lus kyi gnas su 'phro 'du bya ba dang / bsnyen pa'i nus pa gsog pa la sras mchog dang 'phro 'du bya ba dang / dam can bsnyen pa la dam can dang 'phro 'du bya ba dang / sgrol ba la dmigs pa'i dus su dgra bgegs dang 'phro 'du bya ba dang / dbang bskur ba'i dus su lha dang 'phro 'du bya ba dang / tshe sgrub pa'i dus su tshe bum dang 'phro 'du bya ba dang / dngos grub len pa'i dus su zhal zas dang 'phro 'du bya ba dang / gshin don gyi dus su gshin po'i sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang brgyad du bshad pa yang yod mod kyi/

'dir skabs su babs pa/ kī la sogs bzlas pa'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba mgal me ltar 'khor ba bsgom pa la/ thog mar kī la ya bzla ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags 'phreng kha dog sngon po'i 'od zer dmar po lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu rdo rje'i dbus ra nas byung / ye shes sems dpa'i shang bug g.yas dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shang phug g.yas nas zhugs de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de las sngags 'phreng byung / mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shang bug g.yas nas 'thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon dang / ye shes sems dpa'i shang bug g.yas nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i dbus ra nas song / rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / sngags 'phreng phyir 'gro dus de las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar chod thams cad zhi bar byas/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gyur/ sngags 'phreng nang du 'ong dus sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sngags 'phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor bar bsam zhing / sems gtad la rang gi sngags brjod pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang / sems can yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyis rang gi sngags bzla grogs byed par bsam zhing / thog mar gtso bo'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ 'khor gzhan rnams kyi bzlas pa bya ba'i tshe/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba rnams lha thams cad kyi thugs tsit+ta'i dkyil 'khor nas brgyud/ srog pa rtsa'i lam nas byung / mid pa byang chub kyi lam nas ljags dmar nag gi steng du 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi 'od zer las/ rang 'dra'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/

mdun bskyed kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor pa la sogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams mchod cing / dngos grub rang 'dra'i skur 'dus/ rang la thim pa dang / yang sngags kyi 'od las rang 'dra ba'i sku spros pa/ 'jig rten pa rnams la phog pas/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnams sbyangs te rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang la 'god par bsam pa dang / skabs 'gar gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi gsal byed rdo rje'i dbal nas 'byung ba ltar gyi/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas sngags so so'i grangs ni/ gtso bo la stong rtsa brgyad/ 'khor rnams la brgya rtsa brgyad/ phra men dang sgo ma la nyi shu rtsa re/ dbang phyug ma la bh+yoḥbadun bdun bzla'o/ /'di dag ni dus rgyun gyi sgrub pa'i grangs tshad du phur pa'i yi ge rnying ma rnams nas 'byung ba yin la/ bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad ni/ spyir rgyud kun nas yig 'bru bco lnga man la 'bru 'bum/ yi ge sum cu man la bzhi 'bum/ de bas mang ba rnams la 'bum mam khri bskyal bar yang gsungs shing / bye brag rdo rje phur pa 'di la/ kī la ya dgongs rgyud nas/ bsnyen pa bdun 'bum nyi khri 'don/ /bye ba sa yas gdon mi za/ /zhes pa dang / bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin dam tshig ma nyams na/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis dus 'dir thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / ting 'dzin 'phro 'du gsal ba yi/ /bsnyen pa nyi khri bdun 'bum bzlas/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags rnams kun/ /dus der mi 'byung mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la/ 'di'i bsnyen pa'i dus su/ kī la ya 'bum phrag bcu drug kha skong dang bcas pa mdzad pa yin te/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi 'od can las/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa la ni tshad med la/ smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang du byas na/

kī la ya la yi ge srog can bcu drug yod pas 'bru 'bum gyi 'bum phrag bcu drug de'i kha skong khri tsho bcu drug stong phrag bcu drug rnams bzlas nas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang gi bar du phyag len rgyun ma chad par yod pa 'di yin zhing / 'o na gtso 'khor thams cad kyi bsnyen pa'i sngags kī la 'ba' zhig la byas pas chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ 'di ni thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags yin pas/ 'di kho na la bsnyen pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ba yin te/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis dkyil 'khor cho ga yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bum pa 'bul tshul bshad pa'i skabs su 'di ltar gsungs te/ dkyil chog las rang sngags kyi phyogs mtshams su dbul lo gsungs pa bzhin kī la ya la/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ /badz+ra shes rab yum du brjod/ /kī li dang po khro bo bcu/ /kī li gnyis pa khro mo bcu/ /zhes de la sogs pa'i sgo nas gtso 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags yin pas bum pa 'bul ba/ sbyin sreg grangs 'dzin pa/ bsnyen pa sogs kī la ya 'ba' zhig mdzad pa 'di ni gtso 'khor thams cad tshang ba la dgongs shing don la gnas pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar gong du bshad pa'i bzlas sngags rnams tshar ba'i rjes su/ gzhi snying gcig tu gril ba'i sngags 'di yang tshar gcig mdzad pa phyag len yin pas/ mahā rak+mo yak+mo/ ka la ru pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la khril khril/ srog la chuṃ chuṃ/ tsit+ta srog la btung btung / thuṃ ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shan/ snying tshag tshag 'ur 'ur/ shig shig gul gul/ nyal nyal/ sod sod/ dha ti ma mā shi gh+raṃ/ karma ka ra/ ma ra s+ya na pra mar+dha ni ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas pa tshar ba dang / bde bar gshegs pa sogs spyi ltar brjod cing 'phreng ba la kha rlangs phog pa rang gi mgo thog tu bzhag pas byin rlabs bstims nas/

mdun gyi nam mkha'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang / bskyed ma thag pa'i ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thims pas/ bdag nyid gzi brjid bkrag mdangs nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan par bsams la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas zhes sogs te/ de yang ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa khyed rnams sngon gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs las bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs sgrol ba dang / kī la ya ste rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'dir thob pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'i don te/ de dag gis ni mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyi nang nas 'dzab kyi mchod pa bya ba'i tshul gyi rnam par bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ lha tshogs mngon sum nyid du bya ba'i phyir/ /gsang sngags zab mo bzlas pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /su yis 'bad kyang tha mal snang srid kun/ /myur du lha sngags ye shes ngo bor 'char/ /dang por dus dang grangs kyi bsnyen pa nyid/ /brtson pas bsgrubs na 'phrin las lha 'di nyid/ /gzhan las thugs rje myur bas mtshan ma'i rtags/ /myur du 'byung zhing de yi byin rlabs kyis/ /yi dam gzhan gyi'ang gegs sel bogs 'don du/ /'gyur ba 'di ni chos 'di'i brgyud pa rnams/ /grub thob kho na byon pa'i rten 'brel las/ /'byung ba yin zhing lha mchog 'di'i bsnyen pa/ /su yis bgyis kyang gegs med mthar phyin du/ /'byung ba'i tshul 'di nyams myong tshad ma yis/ /grub ces sa skya lo tsā'i gsung rab las/ /bshad phyir 'di la som nyi ga la yod/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de dag gis ni rtsa rgyud las/ /bgegs bskrad byin rlabs spyan drangs dngos/ /mchod dang bskang dang bzlog pa dag

/stod kyi las su shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'grel chen 'bum nag las/ stod las smad las 'phrin las so sor gdags/ /zhes pa dang / dkyus kyi tshig drug ma shes na/ /'phrin las gong 'og shan mi phyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar na/ de yan chad kyi stod las sam/ 'phrin las gong ma'am/ yi ge rnying ma 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba ltar na dkar po byang chub lam gyi sgron me zhes bya ba'i rnam gzhag rnams bstan zin pa yin zhing / de ltar bshad pa de dag ni chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang sngags bla med kyi lam thams cad dbang bzhi dang lam rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas nyams su len dgos pa las gong du bshad pa de dag ni bskyed rim gyi skor yin la/ de la yang phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / nang bskyed pa'i rim pa gnyis yod pa las phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa ni gong du rgyas par bshad pa ltar yin la/ da ni nang bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / gsang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs rim dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang nang bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / gsang ba bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs rim dang bcas pa rnams ni phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu nyid las dngos su gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / phur pa gsang rgyud las gsungs pa 'grel chen 'bum nag gi bcud bsdus pa/ 'bum chung du grags pa las 'byung ba ltar bshad na/ de yang gsang rgyud las/ dbang chen 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus la rdzogs/ /phung po lnga ni sras lnga'i dngos/ /sku lnga ye shes dgu dang ldan/ /rang sems nor bu rin po che/ /zhes pas nang bskyed rim bstan pa yin par gsungs shing / gsang ba bskyed rim ni/ yang gsang rgyud las/ gsang ba'i gzhal yas bstan pa ni/ /ye nas rang byung dam pa de/ /sangs rgyas rol mo du mas 'khrid/ /rgyan dang bla bre'i rang bzhin grub/

/sangs rgyas gzhal yas dam pa yin/ /de yi dbus na bzhugs pa'i lha/ /phra la dod bar brtag pa bya/ /de yang yang dang yang du ni/ /phra ba'i sems kyis bzung gyur na/ /'jug tu dmigs pa med par 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pas ston par bshad la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir thig le'i rnal 'byor bshad pa la/ steng sgo 'khor lo la brten te bde ba rim gyis bskyed pa dang / 'og sgo khams gsum rol ba la brten te bde ba gcig car du bskyed pa gnyis/ steng sgo la 'khor lo'i gnas tshul/ ye shes skye tshul/ de la goms par bslab tshul dang gsum yod pa la/ 'khor lo'i gnas tshul ni/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas na sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo gnas so/ /de yang sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /zhes pas spyi bo na rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbus na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ lte ba la haṃ mgo 'thur bstan rtsibs la 'khor lo 'bru brgyad/ rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis la sgra yig sum cu rtsa gnyis gdugs phub pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ mgrin pa na chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las zhes pas rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi dkyil na pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lte ba la oṃ dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ 'dab ma la ki li 'bru brgyad/ rtsa 'dab la dbyangs yig bcu drug sku'i dbyibs su bdag bskyed cig ces pas snying ga na rtsa 'dab brgyad/ dbus na rin chen zur brgyad pa lte ba la hūm̐ mthing ga mgo mthur bstan/ rat+na zur brgyad la ki li 'bru brgyad/ rtsa 'dab la sde tshan brgyad kyi yi ge dang po/ tsakra thams cad kyi srog shing kun 'dar mas byas pas byang sems 'bab pa/ g.yas su ro ma dang / g.yon du rkyang ma/ de gsum lte ba na 'dus pa'o/ /lte ba'i tsakra 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa zhes pas rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus na gru gsum brgyad/

lte ba na oṃ mgo gyen bstan/ gru gsum la ka li 'bru brgyad/ rtsa 'dab la sgra yig sum cu rtsa gnyis phrag gnyis/ me rlung 'phrin las kyi tsakra na/ mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yis/ /zhes pa rlung gi tsakra kha dog sngo skya/ de'i steng na me'i 'khor lo lte ba'i 'og na kha dog dmar po dbyibs gru gsum raṃ yig dang bcas pa 'bar ba'i tshul/ de ni rtag tu drod che'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes skye tshul gyi thabs gtum mo sbar ba ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar/ /zhes pas spyi bo'i haṃ zhu bas thig le 'bab pa'o/ /de yang 'og sgo sgul bas yaṃ las rlung langs/ raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar/ des lte ba'i tsakra zhu/ khams bde ba skye/ de snying ga'i tsakra la phog dngas ma zhu/ de'i 'od kyi mgrin pa dang spyi bo la phog de 'od du zhu byang sems dbu ma nas bab/ lte ba'i tsakra gsos/ bde ba skyes de la goms par bslab bo/ /sngon du rlung la bslabs pa la/ rlung bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ bcing ba/ g.yas su spo ba/ g.yon du spo ba rnams su yod par gsungs shing / gnyis pa 'og sgo ni/ phyag rgya la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes bskyed pa yin te/ yul ni phyag rgya ma ste/ de yang zhi ba la dkar po bong chung zla ba'i mdog rgyas pa la ban lang ser po gru bzhi pa/ dbang la smug mo zla gam mdzes pa'i zhal/ drag po la drag po gru gsum har mig rtsal/ de yang stod smad phyed pa/ smad rgyas pa/ bu gdub pa/ chags pa'i mdang che ba/ rgyan gdags khrus byas la/ yab rdo rje gzhon nur bskyed/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar bskyed/ bskyed mched byin gyis brlabs/ yab kyis mkha' mi dmigs pa las a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu par bskyed/ oṃ las bum pa bskyed/ phaṭ kyis bu ga bkag pa'o/ /yang yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las mā las nyi dkyil/ a las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru la a dmar po bsgom/

de nas nu ma nyed pa dang / mchu 'jib pa byas pas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma sprad pa dang / rig mas sa ma ya ho zhes bskul/ yab kyis sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes gnang ste/ ra ho haṃ ra ga ya mi zhes pa dang / rdo rje pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis bsrub/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sngags bzlas kyis bsrub/ bde ba skyes pa dang 'khor lo bzhir rim gyis bzlog ste bzung / 'dod pa ches na mi thub pas phral gyin bya/ yang bsrub/ bde ba rgyas pa dang / mig gyen la bzlog go /rkang lag gi mthe bong bskum/ ngag tu hik brjod cing / rlung gsang ba nas lte ba dang snying gar then/ sems spyi bo'i haṃ la gtad do/ /des bde ba zag pa med pa rgyud la skye/ de nas dgram pa ni lus 'thems par bya'o/ /zhes yi ge rnying ma las bshad kyang 'phrul 'khor bags kyi dgrems dgos pa'i don yin par sems so/ /de ltar byas pas drod ni 'bar ba dang sprug pa ku co'i sgra 'byin pa'o/ /mtshan ma ni bde ba nyams su myong bas so/ /thig le ma shor na lus la rgas rgud med/ nad kyis mi tshugs/ kha dog bzang / 'od 'bar/ tshe ring / mchog gi 'bras bu sku gsum thob pa la sogs pa rnams 'byung bar gsungs so/ /de dag gis ni nang dang gsang ba'i bskyed rim rgyud las bstan tshul dang / rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag cung zad tsam yi ge rnying ma las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/ shin tu zab pa'i yang phur gyi rdzogs rim/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti'i 'khrid ni 'di pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim gyi mthar thug tu snang bas tshad ldan gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ong pa'i yid ches can gyi zab chos de nyid kho bos ji ltar thob pa bzhin/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la so so'i don gnyer dang 'tshams par spel bar bdag spro'o/ /de ltar na bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor de dag la brten nas ma dag pa'i blo ngor snang ba'i snod bcud kyi 'jig rten la bden par 'dzin pa'i 'khrul snang 'thug po 'di nyid dag pa gzhal yas khang dang lha'i ngo bor gsal bar sgom pa'i bskyed rim gyi sgo nas gsang sngags bzlas pa dang bcas pas dri ma'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs nas/

de yang ye shes kyi rang bzhin blo'i yul las 'das shing rang gi ngo bos stong pa bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo'i rtsis zin par byas nas/ rim gnyis zung 'jug tu sgom pa'i nyams len khyad par can la 'bad par bya dgos te/ sa lo tsā ba chen pos rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi lam rim smon lam las/ ma dag bden 'dzin 'khrul snang 'thug po 'di/ /bskyed rim bzlas pa bcas pa'i legs sbyangs te/ /dag pa'i ye shes rang bzhin ngo bos stong / /blo 'das zung 'jug sngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar yin/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la 'bad pa byas nas brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ba des/ kun tu bzang po'i rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang ji ltar thob pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud las/ rnam par smin dang tshe la dbang / /phyag rgya che dang lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bzhir yod pa las/ thog mar rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang thob pa yin te/ de yang rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin zhes bya ba/ /rnam smin gyi rgyu lha'i ting nge 'dzin bskyed rim gsal bar brtan cing / rdzogs rim lta bas kyang rgyas thebs la/ 'bras bu rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin pas na rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin zhes 'jog pa yin la/ lam gang la gnas na bdag med gnyis la thos bsam gtso bor byas pa'i sgo nas tshogs gsog pas tshogs lam la gnas shing / 'bras bu'i sa mngon du byed pa la mos pas mos pa spyod pa'i sa yang thob pa yin la/ rig 'dzin 'dis bskyed rim brtan pas stong gsum thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du dgongs shing / rang nyid chos nyan pa'i tshe chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pas/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du nyan zhing / gzhan la chos ston pa'i tshe lus kyi brda dang / ngag gi sgras 'gro don dngos su byed la/ de nyid kyis tshogs lam mthar phyin pa'i tshe tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du na 'pho ba yin par bshad la/

de la tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ tshe de nyid la mchog gi 'bras bu mngon du byed pas/ 'chi ba med cing / he ru ka rigs lnga gang rung gi rig 'dzin bas na/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin zhes 'jog pa yin par gsungs la/ de nyid lam gang la gnas na/ sbyor ba'i lam la gnas shing / sa mos pas spyod pa/ dgongs pa ni bskyed rim brtan pas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du dgongs la/ rdzogs rim la brtan pa thob pas/ chos nyan pa'i tshe yang sgra brnyan tsam du nyan zhing / gzhan la ston pa'i tshe yang gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i spros bral gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas ston par mdzad pa yin par bshad cing / de nyid kyi sbyor lam mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin du na 'pho ba yin par gsungs shing / de nyid la phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / gsang sngags bla med pa rang rkang gi 'phags lam thams cad phyag rgya ma la brten dgos pa gtso che zhing / 'di nyid kyis kyang phyag rgya ma la brten nas 'phags pa'i sa thob cing / kun bzang rigs lnga gang rung gi rig 'dzin bas na/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin zhes bya la/ 'di nyid lam gyi dbang du byas na/ thog mar mthong lam ste/ brjod bral blo 'das/ chos dbyings spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sa dang po'i ye shes mngon du byed/ sa de la brten nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa sogs spyad de/ phyi'i yul na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dbang du 'dus shing / nang gi rtsa khams la gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams zhal dngos su mthong / rtsa mdud rnams rim gyis grol nas/ lam gyi dbang du byas na bsgom lam dang / sa'i dbang du byas na sa phyi ma bcu gcig la rim par gnas pa yin zhing / mthar 'di nyid kyi chos thams cad kyi chos dbyings mngon du gyur pas/

brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du dgongs shing / chos nyan pa'i tshe yang / nam mkha'i ngang tshul can du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las nyan la/ gzhan la chos ston na yang / 'gro don dgongs pas khyab tshad du mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i tshe lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin du na 'pho ba yin par gsungs zhing / de la lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chos thams cad ye'am/ gdod ma nas ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa la lhun gyis grub par shes shing / rigs kun la khyab pa kun du bzang po'i rig 'dzin pas na lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin zhes 'jog pa yin la/ sa'i dbang du byas na/ sa bcu gsum pa phyed 'og ma/ lam nye rgyu bsgom pa'i lam la gnas pa yin zhing / chos chos sku las nyan la/ gzhan la chos ston pa lus ngag la mi ltos par/ 'gro don nam mkha'i gar khyab pa 'dis/ khyab pa yin par bshad la/ de ltar lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin de mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can/ chos sku kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba/ chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig par rtogs pa'i ye shes chen po'i ngo bor gnas pa yin la/ de nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdul bya gzhan gyi don gyi phyir gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te/ las dag pa rnams la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / rigs can gsum la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang / gzhan yang las dang skal bar 'tshams pa rnams la/ skye ba sprul sku la sogs par sprul nas mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba ni lam 'di nyams su blangs ba las 'byung ba'i 'bras bu yin par shes par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni nang dang gsang ba'i bskyed rim rgyud las bstan tshul dang / rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bshad pa las 'phros nas/

mthar thug gi 'bras bu kun bzang rigs bzhi thob tshul dang bcas pa legs par bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ zab las ches zab rdo rje phur pa'i lam/ /nyams su blangs pas rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi/ /thob par shes nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /yab chos lhad med 'di la skal bzang rnams/ /gus pas zhugs la rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub/ /bsgrub pas rang rgyud grol nas bstan pa spel/ /spel bas 'di dang phyi ma'i don rnams kun/ /kun kyang 'bad med lhun grub 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las mngon rtogs nyams su blangs pa'i rjes su spro na rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyi bskul bya bar gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang phyag len la mdzad pa ltar gyi rnam par bshad pa cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang / grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin mthu rtsal can rnams drag po'i las la bskul ba la don gsum ste/ spyir bskul ba dang / so sor bskul ba dang / don bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bskul ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ byang chub 'di'i dbyangs ring ba la byang chen zhes bya zhing / sngon gyi dbyangs rnying yin te/ dbyangs yig rnying pa kun nas 'byung ba yin la/ 'di'i dbyangs thung ba ni snye thang pa shes rab snang ba'i dbyangs yig las mi 'byung yang rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung bas de man chad tsam la byung bar sems so/ mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /zhes sogs te/ de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems gnyis bskyed cing / dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gdung 'tshob par mdzad pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams zhes bos nas/ rig 'dzin khyed rnams kyi sngar sems can gyi don mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa de da dus la bab pas/ bdag rnal 'byor pa sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje phur bu sgrub pa'i gtong grogs dang mgon skyabs mdzod cig ces pa'i don yin la/

gnyis pa so sor bskul ba ni/ gzhung las/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis a su ra'i brag phug dang 'dab nye ba'i rgya gar gyi yul phyogs su tsan+dan gyi nags tshal la nags seb na mu stegs kyi grong khyer yod pa de bcoms pa'i phyir/ phur bu btab pas/ nags tshal thams cad nag thul gyis tshig de ma khad la ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul gyi sgo nas lo 'dab me tog rnams rgyas par mdzad pa la sogs pa ji ltar grub pa'i rtags bstan pa de bsnyel lam ci ste ma bsnyel bar mdzod la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rdo rje phur bu'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i stongs grogs dang 'phrin las mdzod cig ces pa ste tshig rkang rjes ma gnyis kyi don 'og ma kun la 'gre ba yin zhing / de bzhin du slob dpon chen po bi ma la mi tra ste dri med bshes gnyen gyis gaṅga la ste/ nam mkhar nas babs pa'i chu bo chen po la klu nor rgyas bya ba mu stegs la 'tsho ba ster ba zhig yod pa de bcom pa'i phyir/ phur pa btab pas gram par skya gsob kyis song zhing / slar chu bo sngar bas kyang cher song ba la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / bal po'i slob dpon chen po shī la mañju ste 'jam dpal tshul khrims kyis maṇ+ḍal la ste dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'i mkhar gong gi brag la mu stegs la sngon shes ston pa'i the'u rang gi pho brang yod pa de bcom pa'i phyir/ phur bu btab pas/ brag hrul gyi zhig 'phral/ slar brag ri ngo mtshar ba byung ba'i grub rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / gzhan yang mchims ston shākya pra bha wa zhes bya ba'i yar lung bgegs kyi phug chung ste gad pa phug tu dam sri spun bdun dngos su btul ba dang / gzhan yang phug pa de nyid du rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ yar lung gi chu bo de la klu bdud gdug pa can gnas pa de nyid 'dul ba'i ched du bsnyen phur chu bo de la btab pas chu bo de nyid gyen du log ste/

klu bdud gdug pa can btul ba la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / yang shod phu dpal gyi seṅges 'on shang gi mdo'i brag ri dmar po la klu bdud gdug pa can gnas pa phur bus bsgral ba la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis has po ri'i yang gong du brag la phur pa btab pa'i rjes da lta'i bar du yod pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / mkhar chen bza' ste ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi mching bu'i nags la me shor ba la phur bus btab pas me shi nas slar nags tshal skyes pa dang / dgung mkhar te sgrub khang gi steng du dbu skra bsil ba'i tshe phyag 'phreng na bza'i steng du bzhag pa bdud kyi sprul pa bya rog ma rungs pa zhig gis 'phreng ba khyer song ba la brtag gzhib dpyad pas/ rdo rje gzhon nu bsgrub pa la bdud nag po skrag med kyis bar chad rtsom par dgongs te/ pho rog nag po'i grib ma sa la yod pa la phur pa btab pas/ pho rog gam bya rog skad cig de nyid la tshar bcad pa lta bu grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / yang mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi ming po mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gi 'u yug mkhar ba sna zhes bya bar phur bu bsgrubs pas/ de'i byang phyogs na bye ma'i rtsibs spyang khu 'dra ba zhig yod pa la/ de skabs yar ldong gi tshong pa mang po yong pa'i tshong lha rgyal po shel ging gis byed pa las/ rgyal po de khros nas spyang khu bcu bzhir sprul nas/ thog mar rta bong rnams bsad rjes/ tha ma mi rnams kyang za ba la byung bas/ tshong pa rnams kyis lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin par shes te/ yul 'dir sngags 'chang grub rtags thon pa su yod ces yul mi kun la dris pas/ mkhar sna na dpal gyi dbang phyug bzhugs zhes gleng gi 'dug pa ltar mkhar snar phyin te zhus pas/

de rnams bstan pa la zhabs rtog byed nges pa'i sbyin bdag yin par mkhyen nas/ rtsibs kyi bye ma pha gi la spyang khu'i sder rjes yod pas de'i bye ma longs shog ngas thabs bya'o gsungs/ der rjes kyi bye ma phul bas bye ma dang bag phye bsres nas spyang khu'i gzugs bcu bzhi bzos pa la dgug gzhug mdzad nas/ bzlas yungs kyis brab cing phur bu btab pas spyang khu sngon po rnams kyi snying shubs nas rgyang gis 'thon te/ spyang khu bcu bzhi po thams cad sgrub khang gi thog na mar ri nyil ba ltar byung ste rgyal po shel ging skad cig de nyid la tshar bcad pa lta bu grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / gzhan yang 'khon ston chen po klu'i dbang po srung bas lha sa yer pa'i brag phug tu rdo rje dril bu bar snang du bzhag pa la sogs pa'i grub rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / gcung ston rdo rje rin chen zhes bya ba'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i dus de'i tshe ling ga la 'phar g.yo sgra 'od la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma bstan pa dang / 'khon ston bal po zhes bya bas tsha mo rong glang gi brag phur ri zhes bya ba'i brag phug tu rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs pa la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos khams kyi grum sa zhes bya ba'i yul mthon po zhig tu sems can thams cad chu med pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa la/ brag la phur bu btab pas sgrub chu dngos su bton te sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad pa la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis grub thob 'bam rom pa chen po'i sgrub gnas 'bam rom brag ces bya ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can du rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dgun gyi dus su'ang 'jam dbyangs me tog shin tu mang bar skyes shing /

brag de nyid la phyag zhabs kyi rjes kun gyis mthong bar bstan pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dgongs pa dang / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i zhal mngon sum du gyur te/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa nod pa'i dus la bab par dgongs nas/ lho rong gi sa'i cha pa tro stag tshang seṅge bsam grub kyi gnas mchog tu phyag phebs par brtsams te lho rong phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i tshe/ pa tro'i gzhi bdag lha chen brag bskyed dang / has kyi khyud 'dus sogs lho kha bzhi'i gzhi bdag rnams/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi zhabs drung du byung bas/ lho rong gi sa yul thams cad zhabs kyis 'chag par mdzad dgos shing / la chu 'phrang sogs kyi 'phrin las thams cad nged gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsgrub pa yin no/ /zhes khas blangs song bas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyis kyang dus der gtor ma rgya chen po gnang zhing / lhag par bsang dpe chen mor yang / pa tro'i lha chen brag skyed dang / /has kyi khyung 'dus la sogs pa'i/ /lho rong lung pa'i gzhi bdag bsang / zhes pa 'di yang de'i dus su 'jug par mdzad pa yin zhes thos la/ de nas bdag nyid chen pos pa tro'i sgrub gnas dam par phebs par dgongs nas/ nags kyi 'phrang dog pa la brten nas/ chibs pas bgrod ma bde ba la dgongs te long ra dbon po sogs lho pa gzhon pa mang po'i rgyab tu sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku gdan drangs te/ stag tshang gi 'phrang zin par phebs pa'i tshe/ de'i lam bar zhig tu skye mthing shwa na ma sogs gzhi bdag 'ga' zhig gi cho 'phrul gyis sems can ma rungs pa zhig gi lam bgags byung ba la/ sngags 'chang nyid kyis/ nged rang rang gnas su 'gro ba la khyed la khyad ci yod phar songs gsung ba sogs kyis bka' sgo mdzad pas/

sems can gyi gzugs de dngos med du yal song ba der yod kun gyis mthong zhing / de nas pa tro'i lam 'phrang la phebs pas gnas de na brag ri ngam che ba gzhan las thog so dgu tsam gyi mtho ba zhig yod pa de'i mgor/ sngon mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis shel 'phreng brgya rtsa gtor ba'i chu mig brgya rtsa yod pa'i chu de thams cad brag chen po de'i mdun la/ dar dkar gyi yol ba bkram pa ltar ngo mtshar che bar 'bab pa zhig yod pa'i brag la chu 'thab de'i dkyil du glo bur nyid la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od bskor gsum sbrag zhig byung nas/ de'i dbus nas 'ja' kha dog sngon po zhig rgyang gis byung ba/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku la zug cing / zhabs drung na gnas pa'i sku 'khor kun la yang 'ja' de'i 'od kyis khyab pa la brten nas/ mi'i mdog dang gos gzan sogs thams cad kyang sngon po 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ba/ de yod kyi skye bo kun gyis mthong ba byung zhing / de'i tshe 'phrang de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ljon shing gi tshogs la brten pa'i spra dang spre'u lag na shing gi yal ga thogs pa mang pos/ mi la mi 'dzems par gral bsgrigs te langs nas sngags 'chang nyid la bsu ba'i tshul du 'dug pa ni/ de dus zhabs drung na 'dug pa kun gyis mthong bar grags la/ de'i tshe sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos sngar gyis brag la chu 'thab nas byung bas 'ja' 'od rnams je gsal je gsal du song byung ba la gzigs pas/ de'i dbus 'od dkar po zhig gi khrod na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / de'i steng phyogs na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor gsum dang / grub thob rig 'dzin mang po khrom tshogs su bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor ba dang / mkha' 'gro sde lnga gar stabs shig shig 'dug pa ni shin tu gsal bar gzigs nas/

de'i tshe sngags 'chang nyid kyi stag tshang gi phug pa'i g.yas 'khris na/ ne'u gseng thil ba zhig yod pa der bzhugs nas/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ sngar gyi gzigs snang la shar ba'i bla ma yi dam rnams kyi sku las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan nyi ma bye bas gzi 'od tsam dang / bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byung nas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku la thim par gyur te/ skad cig nyid la thugs la tha mal gyi rnam rtog gi cha shas cung zad yod pa thams cad khrig 'gags nas/ snang srid thams cad lhag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor khra lam gyis shar nas/ de la thugs zin te/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du lhan gyis gnas byung bas/ de ma thag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin grub thob kyis lha tshogs thams cad 'od sngon po zhig tu gyur nas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la thim zhing / slob dpon yang 'od du zhu la khad 'dug pa gzigs pas/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ da tshe tshad kyang nye bar rdzogs 'gro ba 'dug pas 'ja' 'od de'i steng na phar phyin te slob dpon gyi phyi la 'brangs na dga' ba 'dug snyam pa thugs la shar ba'i tshe/ yang de ma thag dpal ldan sa skya'i sde chen po gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa thugs yul du khra lam ste shar zhing / gdung brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyang sku na gzhon par dgongs nas sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgongs pa gtad de/ de 'phral gu ru drag po'i nyams bzhes shar ma zhig gnang bas/ slob dpon chen po'i sku de sngar las gsal bar gyur pa'i mod la/ gdams pa zab mo dang lung bstan rab tu mang po gnang zhing / lhag par da dung lo du ma'i bar du bstan 'gro'i don dpag tu med pa 'grub par 'dug cing / de nas dag pa'i zhing bde ba can zangs mdog dpal gyi rir pad+ma nga'i drung du byon gsungs pa snyam byed pa'i tshe/

slob dpon nyid kyang 'od sngon po zhig tu zhu nas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku la thim pa'i thugs nyams shin tu gsal bar byung ba'i mod la/ rtog pa dang mi rtog pa thams cad las 'das te/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs la ji ltar mnga' ba bzhin/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi thugs la 'khrungs par gyur nas/ re zhig de'i ngang la 'jam ste/ de las sad pa na/ nyi ma yang phyi mor song 'dug pas myur du bzhengs nas/ de'i nye skor na 'bab chu zhig yod sar phebs te/ dpon slob thams cad kyi sku khrus mdzad pas tshe/ de'i brag zhig la sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes byung ba da lta yang dad pa can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs par kun la grags pa sogs mdor na yul dus gnas skabs kun tu grub pa'i rtags mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston par mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang bla ma bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po 'di nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i tshul rnams zhib tu rtogs par 'dod na/ kho bos byas pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las rtog par bya zhing / 'dir bkod pa'i pa tro stag tshang seṅge bsam grub tu grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa'i tshul 'di rnams ni sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid lho rong nas gdan sa chen por phebs pa'i skabs der/ bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / gzhan yang mkhan chen sku mched/ dpal bzang dang kun bkras byas 'gyur sgrub chen dge slong kun dga' ba rnams la sngags 'chang nyid sku dngos kyi gsung las lho rong gi pa tro stag tshang 'di slob dpon gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yin nges su 'dug pas ngo mtshar ya mtshan can 'di ltar byung zhes bka' phebs gnang ba'i gsung rgyun ma nyams pa 'jam dbyangs sku mched sogs las thos pa dang / lhag par rgyal yum sku mched la sngags 'chang nyid kyi lho rong gi gnas tshul rnams thugs dam bka' shog tu 'khyon pa gnang 'dug pa'i gsung shog de nang bzhin bris pa yin pas skal bzang dang ldan kun gyis som nyi dang bral bar gyis shig

de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar gyi grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa de bsnyel lam ci ste ma bsnyel bar mdzod la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rdo rje phur bu'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i stongs grogs dang 'phrin las mdzod cig ces pa ste/ de ltar bshad pa'i gzhung gi tshig rnams ni/ sgrub thabs bklags pa'i don grub nyid na bzhugs pa dang / der mi gsal zhing kha skong 'os pa rnams sa lo chen po dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyis mdzad pa bzhin gyi don rnams 'grel pa'i sgo nas bshad pa yin la/ de'i rjes su bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i bla ma/ rig pa 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched la bskul ba'i tshig ni/ nged rang gi kha skong du sbyar ba'i/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po yi/ /zhes sogs tshig bcad gnyis te/ de yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gdul bya'i snang ngor/ ngur smrig gi bla gos 'dzin pa'i dpal sa skya pa chen po byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du grub pa thob pa'i rtags mtshan brnyes pa'i tshul zhal gyis bzhes pa ni/ rje nyid kyi gsung rab las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ grub pa'i gnas mchog chen po byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gzim phug khams gsum zil gnon du spros med kyi dge sbyor ci yong bgyis pa'i tshe/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nub mo rmi lam du sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung mgur zhig tu/ dben gnas byas 'gyur dpal ri pad+ma 'od/ /sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje pad 'byung dngos/ /chu rnams chu mig byang chub bdud rtsi'i chu/ /za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor lus sems bde/ /zhes gsungs pa de dran pa'i rkyen byas nas/ byas 'gyur gyi ri 'di nyid zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo dang /

gzim phug de pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang dngos lta bur gyur pa'i dbus na/ pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che gser gyi khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku lta bas mchog mi shes pa mtshan dang dpe byed kyis brgyan pa'i mtha' skor du rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug brgyud pa dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i nang nas nam mkha'i snying po dang rdo rje bdud 'joms gnyis gsal zhing / gzhan rnams 'od kyi rnam pa 'dra ba res mthong res mi mthong ba'i rnam pa can yi dam zhi khro rnams kyi nang nas gur drag dang / yang phur gnyis gsal zhing gzhan rnams gong bzhin/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyi nang nas bde ba'i 'khor lo gsal te rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i zla la 'dug gzhan rnams gong bzhin/ chos skyong rnams kyi nang nas bram gzugs dang ming don mi 'phrod pa'i khro mo shin tu rngam pa/ phyag g.yas na gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon na bse'i sgrom bu ser po 'od 'bar ba par bu kha gcod rgyab pa 'dra ba bsnams pa/ dar nag gi gos gser gyi thig le can la sbrul gyi ske rags bcings shing khram shing sked la btsugs pa cig 'dug pa de gnyis gsal/ gzhan rnams gong bzhin/ gu ru'i thugs su byon pa'i bu med lnga yang shin tu gsal bar 'dug 'di ni mkha' 'gro sde lnga yin nam snyam/ de la sogs te nyams snang dang 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'dres pa'i snang ba rnam pa sna tshogs snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar khra lam me mthong ba la brten nas dad pa'i spu long rab tu g.yos te/ mig nas mchi ma lhung zhing lus kyis phyag du ma zhig btsal/ ngag gis spyir gsol 'debs du ma dang / sgos blo chos su 'gro zhing / chos lam du long nges pa de 'khrul pa dang bral ba'am ma bral yang ye shes su rtogs pa khyad par skye ba dang /

tshe rabs thams cad du khyed kyi zhabs drung du skyes te/ rig 'dzin bzhi'i go 'phang thob nges pa zhig khyed mkhyen zhes phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs kyi 'dug pas gu ru rin po che de nyid dges pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma zhig mdzad de/ de nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga 'ja' tshon lta bu zhig bdag gi snying gar thim pa'i snang ba byung bas/ de'i rkyen gyis nyi ma yang shar te byas 'gyur gyi lung pa thams cad 'od kyis gang nas 'dug pa dang / gnyid sad de shin tu phangs pa cig byung / de ltar rmis pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad cig kyang byas yod do/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang byas 'gyur nyid dang / rta nag za phu/ mnga' rigs sogs kyi gnas rnams su skal ldan rnams kyi snang ngor brag la phyag zhabs sogs kyi rjes bzhag pa dang / skam sar chu bton pa la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ji ltar bstan pa dang zhes sogs man chad kyi don snga ma dang 'dra la/ de nas dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ gzhan ngor gos dkar lcang los mdzes pa'i skur bstan pa rig sngags 'chang ba chen po grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa nyid kyis dmu rgod 'dul dka'i sems can rnams 'jam zhing des pa'i mdzad pa bzang po'i sgo nas smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa'i tshul gyis ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas kyang / khyad par grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags mtshan ston par mdzad pa ni/ chen po 'ga' zhig gi srog bskyab pa'i phyir lho phyogs kyi brgyud du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur skabs shin tu grang ba'i reg byas nyams thag par byed pa'i bsil ba'i ngad chen po dang ldan pa'i ri bo ga la ba der/

dbyar tsha ba'i dus su yang der gnas pa'i spu sdug ldan pa'i g.yag dang / ri dwags rkyang la sogs pa rnams kyang grang ba'i ngad kyis lus rengs shing yan lag rnams 'khong par byed pas na/ g.yag rengs rkyang 'khong zhes grags pa'i la chen zhig yod pa de la nang par dpon slob rnams phebs pa'i do nub kyi tshe/ zhabs drung du gnas pa'i sku 'khor gyi tshogs rnams mgrin gcig pas/ deng sang gi dus 'di dgun stod grang ba'i dus la bab cing / khyad par sa phyogs 'di ming dang mthun par shin du grang ba'i rang bzhin du yod 'dug pa/ nang par ji ltar bya zhes ngal bar gyur kyang / de'i nang par gyi tshe rje btsun sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid/ 'byung bzhi che dang nor rnams la/ /dbang bsgyur phyir na dbang phyug brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang thob pa'i rtags su ri chen po de 'khor yug dang bcas pa phun sum tshogs pa'i legs ldan dpyid kyi dpal mo'i dga' ston gyi dus ltar/ sa phyogs thams cad na bun dang rmugs pas bltams shing / chu 'dzin gzhon nu ma 'khrigs pa dang bcas pas nam mkha'i khams gang ste/ dbyar gyi dus rong gi lung par slebs pa lta bu'i shin tu dro ba'i reg bya dang ldan zhing / sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku'i phyogs su 'ja' dkar po zhig mdung btsugs su zug pa dang / sku de nyid kyi g.yas g.yon gyi rmugs pa'i gseb tu chos skyong gi sprul pa'i bya rog gnyis gshog sgra rgyun mi chad par 'phur bzhin pa dang bcas pa g.yag rengs rkyang 'khong gi la chen po de nyid ma sgrol gyi bar du byung zhes/ de dus zhabs drung na gnas pa kun mgrin gcig tu gleng ba las thos pa yin zhing / mdor na sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' mkhan chen bodhi satwa nyid dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nyid kyi gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams skyong ba'i slad du/ slar yang sku skye ba bzhes pa yin par gdon mi za bas na/

gong du bshad pa'i grub pa'i mtshan ma de tsam la ha cang ngo mtshar du 'dzin dgos pa ma yin te/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya thub pa nyid dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa slob dpon chen pos ma 'ongs lung bstan las gsungs de'i tshul ni rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan can 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal por gter ston chen po chos kyi 'od zer gyi zhu yig phul ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs drung du zhu ba/ drung ram lags la bka' phebs nang ma'i tshul gnang ba'i skor blo ngor shin tu bcags pa byung lags pa dang / zhabs drung rgyan rin po che 'di nyid/ longs sku chen po'i zhing du gsang pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / 'phags yul du mkhan chen bodhi satwa dang / bod yul du dpal ldan bla ma dam par grags pa nyid/ slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha bas phyag bris shog ser la mngon sum 'khrul med du 'dug par brten/ bstan pa dang sems can kho na la phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas yin 'dug lags/ dus re zhig sku'i cha lugs sngags chas 'di kha gnang tshe gang sa nas legs tshogs che ba yod snang lags pa dang / lhag pa'i lha jo bo rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kho na dang / de mthun rdo rje gzhon nu la gnang tshe/ bar skabs sku tshe'i bar chad sel ba dang phyi nang gi dgra 'dre mtha' dag 'dul ba la bsngags pa dang / chos skyong yang mgon po gur zhal gnyis khyad med kyi nang nas/ mgon po gnyan mgon gcig tu 'brel chags pa gnang ba'i gsang sgrub kyi tshul gnang ba dang / gsung ngag snga sor sku grib la brten pa cig 'byung ba snang tshod du 'dug pa/ thog mar khro bo rme ba brtsegs pa'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum pa zhig sku mtshams bcad nas gnang ba dang /

de mthun thugs dam thams cad kyi sngon la brgya rtsa re gnang tshe 'phral 'phral dngas skyed che ba yod lags pa dang / lhag par dam sel dang sku grib la 'dzem pa gnang tshe/ sku tshe mdzad 'phrin gnyis ka la yang shin tu phan pa zhig mngon pas dgongs pa'i dbyings kho nar bzhugs par gnang zhing / don du bstan pa rin po che la phan zhing snyan grags kyang mi chung tsam yong ba sogs gang spyi'i gnas tshul drung ram pas 'bul ba yod pa dgongs dbyings rin po cher bzhugs pa gnang ba mkhyen lags/ tshes bdun la 'greng po gzhis dga' nas mnyel so'i tshul du phul ba'i zhu yig ces 'byung ba yin no/ pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo mtshar ba'i sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / rang re gdul bya rnams kyis rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par cung zad mthong ba brjod pa'i ngag 'di yang shin tu mdzes par bshad pa yin pas na/ gong du bkod pa de dag brjod pa la yang nyes pa med cing ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar grang ba'i ngad ldan gyi ri bo dro ba'i reg bya dang ldan par mdzad pa ni/ kun gyi thun mong du gyur pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa yin mod/ gzhan yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig la/ byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong dang dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang sogs su grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar can bstan pa'i tshul mang du yod kyang 'dir ma spros shing / rgyas par logs su 'chad pa la bdag spro bar gyur to/ /de ltar bshad ma thag par des mtshon te grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa rnams bsnyel lam ci ste/ ma bsnyel bar mdzod la/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje phur bu'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i stongs grogs dang 'phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cig ces pa'i don te de yan gyis rig 'dzin rnams so sor bskul ba bstan zin nas/

gsum pa don bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bskul ba ni/ gzhung las/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi dus la bab/ /ces sogs te/ de yang spyir phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rnams dang / khyad par slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas nas/ sngags 'chang chen po grags pa'i mtshan can gyi bar gyi rig 'dzin khyed rnams kyis sngar sems can gyi don mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa de/ da dus la bab pas sems can gyi don mdzod cig bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyud la byin rlabs stsol ba'i dus la bab pas/ byin gyis rlobs shig dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams mthu rtsal dang rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas lus sems phral te rnam shes mi skyod pa'i zhing du dbyung ba'am skyel ba'i dus la bab pas mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i las mdzod cig bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la gnod par byed pa gzugs can gyi dgra dang / gzugs med kyi bgegs rnams drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyis sgrol ba'i dus la bab pas/ dgra bgegs rnams sgrol ba'i 'phrin las dam pa mdzod cig ces bskul ba'i don yin zhing / gzhan yang skabs 'dir rang gi srung ma gang byed kyi bskul bya bar gsungs pas/ phur srung dam can sogs kyang drag po'i las la bskul bar spro na skabs 'dir bskul bar bya'o/ /de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma so sor bskul ba de rnams ni/ bla ma gong ma grub thob rnams kyi nang nas kyang mchog tu grags che ba rnams bskul bar mdzad pa yin te/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i rin chen rtse'i gnyer pa'i dris lan las/ rig 'dzin bskul dus rgya bod kyi sngags 'chang nus pa che ba rnams smos pa ma gtogs/ dbang gi brgyud pa 'dren pa ma yin/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /de dag gis ni rig 'dzin bla ma rnams bskul ba'i tshul bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rig 'dzin grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rig 'dzin rjes 'jug rnams kyi sgrub grogs su/

/rig 'dzin gang gi dad pas rab bskul na/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug par nges/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa 'jug gi cho ga la/ tshogs/ lhag ma/ las 'jug bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ thog mar 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa/ bar du bshags pa'i mchod pa/ tha mar bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa ste/ de yang gha na 'am tshogs zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs pas na tshogs/ rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa tshogs pas na tshogs/ zhal zas tshogs pas na tshogs zhes bya'o/ /de dag la yang dga' ldan lha'i tshogs/ skal ldan rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs dang gsum las/ dga' ldan lha'i tshogs la/ lha rang yang rgyud sde phyi nang gi lha bsrer mi btub par gsungs te/ lha mthun pa cig bsgom dgos pa yin la/ skal ldan rnal 'byor gyi tshogs kyang / blo mi mthun pas mi rung ste/ dam tshig gtsang ba rnal 'byor pho mo thugs mthun pa/ lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa cig dgos pa yin zhing / 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs kyang / sngags phyi pa rnams dkar gsum mngar gsum bsgrub bya dang / sha chang sgog pa rnams dgag byar byed kyang / bla med kyi skabs 'dir dgag bya med pas bza' bca' gang yang rung ba dang / med du mi rung ba tshe dang / ba la dang / dza gad la sogs pa la bdud rtsis bran pa/ de dag kyang ngan pa dang chung pa ma yin par bzang po dang gya nom par bsgom dgos pa yin zhing / des na 'di la tshogs pa gsum/ gsog pa gsum/ bsang ba gsum/ sbyang ba gsum/ brlab pa gsum/ bskyed pa gsum/ yul gsum/ dam tshig gsum ste gsum tshan brgyad kyi sgo nas don rnams rig par bya ba yin te/ dang po tshogs pa gsum ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ dga' ldan lha/ bde ldan mi/ 'byor ldan yo byad gsum tshogs pa yin la/ gnyis pa gsog pa gsum ni/ grub pa thob pa'i bla ma/

lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo/ 'dod yon lnga'i yo byad de gsum gsog pa yin zhing / gsum pa bsang ba gsum ni/ mdun du tshogs ci 'byor pa bsham pa la rdo rje'i rtse'i nang mchod rang nyid dang / mched lcam dang / tshogs kyi yo byad gsum la gtor zhing / oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod pas/ rang gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / cho ga ma tshang ba sogs kyi dri ma dang / mched lcam rnams kyi nyams grib la sogs pa'i dri ma dang / tshogs kyi yo byad ma dag pa dang nyams pa la sogs pa'i dri ma yod pa rnams/ sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis dag cing bsang bar bsgom/ bzhi pa sbyang ba gsum ni/ snod thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum gyi tshad tsam du bsam la/ nang gi tshogs kyi dngos po'i steng du raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum bsam la/ raṃ gyis mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ gyi rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ gyi chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag cing sbyang bar bsam pa yin zhing / lnga pa brlab pa gsum ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pas me tshogs kyis snod la reg ces sogs brjod cing gong sman raka gtor gsum gyis gtor ma'i skabs ltar 'dod yon lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥzhes pa'i bar brjod cing / tshogs kyi steng du hūm̐ byung bas sngo rting song / a byung bas dmar khrig song / oṃ byung bas dkar po shel ltar song ste/ mdor na dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa ro brgya dang ldan pa lha'i bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsgom pa yin par gsungs la/ drug pa bskyed pa gsum ni/ las kyi bye brag gi tshogs kyi dngos po de nyid mchod pa'i dus su/ 'dod yon lngar bskyed/ bshags pa'i dus su ye shes lngar bskyed/ bzlog pa'i dus su mtshon cha lngar bskyed/ stobs pa'i dus su dgra bgegs kyi don snying lngar bskyed pa yi ge rnying ma dag las bshad pa yin la/

bdun pa yul gsum ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la 'bul ba yin te/ tshogs kyi zhing de dag spyan drangs pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dmigs med 'di'i dbyangs sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas dbyangs yig kun gsal sgra dbyangs nas 'byung bas skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi bai ḍur sngon po'i gdang 'jug par mdzad par snang ngo / mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang tshogs zhing rnams gzung bya dang 'dzin byar dmigs pa med la/ nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin gyi dag cing chos kyi dbyings thams cad la khyab pa'i spros bral bde ba chen po'i sku nyid gang nas spyan drangs pa dang / gang du gshegs su gsol bar don dam par mi dmigs yin mod kyang / kun rdzob 'phrul pa'i sems can rnams dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos pa chos nyid kyi ngang las/ chos sku spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dag pa gnyis ldan la 'god pa'i slad du bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyid gzugs gyi sku'i rnam par sprul pa sgyu ma'i gzugs can du rnam par rol te gshegs su gsol/ zhes chos kyi sku'i ngo bo spyan drangs/ de nas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phung po nyid nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra ba nges pa lnga ldan gyi skur gsal zhing / bzo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku/ mchog gi sprul sku ste sprul pa'i sku kun gyi 'byung gnas chen por gyur cing / theg chen bla na med pa'i chos rnams kun gyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku ste/ rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' tshul can gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ zhes pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams spyan drangs/ mthing nag rngam pa'i dbus kyi zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭ kyi nga ro 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrogs shing /

ri dwags rgyal po seṅge'i nga ros kyang ni bskyod du med pa lta bu'i chos ston par mdzad la/ thugs rje chen po dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis gdul bya ma rungs pa rnams 'dul bar mdzad pa dpa' chen khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu nyid brtse ba snying rje chen pos 'gro drug rnams thar pa'i lam du drangs pa'i phyir tshogs kyi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ zhes pas sprul sku khro rgyal yab dang / snyems pa ste dregs pa mi mnga' la/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs la sogs pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan zhing / spyod pa ma 'dres pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad rnams rab tu rdzogs pas shes rab kyi skur ston la/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' zhing / 'khor 'das kyi chos ci yang ma 'dres pa gsal le mkhyen pa'i mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs nyid 'khor tshogs sgyu ma'i rnam par rol pa dang bcas te gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ zhes pas sprul sku yum 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs ba ste de dag ni brjod pa tshig gi sgo nas spyan drangs ba yin la/ gsang ba sngags kyi sgo nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka sa pa ri wā ra tṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ e ā ra li hriṃ hriṃ/ zhes pas sngags don ni/ tshur byon bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po 'dir byon dam tshig dgongs ces pa yin te de ni sngags kyi sgo nas spyan drangs pa yin zhing / dmigs pa yid kyi sgo ni/ de'i tshe ngo bo sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can rnams/ rnam pa rang 'dra'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin 'phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos la/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs la tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dngos ni/ sgrub thabs las/ gzugs kyi mchod pa zhes sogs te/

/de yang dbyings dang kha dog gi gzugs kyi bsdus pa'i mchod pa mig gi dbang po'i yul du khyad par du che ba dang / zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra yis bsdus pa'i mchod pa rna ba'i dbang po'i yul du yid du 'ong bar ldan pa dang / lhan skyes dang sbyar byung gi dri yi bsdus pa'i mchod pa sna'i dbang po'i yul du tshim pa ste mnyes par mchod pa dang / ro drug gi bsdus pa'i mchod pa ljags kyi dbang po'i yul du bde ba'i mchog bskyed par ldan pa dang / reg byas bsdus pa'i mchod pa lus kyi dbang po'i yul du bla na med pa'i bde ba bskyed pa ste 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga'i tshogs rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa bkang nas/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa kun la rgyas par blos sprul te 'bul zhes pa'i don can gyi tshig brjod cing gzhan yang bla med mchog gi zhes sogs sngar gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas 'bul ba ni/ tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dngos yin la/ brgyad pa tshogs kyi dam tshig gsum la/ mi bya ba gsum/ mi smra ba gsum/ mi bsam pa gsum/ mi 'bral ba gsum rnams su gsungs pa las/ mi bya ba gsum ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs/ sems 'khrug pa'i rtsod pa mi bya/ gzung 'dzin skye ba'i 'phrul gtam mi bya/ theg pa 'og ma'i 'bags btsog bsrung bar mi bya ba dang gsum yin zhing / mi smra ba gsum ni/ tshogs kyi dngos po la gzhan gyi 'di che ste bdag gi 'di chung zhes mi smra/ na ning bzang ste da lo ngan zhes mi smra/ kha sang mang ste de ring nyung zhes mi smra ba gsum yin la/ mi bsam pa gsum ni/ tshogs mthong pa'i tshe/ bza' yi snyam du mi bsam/ btung gi snyam du mi bsam/ zhim gyi snyam du mi bsam pa gsum yin zhing / mi 'bral ba gsum ni/ lus lha dang mi 'bral/
