ngag sngags dang mi 'bral/ sems rdzogs rim dang mi 'bral ba gsum rnams yin par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa tshogs bar pa bshags pas mchod pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ ye nas 'di la dbyangs yig yod par dbyangs kyi brjed byang seṅge'i nga ro las bshad kyang / deng sang rang re'i phyag len la mi snang ngo / mnyam nyid ces sogs te/ de yang ye gdod ma nas 'khor 'das mnyam nyid spros bral chos sku'i ngo bor dag pa la/ mi shes pa'am/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis med pa la yod par sgro 'dogs pa dang / yod pa la med par skur pa btab ste/ sgro skur gyi mtha' la brten pa'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi snang ba rnam pa sna tshogs dge sdig so so'i ngo bor rnam par smin pa yin zhing / mi dge ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal de bzlog pa'i don gyi phyir rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig zab mo rnams mnos te bsrung bar khas blangs kyang bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems can rnams ma rig pa ste mi shes pa'i dbang gis lus dang ngag dang sems kyi sgo nas ma gus pa dang / bag med pa'i tshul gyi khas blangs pa'i dam tshig las 'gal bar gyur te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyi thugs dang ci ltar 'gal ba thams cad/ sgrib pa med pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i thugs rje chen po mnga' ba khyed rnams la gnong pa'i sgo nas bzod par gsol lo/ /khyad par lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa bgyis pa'i las gsum mngon sum gyi yul du bgyis pa dang / ngag gi sgo nas tshig 'khyal smras pa la sogs pa'i las bzhi dag tu dngos su brjod pa dang / sems kyi sgo nas blo ngan pas gzhan la gnod par sems pa dang / gzhan gyi nor la brnab sems dang / gzhan gyi chos dang gang zag la log par lta ba'i las gsum yid kyis bsam pa la sogs pa mdor na 'dod chags dang / khong khro ste zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi kun nas blangs pa'i dbang gis mi dge ba'i las nongs pa bgyis pa thams cad ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad me long nang du gzugs brnyan ltar bkra bar gzigs pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams la bzod par gsol lo/

/bzod par gsol ba la bzod pa dam pa bzhes te/ bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshangs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa bstsal du gsol/ gal te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig gi ngo bor bzhugs pas/ sems can rnams kyi sdig pa bgyis pa la mi mnyes pa dang / dge ba bgyis pa la mnyes pa mi mnga' bas/ bzod par gsol ba mi dgos so snyam na/ ye shes kyi bdag nyid can gyi lha ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mnyes pa dang mi mnyes pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' yang / ye shes kyi lha de yi 'khor gyi tshul du rtogs pa'i dam can srung ma rnams mi yis mi dge ba byed pa 'bags bcog la sogs pa'i skyon mthong ba tsam na/ mi de brlag par mdzad pa mi dge ba'i las snang yin pa/ des na sdig sgrib bag chags ngan pa dam tshig nyams pa dang / ye shes kyi lha khyed kyi thugs dang 'gal ba gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dbang gis las ngan bgyis pa ci mchis pa thams cad so sor 'thol lo bshags so/ /de ltar 'thol zhing bshags pas/ nyes ltung thams cad dag ste tshangs pa chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol zhes pa'i don te/ /de yan gyis 'dod yon gyi mchod pa dang / bshags pa'i mchod pa bstan zin nas/ gsum pa tshogs tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ rgyud kyi chings drug gam/ khog don drug gi nang tshan lnga pa gab pa'i sngags drug dang / tshe lung khrus lung gis kha bskang ste gdab pa'i las bya zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid kyi don rnams nyams su blangs bar bya ba yin te/ 'di la yang rgyas par na sngon 'gro yang 'grel so drug bya ba/ dngos gzhi gdab pa'i las bya ba/ rjes bzlog pa zor gyi las bstan pa gsum gyi sgo nas gdab las rgyas pa nub mtha' ma la bya ba'i cho ga rnams ni/ bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms dang sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bzlog gzhung gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dbal sogs las shes par bya zhing /

de dag gi rnam par bshad pa rgyas pa zhig logs su 'chad par bdag spro la/ 'dir ni de'i rnam par gzhag pa mdo tsam zhig bshad par bya ste/ 'di la yang gang bsgral ba/ gang gis bsgral ba/ tshul ji ltar du bsgral ba dang gsum las/ dang po gang bsgral ba ni/ phur pa khrag 'thung rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang / /theg chen chos la smod pa dang / /bla ma'i sku la bdo ba dang / /rdo rje'i nang du dbyen spyod dang / /sgrub la bar chad byed pa dang / /dam tshig dam las bzlog pa dang / /snying rje med pa'i srin po dang / /mu stegs log ltar gtong ba dang / /sgrub pa po la do bdo ba/ /'di rnams bsgral pa'i zhing bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhing bcu char tshang ba'am/ yang na rtsa ba nyams na sa bon rul pa 'dra/ /yan lag nyams na ljon shing mes tshig 'dra/ /dngos su nyams na sgo nga rul pa 'dra/ /zur gyis nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung ngo / /zhes pa ltar/ dngos shugs gang rung gi sgo nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa/ mdor na ma bsgral na bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la/ gnod tshabs che zhing bsgral bya rang nyid rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye nges kyi las gsog par byed pa'i gdug pa can snying rje'i yul du gyur pa de bsgral ba'i yul du gsungs pa yin la/ gnyis pa gang gis bsgral na/ phur bu ngan sngags gtsug lag gi rgyud las/ phur bu rnam bzhi'i dgongs pa yis/ /gang zag rnam bzhi mthar dbyung ngo / /rig pa ye shes phur bu ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi klong du gdab/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i phur pa ni/ /khams gsum sems can la gdab bo/ /gsang ba byang sems phur pa ni/ /yum gyi mkha' klong dag par gdab/ /mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa ni/ /dgra dang bgegs la gdab pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de'i don ni/ phur pa'i rgyu bzhis gang zag rnam bzhi mthar dbyung /

zhes bshad pas de yang rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa de blo spang mtho la lta ba rgya che ba nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag gis/ yul 'khor 'das thams cad chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig par mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul gyis btab pas/ yang dag pa'i don la rig pa nyid rig pa ye shes su song ba ni 'thebs pa'i tshad yin la/ thugs rje sprul pa'i phur pa de blo brtan la mi 'gyur ba ri bo lta bu'i gang zag gis/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la dmigs med kyi snying rje bsgom pa'i tshul gyis btab pas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa nyid 'thebs pa'i tshad yin zhing / gsang ba byang chub sems gyi phur pa de/ blo chags can te/ bya ka lan da ka lta bu'i gang zag gis yum gyi mkha' la zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i tshul gyis btab pas/ yab yum thabs shes gnyis med du phral ba ni 'thebs pa'i tshad yin la/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa de/ rgyud bzang la gtum pa tsan+dan sdong po lta bu'i gang zag gis gzugs can gyi dgra dang gzugs med kyi bgegs la btab bas/ dgra bgegs rang zhir song ba ni 'thebs pa'i tshad yin te/ de yang phur pa myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa de/ /rnam rtog gzung 'dzin ngos la gdab/ /dngos po kun bral phur pa de/ /gdab dang mi gdab gnyis las 'das/ /skye med brdal pa'i phur pa de/ /dbyings la gdab na rig par shar/ /sems la gdab na don dam rtogs/ /khyab brdal rang bzhin phur pa de/ /snang srid kun la khyab par gdab/ /de ltar rtogs na 'thebs pa yin/ /mngon du gyur na rtogs pa yin/ /tshig las 'das na sangs rgyas yin/ /grangs las 'das na brjod du med/ /ces gsungs shing / de dag kyang las bzhi dang sbyar na/ de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar gyi gang zag bzhis phur pa bzhi yul bzhi la btab pas nyon mongs pa zhi bas na zhi ba'i phur pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgyas par byed pas na rgyas pa'i phur pa/

rang sems dbang du 'dus pas na dbang gi phur pa/ des 'khor ba las sgrol bar byed pas na drag po'i phur par 'jog pa yin te/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi rnam rol las ma 'das pa'i phyir te/ myang 'das kyi rgyud las/ chos kyi chos nyid phur pa yin/ /sems kyi sems nyid phur pa yin/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid phur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar gdab par byed pa'i phur pa bzhi las/ 'dir skabs su bab pa bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa yul dgra bgegs la gdab pa nyid bshad par bya ba yin la/ 'di la phur bu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsgral ba/ phur bu lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis bsgral ba/ phur bu nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bsgral ba/ phur bu bcu bdun gyis bsgral ba/ phur bu gsum gyis bsgral ba/ phur bu gcig gis bsgral ba sogs mang du yod kyang / 'dir sgrub thabs kyi dngos bstan ltar/ phur bu gcig gis bsgral ba yin la/ gsum pa tshul ji ltar du bsgral ba ni/ liṅga la dgra bgegs gang yin pa de nyid kyi rnam par shes pa dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bzhi byed par bsam zhing / 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ e raṃ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las dkyil 'khor gcig chad/ dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha las ye shes kyi lha chad de/ ye shes kyi lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag gi dpung grogs su byon par bsam zhing / de'i rjes su/ rtsa dum gyi rgyud las/ chos nyid kyi bden pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i sgo nas dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes sogs te/ de yang dbang bzhi bskur ba'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bstsol bar mdzad pa/ rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i byin rlabs dang /

sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun te dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ 'phrin las phur bu/ ma mo rbod stong / dmod pa dgra sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo ste sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / gzhan yang sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / bka' gtod chos skyong / ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / chos thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing / chos can ji snyed pa kun rdzob tu las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / bden pa yang dag pa de kho nar nges pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi mthu dang nus pa'i stobs gang yin pa des/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i spyi dgra bye brag dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra khyad par du dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sdang dgra gzhan yang yon gyi bdag po la sogs pa sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gnod byed gdug pa can/ gzugs can gyi dgra'am/ gzugs med kyi bgegs gang yin ci mchis pa de dag thams cad badz+ra a ku sha dzaḥste/ sprul pa'i pho nya drag po'i tshul can rnams kyis rdo rje lcags kyus khug badz+ra pa sha hūm̐ ste rdo rje zhags pas chings/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ ste/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gis sdoms/ badz+ra a bhe sha a ste/ rdo rje 'bebs pas mnyes par gyis la/ sarba sha trun nā sha yas dgra bgegs thams cad khug cig dzaṃ bha ya/ taṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ bhan+dha ya/ ma ra ya/ zhes pas/ phob cig gzir zhig chings shig

sod cig ces sogs kyis pho nya rnams la bskul ba ltar las mdzad par bsam zhing / rgyas par phye na bden stobs brjod pa sngar bzhin lan mang du bya bar gsungs la/ bsdu na dgug gzhug tshar gsum gyi rjes la/ sngar kun gzhi rtsad bcad de bsgral ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i bskul tshig dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ kyi bar sngar bzhin gyi rjes su/ kī la ya nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing / skabs 'dir sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi lam rim smon lam las/ sngon spyod las kyi zhing bcu sgrol ba'i tshe/ /tha mal snying nang dngas ma lnga yi dbus/ /rnam shes dang po'i dbyangs yig dkar la 'tsher/ /kun gzhi'i gnas tshul ji bzhin shes par shog /las nyon dri ma sbyong byed khrus lung dang / /'chi med chos skur bsgyur ba tshe yi lung / /bcu gnyis gnad ldan dgongs pa rnam gsum gyis/ /bdag 'dzin dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol bar shog /ces gsungs pa'i don rnams dran par byas la/ gsal ba gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas/ liṅga'i snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur bu gdab par bya ba yin la/ de yang gdab las byas pas sems can gyi lus la snying rje med pas mtshon 'debs pa lta bu ma yin te/ 'o na ci lta bu zhe na/ phur pa ni lha dang ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ de btab pas las dang nyon mongs pa zad nas ngan song du mi skye la/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par byed pas/ gsang sngags thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yang / 'di 'dra ba'i rigs can la dgongs pa yin no/ /slar yang liṅga'i snying gar bdag nyid tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur par bsgom la/ de nas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ling ro de 'dod yon lngar sprul nas/ sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabs pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ bai ḍūr sngon po'i rin chen ri rab la/ 'di'i dbyangs la bstab dbyangs zhes bya zhing /

sngon gyi dbyangs rnying yin te dbyangs yig snga ma thams cad las bshad pas so/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang rin po che bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i ri rab la nyi ma dang zla ba stong gi 'od zer ga la ba ste khyab pa lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa'i gtso bo sku mdog sngon po 'od dang 'od zer du ma 'phro ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu nyid du 'khor 'das kyi dpal thams cad dang ldan pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po 'od dang gzi brjid du ma 'bar ba dang bcas te bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang 'od kyi phung po chen po stug po ste/ /shin tu 'thug pa nam mkha'i sprin ltar 'thibs pa de yi dbus na/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams 'jig par byed pa'i rngam pa'i stang stabs zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskum pa'i tshul du bzhugs la/ byin pa thams cad za bar byed pa'i bskal pa'i me phung 'bar ba lta bu yi rdo rje gzhon nu khyed kyi zhal du dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad kyi sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs rnams bstabs te 'bul na/ dges par rol mdzod cig gzhan yang gdug pa mi zad pa'i tshogs rnams 'jigs par byed pa'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa'i zhal gdengs shing khams gsum gyi gdug pa can za bar byed pa'i dkan sgra drag po can nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gnyis kyi gdangs mig gis phyogs bcur gzigs pas/ bgegs kyi dpung ma lus pa sreg par mdzad pa'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa rnams zhal du rol zhing dges par mdzod/ gzhan yang sku las sprul pa'i khro bo hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa yab bcu/ rdo rje sgra 'byin la sogs pa'i yum bcu ste yab yum nyi shu'i zhal du dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs rnams bstab pa ste dbul gyis dges par rol cig de bzhin du sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum las/ slar yang sprul pa'i phyag brnyan mche ba can gyi tshogs dang /

phra men gshog pa can gyi tshogs rnams kyi zhal du/ tshad med pa'i ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo sgo ma bzhi'i zhal du/ gtso bo'i sku las sprul pa'i sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du/ khyad par dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs kyi zhal du/ dpal chen po'i dam can bka'i srung ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal du/ gying chen dge snyen 'khor bcas rnams kyi zhal du/ rdo rje rig 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi zhal du/ phyi dang nang na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi zhal du/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi zhal du/ khyad par dpal ldan re ma ti mched bzhi'i zhal du/ bdud 'dul nag mo chen mo mched bzhi'i zhal du bstab pa ste 'bul gyis/ dges par rol zhes pa'i don to/ /gzhan yang rgyas par spro na/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa/ lha thams cad kyi mtshan nas brjod la zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pa dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes brjod cing / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs rnams lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du dbul bar bsam la/ slar yang tshogs kyi dngos po nyid dgra bgegs kyi don snying lnga sha khrag rus pa dang bcas par bsams te/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i phyi nang gsang 'di'i dbyangs 'di dbyangs yig rnying pa kun las mi 'byung yang / bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyis sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun bzhin bkod par mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i dbyangs yig tshangs dbyangs nga ro las 'byung ba ltar deng sang phyag len la mdzad pa 'di ni/ sa lo chen po yab sras man chad tsam la byung ba kho bo cag sems so/ ba'i mchod pa zhes sogs te/ de yang phyi 'dod yon lnga/ nang bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba lha mo'i mchod pa rgya che zhing gting dpag dka' ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i mchod tshogs 'di nyid/ rig pa 'dzin pa dag gi kun nas dang ba'i sems kyis gus pas 'bul lo/

/dges par bzhes su gsol/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa don snying lnga la sogs pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i mchod rdzas 'di/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs thams cad la gus pas 'bul gyis dges par rol zhing bsnam du gsol/ zhes pa'i don can gyi tshig brjod de ling ro de nyid gtor ma la phul nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams dbul bar bsam zhing / de nas ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams mnyes te/ ha ha zhes bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /phaṭ phaṭ kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rnam shes chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsams te/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol zhing longs spyod par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni rje sa chen gyis sgrub thabs las de nas tshogs bshams la rtsa sngags sam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pas bsang / de nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan lngar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dmigs med mkha' ltar zhes pa nas hriḥ'i bar du brjod la tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs/ de nas badz+ra dhu pe nas rol du gsol gyi bar gyis mchod/ bla med ces pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gis mchod pa phul la/ de nas 'dre gdon la sogs pa gnod pa che na pho nya bzhi sbag tu bskul/ de lta min na khro bcu man chad kyi pho nya btang / yang na srung ma bcu gnyis tsam bskul/ de nas lung bskul yang dgab/ de ltar dgra bgegs bkug la tshogs la bstims la/ de nas rnal 'byor pas phur bu gdab/ de nas dum bu gsum du bcad la/ dang po sgeg mo dpa' mo'i bstod pa dbul/ bar du lus kyis zhes pas bshags pa dbul/ tha ma bai ḍūr zhes pas bstab ste dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshangs pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing dgra bgegs che ge mo khā hi khā hi zhes dbul/ de nas rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bza'/ de nas rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad kyis longs spyad de tshims par bya'o/

/zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun rin po che'i tho yig las/ 'jug gi chos gsum ni/ gdab pa dang / tshogs dang / las 'jug go /dang po gdab pa ni/ shog bu la khrag dang dug gis dgra bgegs kyi ling ga rgyas par bris la/ de la dgug gzhug mang du byas la 'brab khung du bcug la/ lag pas phur bu thogs nas/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ man chad sgrol ba'i mchod pa bzhin byas te/ tshigs bcad brjod pa'i dus su pho nya 'gye zhing dgug gzhug bya/ sngags brjod pa'i dus su phur bus btab ste/ khrag dang sha dang klad pa dang rus pa'i mchod pas mchod de/ de nas bag zan dang dgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa la sogs pa la byas pa'i ling ga sngar bzhin gyi cho ga byas la/ dum bur btub la gtor ma la dbul lo/ /des kyang ma sgrol lam rtog na/ phur pa lag tu blang la/ chos kyi bden pa 'o man chad brjod cing / kī la ya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur pa btab bar bsams la/ ling ga'i snying gar phur bu gdab bo/ /rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du bskyel par bsam mo/ /de dag gi byin rlabs kyis bdag tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur bar bsam mo/ /de nas tshogs ni/ yang snga ma bzhin du byas la/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ro de 'don yon lngar sprul la byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pas lha la dbul/ ha ha ha zhes pas bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bdag la dngos grub bstsal/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba chos nyid du gnas par bsam la tshogs la rol/ zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi dgongs don zhib tu phye ba'i sgo nas tshogs kyi mchod pa rnams kyi rnam par bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ tshogs mchod dang po 'dod yon lngas mchod cing / /tshogs mchod bar pa bshags pas nyes kun sbyangs/ /tshogs mchod tha mas dgra bgegs kun 'joms pa'i/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa rnam gsum 'di ngo mtshar/

/bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa lhag ma la dkyil 'khor chas su gzhug pa dang / gtor ma chas su gzhug pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyas par phye na gnas bdun po re re la dkyil 'khor re re bri zhing sgom par bshad la/ bsdus pa byed na/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du zhing chen gyi steng / rak+ta'i thig le zla gam bdun bri bar bshad cing / slob dpon kha cig mkha' 'gro dang gying gnyis yar gyi gnas kyi phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas la/ gzhan rnams byang shar du e gru gsum thal chen gyis bris pa la bskyed par gsungs kyang / 'dir lhag ma'i yul rnams dam la btags pa'i skabs su/ rdzas kyi dbang bskur rdo rje lag tu gtad/ /ming gi dbang bskur rang ming so sor btags/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur dkyil 'khor mu ran bzhag /zas kyi dbang bskur lhag ma kha chus btab/ /ces pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi mu ran steng du gnas par bsgom pa yin par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gtor ma chas su gzhug pa ni/ tshogs la dgos pa'i cha tha ma ste bar phud dang / rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs kyi lhag ma bsdus pa rnams/ thod pa la sogs pa'i snod gang yang rung ba gcig tu blugs pa/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar gyi phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du bzhag lhag ma dngos la/ yar gyi gnas spyan drangs te gsal btab pa dang / mar gyi gnas bdun spyan drangs te lhag mar btang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i ngang nas phaṭ s+pha ra ṇa zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka nas phaṭ nag po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig skar mda'i tshul gyis 'phros te/ rang gi snying gar thim pas/ bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs par bsams la/ gtso bo la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi sngags dbang phyug ma'i bh+yoḥbar/ sngar bzlas pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin brjod pas/

bdag dang dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor khra lam ste gsal btab/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs ba dngos ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ khro bas khro ba zhi mdzad la/ zhes sogs te/ de yang thugs rjes khros pa'i tshul bstan pas khro bo'i gdul bya dregs pa can zhi bar mdzad pa ni/ thugs rje chen po gzhan gyi dpal yin la/ thugs rjes khros pa'i tshul gyis khro bo'i dbang po dpal chen rngams pa'i tshogs khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi byin rlabs sku gsung thugs gzhan las khyad par du gyur pas na/ smad du byung ba chen po de nyid dus da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slar yang gnad nas bskul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa mā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa mā ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa mā ya phaṭ/ ces pa'i sngags brjod/ de dag gi don ni ye shes rdo rje khro bo'i dam tshig gis bdag dang gnyis su med par mdzod cig mnyes par mdzod cig bdag gi gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa sgrol cig ces bskul bas bdag mdun gnyis kyi thugs kar tshogs shing spyan drangs pa thim nas/ bdag gi gnyis 'dzin gyis sgrib pa bral/ lha dang rtog pa gnyis med kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo/ /de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma bshams pa'i steng du/ dpal gtor nas cha gcig gong du bzhag pa'am 'dir bzhag kyang rung ste/ ding sang phyag len la lhag ma bsdus pa'i steng du tshogs kyi phud phul ba 'jog par mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi don tshang pa yin la/ de yang rje thog tu 'bangs dbab pa dang / 'bangs thog tu rje dbab pa gnyis las/ 'dir 'bangs thog tu rje phab na las myur/ bka' nyan/ rtse log chung / btsun sla/ 'jig rten gyi tshul lugs dang mthun zhing bkra shis par gsungs pa de'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa yin zhing / gnyis pa mar gyi gnas bdun spyan drangs te lhag ma btang ba la/ rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnas bstan pa/

rgyud drug sgrol mdzad phra men bco brgyad kyi gnas bstan pa/ ti ra'i gnas nyul zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi drod nyul ba 'bar ma brgyad kyi gnas bstan pa/ dpal gyi bka' nyan dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi gnas bstan pa/ sha khrag rlon pa sbyor zhing dregs pa can dbang du bsdud pa ma bdun gyi gnas bstan pa/ sngags 'chang gi bka' bstod sring bzhi'i gnas bstan pa/ mgyogs pa'i las byed pho nya sum brgya drug cu'i gnas bstan pa dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ lhag ma za ba'i mkha' 'gro'i bye brag pho nya dang / phra men ma/ 'bar ma/ dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun/ sring bzhi/ pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams skad cig nyid du blos bkug la lhag ma'i tshogs kyis mchod par bsam zhing / sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'di'i dbyangs sngon gyi dbyangs yig kun las mi 'byung yang / bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar phyag len la mdzad pa 'di ni/ sa lo chen po dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po sogs kyis gsar du mdzad dam snyam mo/ gzhon nu dang / /zhes sogs brjod pa ste/ de yang thabs snying rje chen po'i ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu dang / shes rab kyi ngo bo yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis la/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med cing mtha' yas pas bskor ba las/ grub pa brnyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba gsal gdab pa ni/ dpal chen po nga ni srin po'i bdag po lang ka'i rgyal po yin pas/ snying rje chen po'i dam tshig dang yang dag par ldan zhing / snying rje chen po'i dam tshig de'i dbang gis lang ka'i srin po'i tshul bzung ba'i srin po'i tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shig dpal chen nga ni dur khrod na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro chen po rnams kyi bdag po ste/ grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dam tshig dang yang dag pa ldan pas/

grub pa'i dam tshig de'i dbang gis grub pa brnyes pa'i tshul ston pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'dir 'dus shig dpal chen nga ni gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun gyi bdag po ste/ gsang ba'i sngags kyi dam tshig dang yang dag par ldan la/ gsang ba'i dam tshig de'i dbang gis gsang ba'i bdag po'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams gnas 'dir 'dus shig dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi gnas srung zhing / dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa ba las mi 'da' ba dam tshig gi sgo 'byed par byed pa rdo rje srin mo 'bar ba'i tshogs can kha cig ni rdo rje'i khar spu gri'i so 'phyang ba dang / kha cig ni stong nyid rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gyi sgra ci yang sgrog pa dang / kha cig ni rdo rje'i gzugs 'jigs shing rngam par byed pa ma dang / kha cig ni dam tshig gi ha ha'i gad rgyangs kyi sgra sna tshogs sgrog pa byed pa khyed rnams kyis dam tshig zhal gyis bzhes pa dus la bab pas/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa 'di bzhes la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa mched dang lcam bral 'khor dang bcas pa bsrung ba dang / bdag cag rnams la nang gi gzung 'dzin gyi rkyen ngan las byung ba'i phyi rol dgra bo'i rnam par snang ba rnams/ skad cig gam yud tsam gyis med par mdzod/ ces brjod cing lhag gtor la/ dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ bran/ de nas lhag gtor de nyid las byed kyi rdo rjes/ rdo rje 'gros kyis phyir nur la/ dpal chen yab yum kyi sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs shing mchod par bya ba ni sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ 'jig rten las 'di'i dbyangs la sgrub thabs kyi dpal gyi pho nya ring ba 'jug pa deng sang phyag len yin zhing / 'di'i 'og gi 'jig rten las 'das pho nya mo/ /gzugs ni cir yang ma nges te/ zhes pa la/ sngon gyi dbyangs yig rnams las/ 'di rang la sger dbyangs zhig yod par gsungs kyang rang re'i phyag len la mi mdzad pas/

sgrub thabs kyi dpal gyi pho nya thung ba 'jug pa yin no/ 'das pho nya mo/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po yab yum la pho nya mo 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i tshul ston par byed pa'i pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ gzi ldan 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ yab yum gnyis kyi mkha' gsang nas kun+da byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phro ba can dkar po 'phros pas/ rak+ta byang chub kyi sems dmar por 'khyil/ yang byang sems dmar por 'phros pas dkar por 'khyil/ de ltar phar 'khyil tshur 'khyil gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis byin rlabs las/ sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs phyogs bcur byung 'di skabs kyi/ dkar por 'phros pas dmar por 'khyil/ /dmar por 'phros pas dkar por 'khyil/ /zhes pa'i don/ gtso bo yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa las/ pho nya'i tshogs spros pa'i tshul 'di ni/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab las kyang 'byung ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyis rin chen rtse'i gnyer pa'i dris lan las/ lhag ma'i skabs su/ dkar por 'phros pas dmar por/ sogs pa'i don/ gtso bo yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa las/ pho nya'i tshogs 'di lta bu sprul zhes pa'i don yin/ zhes 'byung bas so/ ba ni/ shar gyi phyogs kyi pho nya mo gser gyi seṅge rngam brjid can gyi khri la/ mi mo seṅge'i tshul can zhon pa/ mgo bo brgya dang ldan ma la lag pa brgya dang ldan ma/ lag pa de dag la las rdo rje 'dzin zhing / la las dgra bgegs lcags kyu'i 'dren par byed ma/ pho nya 'di 'dra ba gcig pur ma nges te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par sprul par byed ma khyed rnams shar gyi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ pho nya de'i bka' nyan zhing las byed pa'i pho nya ni/ dung gi spyang mo mgo dgu pa'i rnam pa can la g.yu'i ral pa'i cod paṇa du ma 'phyang pa can/

ral pa re re la pho nya'i tshogs lag na lcags kyu thogs pa nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtib pa dang bcas shar lho'i mtshams nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ lho'i phyogs kyi pho nya mo ni stag gi rngams brjid can gyi khri chen po la/ mi mo stag gi mgo can/ mgo bo brgya dang ldan ma la lag pa brgya dang ldan ma zhon cing / lag pa la las zhags pa 'debs par byed la/ lag pa la las sems can la sbyin pa gtong / pho nya mo 'di 'dra ba gcig pur ma nges te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyis khams khyab par sprul par byed ma khyed rnams lho'i phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ pho nya mo de'i bka' stod cing gsung nyan par byed pa'i pho nya mo ni/ lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu pa la/ shel gyi ral pa'i cod paṇa du ma 'phyang ba can/ ral pa lcang lo re re la yang pho nya lag tu zhags pa thogs pa nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs pa dang bcas lho nub mtshams nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ nub kyi phyogs kyi pho nya mo ni/ dung gi glang po 'gros 'phur pa bas mgyogs pa can gyi bzhon pa la/ mi mo dung gi ngang tshul can zhon zhing / /de yang mgo bo brgya dang ldan ma la lag pa brgya dang ldan ma/ lag pa la las lcags sgrog 'dzin zhing / lag pa la las khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed ma/ pho nya mo 'di 'dra ba gcig pur ma nges te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par sprul par byed ma khyed rnams nub kyi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ pho nya mo de'i bka' stod cing gsung nyan par byed pa'i pho nya mo ni/ zangs kyi spyang mo mgo dgu pa la/ bse'i ral pa'i cod paṇa du ma 'phyang pa can/ ral pa lcang lo re re la yang pho nya'i tshogs lag tu lcags sgrog thogs pa nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtib pa dang bcas pa nub byang mtshams nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ byang gi phyogs kyi pho nya mo ni/ lcags kyi dre rta rkang gsum la mi mo lcags kyi tshul can zhon zhing /

mgo bo brgya dang ldan ma la lag pa brgya dang ldan ma/ lag pa la las dril bu 'khrol lo/ lag pa la las 'gro ba rnams gnas nas spor bar byed pa'i pho nya mo 'di 'dra ba gcig pur ma nges te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par sprul par byed ma khyed rnams byang gi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ pho nya mo de'i bka' stod gsung nyan par byed pa'i pho nya mo ni/ g.yu'i spyang mo mgo dgu pa la/ g.yu'i ral pa'i cod paṇa du ma 'phyang pa can/ ral pa lcang lo re re la yang pho nya lag tu dril bu thogs pa nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtib pa dang bcas byang shar mtshams nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ 'og gi phyogs kyi pho nya mo ni/ lcags kyi rang bzhin can gyi byi ba chen mo la/ mi mo lcags kyi ngang tshul can bzhon pa/ de yang ngo ni rgya rnga tsam/ mig ni rgya long lta bu/ so dang skra ni spu gri'i rang bzhin can/ /kha brgya nas dgra bo la khus 'debs shing / mig brgya bzlog ste gdangs mig tu lta bar byed pas lha srin sde brgyad kyang phung bar byed ma khyed kyang sngon gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs te/ 'og gi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ steng gi phyogs kyi pho nya mo ni/ lcags kyi bya khra brgya khri'i bdag nyid can gyi bzhon pa la/ mi mo lcags kyi bya khra chen mo'i tshul can bzhon pa/ skya rengs kyi lus can la dgu tshigs sked la bcings shing / gnam gyi phyed gos su gyon pa/ nyi zla gza' skar gyis bskor zhing / sa'i phyed gdan du btings pa/ klu dang gza' brgyad kyis bskor bas gang ba/ mig gnyis ni nyi zla 'khyil ba 'dra ba la/ nyi zla gnyis dang gza' skar gyis sku la brgyan pa/ khyed sngon gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs te steng gi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ pho nya'i tshogs chen po rnams kyang rab tu 'jigs pa kun yang ral pa me ltar 'bar ba la/

lag na lcags kyu dang dgra satwa rab tu thogs shing / stag gi mgo dang 'jug ma can gyi pags pa gyon pa la zhal nas he he dang phaṭ phaṭ kyis rngams pa'i gad rgyangs sam/ skad gdangs chen por sgrogs pa can/ zhing chen gyi pags pa yan lag nas 'dzin par byed pa ste/ mi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun la dbang sgyur bar byed la/ bar snang khams la rgyu ba ste lha'i lo kha dbang du byed/ phyag g.yon pa'i lcags kyus dgra bgegs kyi snying nas 'dren zhing / g.yas pa'i sta res dgra bgegs nges par 'joms par mdzad pa khyed rnams kyi thugs dam bcas pa dus la bab pas/ sngon gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs te/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'di dag bzhes la/ gang bcol ba'i 'phrin las dam pa grub par mdzod/ gzhan yang 'jig rten las 'das pa 'jig rten pa'i tshul ston pa'i pho nya mo gzugs kyi snang brnyan ni/ mtha' cir yang ma nges te/ skabs gcig tu stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khyab pa'i lus 'chang ma/ lus gcig pu de nyid la mgo bo brgya dang ldan ma/ mgo brgya la spyan bcu bcu ste spyan stong dang ldan mar ston zhing / skabs 'gar zhal gcig ma la so stong dang ldan ma/ glog stong 'bar ba'i rnam pa can gyi kha rlangs 'phro ba can khrag dang thal ba'i thig les sku lus brgyan zhing / zhing chen gyi gos la bha su ta ste rgyu ma'i ske rags can/ gzhan yang gser gyi glog pa go su gyon pa la/ pro dza an dzas rgyan du byas pa can du ston la/ skabs 'gar sku lus gcer bu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i tshogs chen po la/ bde mchog smug nag me 'bar bas 'jig rten gyi khams kun sreg par mdzad pa/ zhing la sdod cing 'thab pa'i tshul ston par mdzad la/ rnal 'byor pas gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bo rnams khab len gyis khab ltar yud kyis blangs nas khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku yi zhal du btab cing /

chem chem gsol ba'i las mdzad pa khyed rnams rnal 'byor pa bdag la dgongs la sa ma ya ste/ dam tshig dran par mdzod/ sngon dpal chen po'i spyan sngar thugs dam bcas shing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rjes su dgongs la/ spyan drangs pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas rnal 'byor bdag gi gang bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ ces pa'i don dran pa dang bcas pas brjod de/ sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pas mchod do/ /gnyis pa rgyud drug sgrol mdzad phra men bco brgyad kyi gnas bstan pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbyangs sngon gyi dbyangs yig rnams las 'byung ba/ da lta sgo ma'i bstod bskul la 'jug pa de yin no/ de yi phyi rim na/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor chen po de'i phyi rim mu ran na/ mgo lus mi cig pa phra men gyi tshogs kyi skor ba ni/ kun la khyab par byed pa phra men chen mo khyud mgo ma/ sa gzhi mtha' nas khyab par byed pa'i gshog rgyang can ma khyed/ rnal 'byor pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa mtha' nas thul la med par mdzod cig bstan pa 'dzin par byed pa'i phra men chen mo spyang ki'i mgo can ma khyed/ rnal 'byor pas gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs rnams nor pa re ste ma nor ba gyis la dgra bgegs thul cig dgra bgegs gsod par byed pa'i phra men chen mo dred mo'i mgo can khyed/ gang la bya ba nor ba re te/ ma nor ba gyis la/ dgra bgegs kyi srog chod cig dgra bgegs kyi snying 'byin par byed pa'i phra men chen mo byi bla dang pu shud kyi mgo can khyed gnyis kyang / rang gi bya ba dgra bgegs kyi snying nas snying rtsa da phyung la dgra bgegs med par mdzod/ dgra bgegs myos par byed pa'i phra men chen mo lto 'phye ste sbrul dang rmigs bu'i mgo can khyed gnyis kyang / rang gi bya ba dgra bgegs rnams smyo zhing ded las shog la myos par gyis shig

dgra bgegs kyi bla tshe la rkun byed pa'i phra men chen mo byi ba'i mgo can khyed kyang / rang gi bya ba dgra bgegs rnams kyis bla dang tshe da rkus shig gdug pa can gyi las byed pa'i phra men chen mo stag gi mgo can ma khyed kyang / rang gi bya ba dgra bgegs la sdug pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa da ston par gyis shig sgron byed kyi phra men chen mo seṅge dang pha wang gi mgo can khyed rnams kyang / gang la bya ba nor ba re te/ ma nor ba gyis la/ dgra bgegs rnams rdul phran bzhin du rlog par gyis/ mdor na de dag la sogs pa phra men chen mo khyed rnams kyang dpal chen bka' yis pham 'bags kyi lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di longs la rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ ces pa'i don no/ /gsum pa ti ra'i gnas nyul zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi drod nyul ba 'bar ma brgyad kyi gnas bstan pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ 'bar ma'i tshogs gyis bskor ba ni/ 'di'i dbyangs snye thang pa bsod nams dpal ba'am/ shes rab snang bas mdzad pas dbyangs yig gsal ba'i me long las mi 'byung yang / rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris dbyangs kyi brjed byang seṅge'i nga ro las bshad pas/ de tsam na byung ba kho bo sems so/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal chen po la pho nya 'bar mi'i tshogs kyi bskor ba ni/ 'bar ma chen mo sku 'bar ma ste/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku las bskal pa'i me 'dra ba'i 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba las skyes ma dang / 'bar ma chen mo phyag na nyi ma'i zhags pa 'dra bas dgra bgegs la 'debs par byed ma dang / 'bar ma chen mo phyag na me chen khyer ba 'dra ba'i glog gi 'phreng ba chen po 'dzin ma dang / 'bar ma chen mo gshin rje skar mda' dgra bgegs la 'phen ma dang / 'bar ma chen po srin mo dgra bgegs la mdung thung 'phen pa ma dang / 'bar ma chen mo klu mo dgra bgegs la lce 'bebs pa'i gnod pa gtong bar byed ma dang /

'bar ma chen mo rlung bdag ma ral gri'i skra ste spu gri can gyi rlung 'dzin par byed ma dang / 'bar ma chen mo gnod sbyin phyag na khyung thogs pa ma dang / 'bar ma chen mo gtum mo ba glang sna chen ma ste/ 'bar ma chen mo brgyad po khyed rnams kyang / sngon gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bcol ba'i las thams cad grub par mdzod/ ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab nas/ lhag ma'i gtor ma bsngo ba dngos la/ lhag ma'i phud la dbang ba dang / lhag ma dngos la dbang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lhag ma'i mgron rnams don rigs lngar gnas pa'i phyir mchod pa spyir dbul zhing las so sor mdzad par gsol ba gdab dgos te/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i lhag ma'i gzhung las/ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal he ru ka /'phrin las sgrub byed gnas bdun tshogs kyis bskor/ /bde gshegs thams cad rigs lnga'i rang bzhin la/ /rigs rnams so sor bye la las mdzod cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ lhag ma'i mgron rdo rje rigs 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams la/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur nas gsol zhig par bsams te/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni pra ti tsa i maṃ bha liṃ hūm̐ ste rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams gtor ma 'di rab tu bzhes shig ces pa'i don bsam pa dang bcas gtor ma phul bas mnyes te/ rnal 'byor pa la ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar bsgom pa yin la/ de bzhin du bud+dha ḍā ki ṇi/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams dang / rat+na ḍā ki ṇi zhes pas rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'am/ rin po che'i rigs rnams dang / pad+ma ḍā ki ṇi zhes pas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'am/ pad+ma'i rigs rnams dang / karma ḍā ki ṇi zhes pas las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'am las kyi rigs rnams la gtor ma phul bas mnyes par bsam zhing dngos grub zhu/ yang na gnas bdun gyi gtso mo brgyad la lhag ma'i gtor ma'i phud phul la dngos grub blang bar bya ba yang gsungs pa yin no/

/gnyis pa lhag ma dngos la dbang ba ni/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ras/ mkha' 'gro zhing dang dbang phyug ma yis tshogs/ /lhag ma kha chus btab la gtor ma rnams/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod kyis bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa dang / yang slob dpon de nyid kyis/ dbang phyug ma dang ging gi tshogs/ /lhag ma kha chu'i mnga' bdag rnams/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lhag ma dngos la dbang phyug ma rnams dbang zhing / lhag phud la gnas drug char dbang la/ kha chu la gnas bdun char dbang bar bshad pas/ thog mar lhag ma dngos ni/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma sbyin zhing / de la kha chu'am kha khru btab pa la/ kha chu de yang rnal 'byor pa lta spyod gdengs su ma gyur pas dngos su btab na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams ci rung rung zer nas sna bkag nas 'bros par 'gyur bar gsungs pas ting nge 'dzin gyis btab ste/ mkha' dbyings kyi phyag rgya mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis rtse sprad mdzub mo gcig la gcig 'khyud sor mo gzhan rnams brkyangs la gtor ma'i steng du bcas la/ de'i bar du sman phud kyi thod pa bcug la kha chus lan gsum gdab ste/ 'di'i dmigs pa la phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa'i/ dang po phyi ltar na bdag nyid dpal chen mor bsgom la/ lce'i rtse mo rdo rje rtse gsum par bsam la/ rdo rje'i rwa brag nas kha chu bdud rtsir bsam nas btab nas/ gtor ma'i nyes pa'i dri ma thams cad dag par bsam/ de la dgos pa ci yod na/ dang po bran du zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus su/ dbus su mchis skal mi ldan gyis/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' la zhog /phud la 'tshal skal mi ldan gyis/ /lhag ma zhal chab bron la stsol/ /ces dam du bcas nas kha chus ma gdab na mi gsol la/ gsol bar bya ba'i phyir btab bo/ /gnyis pa nang ltar na bdag dpal chen du bsgom la/ ya dkan zla ba ma dkan nyi ma lce pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du rta mgrin tshon gang pa la yum bzhi'i bskor ba bsgoms la/

de rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa lta bu gtor ma la 'phros te/ gtor ma don bdud rtsi chen po'i rang bzhin la/ rnam pa sha khrag gi phung po ri rab tsam du bsam/ de la dgos pa ci yod na/ dang po dpal rta mgrin gyis mgron dbang du bsdus pa'i dus su/ 'bangs su mchi/ bka' nyan/ 'phrin las gang bcol nyan zer bas/ mar gyi gnas bdun gyi 'phrin las byed pa'i phyir gdab bo/ /gsum pa gsang ba ltar bdag dpal chen du bsgom la/ mkha'i dbyings kyi phyag rgya de la mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mkha' bsdus te/ bdag dpal chen po dang sbyor ba byas nas gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mkha' ru 'phros pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams la lhag pa byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ro/ /de'i dgos pa ni/ sbyor ba'i mchod pa'i dbang du sdud pas/ 'phrin las bzhi thogs pa med par byed pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir gdab bo/ /de ltar phud dang lhag ma kha khru gsum gcig tu bsres la bsngo ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dang po phud kyi mi mchod du/ 'di'i dbyangs la lhag ma'i gdung dbyangs/ thang lha'i dbyangs gcig ma zhes bya zhing / sngon gyi dbyangs rnying yin par snang ngo / /zhes sogs te/ dang por dpal chen po 'khor bcas dang / rgyal mo brgyad la phud kyi mi mchod du mchod par bya dgos te/ dpal chen he ru ka rgyal mo brgyad dang bcas pa phud kyi bdag nyid yin pas so/ /bar du blon mo brgyad dbang phyug dang bcas pa tshogs la mi rol du rol bar bya dgos te/ blon mo brgyad kyi tshogs dbang phyug ma dang bcas pa tshogs la rol ba'i bdag nyid yin pas so/ /de dag bka' yi pham 'bags mi gsol du gsol bar bya dgos te/ dbang phyug ma khyed rnams dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu nged kyi bran dang g.yog yin pas so/ /dred mo lnga la sogs pa gnas bdun gyi lhag ma lnga la gtor ma sbyin tshe/

lhag ma'i gtor ma la kha chu'i mi btab tu gdab par bya dgos te/ nged rje dang khyed 'bangs su khyad par che bas so/ /phud dang lhag ma kha chu rnam pa gsum dbyer med gcig tu mi bsre ru bsre dgos te/ lhag ma'i gnas su rgyal blon bran gsum char khyad par med pas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / ye shes kyi snang ngor sgyu ma'i tshul can gyi sangs rgyas su snang ba dang / log rtog gi snang ngor sgyu ma'i tshul gyi sems can du snang ba gnyis/ ye shes dang log tog gi ngos nas khyad par che yang sgyu mar snang ba nyid du/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis mnyam pa'i phyir/ de bas na mkha' 'gro ma ma dang sring mo dang / bu mo dang / slas dang / g.yem ma dang / bran mo'i tshogs su ston pa khyed rnams bka' yi gtor ma chen po 'di longs la/ dbang phyug gi las brgyad kyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir da tshur spyon zhes snyan bsnan pa'o/ /bzhi pa dpal gyi bka' nyan dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi gnas bstan pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dbang phyug tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal chen po la dbang phyug ma'i tshogs nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba ni/ de dag kyang sku slas dang / g.yem ma dang / bran mo'i tshogs su ston kyang don grub pa'i sa brnyes pa ste/ lhag ma'i gzhung las/ bsam pa mya ngan 'das gyur kyang / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de dag kyang 'gro ba'i don du bu gcig pa la ma byams pa'i tshul du mdzad pas/ sku bu med kyi tshul du ston par mdzad ma dbang phyug ma'i tshogs tshangs ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad po 'di rnams ni 'jig rten pa rnams kyi don la brtse zhing gdung pa'i sgo nas skyob par mdzad pas srin mo lta bu ste/ de dag gi lag pa na mi'i glo snying dang / nang khrol dang / mkhal ma dang / khrag rlangs rnams snyim par 'dzin pa ste par bar 'dzin zhing / glo snying la sogs pa de dag za zhing phyogs rnams kun du rgyug par ston pa dang /

kha cig spu gri'i so 'dra ba'i sku yag pa brdzes ma dang / mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum 'bru tshugs su blta ba dang / ha ha la sogs pa'i gad rgyangs kyi sgra chen po 'byin zhing / dur khrod chen po 'bar ba'i gnas su rol bar byed pa dang / kha cig gsod pa'i las rnams kun la brtson par byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig rgyal po dang blon por sprul par byed pa dang gzhan yang ded dpon ma dang / g.yog mo dang ni/ yang g.yog ma dang / bran dang / yang bran dang / 'khor gyi rnam par ston par byed pa dang bcas pa khyed rnams/ sngon gyi dus su dpal chen he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes dang / 'jig rten pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la thob par bya ba'i phyir/ grub pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams kyi grogs byas te 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi bya zhing / rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba rdo rje lag tu byin nas gtad/ ming gi dbang bskur ba rang ming so sor btags pa'i tshe/ 'bangs su khas blangs nas dam bcas pa bzhin du he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka'i gtor ma chen po 'di longs la so sor bzhes shig de tshe sprul bsgyur ma yin pa rang so so'i gzugs mchog gang yin pa dag mngon par ston la grub pa'i las kyi mchog dam tshig rnams phul/ de'i tshe gal srid grub mchog dam tshig ma phul zhing / khyed rnams kyi gzugs mchog mngon sum du ston par ma gyur kyang / dpal chen po'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i mtha' tshig zab mo nye bar dgongs te rnal 'byor pa bdag gi rim gnyis rab tu bsten pa'i gnas mchog 'dir khyed rnams 'dus la/ rang rang gi 'phrin las kyi bya ba rnams kun du byos shig ces pa'i don no/ /lnga pa sha khrag rlon pa sbyor zhing dregs pa can dbang du sdud pa ma bdun gyi gnas bstan pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dpal chen 'di'i dbyangs la ma mo'i 'dur dbyangs zhes bya zhing /

sger dbyangs zhig yod par sngon gyi dbyangs yig rnying pa las bshad kyang / deng sang phyag len la sgrub thabs kyi bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs 'jug par mdzad do/ khro rgyal yab yum la/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ ma mo chen mo bdun gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba las/ shar gyi phyogs kyi ma mo chen mo ni/ sku mdog dkar mo spyi bor dung gi thor tshugs can/ ma mo khyod ni dri za rnams kyi rgyal mo chen mo ste/ chibs su ra bcu pa can gyi sha ba chibs nas dri za'i tshogs yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i las byed cing / rgyan du gser dang mu tig gi se mo dos brgyan pa/ shar phyogs kyi ma bdun tshogs kyi gtso mo lags kyi/ khyed rnams shar phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ lho'i phyogs kyi ma mo chen mo ni/ sku mdog sngon mo gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ khyed ni grul bum rnams kyi rgyal mo chen mo ste/ chibs su gnod sbyin dang srin po la chibs shing / gshin rje'i tshogs rnams la dbang bsgyur ba'i las mdzad ma rgyan du gser gyis brgyan pa la sogs pa'i ma mo khyed rnams lho'i phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ nub kyi phyogs kyi ma mo chen mo ni/ sku mdog dmar mo zangs kyi len phran can khyed ni klu'i rgyal mo chen po ste/ chibs su chu glang dkar po chibs la/ klu phran stong phrag du ma la dbang bsgyur zhing gser dang byu ru'i cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa can/ nub kyi ma mo ma bdun tshogs kyi gtso mo lags kyi/ khyed nub kyi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ byang gi phyogs kyi ma mo chen mo ni/ sku mdog gser gyi 'od zer gyi mda' 'phen pa lta bu ser mo ma/ khyed ni gnod sbyin rnams kyi rgyal mo ste/ chibs su sa le grum pa chibs la/ gnod sbyin stong gi tshogs la dbang bsgyur zhing /

gser dang mu men gyi thor gtsug can/ byang phyogs kyi ma bdun tshogs kyi gtso mo lags kyi/ khyed rnams byang gi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ steng gi phyogs kyi ma mo chen mo ni/ sku'i cha ni bar snang gi khams na bzhugs pa shin tu che bas phyag gang tsam gyi gnam du ma sleb pa/ dbu che ba'i khyad par ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam la/ ma mo khyed kyi srin lag dang mthe bong las/ smin drug la sogs pa'i rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lte ba'i phyogs thad nas nyi ma dang / zla ba 'char ba/ khyod ni srid pa'i ma mo chen mo ste sngon dpal chen gyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs la steng gi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ 'og gi phyogs kyi ma mo chen mo ni/ gdug pa can ru ṭa sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ sku'i cha shas zhabs ni rgya mtsho chen po'i gting nas 'phyo zhing / sku'i ngo bo ni bar snang khams na bzhugs la/ dbu la dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen po brgyad kyang nye bar gnas pa/ khyod ni srid pa'i ma mo chen mo ste/ sngon dpal chen gyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i thugs dam rjes su dgongs la/ 'og gi phyogs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ ma mo chen mo dpal ldan nag mo shugs sgrol ma ni/ khab kyi ba spu la spu gri'i so can ma/ phyag na bdud rtsi tha ma las 'da' ba ste ro mchog tu gyur pas gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhal na bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma gsol ba khyod ni/ nam mkha'i rgyal mo chen mo ste/ spyan drangs pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs nas mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ mdzad pa brda' gdags kyi phyag rgya rdo rje'i brda' yi mtshon nas ni sngags tshig spyug pa g.yas brda'i spyan 'dren par byed na/ sngon dpal chen po'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/ thugs dam de'i dbang gi gnas 'dir gshegs par mdzod cig

drug pa sngags 'chang gi bka' stod sring bzhi'i gnas bstan pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi srid/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang gling bzhi yud tsam gyis bgrod pas shin tu mgyogs ma lha yi sring la sogs pa shar gyi mgyogs ma rnams gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ nam mkha' la khyud lding pa ltar gshin rje'i lcam mam sring mo la sogs pa lho yi mgyogs ma rnams gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ dkar shams g.yag stod can klu yi sring la sogs pa nub kyi mgyogs ma rnams gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ nag mo gter chen la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi sring mo chen mo byang gi mgyogs ma rnams gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ de ltar sring mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang gdug pa can la khro ba dang / rnal 'byor pa la bar chad zhi ba'i las mdzad ma ste/ dam tshig can la brtse ba chen pos dgongs te gnas 'dir gshegs nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ bdun pa mgyogs pa'i las byed pho nya gsum brgya drug cu'i gnas bstan pa la/ spyir bskul ba dang bye brag tu re ma ti bskul ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ khro rgyal dpal gyi zhes sogs te/ de yang khro bo'i rgyal po dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i 'khor gyi pho nya mo tshangs ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gar ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'bar ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dang / mdor na pho nya sum brgya drug cu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dpal chen bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la/ rnal 'byor pa'i bcol ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rnams myur du grub par gyis shig tshangs ma la sogs pa dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyang ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa po rnams bsrung ba dang / sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/

sgrub pa po'i bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu re ma ti bskul ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ ma g.yel 'di'i dbyangs sngon gyi dbyangs rnying ste/ sgrub thabs kyi sgo ma'i bskyed dbyangs la bcug pa de yin no/ ma g.yel yal gam can/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang thugs ma g.yel ma g.yel yal gam ste mna' gam zhes pa can dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo re ma ti nyid/ chibs su dre rta rkang gsum chibs pa la rin chen bse yi sga dang srab byas la/ byu ru dmar po'i 'thur mgo can gyis spras pa/ dra ba dgu yi lde men can la mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram shing / mi khrag dang rta khrag mtsho lta bu ru bskyil ba'i dbus su/ dbu la re ba'i tho cog gsol zhing / sku la re ba'i shams thabs bsnams shing / zhal nas khrag gi rgyun tsa ra ra 'dzag cing / spyan nas khrag gi rgyun zu lu lu 'dzag pa dang / gzhan yang ral pa dmar po me 'od can gyen du brdzes shing / ral pa'i seb nas me stag skar mda' ltar 'khrug pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston par mdzad pa gshin rje rnams kyi yum chen mo/ bdud rnams kyi lcam/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma de nyid gnas skabs 'gar/ dbu la ban+dha lcang lo gsol ma dang / sku la me khra khra la la 'bar zhing / phyag na mdung dmar chems se chems pa dang bcas/ nyi ma re re bzhin khyo bdun skung du sbed la/ mtshan mo re re bzhin khyo bdun skung nas 'don pa'i sgo nas mkha' 'gro rnams dang gzugs med rnams sprin bzhin 'dus pa'i dus su dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa dang / nam gyi srod la sku mdog ser mo'i chas su zhugs nas/ rak+ṣa srin mo ste srin po srin mo'i srog 'phrog par mdzad ma/ gung la sku mdog nag mo'i chas su zhugs nas dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bo'i srog dbugs 'phrog par byed pa'i sgo nas sgrol ba'i las mdzad ma/ tho rangs sku mdog dmar mo'i chas su zhugs nas rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la mthu rtsal dang rdzu 'phrul bskyed par byed ma/

khrag gi dri tshor na dpag tshad brgyad khri'i sar yang skad cig nyid la brgyug la/ yongs bsnyan te de ni yongs su bsnyen na bsnyan par byed ma/ ma mo chen mo khyod ni skyod par byed pa'i lha yin te/ sha za dang srin po bu mang po dang bcas pa yang ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung ba'i sgo nas skyob par mdzad/ yang bcol te/ yang 'phrin las mdzad par bcol na/ ma mo chen mo khyod ni skyob par byed pa'i lha yin te/ lang ka'i srin po mgrin bcu 'khor dang bcas pa yang ma ltar byams shing pha ltar gdung ba'i sgo nas skyob par mdzad pa sogs rdzu 'phrul dang sprul pa du ma'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa khyed/ sngon dpal chen gyi spyan sngar thugs dam zhal gyi bzhes pa rnams rjes su dgongs la rnal 'byor ba bdag gi bcol ba'i las rnams myur du grub par mdzod/ gzhan yang dpal chen 'di la sgrub thabs kyi shwa na ma'i bstod bskul gyi dbyangs thung ba 'jug pa phyag len la mdzad pa lags so/ rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi pho nya mo bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhir grags pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo rje gzhon nu sgrub pa po rnams bka' gzhung nas bshad pa dang / dam tshig gzhung bzhin sgrub pa rnams la gnod par byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra dang gzugs med kyi bgegs rnams rnal 'byor pa rang gi gang la dmigs pa skad cig gcig la len par byed pa ste/ de yang nag mo khrag gi ral pa can/ dam tshig nyams pa'i khrag 'thung ba'i dbang mo che yin pas/ srin mo khrag 'thung chen mo yin pa ste/ nam gyi srod la dgra bo'i snying 'byin par byed ma/ khyod kyi thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa/ da dus la bab pas sgrub pa po bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ de yang dang por slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang / bar du sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi bka' dang /

da lta rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rnams kyis 'bod cing bskul ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar bcol ba'i las 'di rnams myur du grub par mdzod/ gzhan yang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi pho nya mo bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi las/ gcig ni sku mdog nag mo nam gyi phyed na rgyu zhing / nag mo chen mo zhag gi ral pa can yin pas/ srin mo zhag 'thung yin pa ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par byed pa sdang ba dgra'i khrag 'thung ba'i dbang mo che nam gyi phyed na dgra bo'i snying 'byin par byed ma/ khyod kyi thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa de/ da dus la bab pas sgrub pa po bdag gi bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams grub par mdzod/ /dang po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs snga ma bzhin shes par byas nas/ 'og ma gnyis la'ang sbyar bar bya ba yin zhing / dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi pho nya mo bdud 'dul nag mo chen mo mched bzhi las/ gcig ni sku mdog nag mo nyi ma'i zer la 'khril te rgyug cing / nag mo de'i ral pa ni dung gi ral pa dkar po can/ dam tshig nyams pa'i khrag 'thung bar byed pa'i dbang mo che yin pas/ srin mo khrag 'thung yin par grags pa khyod kyi nyi ma'i zer la dgra bo'i bla 'gugs par byed ma/ srin mo khyod kyi lag tu phor pa thogs pas srin mo phor thogs zhes kyang grags pa yin pa ste/ de ltar na khyed kyi thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa da dus la bab pas/ sdang ba'i dgra chen po dang gnod pa'i bgegs kyi bla khug cig rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams myur du grub par mdzod/ dang po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs 'gre zhing / dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi pho nya chen mo bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi las/ rdo rje nyi ma ni nyi ma grib so rub pa ste rub pa dang / grib se la bzhon nas dgra bo gsod par byed cing nag mo de'i ral pa ni zangs kyi ral pa can/

dam tshig nyams pa'i khrag 'thung bar byed pa'i dbang mo che nyid/ lag tu gzhong pa thogs pas srin mo gzhong thogs kyang yin pa ste/ de ltar na khyod kyi thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa de/ da dus la bab pas/ sgrub pa po bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ dang po pad+ma 'di'i dbyangs sngon gyi dbyangs rnying yin par snye thang ba'i dbyangs yig dang / rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris gnyis ka las bshad do/ 'byung gnas sogs 'dra la/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi pho nya chen mo bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyang sngon dpal chen gyi spyan sngar thugs dam zhal gyi bzhes pa rnams dam tshig rjes su dgongs la gdug pa can gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa gang yin pa de'i khrag 'thung zhing sha rus la rol bar mdzod/ sarba ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod pa dang bcas pas lhag ma btab bo/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rje sa chen gyi yang phur thun mong gi sgrub thabs las de nas lhag ma bsdus la lhag chog byas te/ bdag nyid kyis phaṭ ces pa nas dbul bar bya ba'i bar gyis bstan te/ de'i don yang mdun gyi ye shes pa'i thugs ka nas phaṭ nag po gcig 'phros te bdag gi snying gar thim pas bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs par bsam/ de nas oṃ badz+ra kī la ya zhes pa nas bh+yoḥ'i bdag dam tshig gi 'khor lor gsal btab la/ oṃ khro la khros pa nas sa ma ya phaṭ kyi bar du brjod pas bdag gi thugs kar ye shes pa mdun du bkod pa dang tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs pa thim pa ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas lhag ma za ba'i bye brag gi dang po pho nya dang / phra men dang / 'bar ma dang / dbang phyug ma dang / ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams blos bkug la mchod do/ /de nas bcom ldan zhes pa nas gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags yan chad brjod nas/

gho ru tras kha chus gdab/ des dbang phyug ma brgyad po dang / de la dang po phud kyis zhes pa nas/ da tshur spyon yan chad kyis lta ba bstan to/ /de nas ma ra rim pas khrag dmar gyis mchod/ de nas gtor ma gtang / zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun rin po che'i tho yig las kyang / lhag ma bsdus la kha phrus btab la/ phud kyi gtor ma dang bsres nas las byed pa'i chos skyong rnams la byin par bsam/ gong gi bran dang bka' nyan zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa'i rjes la/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom mo/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag gi dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ba'i sgo nas lhag ma bya ba'i tshul gyi rnam par bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ lhag pa'i lha mchog mchod cing rol ba yis/ /lhag mas gtor ma'i mgron rnams mnyes byed 'di/ /lhag pa'i lha 'di sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /lhag par nyams su blang na don gnyis 'grub/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa las 'jug bstan pa ni/ rgyud kyi chings drug gam/ khog don drug gi nang tshan/ drug pa mnan bsregs 'phang gsum gyi sgo nas las kyi mjug bsdu ba zhes gsungs pa'i don rnams 'chad pa la/ bstan ma bskul ba/ zor las bstan pa/ las bzhi'i bro rdung pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod par gsol ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ bdag nyid bsrung ba/ las rjes bsdu ba/ bsngo ba smon lam/ shis pa brjod pa dang bcu las/ dang po bstan ma bskul ba ni/ gtor ma dang khang bzang sogs phyag len skabs 'dir bstan ma rnams la bsngo rgyu'i gtor ma ni/ dpal chen mo'i pham 'bags te dpal gtor nyid yin yang / deng sang phyag len la bstan ma rang gi sgos kyi gtor ma khang bzang gi steng du bzlum gtor gcig dang / zur gsum pa gcig yang bcus gtor gcig dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bshom par mdzad pa 'di ni/

stan skyong gi dus 'dir/ dpal gtor gyi steng du bstan ma rang gi gtor ma 'di bzhin gnang ba la bstan ma rnams shin tu dges pa'i rnam 'gyur bdag chen rgya gar bas mngon sum du gzigs nas/ phyag len la mdzad pa'i rgyun yin par snang ste/ bdag chen de nyid kyi gsung rab las/ bstan ma skyong bar bya'o/ /'di'i skabs su kho bo rang gi lag len la/ bstan ma rang gi gtor ma gcig kyang bsham la/ dpal gyi pham 'bags dang sbrags phul ba la bstan ma rnams thugs dges pa mthong myong gis grub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ ltar dgra bo yod pa'i sa phyogs sam khang steng sogs su khyer la/ ho zhes pas bstan ma rnams bos la/ tshul ji ltar du 'bod na/ bod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka'i pham 'bags la mnos te rnal 'byor pa bdag gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i stong dang grogs la nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo mched bzhi dang / dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo mched bzhi dang / dkar sham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo mched bzhi rnams/ sngon slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar thugs dam zhal gyi bzhes pa las ma 'da' bar gnas 'dir gshegs shig ces tshig lhug pa'i sgo nas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥḍā ki ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ e ā ra li hriṃ hriṃ zhes pas sngags kyi sgo nas dang / dmigs pa'i sgo ni de'i tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams mngon sum du sprin 'thibs pa ltar dgug par bsams nas/ rang gi lag pa rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug sor mo lhag ma rnams gshog pa ltar byas pa'i khyung gshog gi phyag rgyas mthil gyis mnan la/ de nas tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas spyan drangs shing / gtor ma bsngo ba dngos ni/

sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ bh+yoḥbaka' yi 'di'i dbyangs sngon gyi dbyangs rnying yin te/ dbyangs yig snga ma kun las kyang bshad pas so/ bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal chen po'i bka' yi bran dang g.yog gi tshogs dang bcas pa nyid du/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung ngam he ru ka nyid de bzhin nyid las mi 'gyur bas nam mkha'i mdog can gyi skur ston pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa rnams tshur gshegs tshur gshegs/ gang gshegs na bod khams kyi bstan ma dang skyong ma rnams gshegs/ gang la brten nas gshegs na/ sngon dpal chen gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs la gshegs/ gang du gshegs na sgrub pa po'i spyan drangs ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/gshegs nas ci byed na/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang slob dpon pad+ma'i dam tshig dgongs te rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la gang bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams myur ba nyid du grub par mdzod/ ces bstan ma rnams thun mong du spyan drangs shing gtor ma bsngo ba ni spyir bskul ba yin la/ de nas so sor bskul ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma rnams kyi nang nas mtshan yongs su grags pa ltar na bdag nyid chen mo dang / gsang ba'i mtshan ltar na rdo rje kun grags ma zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog mthing nag na bza' nang dmar po/ phyi ber ljang ser/ dbu la dkrog zhu/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon khram khram 'pham zhes pa'ang snang / shing / sha ba yu mo la zhon pa dang / de bzhin du mtshan yongs grags ltar na dpal ldan ha ri zhes bya zhing / gsang mtshan rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ na bza' nang dmar/ phyi ber ljang nag dbu la dkrog zhu/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang /

g.yon zhags pa 'dzin zhing / rta dmar po la zhon pa/ gzhan yang yongs grags kyi mtshan gangs kyi yum chen zhes bya zhing / gsang ba'i mtshan du rdo rje kun du bzang mo zhes bya ba ni/ sku mthing nag ces pa'ang snang / mdog dmar mo/ nang gos ljang nag phyi ber dmar po/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod khrag bong stag la gzhon pa bzhes pa'ang snang / bu la zhon pa/ de bzhin du mtshan yongs grags su 'brog chen 'khor 'dus dang / gsang mtshan rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ljang khu/ nang gos dmar po/ phyi ber ljang ser/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon be con/ rnga mo gwa pa la bzhon pa ste/ de ltar bdud kyi bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa yang / sngon zhal gyi bzhes pa'i thugs dam dang dam tshig rjes su dgongs la/ bran gyi tshogs dang g.yog 'khor mang po'i tshogs dang bcas shing / na bza'i lhab lhub dang rin po che mang po'i rgyan dang bcas te gnas 'dir gshegs la/ sngon kyi dam tshig dgongs te/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bcol ba'i las rnams myur du grub par mdzod/ ces pas bdud mo chen mo bzhi la bskul zhing gtor ma phul nas/ de nas gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi la bskul ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ gang dkar sha med ces sogs te/ de yang bstan ma rnams kyi nang nas mtshan yongs su grags pa ltar na gangs dkar sha med dang / gsang ba'i mtshan ltar na rdo rje g.yu bun ma zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nang gos dmar/ dmar mo zhes pa'ang snang / phyi ber ljang ser/ phyag g.yas rdo thod khrag ces pa'ang snang / rje/ g.yon ral gri/ stag la bong bu la zhes pa'ang snang / bzhon pa/ de bzhin du mtshan yongs grags su kha rag khyung btsun dang / gsang ba'i mtshan rdo rje dpal gyi yum zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog dmar ser mo zhes pa'ang snang / mo/ nang gos ljang ser/

phyi ber dmar po/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon lcags kyu'i mtshan pa'i dbyug dgra satwa zhes pa'ang snang / pa/ dom nag la rta la zhes pa'ang snang / bzhon pa/ gzhan yang mtshan yongs grags ltar na gser chen mkhar rgyu dang / gsang ba'i mtshan ni rdo rje klu mo zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang nag phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dgra satwa/ lcags kyu zhes pa'ang snang / glang dmar po la zhon dom la zhes pa'ang snang / pa/ gzhan yang mtshan yongs grags su rma ri rab 'byams dang / gsang mtshan ltar na rdo rje grags mo rgyal zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ljang khu/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang ser/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon tsit+ta 'dzin pa/ mi dred la bzhon pa ste/ gnod sbyin gyi bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa yang / sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ zhes sogs tshig rkang lnga'i bshad pa sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar gnod sbyin ma bzhi la bskul zhing gtor ma phul nas/ de nas sman btsun ma bzhi la bskul ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ kong btsun de mo la sogs te/ de yang bstan ma rnams kyi nang nas mtshan yongs grags ltar na kong btsun de mo dang / gsang mtshan rdo rje bod khams skyong zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog dkar mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang khu/ phyag g.yas zhags pa rdo rje/ g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa/ rwa bcu sha ba la bzhon pa/ de bzhin du mtshan yongs grags ltar na/ btsan la la rog gsang mtshan rdo rje sman gcig ma zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ser mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang nag phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu/ btsos la bzhon pa/ gzhan yang yongs grags kyi mtshan sman btsun ug chos zhes bya zhing / gsang mtshan rdo rje g.yar mo sil zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog dmar mo/ nang gos dmar/ phyi ber ljang khu/ phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon tshon sna lnga'i gru gu 'dzin pa/ 'bri mo la bzhon pa/

de bzhin du mtshan yongs grags su g.yu'i dril bu dang / gsang mtshan rdo rje gzugs legs ma zhes bya ba ni/ sku mdog ljang nag nang gos dmar po/ phyi ber ljang nag phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon lcags kyu'i mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ rkyang la bzhon pa ste sman btsun bu mo chen mo mched bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa yang / sngon thugs dam sogs tshig rkang lnga'i bshad pa gong du bstan pa bzhin yin la/ de ltar sman btsun ma bzhi bskul nas/ de nas thun mong du dam tshig dran par bskul zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ che 'di la sger dbyangs shig yod bar rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris las 'byung yang / deng sang rang re'i phyag len la mi snang / zhes chen mo zhes sogs te/ de dag gi don ni/ de ltar spyi dang so sor bskul zhing gtor ma phul bas 'jig rten na mthu bo che zhes grags pa rnams las mthu chen mor gyur pa bstan ma chen mo khyed rnams kyang / rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal gyi spyan snga ru zhing chen tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po bkrams nas/ 'dod yon rnam pa lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rdzas kyi longs spyod sbyin dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ gsang ming re re btags/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa mnos te thar pa thob pa'i ming btags nas/ dbang btags lag pa g.yas su rdo rje re byin nas/ sngags 'chang rdo rje 'chang gi gral la zhag pa'i tshe/ rang rang gi ji ltar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa po bdag gi mthun pa'i grogs byos shig sdang dgra gnod bgegs thams cad 'dul ba dang / yams nad la sogs pa'i nad kyi rnam pa thams cad bzlog pa dang / chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ bka' yi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di longs la/ bdag gis bcol ba'i las thams cad myur du grub par mdzod/

de ltar bcol ba'i dam tshig 'di las nam yang ma 'da' zhig gal te dam tshig 'di las 'das par gyur na/ rdo rje gzhon nu nyid/ badz+ra yak+ṣa ste rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu khros par gyur pa bzhin du gyur pas khyed rnams kyi snying gi dkyil nas snying khrag drangs nas 'o dod 'bod par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa gdon mi za ba/ de bas na rnal 'byor pa bdag gis gang bcol ba'i las bzhi'i 'phrin las thams cad myur du grub par mdzod/ ces pa ste de dag gis ni bstan ma bskyangs shing 'phrin las bskul ba'i tshul gyi rnam par bshad pa bstan zin pa yin la/ de ltar bshad pa'i bstan ma rnams kyi sku mdog dang bzhon pa mi 'dra ba dang / phyag mtshan rgyas bsdus sogs yi ge rnying ma rnams las mi 'dra ba'i tshul du ma zhig 'byung yang / rnam bshad 'dir ni gong dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang / 'jug bstan skyong gi skabs su bshad pa 'di gnyis ka bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi phur pa'i yi ge rnying ma tshad thub rnams dang / bris thang khung ma rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mngon rtogs rnams bsnyel tho'i tshul du mdzad pa'i phyag dpe tshan pa gnyis nas gsungs pa bzhin sgra ji bzhin du bkod pa yin pas/ blo gsal rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis go bar gyis shig gnyis pa zor las bstan pa ni/ gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ gtor zor du byas te 'phang bar 'dod na/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams zor gyi las la bskul ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ 'jam dpal sku 'di la sngon gyi dbyangs yig rnying pa zhig yod par shes rab snang ba'i dbyangs yig gsal ba'i me long las sger dbyangs shig yod par bshad kyang rang re'i phyag len la mi mdzad do/ yi lha tshogs kyis/

/zhes sogs te/ de yang 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis do nub drag po'i gtor zor dgra bgegs la 'phang pa'i las kyi grogs mdzod cig de bzhin du pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub zor gyi sogs tshig rkang phyi ma'i don rnams snga ma'i rigs 'gre sbyar te shes par byas la/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ phur pa 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yis do nub sogs 'gre/ dpal gyi yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ dgra bgegs 'jig par byed pa khro bo bcu yis do nub sogs 'gre/ dbyings kyi rang bzhin rdo rje khro mo bcu po yis do nub sogs 'gre/ sprul pa'i phra thabs yab yum nyi shu yis do nub sogs 'gre/ phur bu sras kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ ye shes tshad med rang bzhin sgo ma bzhi po yis do nub sogs 'gre/ phur srung dam can shwa na ma mched bzhi la sogs pa bcu gnyis kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa yis do nub sogs 'gre/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub sogs 'gre/ rig 'dzin mthu rtsal can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis do nub drag po'i gtor zor dgra bgegs la 'phang ba'i las kyi grogs mdzod cig ces zor bskul nas/ de nas zor lam dbye ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ do nub kyi zor kha gnyen po 'di/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang dus do nub kyi gtor ma'i zor kha rno la rtsub pa gnyan po 'di/ steng phyogs kyi lha rnams la mi zor te mi 'phang zhing mi brdeg pas lha rnams gshegs yul gangs dkar gyi rtse la gshegs te/

gtor zor dgra bgegs la 'phen pa'i lam gnyan po da phyes shig de bzhin du/ do nub kyi gtor zor gnyan po 'di/ bar gyi cha la gnas pa'i btsan gyi phyogs la'ang mi zor ro/ /btsan rnams gshegs yul brag dmar gyi ngos la sogs par gshegs la gtor zor gyi lam gnyan po da phyes shig do nub kyi gtor ma'i zor kha gnyan po 'di shin tu rno ba 'di 'og gi cha la gnas pa'i klu rnams la yang mi zor ro/ /klu khyed rnams gshegs yul rgya mtsho'i gting du gshegs la/ gtor zor gyi lam gnyan po da phyes shig 'o na gtor ma'i zor kha 'di nyid gang la zor na/ do nub brdeg pa'i gtor ma'i zor kha gnyan po 'di ni/ yas kyi bdud g.yos cig la zor zhing / der ma zad mas kyi sri langs dang / pha tshan gyi rgya 'dre can dang / ma bu'i byur 'dre can dang / yul mi'i gdong 'dre can dang / sdang ba gzugs can gyi dgra dang / gnod pa'i gzugs med kyi bgegs dang / nor phung bar byed pa phung sri'i snying gi dkyil du dang / byur gtong bar byed pa byur sri'i klad pa'i dkyil du dang / dam tshig nyams pa'i snying gi dkyil du dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas sdig ngan pa ston par byed pa rnams kyi snying gi dkyil du zor ba ste brdeg par byed/ ces pa ste de ltar zor bskul zhing zor lam phye nas/ zor gtor de nyid dug khrag gi thun du bsams nas 'phang pas dgra'i rnam shes mar me lta bu gsal le 'bar ba la phog pas/ nag thum thum bsad cing rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral bar bsams la/ rlung phyogs sam rdzi phyogs dang bstun nas gtor ma zor du 'phangs te/ rang nyid dpal chen po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas kī la ya dang / hūm̐ ka ra sogs khro bo bcu'i sngags dang / oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ sogs bsgral mchod kyi sngags rnams brjod cing thams cad blta ba zab mo'i rtsis zin par byed pa ni med thabs med pa'i man ngag go

/de dag gis ni gtor ma zor gyis las bstan pa'i rnam par gzhag pa bstan zin nas/ gsum pa las bzhi'i bro rdung ba ni/ gtor ma zor du 'phangs zin pa dang / yar log la gtor snod rnams ji ltar rigs pa kha phub ste/ zhi ba'i bro brdung bar byed pa ni/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ hūm̐ dang po gti mug nyid las byung / /zhes sogs te/ de yang 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di rnams dang por gti mug ste ma rig pa nyid las byung / bar du yang gti mug de nyid kyis 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khor/ tha ma gti mug de nyid rang bzhin med par shes pa nyid kyis gti mug de nyid 'dul te/ gti mug rnam par dag pa gti mug rdo rje'am rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi rgyu dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag las grub pa/ mgo bo dang rgya mdud dang / rtse mo zlum po'i dbyibs can gyi phur pa'i logs la zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams bsgoms pa ste gnas shing / khong sang stong pa ni stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub kyi sems su rgyud lung las bstan zhing / de lta bu'i rtse mo zlum po'i dbyibs can gyi phur pa btab pa yis zhi bya thams cad ma lus par zhi bar 'gyur la/ zhi bar ma gyur pa gang yang med pas na zhi bar mdzad pa'i lha rnam par snang mdzad dam bud+dha he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang / oṃ dīp+ta tsakra kī li kī la ya sarba bhi gh+nan ban+dha shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags don ni/ oṃ dam bca' ba/ dīp+ta 'bar ba/ tsakra 'khor lo/ kī li kī la ya phur bu/ sarba thams cad/ bi gh+nan dgra bgegs/ ban+dha 'ching ba/ shān+tiṃ zhi ba/ ku ru gyur cig swāhā gzhi tshugs zhes pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang tshig don dang sngags don rnams 'don pa bsgyur ba shes pa'i sgo nas/ rgyas pa'i bro rdung ni/ dang por 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di rnams nga rgyal nyid las byung /

bar du nga rgyal nyid kyis 'khor bar 'khor/ tha mar nga rgyal de nyid kyi rang gi shes pas 'dul/ de ltar na nga rgyal rdo rje'am rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor bcas kyi rgyu gser ram ser po'i shing la grub pa'i mgo bo dang rgya mdud dang / rtse mo zur bzhi pa'i dbyibs can gyi logs la rgyas pa'i lha tshogs gsal bar gnas shing khong sang stong pa byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid can gyi rtse mo zur bzhi pa'i phur pa btab pas/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad ma lus pa rgyas par 'gyur zhing / rgyas par ma gyur pa gang yang med pas/ rgyas par mdzad pa'i lha rat+na he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ dīp+ta rat+na kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dha ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes pa ste/ ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ni tshe rgyas pa zhes pa'o/ /dbang gi bro rdung ni/ dang por 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di 'dod chags nyid las byung / bar du 'dod chags nyid kyis 'khor bar 'khor/ tha ma 'dod chags nyid kyi rang ngo shes pas 'dul/ de ltar na 'dod chags dag pa 'dod chags rdo rje'am/ 'od dpag med nyid kyi rgyu zangs sam dmar po'i shing las grub pa'i mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo rnams zla gam gyi dbyibs can gyi phur pa'i logs la dbang gi lha tshogs gsal bar gnas shing khong sang stong pa byang chub kyi sems kyi bdag nyid can rtse mo zla gam gyi dbyibs can gyi phur pa btab pas/ 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdud pa'i dbang bsdud kyi lha pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ dīp+ta pad+ma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dha tri dhā tu wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes pa ste tri dhā ru wa shaṃ zhes pa ni khams gsum dbang bsdud ces pa'i don no/ /drag po'i bro rdung ba ni/ dang 'di'i gdang sngon gyi gdang rnying yin kyang dbyangs yig rnying pa kun tu mi 'byung ba ni/ las sla ba'i phyir yi ge'i tshogs skyung ba yin par sems so/

por 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di rnams zhe sdang nyid las byung / bar du zhe sdang nyid kyis 'khor bar mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ tha mar zhe sdang de nyid zhe sdang rdo rjer shes te bsgoms pas zhe sdang de nyid 'dul/ de ltar zhe sdang ma spangs dbyings su dag pa zhe sdang rdo rje'am mi bskyod pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rgyu lcags sam nag po'i shing dag las grub pa'i dbyibs mgo bo dang rgya mdud dang rtse mo zur gsum pa'i logs la drag po'i lha tshogs gsal bar sgom zhing gnas pa'i khong sang stong pa byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin can gyi rtse mo zur gsum shin du rno ba'i phur pa 'di yul dgra bgegs la btab pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa thams cad brlag par 'gyur zhing / sngar gyi dgra bgegs su gnas pa brlag par ma gyur ba gang yang med pas/ drag po'i lha zhe sdang rdo rje'am badz+ra he ru ka khyed la bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ dīp+ta karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan ban+dha sarba sha trun mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa ste sngags don ni phyag 'tshal lo 'bar ba las kyi phur bu la bgegs thams cad 'ching / dgra thams cad gsod ces pa'i don no/ /de rnams kyis las bzhi'i bro rdung pa'i rnam par gzhag pa bstan zin nas/ bzhi pa dngos grub blangs ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ ye shes lnga ldan 'di'i dbyangs la dngos grub kun 'dus kyi dbyangs zhes bya zhing / dbyangs yig snga phyi kun tu gsal bar mi bzhugs kyang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun ma nyams las 'byung ba bzhin deng sang dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod chen mo dang 'grel ba 'di nyid legs so/ zhes sogs te/ de yang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te ye shes lnga dang ldan zhing /
