lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa/ mi skyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa ste/ kun bzang rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can khyed rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing zhi ba dang khro bo'i sgo nas sku mtha' yas par ston pa khyed rnams thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgong nas drag po'i mthu stobs kyis gdug pa can dgra bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bsgral bar nus pa'i dngos grub dang / khyad par du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang myur ba nyid du stsol ba dang / de mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du yang sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe dpal thams cad rgyas pa dang / 'gro kun dbang du 'du ba la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol zhes pa ste de ltar zhe thag pa nas brjod cing dngos grub blang ba'i tshul gyi gsol ba btab pas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis thugs dges bzhin pa dang bcas pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad myur ba nyid du ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i tshul gyis bstsal bar bsams pa yin no/ /de dag gis ni dngos grub blang ba'i tshul bstan zin nas/ lnga pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs gsungs te/ de yang mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / cho ga'i tshig don nyams pa dang / gzhan gang yang bdag byis pa so so skye bo mi shes pa rmongs pa'i blo yis 'gal chad nongs 'phrul 'jigs pa'i tshogs ji snyed bgyis pa dang / gzhan bgyid du stsal ba de dag thams cad kun 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/

khyed rnams kyis rigs drug gi sems can gyi khams la thugs rjes su brtse bas bka' stsal zhing bris pa'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs te sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad na/ bdag cag so so skye bo rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ram ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma thob pa rnams rgyud ngan pa'am mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa gang cung zad ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ste tshig brjod cing don dran par bya ba ni bzod par gsol ba yin la/ drug pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod/ /ces sogs te/ de yang ye shes kyi rang bzhin can khyed rnams kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bstan te/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi don kun bsgrubs par mdzad de/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol la/ re zhig chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i dbyings su ro cig pa sangs rgyas kyi yul du gshegs nas kyang / slar yang 'gro ba'i don du bskul ba'i tshe/ myur du 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas mdun gyi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing / sarba sa ma ya/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ zhes pa'i sngags brjod cing / de'i sngags don ni/ dam tshig pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad songs zhes pa'i don dran bzhin pas/ lag pa rgyab sbyar ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs pas/ dam can rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ de nas rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de dag 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa la thim/

de dag kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ lha de thams cad gtso bo yab yum la thim/ gtso mo yum yang yab la bsdus te/ rang nyid gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal gyis 'og nas bshad pa ltar gyi spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor thams cad dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po rjes su bcad par bya ba yin no/ /de dag gis ni dkyil 'khor bsdu ba bstan zin nas/ bdun pa bdag nyid bsrung ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dhā rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces sogs te/ de yang oṃ ni dam bca' ba/ shrī dpal/ badz+ra rdo rje/ ku mā ra gzhon nu/ kro dha khro bo/ rak+ṣa bsrung ba ste rang gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go mtshams med par bltams pas/ rang nyid gzi brjid dang nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur par bsgoms pa yin la/ de nas go bsgo ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra kawa tsi hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa ste de'i sngags don ni/ rdo rje'i lus la go gyon pa zhes pa ste/ rang gi lus la rdo rje'i go cha gyon pas bar chad kyi rnam pa thams cad kyi mi tshugs par bsam pa yin zhing / de nas zab mo'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtag dpyad kyi mtha' gsal ba ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ rang bzhin sems kyi chos nyid 'di/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang rang bzhin gang du yang ma grub pa sems kyi chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di rkyen gyis gsar du ma bcos shing gdod ma nas gzhi med rtsa bral du lhug par gnas pa'i gnas lugs kyi don yod pa rtag pa'i mtha' dang / med pa chad pa'i mtha' ste ngo bo'i mtha' thams cad spangs shing tshig gi lam du brjod pa dang bral ba/ yod min med min gyi mu bzhi'i spros pa las 'das pa 'bad rtsol sogs la ma bltos pa rtsol med nyid du rang babs gshis lugs su gnas pa'i sems kyi chos nyid de ni/

'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi don nam rang bzhin gnas lugs kyi don mtshon pa'o/ /zhes pa ste 'di ni tshig gi sgo nas lta ba gsal btab pa yin la/ de nyid kyi don la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ oṃ a ka ru mo khaṃ sarba dharma ṇa ā d+ye nut+pan+nā twa ta/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod cing / chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid bdag med rtogs pa'i blta ba zab mo la blo ci gnas su 'jog cing / lta ba de nyid kyis chos thams cad la rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni bdag nyid bsrung zhing go bsgo ba rtag chad kyi mtha' gsal ba rnams bstan zin nas/ brgyad pa las rjes bsdu ba ni/ de ltar dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs dang 'brel ba dang ma 'brel ba/ gang ltar yang rnal 'byor pa rang nyid dpon slob rnams kyi bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa legs par bshad zin nas/ gzhan gsang sngags sgrub pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan pas/ mig gi yul du mthong du mi rung ba'i gsang ba'i rdzas dang / yo byad thams cad legs par bsdus la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa sogs kyi las byas pa'i rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /dgu pa bsngo ba smon lam ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang bdag gis rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor chen po bris bsgrubs/ rim gnyis kyi sgom bzlas bgyis pa la sogs pa'i dge ba 'di dang / gzhan yang bdag gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba dpag tu med pa 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas mtha' yas pa'i rigs drug gi sems can ma lus pa kun/ phyi nang gi nye 'tshe'i bdud thams cad las rnam par rgyal te sa lam gyi bar chad kun nye bar bcom nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i lam la brten zhing / mya ngan las 'das pa yi bla na med pa'i 'bras bu byang chub chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nges par myur du 'grub par gyur cig

ces pa'i don yin la/ bcu pa shis pa brjod pa la/ thog mar gtso bo yab kyi bkra shis ni/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ hūm̐ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /zhes sogs te/ de yang skye 'gag gnas su med pa chos kyi sku rang bzhin rnam dag gi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du 'gro ba'i don mdzad par thugs dam zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dbang gis gzugs kyi skur rnam par sprul pa bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku can gyis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams las nyon gyi skye shi med pa skye med kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis phyug pa'i bkra shis stsol bar shog ces pa'i don yin la/ de'i rjes su gtso mo yum gyi bkra shis ni/ sgrub thabs las ma skyes mi dmigs zhes sogs te/ de yang / dang por ma skyes/ bar du mi dmigs/ tha mar chos kyi dbyings nyid las ma g.yos pa'i cho 'phrul gyi dngos po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid yum gyi skur ston pa/ dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la don gyi yon tan spangs rtogs mthar thug pa myur du 'byung ba'i bkra shis stsol bar shog ces pa'i don yin zhing / de nas sprul pa'i khro bcu'i bkra shis ni/ sgrub thabs las/ ye shes thugs kyi zhes sogs te/ de yang dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las khro bo bcur sku sprul nas/ bgegs kyi bdag po shar phyogs la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu skyong ba brgya byin la sogs pa rnams zhabs kyi gdan du bting nas bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams chos dbyings rang gnas su sgrol ba'i sprul pa'i khro rgyal chen po hūm̐ mdzad yab yum la sogs pa bcus bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la bkra shis stsol bar shog

ces pa'i don yin la/ de nas yang sprul phyag brnyan sgo ma sras mchog pho nya dang bcas pa'i bkra shis ni/ sgrub thabs las/ yang sprul phyag brnyan nyi shu'i zhes sogs te/ de yang khro bcu yab yum bcu las kyang / yang sprul du gyur pa'i phyag brnyan phag gi mgo can la sogs pa nyi shus bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la bkra shis stsol bar shog ye shes tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin sgo ma bzhis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la bkra shis stsol bar shog dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga'i mthu dpal gyis bkra shis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la stsol bar shog sprul pa'i pho nya sum brgya drug cus bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la phan bde'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'i bkra shis stsol bar shog ces pa'i don yin zhing / de ltar gong du brjod pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs la brten/ sgrub pa po rnams mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis mchog tu 'phel ba'i shis pa brjod pa ni/ gsang sngags rnal 'byor zhes sogs te/ de yang gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa grub pa'i sa chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab can/ rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyi ji ltar nyams su bzhes pa bzhin du/ lta spyod yal bar ma gyur pa ste zung du 'brel ba'i dgongs pa'i sgo nas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa tshul bzhin du spyod cing gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrub pas bdag cag sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob rnams la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog ces pa ste de dag gi don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas shis pa brjod la me tog gi char chen po dbab cing rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bsgrags te/ rang gzhan thams cad bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal la 'god par bya'o/

/de dag gis ni rje sa chen gyis sgrub thabs las/ de nas gtor ma btang / bstan ma skyang / yar ldog la ru lu bzlas/ 'breng rgyas kyi bkra shis bya/ ye nas mnyam nyid kyi lhag chad bshags/ bzod par gsol/ smon lam btab/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la ci bder gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi tho yig las/ las 'jug ni mnan pa dang / sbyin sreg bya/ gtor ma zor du 'phang pa'o/ /zhes pa nas/ gtor ma bskyangs nas yar log pa dang chos bdag med par bsgoms/ sngags bzlas pas bsrung / nang du chang la sogs pa longs spyad/ las bzhi'i bro dang glu gar dang bkra shis kyi tshig mang du brjod/ ces pa'i bar gsungs pa rnams kyis dgongs don rnams zhib tu phye ba'i sgo nas las 'jug bstan pa'i rnam par bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ bstan skyong ma mo bcu gnyis mnyes byed cing / /bstan la gnod byed zor gyis bsgral ba dang / /bstan pa rgyas phyir las bzhi'i bro brdung rnams/ /bstan 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams kyis nyams len chos/ 1 /ye shes lha la dngos grub bcud blangs shing / /rang gi nongs pa'i tshogs rnams bzod gsol te/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus nas rang nyid bsrung ba dang / /rdzogs chen lta bas rtag chad mtha' gsal nas/ 2 /las rjes bsdu dang bsngo ba smon lam gyis/ /rgyas btab shis pa brjod pas rang gzhan kun/ /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis dpal 'bar ba'i/ /nyams len tshul 'di lam 'di'i 'jug chos yin/ 3 /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar gong du bshad pa'i mnyam gzhag dang rjes spyod kyi nyams len de thams cad bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas nyams su len pa cis kyang gal che zhing / de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe yang / phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu rang nyid lhag pa'i lha rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal dang mi bral ba dang /

ngag kī la ya'i sgra dang mi 'bral ba dang / yid chos nyid byang chub sems kyi phur bu rtse gcig pa gsal stong dbyer med pa dang mi 'bral ba ste/ mi 'bral ba rnam pa gsum la dran 'dun rgyun chad med par bya ba dang / gzhan yang rgyud las/ bdag mchod kun mnyes thams cad 'brangs/ /kun la phan pa'i sman yin te/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yis/ /thams cad za zhing brgyan par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du bstan bcos tshad ldan las kyang / za ba bdud brtsi'i rang lus yi dam mchod/ /mnal tshe 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang la 'jog /ldang tshe zung 'jug gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas/ /snod bcud dag pa'i snang bar bltas la 'dud/ /ces pa ltar/ nyal ldang 'gro chags bza' btung bya ba sogs spyod lam thams cad lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan par bya ba'i tshul ni/ 'di nyid kyi yi ge rnying ma rnams las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dgongs mo nyal ba'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya shu n+ya ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod la rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i ngang nas seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis chos dbyings kyi ngang du nyal/ snga dro ldang ba'i dus su/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas chos nyid skye ba med pa las langs te/ 'gag pa med pa dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur bzhengs par bsam zhing / 'gro ba'i dus su/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya e waṃ ma ya dharma ka ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing 'gro ba 'dren pa'i don du 'gro bar bsams la/ 'dug pa'i dus su rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal du gsal ba'i ngang nas/ gang du gnas pa de ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang du bsgom zhing / 'khor dang nyer gnas thams cad sprul pa'i 'khor du bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod/ bza' btung bya ba'i tshe/ zas la rgyas par na/ gong tshogs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar byin rlabs byas pa'i zas de thog mar mchod yul rnams la phul nas/

de nas rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba de mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad cing lhag ma bsdus pa btang bar bya la/ zas kyi rnal 'byor bsdus pa ni/ kha zas za ba'i dus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas lha mchod pa'i tshul du rol zhing / mkha' 'gro ma rnams la lhag ma'i gtor ma sngags tsam gyis sbyin no/ /btung ba la spyi dang bye brag dza gad btung ba la/ dza gad de nyid traṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam/ oṃ na mo gu ru badz+ra kī li kī ya dha ti ma ma karma dza gad pra ba ya kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis dbul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dngos grub bsdus nas/ lha la lha'i mchod pa'i tshul du rol bar bshad do/ /de ltar dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du lhag pa'i lha 'di'i rnal 'byor zab mo dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas nyams len la rtag 'grus su bgyis na/ yi dam 'di nyid 'phrin las kyi lha yin pas sgrub thag shin tu nye bar gsungs pas na/ gang zag dbang po yang rab la yi dam gyi lha nyid kyis zhal dngos su bstan nas byin gyis brlob par 'gyur la/ 'bring dang tha ma sogs la/ nyams dang rmi lam du zhal bstan pa sogs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma yid ches can 'byung ba ni myong bas grub pa yin zhing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar/ kho bo cag gis kyang yi dam gyi lha 'di sgrub cing mchod pa sogs la 'bad rtsol du bgyis pas 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing don gnyis lhun grub tu byung ba legs pas skal bzang dang ldan rnams kyi dgongs par mdzod la/ yid yul du bcangs nas nyams len la 'bad par bya'o/ /gal te gang zag 'ga' zhig la tshe 'dir rtags mtshan mngon gyur pa ma byung yang / nyams len la 'bad pas lha'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i byin rlabs kyis 'chi khar lhar gsal zhing /

de gsal bas bar dor rdo rje gzhon nu'i ngang du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur pa ni nges pa yin par yi ge rnying ma rnams las bshad de/ de ni bskyed rim la brten nas bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul yin la/ rdzogs rim zab mo lta ba la brten nas bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul ni slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i man ngag 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi gdams pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de yang dus rgyun du rdo rje phur pa'i lam zab mo bsgom pa la/ 'bad rtsol du bgyis pas/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa de 'chi ba'i dus su/ 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi dgongs pa la gnas par bya ste/ 'chi ba'i dus tsam na/ sa'i rlung chu la thim pa'i dus su lus lci ba snyam byed cing / phung po mi theg pa snyam byed cing / phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin rags pa 'gag chu'i rlung me la thim pa'i dus su/ kha sna skam zhing / brlan gsher nyung / mig gting du bros/ lus kyi zon bag mi bde/ phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin 'bri dka'o/ /me'i rlung rlung la thim pa'i rtags su/ drod 'chor/ khyad par rkang pa grang / phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin phra ba 'gag rlung gi rlung nam mkha' la thim pas/ dbugs thung rngam pa brtseg phyi nang gi gzung 'dzin phra ba'i phra ba 'gag de nas nam mkha'i rlung chos nyid la thim pas/ tshogs drug gi yul 'gags nas/ lus sems bral te bar ma dor ye shes ngos zin par bya'o/ /de yang ye shes ngos 'dzin pa la bzhi ste/ 'gag pa med pa'i tshe/ chad pa med pa'i srog dmigs pa med pa'i yul/ skye ba med pa'i sems/ de'i don bshad pa ni/ skye ba med pa'i sems ni/ 'chi ba'i dus der rang gi sems skye med stong gsal phur pa'i ngang la gtad pa'o/ /de la gtad tsam na/ de'i ngang du dbugs chad pa dang / de'i rgyan 'khrig zin nas/ gnas pa chos sku'i de kho na nyid la 'gag pa med pa'i tshe zhes bya/

de la gnas pas srog chad du med de/ rgyud 'thung nas stong gsal de'i ngang du sangs rgya ba de la chad pa med pa'i srog ces bya'o/ /de ltar na 'bras bu rang 'byung gi ye shes/ phur bu byang chub sems kyi ngang de las/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ bde ba chen po la 'das pas dmigs pa med pa'i yul te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'o/ /de tsam na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal te/ rang gi sems skye med du shes pa de chos dbyings ye shes/ de'i rol par shar ba me long lta bu/ de gnyis dbyer med pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ de ltar rtogs pa de so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de'i don mthar phyin pa bya ba grub pa'o/ /de tsam na mngon par shes pa drug kyang 'char te/ de'i tshe 'gro ba'i don du/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis mtshan pa'i rdo rje 'chang du snang la/ 'gro ba rigs drug la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i sprul pa'i skur snang nas chos ston par byed pas/ de ltar na 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa ste/ de dag gis ni spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul 'phros don cung zad dang bcas pa bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ nyal sdang la sogs 'phral gyi spyod lam kun/ /kun kyang 'khor lo'i rol bar gsal 'debs gang / /gang 'di rjes spyod rnal 'byor zhes su grags/ /grags pa 'di don tshul bzhin nyams su longs/ 1 /de ltar sa skya'i rje btsun yab chos mchog /dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa'i lam bzang 'di/ /brtson pas bsgrub na gang zag dbang po rab/ /tshe 'di nyid la grol ba mchog thob cing / 2 /'bring dang tha ma 'chi kha'am bar do ru/ /'bras bu smin zhing shin tu tha shal kyang / /skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du/

/nges par rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob 'gyur/ 3 /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i lam thams cad chu bo bzhir bsdus nas nyams su len par gsungs pa ltar gyi/ thog mar smin byed dbang gi chu bos rgyud smin par byas pa'i gang zag des/ gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo nyid nyams su len pa'i tshul rnams/ rgyud gyi khog don drug dang sbyar te stod las gtso bo dang / smad las zhar byung du bstan pa'i sgo nas sgrub thabs bklags pas don grub kyi don 'grel rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis legs par bshad zin nas/ da ni dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo dang man ngag gnad kyi chu bo gnyis kyi rnam par gzhag pa cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭīka stong thun dang bcas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i dkyus bshad ces pa ni rgyud kyi bshad pa yin la/ gzhung gi chu bo ni phur pa rtsa dum nyid yin zhing / 'grel ṭīka stong thun dang bcas pa ni rnam pa mang yang / 'dir rtsa dum man ngag lugs su bshad pa rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge rnying ma rnams dang / dkyil chog rdo rje las rim rtsa ba/ de'i 'grel pa rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang las byang / rje btsun rin po che'i tho yig dpal ldan bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba/ de'i dngos kyi slob ma rnams kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i phyogs 'di la mkho ba'i yig cha mang du 'byung ba de rnams dang / gzhan yang bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub gsal byed la sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mchan bu gnang ba/

sa lo nyid dang sngags 'chang bstan pa'i gsal byed chen pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dbang chog sogs dang / bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring bsdus gnyis sogs gsung rab tshad ldan de rnams la rtsa dum man ngag lugs su bshad pa'i 'grel ṭīka stong thun du 'jog pa yin te/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rin chen rtse pa'i dris lan springs yig las/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu la/ sa lugs kyi 'grel par ming btags pa ni ma mthong / don la rje btsun gyi tho yig dang / bla ma dam pa'i mngon rtogs che chung gnyis ka 'grel pa yin mod/ ces gsungs pas so/ /de rnams kyi dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo'i rnam par gzhag pa mdo tsam bstan zin nas/ da ni man ngag gnad kyi chu bo dris lan gegs sel dang bcas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don cung zad bshad na/ de yang man ngag ces pa ni nye bar phan 'dogs pa'i don gyis na de skad ces bya la/ gnad kyi chu bo ni bskyed rdzogs kyis bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i zab mo'i lam rnams yin zhing / dris lan gegs sel dang bcas pa ni/ de ltar lam nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ gnas lugs zab mo'i de kho na nyid mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du/ phyi nang gi bdud dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyis gzugs ston pa dang / sgra brjod pa dang / lta grub bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i gegs sam bar du gcod pa rtsom par 'gyur bas na/ de dag bzlog pa'i phyir du nyams myong can gyi bla ma rdo rje slob dpon las gegs sel gyi gdams pa rnams/ dri ba dang dris lan gyi sgo nas khongs su chud par byas la/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa ni/ med thabs med pa'i man ngag dam pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don yin te/ de ltar na chu bo bzhi las phye ba'i khog don drug gi sgo nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo chen po bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to//

༈ //swasti pra dzā bh+yaḥ skye dgu rnams bde legs su gyur cig 'jam dbyangs 'od gsal lhar spyi ring g.yu ring g.yu se gsum du sprul thig le'i rgyun/ /nye bar 'dzin pa'i 'khon bar skyes nas bzung 'khon rigs bla chen kun dga' snying po nas brtsams te sa skya pa/ /zhes mtshan mchog gsum ldan du grags pa'i mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs/ /rim gdung brgyud rin po che dri ma med pa par byon pa rnams kyis bdag srungs shig 1 /gang gi rigs las 'khrung pa'i 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skyes bu'i mchog /dpa' mdzangs yon tan gyi tshogs yon tan kun ldan dpa' bo zhig /'jam dbyangs 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i blon por chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi nang blon 'khon dpal po che zhes bya bar gyur/ /de yi rigs 'khrungs 'khon ston mched 'khon klu'i dbang po dang rdo rje rin chen bcas kyis/ 2 /brtul shugs grub pa pad+ma u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po 'byung gnas zhabs/ /legs bsten gsung gi bdud yang phur gnyis la sogs pa'i chos kyi rtsis thugs rgyud bltams/ /grub dbang 'khon ston bal po'i mtshan dang 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims sogs/ /'od gsal lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen phal cher gyis/ 3 /yang phur gnyis yi dam gyi gtso bor mdzad pas zhal gzigs shing grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ /de dag kun gyi chos skyong dkar bdud lcam dral dang / /phur srung dam can bcu gnyis la sogs bran 'khol zhing / /bod yul gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung / 4 /de nas 'khon ston chen po dkon mchog rgyal po des/ zhes grags pa/ /sngags gzhung yang phur sogs rnying ma dang kyai rdor gyi rgyud man ngag sogs gsar rnying kun gyi mdzod bzung nas/

/gangs can bod kyi lte ba 'am yul dbus su gyur pa rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i zhes kun tu grags pa'i dgon gnas chen po 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa chu mo glang gi lo la btab/ 5 /gnas mchog gang der nges pa'i don du rigs gsum 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs mgon po nyid/ /gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor la la ngur smṛg gos 'chang ba ste rab byung dge slong gi tshul 'dzin zhing / /la la gos dkar lcang los mdzes ba ste dge bsnyen khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur/ /sprul nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams skyong pa la/ 6 /sa skya pa 'i gdung brgyud zhes grags pa'i snyan pa'i rnga sgra ni/ /phyogs gcig ma yin 'dzam bu gling gi phyogs kun tu gsal/ /dgra bcom chung ngu rgya mtsho'i dbus na dgra bcom chen po rgyal ba ltar/ /byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir mkhas grub kyi skyes bu kun gyi 'gran zla'i dben par gyur/ 7 /gang de'i gdung rigs 'khrungs pa/ dpal ldan chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /se chen rgyal po'i go be la gtsug tu legs bkod de/ /bod kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur lan gsum zhus pa'i dang po la bod khri bskor bcu gsumayul shing sgo 'dzin pa'i bar pa la dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod ko le mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad gyer gling rta'i chol kha ste chol kha gsum/ phyi ma rgya'i ma yul chen mo rnams/ /dam pa chos kyi yon du phul ba nas bzung ste/ 8 /sa ding sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na chen por rlom pa mang yang skya pa yi 'bangs su ma gyur pa'i gang zag su/ zhig yod/

/de rjes 'phags ma sgrol mas lung bstan pa bzhin bdag nyid bzang po dpal bas ches/ /rtsod bral lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rigs tī shrī kun blo sogs yab gcig yum mi gcig pa'i sras dgu la sogs te mang du bskrun pa las/ /rmad byung bstan pa'i rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ 9 /gzhan las phul byung bla brang go bzhir bzhi thog pa/ rin chen sgang pa/ lha khang pa/ dus mchod pa ste/ 'phel/ /de yang dper na rgyu skar khrod na 'od chen po dang ldan pa mang du yod kyang zla ba sa mun pa sel ba la 'gran mi nus paltar/ /bla brang gzhan gsum gyi gdung brgyud ding sang chad nas mi bzhugs kyang / bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du sems can gyi don du gdung rigs rgyun mi chad pa byon pa'i sgo nas/ 'gran gyi do med dus mchod bla brang pa/ /zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i sprul pa'i gdung brgyud mkhas pa dang grub pa'i tshogs/ 10 /dus ding sang gi bar nas bzung ste/ srid mthar rgyun chad med par 'byon par 'gyur ba 'di ngo mtshar gnas/ /de ltar mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i rim par byon pa'i skyes chen thams cad kyis/ /bde skyid kyi rtsa ba sangs rgyas bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar te gong 'phel du spel/ /khyad par 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ 11 /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /yab chos rdo rje phur pa'i lam srol dri ma med pa rnams gyis/ rgyun bstan pa'i me ro te bka' chad la thug pa rmangs te rtsa ba nas slongs bar mdzad de/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas chos kyi sgron me cher gsal ba ra mdzad pa sa/

12 /brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma'i tshogs kyi dbus gtsang ljongs 'dir khyab pas deng sang snyigs ma'i dus kyang / /rgyun chad med ba byung ba 'di 'gro mgon chos rje bla ma dam pa de'i drin las byung / /gzhan yang theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang rgya gar shes bzang mtshan/ 13 /sa skya lo tsā 'jam pa'i rdo rje kun dga' bsod nams rnams/ /rdo rje phur pa'i lam srol 'di la bka' drin che zhes rgyu mtshan mang du thos/ shing mthong la/ /'on kyang yid de'i rjes sogs su bsrub te bdud rigs stobs ldan 'ga' yis rgyus/ /bar skabs zhig tu bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ 14 /bstan dang bstan gdung brgyud 'dzin dgon sde dang gtsug lag khang rnams gnas bcas pa yang / /dus ngan mtshan gyi lhag mar ste med pa nye bar gyur/ /de tshe dus phyis sngags 'chang bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes bya ba'i/ 'di'i sku'i skye ba snga ma rnams su byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po/ gnas brtan kun dga' bo/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta rnams yin par dri ma med pa'i lung gis grub cing / sku'i skye ba 'dir yang / 15 /mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul bsam yas te so so skye bos blos gzhal bar mi nus pa de byon nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis zhi rgyas dbang drag bdud lha gnas sogs dpung tshar bcad de/ /sa skya pa'i/ bstan dang bstan 'dzin gdung rigs bskrun pa sogs dang dgon gnas sa skya sogs gtsug lag khang / /dge 'dun 'du ba'i thub bstan lha chen/ bde chen gling / bsam yas rab byung gi sde sogs mdo sngags bshad grwa sogs/

16 /nyams gso gsar du btsugs pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba brlab po che'i mdzad 'phrin gyis/ /kun bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun rnams kyang dbyar mtsho bzhin te gong nas gong 'phel du rgyas bar/ mdzad nas/ /rgyal rgyu ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa dang 'bras bu/ 'gro ba rnams la bde skyid 'byung ba gnyis/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin kun kyang yar ldan du 'phel pa'i tshul/ 17 /'di 'dra bsam bzhin sngags 'chang bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen de'i/ /bka' drin la gang nas bsams kyang gzhal du med do rjes dang / 'jug rnams/ nged kyi de'i tshul go bar gyis shig /sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang bla ma gang de'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur sogs rnying ma dang bde kyai gsang gsum sogs gsar ma'i tshogs/ spel bar mdzad pa kun gyi nang nas kyang / 18 /yab chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa 'i lam srol 'di/ /smin grol gyis bsdus pa'i lam ston pa dang / de'i cha lag dbyangs rol gar 'cham sogs kyi phyag len la gzhan las nan tan du mdzad pa sogs/ thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas 'phel bar mdzad/ /de lta'i bu bstan pa'i rin po che rgyun bzang mi nub bar skyong ba la/ /'gran gyi do med mkhas pa dang grub pa'i phul/ du phyin pa ste grub mchog bsod nams dbang po dang / 19 /bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched khyad par bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la/ /kho bo cag rang nyid la rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bka' drin che ba'i tshul dran pas slar yang yid gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang / /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs zhi khro rnams dang chos skyong srung ma nor lhar 'i tshogs dang bcas/ pa/

20 /kun gyi spro ba dang bsdu da pa'i byed pa po yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhas grub kun gyi rje 'o/ /skyabs gnas bslu med rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can gang de'i bdag byang chub bar du skyongs shig /de sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams las/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ sdom pa gsum dang chos tshul mdo dang sngags gsar rnying sogs rgya mtsho yi/ 21 /bka' drin thob pa'i shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /chos tshul zab mo/ mang du thos pa can gang des rnam par bshad pa'i tshul 'di sbyar/ /sngon tshe skal bzang dus kyi blo gsal gzhon nu rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams/ /chos dang bla ma bzang po gang na bzhugs kyang 'bad pa chen pos 'tshol bas rtag tu brel/ 22 /deng sang bla ma dag gi zab yangs chos tshul 'di longs zhes/ /lan brgyar smras slob ma rnams kyi khrod nas kyang don gnyer re re tsam/ /de phyir legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos 'di nyid kyang / /bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir du brtsams pa yin mod kyi/ 23 /'on kyang deng sang gi dus kyi skye bo phal cher 'dir snang gi bya ba la rkang btsugs dang / chos la gzhor las su byas nas/ don gnyer byed pa nyung bas na rang nyid lus sems ngal ba tsam zhig las/ /skal ngan rnams bsod nams ma yin pa bsog pa la brtson pa la phan par ma gyur dogs/ /de lta na yang rang nyid bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /goms pa lhur len pa'i phyir dang rang nyid kyi rjes 'jug gi 24 /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad nyin mor byed pa'i ming don dang ldan pa 'di kho bos bshad/

/'di ni lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal ldan rdo rje phur pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pas don grub kyi tshig don rnams rnam par phye ba'i rgyas 'grel rnam bshad te/ 25 /legs par brtags na dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa he ru ka'i/ /sgrub thabs kyi cho ga don rnams yang phal cher rtogs par 'gyur/ /de phyir snga 'gyur rje btsun sa skya'i pa yab chos yang phur rnams/ /don du gnyer ba'i skal bzang dpyod ldan rnams kyi 'di rnam bshad longs shig 16 /deng sang gi dus 'di na chos dang gang zag 'di bzang po 'di ngan pa zhes dang / /'di mkhas pa dang 'di rmongs pa zhes smra shes pa rtags su bkod nas rnam dbye byed pa mang yang / /phal cher rang dang zas nor sogs kyi 'brel ba'i sdig pa'i grogs po phyogs mthun bstod pa las/ /gzur bor gnas pa'i blos chos dang gang zag la bzang ngan mkhas rmongs zhes gnas lugs kyi smra ba brgya la srid pa tsam/ 27 /de phyir mang du thos pa'i nor dang ldan shing rnam dpyod ldan/ /gzur gnas kyi blo can rnams kyis bstan bcos 'di la brtags bya yi/ /phyogs 'dzin can dang nga rgyal can dang na tshod rgan pas bzang por rlom pa sogs chags sdang rmongs gsum la a 'thas can gyis dug chus bslad pa'i blun po rnams/ kho bo la zhe sdang ba'i sgo nas bstan bcos 'di la/ /lan brgyar dmod kyang kho rang tshor snying rje'i yul du gyur pa yin te/ sngon kyang skyes bu dam pa rnams la skyes ngan rnams kyis de ltar byung ba'i tshul mang du bshad pas so/ zad/ 28 /rings nas goms pa'i ste skye ba mang por spyad pa skal bzang las 'phro can/ gyi gang zag /legs bshad 'di nyid kyi don rtogs pa la dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas gcig tu 'dun pa yi/

/blo gsal gyi gdul bya rnams la bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /rnam par bshad pa'i/ chos 'di spel ba phur srung rgya mtsho'i dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal thod pa'i 'phreng ba can dam can bcu gnyis rnams kyis mdzod/ 29 /rdo rje phur pa'i rnam bshad 'di ni sngon byon gong ma yi/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsung rab tshad ldan rnams kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /ring po'i dus ste lo mang po zhig nas shin tu zhib mo'i rnam dpyod kyi blos/ gros kyis/ /legs par btus nas bsgrigs shing brtsams pa yin pa'i phyir nyes pa med snyam sems/ mod/ 30 /'on kyang bdag lta bu so so skye bo'i blo gros mthu chung zhing / /rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams kyang tshig don rgya che zhing zab pas na rtogs par dka' bas/ /gal te rnam bshad bstan bcos 'di la ma rtogs log rtogs sogs nongs pa'i cha mchis na/ /bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong srung mar bcas rnams la/ 31 /bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar slob bu gyur pa yis/ /tshe rabs thog med 'khor ba'i dus nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang lhan cig tu/ /snying nas 'gyod pa chen pos nongs bzhin pas bshags lags na/ /sdig pa'i 'bras bu zhi bar ste 'phral dang yun du sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba mdzad du gsol/ 32 /'di bgyis pa las lus dub cing sems ngal gyur pa'i/ /dge ba 'dis mtshon 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum ste dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs bsags pa gang de'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi gtso byas sems can thams cad dus 'dir tshe ring shing / nad med pa dang / /bsam don kun 'grub ste bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rab tu rgyas pa 'di 'byung dang ldan pa pa dang /

33 /rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis ma lus pa bsam pa bzhin du mthar phyin te/ /tshe la bar chad med pa'i sgo nas/ nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa'i de ma thag bar do'i 'khrul snang med par/ /dpon slob kun kyang dus da nas byang chub bar du phan tshun 'bral ba med par lhan cig tu/ thogs pa med pa'i tshul gyi dag pa'i/ /zhing gi mchog bde ba can du pad+mo las brdzus te skye bar shog 34 /gnas der rgyal ba 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed cing / /rgyal dbang 'od dpag med kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis/ sa lam thams cad skad cig gis bsgrod pa'i spang rtogs kyi yon tan myur du mthar phyin par gyur nas/ sna tshogs pa'i yid du gang la gang 'dul gyi skur sprul nas thog ma med pa nas /pha mar gyur pa'i rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang / /kun kyang ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i tshul gyis rnam par grol ba'i lam la 'god par nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig 35 /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo chen pos bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam pa bshad pa 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par sprul pa rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rten g.yo kun khyab srid zhi'i bdag po chos sku kun tu bzang po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smṛg gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/

sprul pa'i sku spyan mnga' rin po che kun dga' don grub/ rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ grub mchog chos rje dbang phyug rab brtan la sogs te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma la gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bka' drin mnos shing / khyad par rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / spyan mnga' chos kyi spyan ldan/ chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan rnams las/ lugs 'di'i smin grol gyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i skal ba bzang po can/ shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rigs dang chos kyi bu la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan pa'i phyir dang / lhag par nged rang sa skya pa'i pha chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i kun nas blangs te/ thog mar slob dpon pad+ma sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs 'phrin gzhung khungs thug du ma rnams dang / dkyil chog rdo rje las rim/ de'i 'grel pa/ lhag par rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yang phur thun mong ba'i sgrub thabs/ yang des mdzad pa'i las byang gi gzhung / rje btsun rin po che'i phur pa'i tho yig bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas phur pa rang bsgyur du mdzad pa'i rgyud dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rtogs par sla ba sogs dang / bdag chen rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / yang de nyid kyi phur pa lugs srol mang po'i man ngag zab bsdus nyer mkho rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrig par mdzad pa'i yig cha ngo mtshar can/

sa lo tsā ba chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub gsal byed dang / dkyil chog rin chen do shal/ rin chen rtse'i gnyer pa'i dris lan sogs dang / snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub gsal byed kyi mchan bu yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ stod las dang smad las kyi dbang dang rjes gnang gi yig cha/ stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub kyi dris lan sogs dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge chung ngu dang / sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun la sogs te rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i gsung rab khyad par can ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba de rnams kyi dgongs pa gzhir bzhag cing / de dag tu cung zad mi gsal ba rnams slob dpon rnam gsum gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus par grags pa'i 'grel chen 'bum nag dang / de'i snying po bsdus pa'i 'grel pa 'bum chung bcud bsdus zhes bya ba dang / gsang sngags 'dzin pa dpal ldan rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i phur pa sna nam lugs su grags pa'i rmad du byung ba'i bshad 'bum rdo rje don gsal/ slob dpon lang lhag ston pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i bstod 'bum du grags pa'i rnam bshad ngo mtshar can dang / mi nyag bstan pa dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rtsa dum man ngag lugs su bshad pa'i rnam bshad snying po don gsal zhes bya ba'i yig cha khyad par can de nyid sogs mdor na lugs 'di la mkho ba'i gsung rab che phran mang po zhig nas legs bshad kyi cha blangs shing / yang dag pa'i lung dang / chos nyid zab mo'i rig pa dang / /bla ma mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung bgros kyis kyang cung zad gsal bar byas te/

chu bo rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo nyid khog don drug gi sgo nas zhib tu phye ste/ sgrub thabs bklags pas don grub kyi don 'grel rgyas bshad kyi tshul du bkod pa 'di ni rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma 'khon ston rim par byon pa rnams la rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i gsol ba btab cing / dkar mo lcam dral sogs phur srung dam can rgya mtsho la 'khu zlog mi 'byung zhing / snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las bcol nas/ 'phags pa'i yul na k+ṣa yaḥzhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la me pho stag gi lo/ bye pā ṣa zhes pa sa ga zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus kyi gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la/ yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi shar phyogs rje btsun gong ma na rim bzhin gyis byin gyis brlabs shing / lhag par sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan sku mched dang / sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje rnams kyis rgyun ring mo'i bar du gzim chung mdzad pa'i bsti gnas dam par gyur ba dang / khyad par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis rdo rje phur pa'i gsung bsnyen lan mang du mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gros gsal zhing yi ge'i 'du byed la gcig tu yid gzhungs pa shab stod pa bkra shis don grub dang / yi ge'i brda dag kun la rnam dpyod phul du phyin pa smon 'gro ba ngag dbang chos 'phel/ gso rig dang yi ge la mkhas pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen rnams kyis dad gus dang brtson 'grus chen po'i sgo nas bgyis pa 'dis/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa yun ring du mi nub cing gnas pa'i gyur gyur cig

/'dir smras pa/ lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam bshad bstan bcos 'di/ /dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral dang / /dam can bcu gnyis rnams la gnyer du gtad/ /ces rdo rje phur pa'i bka' srung khyad par can rnams la bstan bcos 'di'i gnyer du gsol ba la brten nas/ bstan srung dbang po rnams kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu rtsal gyis 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dharma u da ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig i daṃ sha sa di bstan pa dang na tsa sa twa hi sems can la phan par gyur cig swasti pra dzā bh+yaḥ maṅga laṃ bkra shis/ karma bistā ra bha wa phrin las rgyas par gyur cig tu// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 244 a myes zhabs/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad pad+mo rgyas byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
